qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over het bericht dat aankoopmakelaars de woningmarkt in hun greep hebben

An MP asks whether buyer's agents (aankoopmakelaars) hold the housing market in a grip through opaque fees, early knowledge of listings, refusal of buyers without an agent, and percentage-based commissions. The minister acknowledges opacity, calls for transparency, flags an information advantage the ACM is looking at, finds refusing buyers without an agent undesirable but notes no structural exclusion, and says percentage fees are not prohibited but may create a slight incentive.
I have no insight into the extent to which this happens and what it means for the position of the client in the purchase process.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de mate waarin dit gebeurt en wat dit betekent voor de positie van de klant in het koopproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over het bericht “ABN Amro zegt duizenden klanten de wacht aan”

MP Koolmees asked the Finance Minister about ABN Amro's decision to require about 15,000 private clients living permanently outside Europe to close their accounts, and whether this is desirable, whether regulation can be simplified, what happens to affected clients and whether they can still bank in the Netherlands. The minister answered that banks set their own strategy and risk profile, acknowledged that ABN Amro's decision reflects regulatory complexity and its own strategy, pointed to FATF and ministry guidance, said the NVB knows of no signals that such clients cannot bank elsewhere, but could not guarantee it.
Banks themselves determine their business strategy and the risk profile they desire, and tailor their customer base accordingly.
Banken bepalen zelf hun ondernemingsstrategie en het door hen gewenste risicoprofiel en stemmen hun klantenbestand daar op af.
Antwoord op van de leden Ronnes en Koolmees over het bericht ‘Inkomen niet in Euro’s? Dan geen hypotheek!’

MPs Ronnes and Koolmees asked the Finance Minister whether borrowers with foreign-currency income can no longer get mortgages, and whether an investigation will follow. The minister confirmed signals from the sector, pointed to the EU Mortgage Credit Directive's currency-risk rules, and saw no reason for further investigation since ABN AMRO resumed such lending, though he will raise the issue with the European Commission.
Given the consultation held with the sector and the fact that ABN AMRO again offers mortgage credit in foreign currency, I currently see no reason for further investigation.
Gezien het overleg dat is gevoerd met de sector en het gegeven dat ABN AMRO weer hypothecaire kredieten in vreemde valuta aanbiedt, zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding voor verder onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Koolmees over het bericht ‘Grote steden voelen niks voor bouwen in groene zones’

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Housing and Infrastructure about a report claiming big cities resist building on green zones, and whether the government should steer housing growth towards urban infill. The minister answered that municipalities and provinces hold the regie over housing, that the Ladder for Sustainable Urbanisation guides the choice between inner-city and edge-of-city building, and that further research and a National Environment Vision are forthcoming.
Municipalities and provinces have the lead role in making spatial considerations in urbanisation and housing construction.
Gemeenten en provincies hebben bij verstedelijking en woningbouw de regie bij het maken van ruimtelijke afwegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koolmees en Verhoeven over het bericht “Renovatie Binnenhof officieel geheim”

MPs Koolmees and Verhoeven asked why the Binnenhof renovation was declared secret, bypassing open tender, and how contractors are selected and costs checked. Minister Blok answered that security risks justified secrecy, pointed to precedents, and said selection criteria and price checks apply despite limited competition.
I decided to deviate from the usual procedures in order to limit risks to the security situation of the Binnenhof complex and its users.
Ik heb besloten af te wijken van de gebruikelijke procedures om risico’s voor de veiligheidssituatie van het Binnenhofcomplex en zijn gebruikers te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koolmees en Kerstens over de uitspraak van de Raad van State dat Haagse subsidieregels die topsalarissen verbieden in strijd zijn met de wet

MPs Koolmees and Kerstens asked the Minister of the Interior how he responds to the Council of State ruling that The Hague's subsidy rules banning top salaries violate the General Administrative Law Act, and whether he will amend the law. The minister says the ruling limits subsidy conditions to the purpose of the subsidy, that the Awb already allows conditions on top incomes, and that a legal basis for municipal salary caps would not resolve municipalities' objections because the WNT transitional rules would still apply.
Therefore the objections of municipalities cannot be met by creating a legal basis for top income caps by local governments in any law.
Er kan dus niet aan de bezwaren van gemeenten tegemoet worden gekomen door in enige wet een wettelijke basis te creëren voor topinkomensnormering door decentrale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Koolmees over het bericht dat de pachttermijn van zes jaar voor landbouwgrond te kort is

MPs Koşer Kaya and Koolmees asked about reports that six-year farm lease terms are too short to protect soil fertility in Flevoland and elsewhere, and about lease prices, farm incomes, Rijksvastgoedbedrijf practices and possible lease discounts for sustainable soil management. The State Secretary answered that the government is aware of the soil concerns, describes the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf's soil-quality checks and building plans, provides lease price and income data, and declines to introduce a lease discount while exploring a broader review of the lease system.
I am not prepared to introduce a lease discount.
Ik ben niet bereid een pachtkorting te introduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over het bericht ‘100% veilige bank’ sneuvelt op depositogarantiestelsel

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a proposed 'fully safe' bank (Depositobank) and whether DNB can exempt banks from the deposit guarantee scheme and set near-zero contributions for low-risk banks. The minister answered that no bank is fully safe, that participation is mandatory under EU law with no DNB discretion to exclude, and that risk-based contributions are proportionate, while agreeing to examine the scheme as an entry barrier.
No. As indicated in answer 2, even with a very low credit risk, risks remain for depositors.
Nee. Zoals aangegeven bij vraag 2 blijven er, ook indien sprake is van een zeer laag kredietrisico, voor depositohouders risico’s bestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir, Jacobi, Albert de Vries, Koolmees, Ronnes en Van der Linde over aankoop van Dekemahiem door Vereniging Doarpskorporaasje Jirnsum

MPs asked the minister whether housing corporation Elkien's plan to demolish 24 affordable homes for elderly and starters in Jirnsum without rebuilding, and the sale to a village cooperative, required an Inspectorate review and a residual valuation, and why the process took so long. The minister answered that local housing policy is for the municipality, that sales to third parties need the regulator's consent at no less than market value, that the residual valuation request was refused, that the earlier rules applied, and that the 12-week decision period was not exceeded.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koolmees, Omtzigt en Bashir over de informatie over de bonus van de voorzitter van de Raad van Bestuur van NS

MPs Koolmees, Omtzigt and Bashir asked the Finance Minister whether NS had emailed the ministry in April 2015 that its board received a 17.5% bonus, and why the ministry only checked the status of the bonuses on 17 June. Minister Dijsselbloem confirmed the April email, said agreement on the CEO bonus existed but payment could not occur until the CFO salary compensation was agreed on 30 May, and pointed to previously public documents for the communication request.
It is correct that NS sent an email on 14 April about a possible communication line on the variable pay awarded to NS's statutory board.
Het klopt dat NS op 14 april een e-mail heeft gestuurd over een eventuele communicatielijn over de toegekende variabele beloning van de statutaire directie van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes c.s. over de inhoud van de prospectus voor beursgang ABN AMRO

MPs from several parties asked the Finance Minister whether the ABN AMRO prospectus for its stock market listing shows share-linked bonuses that conflict with earlier assurances and the Merkies/Nijboer amendment, and about conflicts of interest of two board members. The minister answered that identified staff may receive variable pay in non-cash form, that the top 7 board members and 25 senior managers are barred from variable pay while the state holds a stake, that the amendment is complied with, and that the bonus decisions rest with ABN AMRO itself.
ABN AMRO as a company itself bears responsibility for drawing up a variable pay scheme within the legal framework.
ABN AMRO heeft als vennootschap zelf de verantwoordelijkheid om binnen het wettelijke kader een variabele beloningsregeling op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Neppérus en Koolmees over dubbele belasting voor Nederlanders met de Amerikaanse nationaliteit

MPs Omtzigt, Neppérus and Koolmees asked the State Secretary of Finance about double taxation of Dutch citizens who also hold US nationality, covering US taxation of foreign benefits, home sale gains, BV loans, investment restrictions and IRS penalties. The State Secretary answered that the US applies nationality-based taxation under the 1992 treaty, that no concrete cases of double taxation are known, that no treaty renegotiation or OECD agenda item is planned, and that the US sets its own penalty regime.
I have no concrete signals that there is suddenly double taxation.
Ik heb geen concrete signalen dat er nu opeens sprake zou zijn van dubbele belastingheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over beweerdelijk belemmeren van financiële start-ups door de Autoriteit Financiële Markten

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the AFM caps start-up financial firms at six staff, on what legal basis and rationale, and whether it will reconsider such limits to allow faster growth and competition. The minister denied any formal cap, explained that a relaxed suitability test applies to firms of up to six persons, and said growth is not blocked and the AFM will keep the balance with competition in view.
No, the Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM) of course does not set a minimum or maximum requirement on the size of a start-up firm.
Nee, de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) stelt uiteraard geen minimum- of maximumeis aan de omvang van een startende onderneming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Koolmees over rentemiddeling waardoor hypotheekbezitters kunnen profiteren van een lagere hypotheekrente

MPs Nijboer and Koolmees asked whether banks should offer 'rentemiddeling' (averaging a fixed mortgage rate with market rates to spread the early-repayment penalty) so homeowners can benefit from lower rates, and whether the penalty calculation can be made transparent. The minister said six banks offer it, that it depends on individual circumstances, that he will ask the sector by letter to offer it, and that the penalty calculation will be further regulated under the Mortgage Credit Directive in 2016.
I will ask the sector, by letter, to offer rentemiddeling as an option, whereby in individual situations it must be considered whether rentemiddeling is in the customer's interest.
Ik zal de sector, middels een brief, verzoeken om rentemiddeling als optie aan te bieden, waarbij in individuele situaties moet worden bezien of rentemiddeling in het belang is van de klant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over banken die dienstverlening weigeren aan coffeeshops

MP Koolmees asked the Finance Minister whether banks still refuse payment services to coffeeshops without clear reasons, whether banks have adjusted their acceptance policies, and whether the minister will again negotiate with the Dutch Banking Association (NVB). The minister answered that banks assess each application individually, that the 2010 agreement with the NVB was reconfirmed, and that the NVB will publish information on the complaints procedure.
The NVB has reconfirmed the agreements made in 2010.
De NVB heeft de afspraken zoals gemaakt in 2010 zijn nogmaals herbevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Koolmees over het bericht ‘Afvalgigant kaalgeplukt’

MPs Van Veldhoven and Koolmees asked whether Attero's sale to Waterland drained 183 million euro, including 87 million earmarked for pre-aftercare, and whether closed landfills stay safely financed and provinces accept the cut. The Staatssecretaris confirms the 183 million figure from Waterland's statement, says prior provincial consent was not needed and was not sought, and says legal aftercare and capping guarantees are unchanged while Attero must report to the competent authority.
No prior consultation took place with the provinces of Drenthe, Limburg and Noord-Brabant on this matter.
Met de provincies Drenthe, Limburg en Noord-Brabant heeft hierover vooraf geen overleg plaats gehad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over diverse berichten over bedreigingen voor crowdfunding

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports of a proposed EU VAT burden on crowdfunding and a DNB ban on Kredietbank Nederland raising funds via crowdfunding. The minister said no such Commission proposal is known, only a VAT committee paper with no binding guidance, and that the ban applies under the Wft as Kredietbank lacks a bank licence, with a review of a possible exemption promised for Q4.
As previously promised, I will inform your House in the fourth quarter in more detail on this point, among others.
Zoals eerder toegezegd, zal ik uw Kamer in het vierde kwartaal nader informeren over onder meer dit punt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Koolmees over het bericht ‘Brussel ligt dwars bij nieuw instituut voor hypotheken’

MPs Verhoeven and Koolmees asked the Ministers of Housing and of Finance about reports that Brussels opposes the planned Dutch mortgage institute (NHI), including the state-aid and debt-classification issues, the difference from the existing NHG guarantee, and the added value of the NHI in current market conditions. The minister answered that talks with the European Commission and Eurostat are not concluded, that state-aid and classification outcomes are still open, that the NHI's added value lies mainly in stress periods and transparency, and that no signals of waning investor interest were received.

Naturally, I aim to have sufficient clarity and assurance as soon as possible on whether the preconditions can be met so that the NHI does not lead to state aid and is not classified in the government sector.
Vanzelfsprekend streef ik ernaar zo spoedig mogelijk voldoende duidelijkheid en comfort te hebben of aan de randvoorwaarden kan worden voldaan dat de NHI niet leidt tot staatssteun

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Berndsen-Jansen, Van Weyenberg en Koolmees over het bericht dat een farmaceutisch bedrijf dat zich onlangs in Nederland heeft gevestigd, doodstraf-medicatie levert aan de Amerik

MPs from D66 asked whether Dutch-based pharmaceutical company Mylan supplies the muscle relaxant rocuronium bromide for US executions, whether this conflicts with the EU export ban and Dutch policy against the death penalty, whether pension funds should keep investing, whether tax rulings were involved, and whether Mylan will stop. The government neither confirmed nor denied the supply, said the EU export regulation does not cover the drug, pledged to propose adding it to the list and to raise the matter with Mylan, and declined to disclose tax ruling details citing confidentiality law.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act does not permit disclosing information about the tax position of an individual taxpayer, such as Mylan in this case.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen staat niet toe informatie bekend te maken over de belastingpositie van een individuele belastingplichtige, zoals in het onderhavige geval Mylan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Neppérus en Koolmees over de fiscale behandeling van uitkeringen uit het Artikel 2-fonds aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën

MPs Neppérus and Koolmees asked how Artikel 2-fonds payments from Germany are taxed and whether they count toward income-dependent allowances, and whether this can be changed. Secretary Wiebes answered that the payments count as taxable income and thus reduce allowances, that excluding them would be principled wrong and set a precedent for other benefits, but he will ask the Landsadvocaat to study the option and report back.
I will inform the House of the outcome of this study and my findings arising from it.
Over de uitkomst van dit onderzoek en mijn bevindingen naar aanleiding daarvan zal ik Uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Bergkamp en Koolmees over Verklaring arbeidsrelatie (VAR) voor zzp’ers

MPs from D66 asked the government how the Tax Authority can grant and then withdraw VAR-WUO declarations for care freelancers working through agencies, and how many were reviewed and reclassified. The minister explained that VARs are assessed on submitted facts, that roughly 900 of about 1,500 reviewed cases were reclassified as employment, and that the pilot was extended to address the problem.
The cabinet will shortly start an interdepartmental policy study on freelancers to examine whether laws and regulations for freelancers and employees are sufficiently in balance.

Het kabinet zal op korte termijn een Interdepartementaal Beleidsonderzoek (IBO) starten met betrekking tot zzp'ers om te bezien of wet- en regelgeving voor zzp'ers en werknemers voldoende in balans zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koolmees en Schouw over de lastenstijging bij provincies

MPs Koolmees and Schouw asked the State Secretary of Finance about a reported rise in provincial tax revenue from opcenten on motor vehicle tax, how much of it stems from national policy, when provinces were informed of the change, and whether provinces should be compensated through a rate cut. The State Secretary said the volume effect is not solely due to national policy, that provinces were informed on Prinsjesdag with prior consultation, and rejected a compensation arrangement since provinces set their own rates within statutory maxima.
That effect is also determined by how provinces estimate the development of the vehicle fleet in their own province (number, type and weight).
Dat effect wordt ook bepaald door hoe provincies de ontwikkeling van het wagenpark in de eigen provincie inschatten (aantal, soort en gewicht).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Koolmees over de conclusie van de Europese Rekenkamer dat de door de lidstaten verrichte verificaties van de EU-landbouwuitgaven niet betrouwbaar zijn

MPs Schouw and Koolmees asked the Finance Minister about the European Court of Auditors' finding that member states' verification of EU agricultural spending is unreliable, and whether the Commission's error rates given to Parliament are flawed. The minister acknowledged the criticism, said the verification gap has been legally remedied from 2015, and stated the Netherlands relies mainly on the Court's own figures rather than Commission statistics.
I am therefore pleased that the European Court of Auditors has devoted a specific audit to this subject regarding the Common Agricultural Policy.
Ik ben daarom verheugd dat de Europese Rekenkamer voor wat betreft het Gemeenschappelijke Landbouwbeleid een specifiek onderzoek heeft gewijd aan dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Bergkamp en Koolmees over VAR-verklaringen voor zzp’ers

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers about the Belastingdienst's handling of VAR declarations for self-employed workers (zzp'ers), including reports of fewer VAR-WUO grants in healthcare and revocations for 250 people tied to care intermediaries. The government replied that the criteria have not changed, that enforcement against false self-employment has increased, and that a planned joint-liability rule for clients and an online VAR module are under development.
The statutory confidentiality obligation means that no statements can be made about individual cases.
De in de wet verankerde geheimhoudingsverplichting maakt dat over individuele gevallen geen mededelingen kunnen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over het provisieverbod en kosten voor preventief advies bij dreigende betalingsachterstanden

Koolmees (D66) asked the Finance Minister whether banks and intermediaries may charge advisory fees for preventive advice to clients facing payment arrears on their mortgages, and whether a legal basis exists for such fees. The minister answered that under the advice-fee rules fees generally need not be charged for servicing talks with existing clients about foreseeable arrears, since these aim at a payment arrangement rather than a new contract, and that the AFM has published guidance on this.
Banks do not need to charge advisory costs to the client for such servicing talks because the talks are not aimed at concluding a (new) agreement.
Banken hoeven voor dergelijke beheergesprekken geen advieskosten in rekening te brengen bij de klant omdat de gesprekken niet gericht zijn op het tot stand brengen van een (nieuwe) overeenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over banken die geen producten verkopen na onafhankelijk advies

An MP asked whether banks that only sell their products to clients who also take an advice meeting with them, and whether consumers with independent advice can buy at any bank without extra advice costs, and what options exist for market improvement. The Minister answered that consumers are free to choose where to get advice, that banks must charge advice costs directly, that double payment can be disproportionate, and that the AFM will talk with market parties while the government monitors the market after the commission ban.
Consumers are free to decide where they want to obtain advice, just as providers are free to organise the distribution of a financial product within the applicable legal framework.

Het staat de consument vrij om te besluiten waar hij een advies wil afnemen, net als het aanbieders vrij staat om – binnen de daarvoor geldende wettelijke kaders – de distributie van een financieel product in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over het niet afbouwen van staatssteun aan ING

MP Koolmees asks the Finance Minister about the Alt-A mortgage portfolio guaranteed for ING, whether it is above break-even, whether it will be sold, and the costs and proceeds to the state. The minister states the portfolio's market value exceeds the remaining obligation to ING, refers to a separate letter for the sale question, and gives a cost overview with expected net gain of about EUR 800 million.
For the answer to these questions I refer you to the letter to the House on winding down state support for ING that I sent on 1 November.
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik u naar de kamerbrief «afbouw staatssteun ING» die ik op 1 november aan de Tweede Kamer heb verstuurd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Koolmees over het bericht dat financiële data-analyse nauwelijks terreur voorkomt

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice minister about a report that financial data analysis rarely prevents terrorism, covering SWIFT data, AML/CFT rules, bank costs, retention and possible suspension of the EU-US TFTP agreement. The minister partly agreed with the report, said results are hard to quantify and often confidential, gave no case counts or false-positive figures, and saw no reason to suspend the TFTP agreement or change the EU AML directive position.
Given the highly confidential nature of this type of matter, I cannot rule out that the results will also have to remain partly confidential.
Gezien de zeer vertrouwelijke aard van dit type zaken, kan ik overigens niet uitsluiten dat de resultaten eveneens deels vertrouwelijk zullen moeten blijven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Koolmees over het bericht dat de servers van de Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) mogelijk zijn afgetapt door de NSA

MPs Schouw and Koolmees asked ministers whether the NSA tapped SWIFT servers, including any server in the Netherlands, and what the government would do about it, including the EU-US TFTP programme. The government said it cannot confirm the report, SWIFT found no evidence of unauthorised access, the Commission has asked US authorities for clarification, and it sees no reason to suspend the TFTP agreement for now.
However, I cannot confirm the accuracy of that report.
Ik kan de juistheid van dat bericht echter niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koolmees en Berndsen-Jansen over de kosten van het softdrugsbeleid van de financiële effecten van het reguleren van softdrugs

MPs Koolmees and Berndsen-Jansen (D66) asked about enforcement costs of soft drug policy, the Taskforce B5 results and costs, coffeeshop turnover and tax revenue, and the financial effects of regulating soft drugs. The government answered that enforcement capacity is not earmarked, the Taskforce B5 cost about 1.99 million euro, and that tax data on coffeeshops are not available per branch, while stating that regulation would not reduce enforcement costs.
Whereas the current cabinet is doing everything it can to turn the tide and tackle crime, nuisance and drug tourism hard.
Dit terwijl het huidige kabinet er juist alles aan doet om het tij te keren en criminaliteit, overlast en drugstoerisme hard aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Koolmees over de ongewogen kapitaalratio

MPs Nijboer and Koolmees asked the Finance Minister about risk-weighted capital ratios, the non-risk-weighted leverage ratio, and related Basel III and CRD IV timing and accounting issues. The minister answered that internal models allow useful flexibility but create variation and risks, that the EU and Basel are studying the variation, that the leverage ratio should complement risk-weighted requirements, and that a binding minimum will come later (2018).

For this reason, both the European Banking Authority (EBA) and the Basel Committee have for some time been researching the causes of differences in RWA and policy options to limit undesirable differences.

Daarom doen zowel de Europese Bankenautoriteit (EBA) als het Bazels Comité op dit moment al enige tijd onderzoek naar de oorzaken van verschillen in RWA en beleidsopties om ongewenste verschillen te beperken.
Antwoord vragen Schouw en Koolmees over het bericht ‘Banken verkopen pingedrag klanten’

MPs Schouw and Koolmees asked the state secretary about reports that banks and Equens planned to sell customers' PIN-transaction data, and whether this violates the Dutch data protection act (Wbp). The government answered that Equens has suspended the plans, that whether the data are personal data and whether the Wbp is breached is for the independent data protection authority (CBP) to judge, and that the CBP sees no reason to open an investigation for now.
It is not for us to pronounce on whether the data concern personal data and whether this is compatible with the Wbp.
Het past ons niet een uitspraak te doen over de vragen of de gegevens persoonsgegevens betreffen en of sprake is van verenigbaarheid met de Wbp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koolmees over het ontduiken van wetgeving door accountants

An MP asked the Finance Minister about roughly fifty dubious contracts accountants concluded at the end of 2012 that the AFM said circumvent the new separation of audit and advisory work, and what the government would do. The minister answered that the transition period was not meant for new long-term advisory contracts, that the AFM has asked the Big 4 firms to reassess them and most have withdrawn or limited them, and that the sector must change its behaviour.
The AFM urgently called on the firms to reassess all contracts concluded just before 1 January 2013 and to end or limit those not in line with the legislator's intention.

De AFM heeft een dringend beroep gedaan op de kantoren om alle vlak voor 1 januari 2013 afgesloten contracten te (her)beoordelen en die contracten die niet in overeenstemming zijn met de bedoeling van de wetgever te beëindigen of te beperken.
Antwoord vragen Koolmees en Bergkamp over een tax shelter voor de filmindustrie

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about introducing a tax shelter for the Dutch film industry, its prevalence in the EU, its design, and its effects on competitiveness and Dutch post-production firms. The government answered that it does not intend to introduce a tax shelter because it conflicts with its simplification agenda, and gave limited figures on foreign spending and bankruptcies while saying the effects on public finances are unknown.
The cabinet therefore does not intend to introduce a tax shelter for the Dutch film industry.
Het kabinet is daarom niet voornemens een tax shelter voor de Nederlandse filmindustrie te introduceren.

Vragen van de leden Hachchi en Koolmees (beiden D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de gevolgen van nieuwe belastingregels op de economie van Saba

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about the effects of the new tax regime (ABB, flat tax, excise duties) on the economy of Saba and Sint Eustatius, including tax burden, prices, transport costs, Sint Maarten transit, and budget effects. The state secretary answered that the overall tax burden stayed roughly constant with a shift from direct to indirect taxes, that most households gained net income, and that no separate figures exist for several effects, while committing to talks with Sint Maarten on exemption of transit goods.
There are no figures known on the effect of the ABB on the government budget on Saba and Sint Eustatius.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over het effect van de ABB op het overheidsbudget op Saba en Sint Eustatius.
Antwoord vragen Schouw en Koolmees over het doorgeven van van Europese data aan de Verenigde Staten

MPs Schouw and Koolmees asked about the Netherlands joining a US-G5 government-to-government approach to FATCA, its data-protection implications for EU data sent to US authorities, and what the government would do about it. The state secretary answered that the joint statement is a non-binding intention, that the Commission is studying the data-protection issues, that no Dutch cases of forced US data disclosure are known, and that the matter is for the Commission and member states to resolve.
The Netherlands has declared its willingness to join the statement of intent for this government-to-government approach.
Nederland heeft zich bereid verklaard om aan te sluiten bij de intentieverklaring voor deze »government to government approach».
Antwoord vragen Koolmees en Verhoeven over het voorstel tot een ‘Slim Reisbudget’ vanuit 50 grote werkgevers

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the B50 proposals for a 'Smart Travel Budget' (Persoonlijk Mobiliteitsbudget and Bonus Malus Leasebudget), including whether the government would assess them, how they relate to the Autobrief tax study, and the expected effects on traffic and emissions. The State Secretary responded positively in principle, promised to test budget neutrality and administrative costs and to report on the proposals before the summer recess, while stating that effects depend on how employers and employees implement them.
I previously committed to sending the results of that study to your House before the summer recess.
Ik heb eerder toegezegd de resultaten van dat onderzoek voor het zomerreces aan uw Kamer te zullen toezenden.
Vragen van de leden Groot, Monasch (beiden PvdA) en Koolmees (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Financien over de fiscale behandeling van transformatie van kantoorpanden (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

MPs Groot, Monasch and Koolmees asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax obstacles to converting office buildings into housing, including double VAT, the transfer-tax exemption period and WOZ valuation. The State Secretary rejected changes to VAT integration levy, transfer tax and other fiscal incentives, citing budgetary, EU and simplicity considerations, and gave no commitment to action.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daar ben ik niet toe bereid.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Neppérus (VVD), Van Vliet (PVV), Koolmees (D66), Braakhuis (GroenLinks) en Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het rechtstreeks overmaken van kinderopvang

Six MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary of Finance whether childcare allowance should be paid directly to childcare providers to prevent parental arrears, and whether a system with certified payee parties would be designed with stakeholders. The State Secretary said government should in principle not intervene, that a single bank account per taxpayer is planned with an exception for childcare centres under strict conditions, and that the Minister of Social Affairs will consult the sector and report to parliament.

As I indicated at the legislative consultation of 7 November regarding the Tax Package 2012, I will include an exception for childcare centres to the mandatory use of a single bank account via an amendment.

Zoals ik in het wetgevingsoverleg van 7 november jl. over het Belastingpakket 2012 heb aangegeven, zal ik bij nota van wijziging voor kindercentra een uitzondering op het verplicht gebruik van één rekeningnummer opnemen.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink (VVD), Vermeij (PvdA), Ulenbelt (SP), Klaver (Groenlinks), Koolmees (D66), Schouten (ChristenUnie), Dijkgraaf (SGP), Van den Besselaar (PVV) en Thieme (Partij

Ten MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs about a reported 450 million euro fee paid by pension funds (PME and another fund) to Mn Services for asset management, and about transparency and remedies for members. The minister said the fee passage in the court ruling contained a typo, that supervisors alone may request such information and are bound by confidentiality, that members can raise concerns with the accountability body and as a last resort the Ondernemingskamer, and that a cost-reporting guideline is due in November 2011.
The Pension Act provides that only the supervisors, DNB and AFM, have the authority to request information from pension funds.
In de Pensioenwet is bepaald dat alleen de toezichthouders, DNB en AFM, de bevoegdheid hebben om informatie op te vragen bij pensioenfondsen.

Vragen van de leden Schouw en Koolmees (beiden D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over lastenverzwaring via sluiproute (ingezonden 28 ap

D66 MPs asked whether shifting dike and dune investment costs to water boards (reaching EUR 200 million by 2015) would raise local water-board taxes, and whether such cost increases are acceptable. The state secretary answered that the costs will be funded partly through water-board levies, that efficiency savings are intended to keep increases moderate, and that the costs will be monitored and reported under the Bestuursakkoord Water.
The Bestuursakkoord Water further agrees to closely monitor and report on local charges and the savings achieved.
In het Bestuursakkoord Water is verder afgesproken om de lokale lasten en de behaalde besparingen nauwgezet te monitoren en te rapporteren.
Vragen van de leden Dijkstra en Koolmees (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Financiën over opnieuw een tegenvaller in de zorg (ingezonden 5 april 2011).

MPs Dijkstra and Koolmees asked the health and finance ministers about a reported extra overspend in healthcare in 2010 and its causes, whether it is structural, and whether enough is being done to curb rising costs. The minister denied an additional EUR 1 billion overspend, put the total budget overrun at EUR 1.4 billion with components specified, promised fuller figures in the annual report and spring memorandum, and defended the policy of containing growth through efficiency measures and shifting costs to individuals.
With the Annual Report, which your House receives on the third Wednesday of May, the latest insights will be shared.
Met het Jaarverslag, dat uw Kamer op de derde woensdag van mei ontvangt, worden de laatste inzichten gedeeld.

Vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Koolmees (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de plannen van de Europese Commissie om brandstofheffingen sterker aan energie-inhoud te koppelen (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

MPs Van Veldhoven and Koolmees asked the State Secretary of Finance about reported EU Commission plans to link fuel taxes more closely to energy content, including effects on climate goals, diesel use, air quality and the Mannheim inland shipping excise exemptions. The government answered that it has discussed the Green Paper with the Commission, will assess the effects only once a formal proposal exists, has a CE Delft/Ecofys study underway, and will discuss shipping and vehicle excise issues within the Energy Taxation Directive and Transport White Paper talks.
Should the European Commission submit a proposal, the First and Second Chamber will be informed of it through the so-called BNC fiche, along with the cabinet's initial position.

Mocht de Europese Commissie een voorstel indienen, dan zullen de Eerste en Tweede Kamer door middel van het zogenoemde BNC-fiche op de hoogte worden gebracht van dit voorstel en de eerste positie van het kabinet ter zake.

Vragen van de leden Koolmees en Schouw (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de doorgifte van financiële data van Europese burgers aan de Verenigde Staten (ingezonden 22 maart 201

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Justice whether bilateral transfer of financial data to the United States is still possible under the EU-US TFTP Agreement, and whether any such transfer has occurred since the agreement took effect. The minister answered that bilateral SWIFT data transfer is not possible under the agreement and that no bilateral transfer has taken place between the Netherlands and the United States.
No bilateral transfer of SWIFT data has taken place between the Netherlands and the United States.
Er heeft geen bilaterale doorgifte van SWIFT-data plaatsgevonden tussen Nederland en de Verenigde Staten.
Vragen van de leden Koolmees (D66) en Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over de bankiersverklaring (ingezonden 24 januari 2011).

MPs Koolmees and Braakhuis asked whether the banker's oath is a token gesture, why DNB did not take a coordinating role, and whether it should be formalised and enforced as a condition for approval of bank directors. The minister acknowledged the oath's importance, noted it is embedded in the legally anchored Code Banken, and committed to consulting the NVB, DNB and AFM on giving it a more formal status, including possible linkage to DNB suitability checks.
In light of this, I will consult with the Dutch Banking Association, DNB and the AFM on giving the moral-ethical declaration a more formal status.

Mede gelet hierop zal ik met de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken (hierna: de NVB), DNB en de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (hierna: de AFM) in overleg treden over een meer formele status van de moreel-ethische verklaring.
Vragen van het lid Koolmees (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over aftrekbaarheid van boetes (ingezonden 17 januari 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance whether it is right that taxpayers partly fund settlements and which fines are tax-deductible, after press reports on the Klimop property fraud case and a Supreme Court ruling on NMa fines. The government answered that fines are not deductible under the income and corporate tax acts, while confiscation of unlawful gains and damages are computed under normal profit rules so taxpayers do not contribute to those parts of transactions.
An amount paid as a fine is not deductible.
Een bedrag dat wordt betaald als boete is niet aftrekbaar.

Vragen van de leden Koolmees en Van der Ham (beiden D66) aan de minister van Financiën en de staatsecretaris voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de financiële gevolgen van de BTW-verhoging op kunst voor alternatie

MPs Koolmees and Van der Ham asked whether art dealers importing art via the UK to avoid the 2011 VAT increase is legal, and about the revenue loss and competitiveness effects. The government answered that such imports are legal if genuine transactions, that no evasion was factored into revenue estimates, and that the revenue loss cannot yet be quantified, while giving illustrative examples and an EU rate overview.
If supervision by the Tax Authority shows that sham constructions are being used to avoid VAT on imports that actually take place in the Netherlands, these constructions will be tackled.

Indien in het toezicht door de Belastingdienst blijkt dat sprake is van schijnconstructies met het doel te voorkomen dat btw wordt geheven over de invoer die feitelijk in Nederland plaatsvindt, zullen deze constructies worden aangepakt.

Vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Koolmees (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Financiën over de hoge hypotheekmarges in Nederland (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

Two MPs from D66 asked the economics and finance ministers about high mortgage margins in the Netherlands, prompted by an NMa quick scan, asking about the cause, the timing of the full study, possible price-fixing, transparency and fiscal treatment. The minister answered that margins are high historically and relative to other countries, that the NMa's second study will examine causes, that no suspicion of price agreements exists, and that the finance minister will consult market parties on transparency.
As I answered to your earlier questions, the NMa will in the second part of its study of the Dutch mortgage market examine in depth the competitive conditions and their developments.

Zoals ik op eerdere van uw vragen heb geantwoord, zal de NMa in het tweede deel van haar onderzoek naar de Nederlandse hypotheekmarkt diepgaand ingaan op de concurrentieomstandigheden en de ontwikkelingen daarvan.
Vragen van het lid Koolmees (D66) aan de minister van Financiën over de kwartaalcijfers Nationale Hypotheek Garantie (ingezonden 11 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the Finance Minister about NHG mortgage guarantee quarterly figures, including the share of homes covered, the rise in loss claims, and the state's risk exposure. The minister answered that about 80% of purchases under the €350,000 limit use NHG, that the guarantee fund buffer and premiums cover the claims, and that no state budget provision is needed.
An investigation into the effectiveness of the crisis measures is currently underway.
Op dit moment loopt een onderzoek naar de effectiviteit van de crisismaatregelen.

Vragen van de leden Koolmees en Verhoeven (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Financiën en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over de effectiviteit van besteding van belastinggeld door btw-verlaging in de bouw (ingezonden 10

D66 MPs asked whether the temporary VAT reduction on labour costs in construction (renovation and repair of homes) is an effective and efficient use of tax money, citing differing impact estimates from ABN AMRO and Bouwend Nederland, and asked when the evaluation of housing-market measures would be available. The minister acknowledged the estimates, argued the measure is a targeted temporary stimulus that the industry committed to pass on to consumers, said the effects can only be judged after the measure ends, and stated that the EIB evaluation will be sent to parliament in 2011.
In the course of 2011 the final report will be sent to the House of Representatives.
In de loop van 2011 zal de eindrapportage naar de Tweede Kamer worden gestuurd.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering minimum wage, childcare subsidy, rent allowance, the AOW gap, child poverty targets, institutional racism and the Rainbow Accord. The government answered most questions substantively but deferred many details (funding, targets, the Rainbow Accord) to later elaboration by the cabinet.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a cabinet decision. You will be informed about this during the further elaboration.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover bij de nadere uitwerking geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht ‘‘Gratis geld, en nog laat KLM haar flexwerkers spartelen’’

MP Palland (CDA) asked the minister about reports that KLM dismissed flexible workers during COVID-19 without adequate severance or reemployment support, and about the EGF subsidy application that covered only permanent staff. The government answered that it lacks full data, provided the EGF application, explained the EGF eligibility rules and their change, and said the responsibility for school-to-work transitions lies with employer and employee.
It is not possible for me to provide all the requested information, because I do not have it.
Het is voor mij niet mogelijk om alle gevraagde informatie te verstrekken, omdat ik daarover niet beschik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de compensatie van de eigen bijdrage voor kinderopvang vanwege de sluiting door Corona

An SP MP asked whether all parents using childcare, with or without childcare allowance, were compensated for their own contribution during the Covid closures, and whether parents not receiving childcare allowance for certain hours were compensated. The Staatssecretaris explained that parents with allowance received a SVB compensation based on allowance data, that some parents received substantially less, and that the government will revise the scheme and not appeal court rulings.
The State Secretary for Finance – Tax and Customs Administration and I have decided to revise the compensation scheme and not to appeal the court rulings mentioned above.

De Staatssecretaris van Financiën – Toeslagen en Douane en ik hebben besloten om de tegemoetkomingsregeling te herzien en voorts om geen hoger beroep in te stellen tegen de hierboven bedoelde rechterlijke uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de afwikkeling van de compensatie van gedupeerden in het Toeslagenschandaal

An SP MP asked whether the secretaries-general of two ministries prepared a memo on the compensation of victims of the childcare benefits scandal, its status, and whether it could be sent to parliament. The government answered that no such memo could be found, but that related emails on interdepartmental capacity for the restoration agency were located, and it offered to search further if the MP specifies the expected content.
Based on the information in your questions, we have not been able to find such a memo.
Op basis van de informatie in uw vragen hebben wij een dergelijke notitie niet kunnen vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over misstanden in de pakketbezorging

An MP asked the government about misconduct in parcel delivery, including high complaint volumes, pressure on couriers, subcontracting, enforcement by the labour inspectorate and ACM, and whether directors could be held liable. The state secretary largely defended the market and existing rules, pointed to ongoing inspection and evaluation work, and committed to an evaluation and further information without accepting new sector-specific measures.
It is important that work is carried out in line with the legal framework within which the employment contract falls.
Het is van belang dat conform het wettelijk kader wordt gewerkt waarbinnen de arbeidsovereenkomst valt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Baarle over het bericht dat volgens de rechter Uber chauffeurs in dienst moet nemen

An MP asked the government how it views the court ruling that Uber must employ its drivers, including whether it constitutes modern employer authority, whether specific regulation against false self-employment on platforms is needed, whether the ruling is immediately enforceable, and the status of the taxi sector review and COVID support. The government answered that it cannot judge court rulings, that clarification of employment relationships is needed and is a task for a new cabinet, that it is studying a legal presumption of employer status for platform work, that the ruling is enforceable pending appeal, and that the taxi sector evaluation and a study on drivers' finances will report in 2022.
The cabinet is therefore examining, for a future cabinet, whether and how a legal presumption for platform work could strengthen the position of platform workers in practice.
Het kabinet onderzoekt daarom, ten behoeve van een toekomstig kabinet, of en hoe een rechtsvermoeden bij platformwerk, de positie van platformwerkers in de praktijk kan versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar, Brekelmans en El Yassini over het bericht 'FBI raids ZPMC delivery vessel'

MPs Valstar, Brekelmans and El Yassini (VVD) asked about reports of FBI raids on ZPMC (a Chinese state-owned shipbuilder) over suspected espionage, whether Dutch authorities had contact with US and Chinese authorities, how work-residence permits via recognised sponsor status are vetted for firms from China, Russia and Iran, and whether that status should be reconsidered. The State Secretary declined to comment on intelligence knowledge or diplomatic contacts, said fewer than five work permits were issued to ZPMC Netherlands staff since 2015 with none revoked, described the IND's sponsor vetting and the limited role of intelligence services, and said the government is critically reviewing the sponsor scheme with a later update promised.
No public statements are made about the knowledge level of the intelligence and security services.
Over het kennisniveau van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Van Meenen over het bericht 'Personeelstekorten kinderopvang lopen spuigaten uit: vrees voor langere wachtlijsten'

Two D66 MPs asked the government about staff shortages in childcare, the status of a motion calling for a labour market vision, and possible actions. The state secretary acknowledged the shortages, said the work on a labour market vision was delayed by COVID-19 and would resume, and listed steps taken such as a recruitment campaign and postponed quality requirements.
I have committed to your House to work towards solutions to address the labour shortage through discussions with the sector.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd om aan de hand van gesprekken met de sector te komen tot oplossingsrichtingen om de krapte aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over "de gebrekkige transparantie van pensioenfondsen"

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Social Affairs about AFM findings that many pension funds fail to report costs correctly or fully under the Pension Act and IORP II, and about the government's responsibility as convenant partner. The State Secretary acknowledges transparency is important and that much work remains, but states the supervisor (AFM) is primarily responsible for enforcement, sees no need yet to revise the rules or approach funds directly, and points to planned IORP II evaluation in 2023.
At this moment I have no picture of the extent to which the 2020 annual reports of pension funds comply with the transparency requirements.
Op dit moment heb ik geen beeld van de mate waarin de jaarverslagen 2020 van pensioenfondsen de transparantie-eisen in acht nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Esch over de aanhoudende onvrede, acties en voorgenomen rechtszaken tegen ambtenaren- en lerarenpensioenfonds ABP

MPs Teunissen and Van Esch asked the ministers about public and legal pressure on pension fund ABP over fossil-fuel and animal-suffering investments, and whether public employers should tender the scheme, and whether conscientious objectors can opt out. The government answered that ABP's board independently manages investments, that ABP has decided to divest from fossil fuel producers, that tendering is not required under the Dutch statutory system, and that individual opt-out for investment objections is not possible.
The ABP board is responsible for implementing the pension scheme, including the investment policy.
Het ABP-bestuur gaat over de uitvoering van de pensioenregeling, inclusief het beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht 'Fouten UWV brengen mensen in financiële problemen'

An SP MP asks the minister about reports that UWV errors push people into financial trouble and whether affected people can be compensated through debt forgiveness or repayment of net amounts. The state secretary acknowledges the problems, states that legal rules require recovery of undue benefits with only a narrow hardship clause, and promises to review the debtor policy and examine net-amount recovery by mid-2022.
What Mr Camps said is correct.
Het klopt wat de heer Camps heeft gezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over "de Regeling dienstverlening aan huis"

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the household-services scheme (Regeling dienstverlening aan huis) is limited to private employers, whether large intermediaries use it to cut costs, and what working conditions and measures apply. The State Secretary answered that the scheme is for private households, that employees have fewer entitlements than standard contracts, that intermediaries misusing it would in fact be direct employers, and that alternatives are for a future cabinet to decide.
I consider it undesirable, as previously stated, if companies try to use the household services scheme while there is in fact a direct employment relationship with the company.

Ik vind het, zoals eerder aangegeven, niet wenselijk als bedrijven de Regeling dienstverlening aan huis proberen te gebruiken, terwijl feitelijk sprake is van een directe dienstbetrekking met het bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de enorme toename van arbeidsuitbuiting in het afgelopen jaar

The MP asks why reports of labour exploitation rose about 70% and what the government will do, and whether the problem is larger than the figures show and why prosecutors judged a case not to be exploitation. The State Secretary answers that reports are a dark number, the enforcement approach is described, the Art. 273f Sr definition is high-threshold, and a revision is being explored but depends on a new cabinet and funding.
However, decision-making on revising Article 273f of the Criminal Code requires a caretaker cabinet and financial coverage.
Voor de besluitvorming over herziening van artikel 273f Sr zijn echter een missionair kabinet en financiële dekking nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht 'OM ziet te weinig bewijs uitbuiting truckers: 'Moet er eerst iemand doodgaan?''

An MP asked the minister about a report that the Public Prosecution Service dropped a labour exploitation case against truck drivers for lack of evidence, and about related rules on forced work, prosecution, and tachograph fraud. The state secretary said prosecutorial decisions are independent, outlined existing criminal and administrative tools and a planned review of article 273f, and committed to informing parliament on the implementation of recommendations by year end.
As Minister I do not comment on decisions of the Public Prosecution Service, which independently decides which cases are brought before the court.
Als Minister doe ik geen uitspraken over besluiten van het OM, dat onafhankelijk en zelfstandig besluit welke zaken al dan niet voor de rechter gebracht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Ceder en Grinwis over de toename in arbeidsuitbuiting

Christian Union MPs asked the ministers about the sharp rise in reported labour exploitation, why few cases reach prosecution, the dismissal of a case involving Filipino truck drivers, and protection for victims. The Secretary of State answered that most reports lack sufficient evidence, explained the prosecution and inspection process, said the high evidentiary burden limits prosecution, and promised implementation of the Aanjaagteam recommendations and a later review of article 273f, while noting the cabinet is caretaker.
However, a fully functioning cabinet and financial resources are needed for the decision-making on revising article 273f of the Criminal Code.
Voor de besluitvorming over herziening van artikel 273f Sr zijn echter een missionair kabinet en financiële middelen nodig.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat er gekort gaat worden bij Reiswerk Pensioenen na de overgang naar pensioenfonds PGB

An SP MP asks the minister why pension entitlements at Reiswerk Pensioenen face cuts of nearly 20% after a collective transfer to Pensioenfonds PGB, and whether individual members should have consent rights and property protection. The Staatssecretaris defends the liquidation transfer as legally permitted and in members' collective interest, leaves the court case and specific judgment to the judiciary, and rejects calls to abandon the new pension contract.
It is not for me to pronounce on a specific case.
Het is niet aan mij om een uitspraak te doen over een specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en El Yassini over het bericht ‘Zoveel banen en toch niet aan de bak: voldoe niet aan profiel’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about a news report of a 60-year-old long-term unemployed woman rejected for not fitting a 'profile', and whether this masks age, gender or ethnic discrimination. The State Secretary cited research on perceived discrimination, said the government will not yet judge the specific case, pointed to its anti-discrimination action plan and a bill on equal opportunities in recruitment, and described re-integration and training support for older jobseekers.
For now I refrain from an opinion on the appearance of age discrimination in this case, because a complete picture of the facts and circumstances is lacking.
Vooralsnog onthoud ik mij van een opvatting over de schijn van leeftijdsdiscriminatie in de onderhavige casus, omdat een volledig beeld van de feiten en omstandigheden ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over de uitspraak van de rechter inzake het verlopen van de inburgeringstermijn

An MP asks the State Secretary why the government appealed one court ruling on repayment of the integration loan after a minor deadline overrun but not a similar one, and whether discretionary, proportionate assessment and partial debt forgiveness will be introduced. The State Secretary answers that the appeal was withdrawn to fit a new policy line being developed with DUO, that a draft regulation for partial forgiveness is in internet consultation, and that a hardship clause is planned in the law.
The 10 June ruling of the Noord-Holland court has led to looking differently at debt forgiveness for the loan when a culpable deadline overrun occurs.

De uitspraak van 10 juni jl. van de rechtbank van Noord-Holland heeft ertoe geleid dat er met een andere blik naar kwijtschelding van de lening bij een verwijtbare termijnoverschrijding wordt gekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht "Steeds meer 55-plussers koersen af op financiële nood"

An MP from the SGP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about a news report on rising financial distress among people aged 55 and over, including how the government will prevent poverty at AOW age and what it will do for older people with disabilities. The State Secretary replies that the social security system already offers income guarantees, that AOW and supplementary schemes protect against poverty, and that new policy on the longer term is for the next cabinet given its caretaker status.
The judgement on the longer-term steps to reduce the risk of poverty and improve the labour market prospects of younger seniors is for the next cabinet.
Het oordeel over de op de lange termijn te zetten stappen om het risico op armoede te reduceren en het arbeidsmarktperspectief van jonge senioren te bevorderen is aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over misleidende praktijken van Multi-level Marketing (MLM)-bedrijven

An MP asked the government about misleading practices of multi-level marketing companies, including unrealistic income promises, medical claims, possible pyramid schemes, bogus self-employment and lack of transparency. The minister answered that MLM is a lawful sales method subject to consumer protection rules enforced by the ACM and NVWA, that existing law suffices and no amendment of the gambling law or new disclosure duties are planned.
I currently see no reason for additional information obligations.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding voor aanvullende informatieverplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Gijs van Dijk over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

MPs Sneller and Van Dijk asked the government about the tendering of photography contracts, including the administrative burden on photographers, a bureau-based model, tariffs, market power and legal grounds for the new approach. Prime Minister Rutte answered that the new framework will be published around late October/early November, that the hourly rate will be about 109 euros versus 117 now, and that the earlier multi-supplier framework was dropped partly for legal reasons.
The hourly rate in the new framework agreement will in all likelihood be 109 euros, for every hour a photographer takes photos on location.
Het uurtarief in de nieuwe raamovereenkomst zal naar alle waarschijnlijkheid € 109 bedragen, voor elk uur dat een fotograaf op locatie foto’s neemt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het verloop rond het ontslag van oud-staatssecretaris Mona Keijzer en de afwezigheid van kabinetsleden bij de hoofdelijk stemming over de invoering van de QR-toegangspas

An MP asked several ministers how they were informed of and consented to the dismissal of State Secretary Mona Keijzer, whether the cabinet's rules of procedure were followed, and why a minister was absent from a vote on the QR access pass. The government answered that the dismissal was materially in line with cabinet procedure via consultation with the vice-prime ministers, and that the ministers' disagreements were part of normal cabinet deliberation.
This materially guarantees that the decision was taken in accordance with the sense of the Council of Ministers and does justice to its rules of procedure.
Hiermee is materieel gewaarborgd dat het besluit is genomen in overeenstemming met het gevoelen van de ministerraad en recht gedaan aan het reglement van orde van de ministerraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat 77 duizend mensen hun baan zijn verloren sinds de invoering van de Wet Arbeidsmarkt in Balans

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that 77,000 people lost their jobs after the Wet Arbeidsmarkt in Balans was introduced, and whether this undermines the law's aim of job security. The Minister answered that it is too early to draw conclusions from a short, partly COVID-affected ABN Amro study, that a formal evaluation is planned for 2025, and that employers' anticipatory dismissals of flex workers were foreseen.
In my view it is still really too early to draw conclusions about the Wab on the basis of this study.
Het is naar mijn mening op dit moment nog echt te vroeg om conclusies over de Wab te trekken op basis van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het feit dat de Anti-flexwerkwet niet leidt niet tot meer vaste banen en vooral vrouwen en jongeren nu hun baan verliezen

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Wab (Wet arbeidsmarkt in balans) is failing to create permanent jobs and is causing women and young people to lose jobs, citing an ABN Amro analysis. The minister answered that it is too early to draw conclusions from the short study period, that the evaluation is scheduled for 2025, and that decisions on further steps are for a next cabinet.
However, it is still too early to draw conclusions based on the short research period on which this report is based.
Het is echter nog te vroeg om conclusies te trekken op basis van de korte onderzoeksperiode waarop dit rapport zich baseert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht "Ministerie kan niets doen tegen bedrijven die vaccinatiebewijs eisen"

MP Stoffer asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether employers may require vaccination certificates from employees, whether the ministry can act against such employers, and whether a law should be created to enable enforcement. The State Secretary answered that employers may not require a corona access certificate from employees under current law, that vaccination remains voluntary, and that the government is exploring whether the employee exemption could be lifted under conditions, with results expected in early November.
Enforcement requires a legal basis; this will be taken into account in the exploration of the possible application of corona access certificates in certain sectors.
Handhaven vereist een wettelijke basis, in de verkenning naar de mogelijke toepassing van de coronatoegangsbewijzen in bepaalde sectoren, zal dit worden meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Dubieuze investeringen van Nederlandse pensioenuitvoerders in Myanmar’

Two D66 MPs asked whether Dutch pension funds investing in companies linked to Myanmar's military should be curbed and whether participants should have more say over investments. The minister said the government advises firms and pension funds not to deal with military-controlled entities, relies on the IMVB covenant and engagement, and points to existing participant voice through boards and accountability bodies.
The cabinet is willing to specifically point pension funds, within this framework, to the lasting importance of the cited cabinet advice and its elaboration.
Het kabinet is bereid om de pensioenfondsen binnen dit verband ook specifiek te wijzen op het blijvende belang van het genoemde kabinetsadvies en de uitwerking er van.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "omstreden risicoprofilering door gemeente Nissewaard"

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about the municipality of Nissewaard's risk-profiling algorithm for detecting welfare fraud, and whether similar practices elsewhere should be stopped and how their legality is ensured. The government replied that municipalities are primarily responsible under the GDPR and that the State Secretary has only stewardship of the Participatiewet; it declined to take national action on other municipalities' algorithms, while promising to inform municipalities of TNO's findings and pointing to existing guidance and ongoing inventories.
I am not aware whether other municipalities use the services of Totta Data Lab.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte of ook andere gemeenten gebruik maken van de diensten van Totta Data Lab.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de (vaststelling van de) NOW

The MP Stoffer asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the cost of accountant and third-party certificates required to verify NOW wage subsidies, their link to VAT and payroll data, and UWV's room for case-specific flexibility and appeal durations. The minister answers that differentiated controls and planned simplifications aim to balance costs with lawful subsidy use, that UWV can filter incidental pay only when objectively verifiable, and that the average appeal takes 32 days.
In designing the NOW control system I deliberately and carefully chose a form of differentiation that matches the size of the business and the amount of the subsidy.

Bij de totstandkoming van de controlesystematiek van de NOW heb ik bewust en zorgvuldig gekozen voor een vorm van differentiatie die aansluit bij de grootte van de onderneming en de hoogte van de subsidie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Amhaouch over herintroductie van de werktijdverkorting

MPs Palland and Amhaouch asked the minister about reintroducing short-time working (WTV), its eligibility rules, sector support, and a part-time unemployment scheme. The minister answered that WTV reopens from 1 October 2021 with pre-corona conditions, that supply shortages are generally normal business risk, and that a structural alternative will be sent to parliament before the budget debate.
Before the SZW 2022 budget debate, the House will receive a letter setting out several variants for a structural calamity/crisis scheme.
Voor de begrotingsbehandeling van SZW 2022 zal de Kamer een brief ontvangen met daarin uitgewerkt een aantal varianten voor een structurele calamiteiten/crisisregeling.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch, en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Coronacrisis kost overheid tot dusver al 76,2 miljard euro' en het bericht 'Een vijfde van de coronasteun ging naar bedrijven met omze

CDA MPs asked the Ministers of Finance, Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about reports that a fifth of corona support went to firms with year-on-year revenue growth, asking how much support was paid, how much was repaid, and whether firms would be asked to voluntarily repay. The government answered that support was not conditioned on annual revenue loss, estimated the share going to growing firms from partial data (TVL about 9%, NOW about 16% per ESB researchers), reported repayment figures, and committed to informing parliament and to a moral appeal to firms to repay.
Having an annual revenue decline was not a condition for using the generic support measures such as the TVL and NOW schemes.
Het hebben van een omzetdaling op jaarbasis is geen voorwaarde geweest om gebruik te maken van de generieke steunmaatregelen zoals de TVL en de NOW-regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Mokumse homohater vaak een allochtoon'

MP Eerdmans asked the ministers whether they acknowledge that anti-gay aggression in Amsterdam is often committed by young men of non-Dutch background, and what policy changes would follow. The government answered that the Amsterdam study is limited in scope, that an updated national study on perpetrators is underway, and that repression, prevention and municipal cooperation are part of the approach.
The cited action research, however, relates only to the Amsterdam situation and moreover has limited scope.
Het aangehaalde Actieonderzoek heeft echter alleen betrekking op de Amsterdamse situatie en het heeft bovendien een beperkte reikwijdte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de uitkeringsafhankelijkheid en huisvesting van statushouders

An MP asks the ministers about rising benefit dependence among refugee status holders, their low education levels, the 2021 housing quota forcing municipalities to house 24,500 status holders, and whether this burdens the welfare state and housing supply. The government answers that benefit dependence falls with length of stay, that it cannot give total welfare costs, that municipalities bear housing duties under the Huisvestingswet, and lists measures to support housing and integration.
Figures are only available from the 2014 cohort onward.
Er zijn alleen cijfers beschikbaar vanaf het cohort 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Maatoug over het vaccineren van arbeidsmigranten

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers how migrant workers in the Netherlands are being vaccinated against COVID-19, including how many have been vaccinated, what outreach exists, and whether employers and GGDs can vaccinate on site. The minister answered that there is no separate registration for this group, describes multilingual outreach, cooperation with employers' organisations and GGDs, on-site and mobile vaccination options, and a working group led by RIVM, while declining to introduce in-company vaccination.
There is no separate registration for this target group.
Er is geen aparte registratie voor deze doelgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over personeelstekort horeca

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the labour shortage in hospitality, including why unemployment remains high and what the government is doing to help the sector find staff. The minister answered that the government supports reintegration through employers' service points, municipal budgets, UWV campaigns and training for chef and restaurant roles, and that helping unemployed people into work is part of the approach for shortage sectors.
Yes, guiding people to work towards shortage occupations is therefore already part of the approach.
Ja, het begeleiden naar werk richting krapte(beroepen) is daarom al onderdeel van de aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over nieuw gifschandaal in binnenvaart

MP Beckerman asked the ministers about a new phosphine gas incident on three inland vessels, prior warnings, prevention measures, who is responsible, and whether incidents with biocides have occurred. The government acknowledged the incident as unacceptable, explained the cause as non-compliance with existing rules for rail transport of fumigated cargo, and announced international proposals, a chain analysis due end-2021, and a criminal investigation led by police.
A criminal investigation is currently underway on the instruction of the Public Prosecutor, led by the national police unit.
Er loopt in opdracht van de Officier van Justitie nu een strafrechtelijk onderzoek, waarin de landelijke eenheid van de politie de regie heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Meldingen eergerelateerd geweld stijgen, opvang vol’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports that honour-related violence notifications are rising while shelter places are full, including shelter capacity, perpetrator removal, early recognition and a multi-year action programme. The government answered that notifications rose only slightly in 2020, that shelter demand peaked and was temporarily solved, that criminal law tools exist, and that work on prevention and a follow-up exploration is ongoing.
Talks are now taking place between the VNG, municipalities and care providers on the availability, occupancy and financing of this specialised shelter, with the aim of reaching a structural solution.

Er vinden nu gesprekken plaats tussen VNG, gemeenten en betrokken zorgaanbieders over de beschikbaarheid, bezetting en financiering van deze specialistische vorm van opvang, met als doel om tot een structurele oplossing te komen.
Antwoord op van het lid Tielen over personeelstekorten en signalen over de werkwijze van UWV met betrekking tot WW’ers die zich om (willen) scholen naar een tekortberoep

MP Tielen asks the minister whether UWV proactively directs WW benefit recipients with limited education or surplus occupations toward short retraining for shortage occupations, how regional mobility teams and employers are involved, what criteria apply to training and exemption from the job-search obligation, and about administrative burdens on training providers. The minister replies that UWV contributes to matching, denies that proactive referral is absent, describes training arrangements, mobility teams, inkoopkader criteria, and data on training budget approvals, and says UWV keeps consulting providers.
I will inform your House in mid-September in more detail about the progress of the rollout of the regional mobility teams.
Ik zal uw Kamer medio september nader informeren over de voortgang van de uitrol van de regionale mobiliteitsteams.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het onterecht korten van leningen op de bijstand

An SP MP asked the minister why Rotterdam cut a benefit recipient's social assistance over a loan from his brother used to pay rent arrears, and whether loans should count as income. The state secretary acknowledges such cuts can produce undesirable outcomes, says the Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling turned on urgent reasons rather than banning loan deductions, and promises to inform municipalities of nuance and to address hardship in a future Participatiewet plan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Kent over "het moeten inleveren van een aangepaste bus"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why UWV is reclaiming an adapted vehicle from a disabled self-employed woman, whether people with disabilities are entitled to such aids when starting a business, what the municipality can do, and what will be done to help similar cases. The State Secretary said UWV's transport provision ends when training ends and self-employed people have no entitlement to transport for work, that UWV tries to arrange a smooth transition, that the municipality has now solved the case via a Wmo vehicle adaptation, and that the rules will not be changed but the case will be included in an evaluation with UWV.
I cannot go into the specific case in my answer, but will address your questions in general terms below.
Ik kan in mijn beantwoording niet specifiek ingaan op betreffende casus, maar zal in onderstaande beantwoording in algemene termen ingaan op uw vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over het bericht dat Nederland op de vingers is getikt door Brussel vanwege het niet strafbaar stellen van ontkenning Holocaust

MPs Bisschop and Stoffer asked why the Netherlands has not criminalised Holocaust denial after EU pressure, and whether a bill will be introduced to address it. Minister Grapperhaus replied that such denial is already punishable under Article 137c of the Criminal Code per Supreme Court case law, but that the Commission considers this insufficiently explicit, so a wording amendment via a re-implementation bill is being prepared.
In response, the Commission was informed that the Netherlands sees reason in the Commission's position to prepare a bill.
In reactie hierop is de Commissie bericht dat Nederland in het standpunt van de Commissie aanleiding ziet om een wetsvoorstel voor te bereiden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Hammelburg over het bericht 'Partnerverlof nadeliger voor laagste inkomens'

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether partner leave (aanvullend geboorteverlof) financially disadvantages the lowest incomes, and how net income effects arise.
