The minister confirmed the net loss pattern stems mainly from the tax structure (arbeidskorting and the benefit cap), said the NRC figures are factually correct but incomplete as they ignore annual tax and allowances, provided household tables, and said the only options are raising the benefit, which the cabinet considers adequate, or a structural tax change beyond scope, with an evaluation of the WIEG to follow.
The evaluation will be sent to your House at the end of this year or the beginning of next year, and may prompt a next cabinet to look again at the level of the benefit.
De evaluatie zal eind dit jaar of begin volgend jaar naar uw Kamer worden gestuurd, en kan mogelijk voor een volgend kabinet aanleiding zijn om opnieuw naar de hoogte van de uitkering te kijken.

Antwoord op van het lid Tony van Dijck over de berichten dat bedrijven voor ruim €4 miljard aan loonsteun moeten terugbetalen en dat dit voor veel ondernemers dreigt uit te draaien op een financiële strop

MP Tony van Dijck asked ministers whether reports that firms must repay over 4 billion euro in NOW wage subsidy, with a risk of financial ruin due to delayed accountant certificates, are accurate, and about the scope of repayments in other Covid schemes and conditions for repayment. The government answered that the repayment estimate is uncertain and partly based on incomplete data, that a 14-week extension is available for accountant and third-party certificates, that repayment terms are generous and interest-free, and that no compensation for accountant costs is planned.
The determination process for the NOW is still ongoing, so it is still unclear how much NOW support will ultimately be paid out.
Het vaststellingsproces van de NOW loopt nog, waardoor het nog onduidelijk is hoeveel NOW-steun er uiteindelijk wordt uitgekeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Teunissen over een brandbrief van KDS over de hoge slachtsnelheid in slachthuizen

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about a letter from the works council of KDS, the meat inspection body, complaining that high slaughter line speeds prevent proper inspection and threaten food safety and worker safety. Minister Schouten answered that the government takes the concern seriously, has frozen line-speed increases pending an investigation due at year-end, and that legally it cannot order a structural reduction in speed immediately.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sneller, Wuite, Romke de Jong en Van Weyenberg over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

D66 MPs asked whether the Ministry of General Affairs' tender for photography services, which bundles assignments with a large image bank, would exclude freelancers and SMEs and create a monopsony. The Prime Minister's answer says the tender is in preparation, that a pool of photographers will be selected via a single agency, that the image-bank and commissioned photography will be split into separate tenders, and that the approach honours the 2017 Vos/Mulder motion.
The Ministry of General Affairs has decided, after further consideration, that the commissioned photography and image-bank photography, initially bundled, will be decoupled in this tender.
Het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken heeft op basis van nadere afwegingen besloten dat de van aanvang gebundeld ingezette opdracht- en beeldbankfotografie in deze aanbesteding worden losgekoppeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Aartsen over "het rapport van de Nationale Ombudsman over ondernemers die in de knel komen als gevolg van corona"

MPs Romke de Jong and Aartsen asked the ministers about the Ombudsman's report on entrepreneurs in financial difficulty due to COVID support schemes, including TONK, SBI-code problems, debt relief and repayment. The State Secretary says the knelpunten are acknowledged, describes fixes (TONK budget doubled, SBI-code adjustments, second reference period, flexible repayment terms) and commits to assisting the Ombudsman.
I am always willing to assist the National Ombudsman in his investigation at his request.
Ik ben altijd bereid om de Nationale ombudsman op zijn verzoek bij te staan in zijn onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over mogelijke problemen bij de cao Participatiewet voorkomen

An SP MP asked whether a new cao for Participatiewet workers could cause back-pay problems that reduce rent and care allowances, and whether a communication plan is needed. The minister argued the cao has no retroactive effect, so no back pay arises, noted that income changes must be reported to the Tax Authority, and declined a dedicated communication plan, promising only to share the questions with social partners.
That means there is no retroactive effect, so back payments and/or debts could not arise.
Dat betekent dat er geen sprake is van terugwerkende kracht waardoor nabetalingen en/of schulden zouden kunnen ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over de fotografie-aanbesteding Rijksoverheid

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked about the upcoming central government photography tender, its status, and whether it would keep freelance photographers' rates from being pressured and give them a fairer chance to compete, as the Vos/Mulder motion requested. The Prime Minister answered that the tender is in preparation with a pre-announcement published, that a single agency will select a pool of photographers under a framework with fixed hourly rates, and that the design is intended to respect the motion's intent.
In my judgement, the new design does justice to the spirit of the Vos/Mulder motion.
Met de nieuwe opzet wordt naar mijn oordeel recht gedaan aan de geest van de motie Vos/Mulder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "schrijnende situaties door de kostendelersnorm"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about hardship cases caused by the cost-sharer norm (kostendelersnorm) in social assistance, including municipalities' scope for exceptions and motions asking for exemptions for homeless people, carers and young people. The state secretary answered that municipalities may temporarily set the norm aside in acute cases, but that categorical exemptions are not possible, that a different design would need legislation, and that municipal reluctance to use discretion will be raised with VNG and Divosa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over Temper

Two PvdA MPs asked why the Inspectorate SZW treats Temper as a temporary-work agency while the Tax Authority treats it as a client, and whether the Tax Authority's position undermines the Inspectorate and leaves vulnerable workers unprotected. The minister answered that the two bodies have different purposes and methods, that individual cases and inspection reports cannot be disclosed, and that workers can bring civil claims or register-based enforcement remains available.
I cannot make any statements about individual cases and investigations of the Inspectorate SZW.
Over individuele zaken en onderzoeken van de Inspectie SZW kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug, Gijs van Dijk, en Van Kent, over het artikel “Mensen in financiële nood door achterstand bij UWV”

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA and SP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV backlogs in WIA disability claims, forcing people into advance payments they must repay, and about hardship, shortages of insurance physicians and debt recovery rules. The minister answered with figures on advance payments and repayments, explained the causes of delays and the lack of a reimbursable-advance alternative, and committed to further talks with UWV and a letter setting out a solution.
I will engage further with VNG and UWV to assess whether this framework is adequate.
Ik ga nader in gesprek met VNG en UWV om te bezien of dit kader toereikend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over "pensioen voor zelfstandigen"

An MP asked whether pension experiments for self-employed workers have stalled and why the related experiment legislation is delayed, and whether the Pensioenakkoord commitment to bring more self-employed into pensions will be honoured. The minister confirms the legislation is expected to take effect by 1 January 2023 for fiscal reasons, says full data-sharing and premium-facilitation demands cannot all be met, and states commitments on self-employed pension building are being worked out through the Stichting van de Arbeid and the bill.
For that reason I cannot anticipate too much on the precise content of the bill.
Ik kan om voornoemde reden niet te veel vooruitlopen op de precieze inhoud van het wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over "de hoogte van het Bbz-krediet"

An MP asked the government about usage and repayment rates of the Bbz business loan, how its 8% interest rate was set, and whether it should be reconsidered as market conditions changed. The State Secretary said repayment data are unavailable, maintained that 8% is market-conform and aligned with high-risk business credit, and said the rate would only be revisited if market rates change.
Unfortunately, I do not have the requested data.
Ik beschik helaas niet over de gevraagde gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "grote tekorten voor de Participatiewet bij gemeenten"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of a structural shortfall of about 1.5 billion euros per year for municipalities under the Participatiewet, and about the support given to the new group of young disabled people. The state secretary said the financial situation has been studied before, that the shortfall figure cannot be confirmed as stated, and that the report was commissioned by VNG and is for the next cabinet to weigh.
It is up to a next cabinet to weigh the outcome of this research and other relevant research in this area and to decide whether, and if so how much, should be invested in municipal services.

Het is aan een volgend kabinet om de uitkomst van dit onderzoek en andere relevante onderzoeken op dit terrein te wegen en te besluiten of, en zo ja hoeveel, er geïnvesteerd moet worden in dienstverlening vanuit gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over grootontvangers betalen onterecht ontvangen loonsteun niet terug

An MP from the Labour party asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether large NOW wage-subsidy recipients that paid dividends or bonuses would repay the subsidy, which companies were involved, and whether the ABU staffing association would be urged to make its members repay. The minister answered that the NOW1 dividend and bonus ban applied only at subsidiary level so the requested per-company data is not available, that accountant checks apply to later tranches, and that the government will not recover lawfully granted subsidy or contact companies directly.
The requested data is therefore not available for NOW1.
De gevraagde gegevens zijn derhalve niet beschikbaar voor NOW1.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht 'België wil rouwverlof uitbreiden, schrijnend dat Nederland het niet heeft'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Dutch bereavement leave is adequate after a relative dies, compared with Belgium's proposal to extend it. The minister said calamity leave is available for funerals, that more collective agreements now include bereavement leave, and that a study on work and grief is under way.
Questions about absence due to grief were not included in the survey this year. I expect these results in 2022.
Vragen omtrent uitval door rouw zijn dit jaar niet in de enquête opgenomen. Ik verwacht deze uitkomsten in 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het naleven van de Europese privacyregels van de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) bij (uitvoerings)instanties

An MP asks multiple ministers whether a long list of public bodies (DUO, CBR, SVB, IND, DJI, UWV, OM, FIOD and others) collect and process personal data in line with GDPR, and whether any are not yet compliant. The government replies per organisation, generally stating compliance, while noting ongoing work and specific gaps such as UWV's SONAR system, SVB processes still in development, and CAK access management.
UWV is working hard to comply with the GDPR.
Het UWV werkt hard om aan de AVG te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Kent over de uitspraak van de rechter omtrent het te laat afronden van de inburgering

MP Van Kent (SP) asks the Minister of Social Affairs about a court ruling that annulled a fine and waived a loan for a late civic integration course, and what this means for others and for the new integration law. The minister accepts the ruling, grants a longer deadline, says a broader review of the system is underway with a letter promised after summer, and notes the new law will include a hardship clause.
I have taken note of the court's ruling. I accept the ruling and will not appeal.
Van de uitspraak van de rechtbank heb ik kennisgenomen. Ik leg me neer bij de uitspraak en stel geen hoger beroep in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over niet kwijtschelding lening t.b.v. inburgering bij geringe termijnoverschrijding van 23 juni jl.

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why a loan for civic integration was not waived when an applicant missed the deadline by a small margin, and whether the court ruling against the government would be followed. The minister defended the current all-or-nothing rule, accepted the ruling without appeal, promised a review of the regulation and said DUO would consider similar cases in future.
I accept the ruling and will not lodge an appeal.
Ik leg me neer bij de uitspraak en stel geen hoger beroep in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over falend schuldenbeleid van de Belastingdienst

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten (SP) asked why the Tax Administration offset benefit debts without applying the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) and how it will fix this and inform debtors. The State Secretary admits the practice was wrong, promises talks with the Ombudsman and LOSR, outlines plans to improve information and access to payment arrangements, and refers to an attached letter for details.
Given the purpose and intent of the Simplification of the Protected Minimum Act, I now conclude together with Toeslagen and the Tax Administration that this method should not have been applied.
Gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet (Wet vBVV) concludeer ik nu met Toeslagen en de Belastingdienst dat deze werkwijze niet had mogen worden toegepast.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Peters, Lodders, Edgar Mulder, Van Weyenberg, Snels, Nijboer, Bruins, Van Raan, Azarkan, Van Haga, Van Otterloo, Leijten, Stoffer en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat de Bel

MPs from many parties asked whether the Tax Authority fails to apply the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) when offsetting benefit overpayments against current allowances, and whether this breaches the law. The State Secretary admits that offsets under the standard payment arrangement were made without applying the protected minimum, that this is a mistaken assumption, and promises a repayment operation and a solution, but declines to meet the requested three-week deadline.
I conclude that this approach, given the purpose and intent of the Wet vBVV, offers citizens insufficient protection.
Ik concludeer dat deze werkwijze, gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vBVV, onvoldoende bescherming aan burgers biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht ‘Rijk belemmert gemeenten in armoedebeleid' en het niet uitvoeren van de motie over dit onderwerp

An MP asked why the government has not implemented an adopted motion to raise the asset limit for local tax waiver to the Participatiewet level, and whether it will do so before 1 July 2021. The minister confirms non-implementation, citing the demissionary cabinet's reluctance, the different purposes of tax waivers and benefits, poverty-trap and tax-burden effects, and refuses to commit to a timeline, leaving the matter to a successor cabinet.
The cabinet has not yet implemented the broadly adopted motion, because the current demissionary cabinet does not consider it opportune to decide on this now.
Het kabinet heeft de breed aangenomen motie nog niet uitgevoerd, omdat het huidige demissionaire kabinet het niet opportuun acht om hier nu over te beslissen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Peters over het bericht ‘Rijk belemmert gemeenten in armoedebeleid’

MPs Van Kent and Peters asked whether low-income people should build a financial buffer, what asset norms apply to local tax relief (kwijtschelding), and whether the government will raise the asset threshold to match welfare norms. The minister says no general buffer norm exists, asset norms are set per scheme, local municipalities set their own norms, and raising the kwijtschelding asset threshold is not decided by this caretaker cabinet because of poverty-trap and tax-burden effects, leaving the decision to a next cabinet.
Because of that complexity and its caretaker status, the cabinet leaves the decision on this to a next cabinet.
Vanwege die complexiteit en zijn demissionaire status laat het kabinet de besluitvorming hierover over aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Van den Hil over "het bericht dat uitkeringen van psychiatrische patiënten zijn stopgezet na een gedwongen opname"

MPs De Kort and Van den Hil asked whether social assistance benefits of psychiatric patients are stopped entirely after a compulsory admission, and how many cases and which municipalities are involved. The minister answers that the right to general assistance is not wholly lost, that the data on cases is not registered, and that an amendment restoring general assistance after compulsory admission is being prepared for entry into force by 1 January 2022.
It is not known in which municipalities benefits under general assistance are stopped upon compulsory admission.
Het is ook niet bekend in welke gemeenten uitkeringen op grond van algemene bijstand bij een gedwongen opname worden stopgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over ondersteuning van LHBTI ‘ers in gesloten gemeenschappen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about support for LHBTI people in closed migrant and religious communities, including survey figures on acceptance and the status of a 3 million euro budget amendment. The minister cited SCP survey data showing lower acceptance in some communities, listed existing projects, and said an exploratory study would be carried out in autumn before implementing the amendment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de leenbijstand

An MP (Omtzigt) asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Social Affairs why the 2014 to 2016 compensation for entrepreneurs hit by the leenbijstand problem was not reported on, why the problem took so long to resolve, and what will be done for those excluded or in debt restructuring. The government admits the long delay, promises to report on compensation use and to examine extending compensation to pre-2014 cases, but declines to hand over the requested memos for now.
Unfortunately it has not yet been possible to report in line with the commitment made.
Het is helaas nog niet gelukt om te rapporteren conform de gedane toezegging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Ceder over het bericht ‘Nieuwe deurwaarderswet brengt schuldenaars in problemen’

MPs Van Kent and Ceder asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that the new attachment-free allowance rules (fictitious housing costs) leave debtors with too little to live on. The minister defended the fictitious housing-cost method as a deliberate choice, said adjustments to the Recofa calculation for the protected amount are being prepared, and promised an evaluation and external study.
The law contains a hardship clause.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over het bericht dat de nieuwe deurwaarderswet schuldenaars in problemen brengt

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether the new garnishment rules (vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet) leave debtors with too little money because fictitious rather than actual housing costs are used, and what will be done. The minister acknowledges the concerns, explains the fictitious housing cost design and the exceptions and hardship clause, and says the law will be evaluated and studied externally rather than changed now.
I will include the effects on housing costs in the external research and the statutory evaluation.
Ik zal de effecten rond de woonkosten meenemen het externe onderzoek en de wetsevaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over antiziganisme, de National Roma Integration Strategy en stateloosheid

MP Van Baarle (DENK) asked the government about anti-Gypsyism, the EU Roma integration strategy, and statelessness among Dutch Roma. The minister answered that policy is generic anti-discrimination plus targeted Roma/Sinti measures, that no data exist on stateless Roma, and that existing law already gives Roma the same naturalisation rights as other aliens.
No data are available on this.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Aartsen over het bericht 'Booking paste bonusregels aan voor miljoenenbeloning top'

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary about plans for a reception centre for 200 asylum seekers and housing for 400 labour migrants in Deelen, questioning whether residents' concerns about nuisance and crime would be taken into account and whether the plan would be stopped. The State Secretary said talks with the municipality of Ede, COA and the owner are ongoing, that residents' concerns are being addressed in operating agreements, and that she rejects generalising asylum seekers as criminals while welcoming the extra reception capacity.
I dissociate myself from the suggestion that all asylum seekers are guilty of nuisance, crime or terror.
Ik neem afstand van de suggestie dat alle asielzoekers zich schuldig maken aan overlast, criminaliteit of terreur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het afsluiten van een CAO in de uitzendsector tussen de LBV en de ABU

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the new temp-sector CAO agreed with a non-independent union (LBV) undermined employers' reliability, whether it conflicted with expected regulation of flexible work, and whether contacts with the ABU and NBBU should be suspended. The minister declined to judge the parties or the CAO, stated that the government will not stop contacts with sector employer organisations, and said the future of driekwart dwingend recht is for the next cabinet.
I therefore do not consider it wise to break off or suspend those contacts.
Ik vind het dan ook niet verstandig om die contacten te verbreken of op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "over UWV gedupeerden bij Kafkaëske keuringen”

The MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV's wrongful re-assessments of about 2,100 people by Ondersteuningsteam Noord and what will be done to prevent such failures and restore benefits. The Minister acknowledges errors and inadequate attention to people's circumstances, describes a meldpunt, individual case-by-case remedies, an external evaluation, and commitments to report back on outcomes.
In the case of those re-assessed by Ondersteuningsteam Noord, people were affected as a result of careless conduct by the government.
In de zaak van de herbeoordeelden door Ondersteuningsteam Noord zijn mensen getroffen als gevolg van onzorgvuldig handelen van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over integratiesubsidies in Nederland

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Social Affairs about integration subsidies in the Netherlands, including misuse risks, an overview of subsidies, the Consortium Zelfbeschikking, and informal religious schooling projects. The minister answered that subsidy safeguards exist, listed current subsidies, explained the alliance funding, said municipalities decide on their own subsidies, and described pilots to improve informal schooling, but did not answer all questions individually.
No, unfortunately that did not succeed.
Nee, dat is helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over "de relatie van de regering met het FNV"

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he condemns an FNV vice-chair's tweet suggesting that FvD was excluded from a union demonstration, and whether he will cease cooperation and subsidies with the FNV. The minister replied that the FNV is a private organisation that sets its own policy, that he has no role in its disagreements with political parties, and that he sees no reason to change his stance toward the FNV.
As Minister of SZW I have no role in that.
Als Minister van SZW heb ik daar geen rol in.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Kent over het bericht dat illegale schoonmaakmiddelen gebruikt worden in de luchtvaartindustrie

An SP MP asks why illegal, allegedly prohibited and hazardous cleaning agents are used to disinfect aircraft when approved alternatives exist, and whether the ministers agreed to the exemptions. The state secretary answers that no authorised biocide could be used on aircraft surfaces, so temporary exemptions were granted on Ctgb advice with conditions, that RIVM advises ordinary cleaning, and that the employer and Inspectie SZW are responsible for worker safety.
I am authorised to grant an exemption if a need for it is established.
Ik ben bevoegd een vrijstelling te verlenen indien hiervoor een noodzaak wordt vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de casus van een deurwaarder die loonbeslag legt in relatie tot de geest en strekking van een door de Tweede Kamer aangenomen motie

An MP asked the ministers whether a bailiff's wage garnishment over a 13-year-old 83-euro debt, despite over 800 euro already paid, conflicts with a parliamentary motion calling for improvements to responsible debt collection, and whether concrete measures would follow. The government called the case distressing, explained that interest and costs under the Civil Code can make small debts grow, said themes sessions with stakeholders are underway with papers to be sent to parliament after the summer recess, and referred to existing legislation without committing to new measures now.
Answer 3, 4: The aim of the broad debt approach is to prevent people with (problematic) debts from getting further into trouble when facing collection by public and private creditors.
Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 3, 4 Inzet van de brede schuldenaanpak is het voorkomen dat mensen met (problematische) schulden verder in de problemen komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat Just Eat Takeaway de databeschermingswet AVG overtreedt in Duitsland

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Just Eat Takeaway's app, reportedly breaching GDPR in Germany, is also used in the Netherlands, what employee data employers may store, and whether the government will investigate. The minister could neither confirm nor deny the app's Dutch use, outlined general GDPR rules, and referred any investigation to the Dutch Data Protection Authority, which is independent.
It is up to the AP whether it sees reason to conduct an investigation.
Het is aan de AP of zij aanleiding ziet onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Van Weyenberg over het bericht 'Hoe juist werken tot armoede leidt: ‘Het probleem is dat toeslagen, loon en uitkering niet op elkaar zijn afgestemd’'

D66 MPs Kat and Van Weyenberg asked about a newspaper report that mismatched payment cycles (four-weekly wages versus monthly benefits and allowances) cause hardship, asking how common this is, how payroll and benefit rules work, and whether uniform payment rules or holiday-pay changes would help. The minister answers that the problem is recognised, explains the rules and offsetting practices in detail, says data on liquidity problems are unavailable, and notes that the answers will feed into a follow-up study of the UWV report.
It is not known how many people experience liquidity problems in connection with receiving wages every four weeks.
Niet bekend is hoeveel personen in verband met de ontvangst van salaris per vier weken liquiditeitsproblemen ondervinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over ''de dalende instroom in de wettelijke schuldsanering''

An MP asked the minister why entry into the statutory debt rescheduling scheme (Wsnp) has fallen again in 2020, and what is being done about it. The minister acknowledged the falling inflow, pointed to measures such as a mandatory creditor response period, a pilot allowing debt administrators to file Wsnp applications, and a forthcoming bill to improve the transition from municipal debt assistance to the statutory route, while rejecting the claim that municipalities had cut back on debt assistance.
The goal is to ensure that everyone receives suitable, good and fast help when they struggle with problematic debts.
Het doel is om te zorgen dat iedereen passende, goede en snelle hulp krijgt als hij of zij kampt met problematische schulden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Romke de Jong en Kat over de Tozo

MPs from D66 asked why the Tozo loan carries 2% interest while the Bbz credit carries 8%, and whether the gap is defensible for entrepreneurs. The minister answered that the Tozo is a temporary crisis scheme pegged to Qredits' rate, the Bbz is a structural last-resort scheme with market-rate interest, and he is not willing to lower the Bbz rate because a lower non-market rate would constitute state aid.
I attach importance to a market-conform interest rate being applied to interest-bearing loans under the regular Bbz.
Ik hecht eraan dat er in het kader van het reguliere Bbz een marktconforme rente wordt gehanteerd voor rentedragende leningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Van Kent over het bericht 'Betere bescherming arbeidsmigranten kan niet wachten op nieuw kabinet'

MPs from D66 and SP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of migrant workers found in degrading conditions on a farm in Limburg, including inspection roles, sanctions, the welfare of the workers and the registration of migrant workers. The minister answered that inspections were carried out by the Inspectorate SZW, police and municipality, that investigations are ongoing, that the workers were traced to Belgium, and that the implementation of the Roemer taskforce recommendations is being pursued with some measures awaiting a new cabinet.
The investigation into this incident has not yet been completed and I cannot therefore assess it at this time.
Het onderzoek naar dit voorval is op dit moment nog niet afgerond en ik kan dit derhalve nog niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "het bericht dat burgers opgejaagd worden en hun privacy wordt geschonden"

An SP MP asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Justice about reports that municipalities monitor welfare recipients' privacy, including waste-pass use, and about the role of the Inlichtingenbureau in data-matching and fraud detection. The minister answered that municipalities may investigate individual cases within legal limits, that the Inlichtingenbureau acts on statutory tasks under ministerial oversight and does not itself investigate fraud, and that a fraud law overhaul is under way.
The decisions taken by the college are open to objection and appeal by the citizen.
De door het college genomen beslissingen zijn vatbaar voor bezwaar en beroep door de burger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over burgergegevens bij het Inlichtingenbureau

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Inlichtingenbureau's data matching that generates 'samenloop' signals to municipalities on benefit fraud, including how signals arise, error rates, complaint routes and whether fraud control is disproportionate. The Minister answered that no risk models are used under the Participatiewet, that signals are data matches sent for municipal follow-up, that outcomes are not tracked centrally, and that complaint and correction routes exist.
It is up to the municipality to assess whether signals merit investigation and, through further inquiry, to establish whether unlawfulness actually exists.
Het is aan de gemeente om de onderzoekwaardigheid van signalen te beoordelen en om aan de hand van nader onderzoek vast te stellen of er daadwerkelijk sprake is van onrechtmatigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat miljoenen mensen dit jaar geen vakantiegeld krijgen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he shares concern that millions of workers may not receive holiday pay this year despite it being legally required and covered by the NOW subsidy, and what he will do about it. The minister acknowledged the situation is worrying, pointed to the NOW uplift covering holiday pay, said the government does not know the specific circumstances of non-payment, and said he will keep discussing the matter with employer and union organisations, without a concrete new measure.
I do not know in what situation or under what circumstances employers choose not to pay holiday allowance, pay it later or pay less.
Ik weet niet in welke situatie of onder welke omstandigheden werkgevers ervoor kiezen om de vakantiebijslag niet, later of in mindere mate uit te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat werknemers kunnen fluiten naar hun vakantiecenten

An MP from the Labour party asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he would act to ensure workers receive holiday pay that employers may delay or withhold during the COVID-19 crisis, and whether NOW subsidies and WW benefits are affected. The minister said workers can claim holiday pay through civil courts and the Labour Inspectorate, that delayed payment is possible only by written agreement and cannot become non-payment, and that the WW benefit calculation reserves holiday pay so non-payment does not reduce benefits.
Employees can claim their holiday pay through the civil court if the employer refuses to pay.
Werknemers kunnen bij de burgerlijke rechter hun vakantiebijslag vorderen als de werkgever weigert uit te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het artikel ‘Bonden: minister moet cao uitzendsector blokkeren’

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a collective agreement signed by the employers' associations ABU and NBBU with the small union LBV, which he considered a non-independent 'fake union', should be stopped by withholding acknowledgment of receipt, and whether pension waiting-time rules for temporary agency workers should be scrapped by law. The minister answered that he takes no position on the agreement, found no grounds to deny acknowledgment (the agreements entered into force on 1 June), will not reverse them, and that the pension waiting-time reduction is already in the pension bill with sector parties responsible for the timing.
I have no reason to assume that LBV does not meet the requirements set out in the Collective Labour Agreements Act for trade unions that conclude a collective agreement.
Ik heb geen redenen om aan te nemen dat LBV niet aan de vereisten voldoet die in de Wet op de collectieve arbeidsovereenkomst gesteld worden aan vakbonden die een cao afsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over het duperen van bijstandontvangers met schulden

SP MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about benefit recipients with debts who were given too low a protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) because of errors in the new debt-collection system, asking about remedies, deputies' responsibilities, and fixes. The minister acknowledged the problems, explained they stem from implementation issues and gemeenten's vacation-allowance reporting, described repayment efforts via the KBvG, and committed to keeping the House informed and to exploring a permanent solution.
I will keep your House regularly informed of progress.
Ik zal uw Kamer regelmatig op de te hoogte houden van de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het artikel 'Ruim 10.000 ontvangers bijstand de dupe van fout bij gemeenten'

An MP from the Labour party asked the Minister of Social Affairs about bijstand recipients who were underpaid their protected income (beslagvrije voet) because some municipalities report holiday allowance annually rather than monthly, and about remedies and responsibility of bailiffs. The Minister answered that no municipal error was involved, that municipalities raise the protected amount manually, bailiffs recalculate and refund, and that a structural solution and possible simplification are being studied.
There is no question of an error by the municipalities.
Er is geen sprake van een fout van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht dat ruim 10.000 ontvangers van bijstand de dupe zijn geworden van een fout bij gemeenten

An MP asked the minister about reports that over 10,000 social assistance recipients were wrongly subjected to garnishment above the legal protected minimum because municipalities reported holiday allowance irregularly to the UWV payroll database. The minister confirmed the error, estimated 10,000 to 15,000 affected garnishments, said municipalities now set the protected amount manually to 95% of income while an automated fix is developed, and described bailiffs being asked to contact affected people and refund excess amounts.
Municipalities that do not report holiday allowance monthly to the Polisadministratie temporarily raise the protected amount manually to 95% of income.
Gemeenten die de vakantietoeslag niet maandelijks doorgeven aan de Polisadministratie verhogen de beslagvrije voet voorlopig handmatig tot 95% van het inkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Arbeidsmigrant krijgt belastingkorting die Nederlander niet krijgt’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance why foreign taxpayers (mostly Polish labour migrants) can claim the income-dependent combination tax credit (IACK) that Dutch families in the same situation may not get, and why a loophole identified in 2015 and 2018 was not fixed. The State Secretary acknowledges an unintended effect of the non-partner exception, provides claim figures, says the legislation will be amended with a bill before Prinsjesdag and in force 1 January 2022, and rejects reopening past assessments.
I intend to amend the legislation so that the treatment of foreign taxpayers and of domestic taxpayers married to a partner living abroad is equated with that of domestic taxpayers.

Ik ben voornemens de wetgeving zodanig aan te passen dat de uitwerking voor de buitenlandse belastingplichtige en voor de binnenlandse belastingplichtige die gehuwd is met een partner woonachtig in het buitenland, wordt gelijkgesteld met die van de binnenlandse belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het Jaarverslag 2020 van de Inspectie SZW

MP Van Kent (SP) asked the minister to respond to the Inspectie SZW 2020 annual report, which found violations in every checked food-delivery employer, and asked about enforcement, protection of delivery workers including bogus self-employed, and Spain's employment presumption. The minister acknowledged the violations, described inspection and enforcement steps, the 2021 extra focus on delivery, and said the government is working on a legal presumption for platform workers.
As a result of the increased pressure on this sector and the violations found last year, the Inspectie SZW is investing extra in this area in 2021.
Als gevolg van de toegenomen druk op deze sector en de vorig jaar geconstateerde overtredingen investeert de Inspectie SZW in 2021 extra hierop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en De Graaf over het bericht dat het CBS gaat stoppen met onderscheid maken tussen een ‘westerse’ en ‘niet-westerse’ achtergrond

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether abandoning the 'western' versus 'non-western' background classification by Statistics Netherlands (CBS) hides immigration problems, and urged the CBS to be called to order. The government replied that the CBS will keep recording origin and migration background, that the categories lost meaning, and that the minister will not interfere with the CBS's statistical categorisation because it is an independent administrative body.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Hij heeft me gewoon opgelicht’

An MP asked the ministers about reports of exploitation of Asian chefs brought to the Netherlands under a residence-and-work permit scheme, including IND permits during closures, recruitment via intermediaries, job ads with harsh conditions, wage deductions and bonds. The government answered at length, stating that employers are responsible and that the Inspectorate and UWV can act, and announced it will end the scheme for non-EU chefs at first application while the scheme is reviewed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Restaurants dicht door corona maar toch 500 Aziatische koks uit het buitenland gehaald’

MP Tielen asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that about 500 Asian cooks were brought from abroad under the residence-and-work permit scheme despite restaurant closures, asking for permit numbers, revocations, undocumented cooks, and whether the scheme should be suspended. The Minister gave detailed figures, reported signals of abuse such as payments to intermediaries and fake cook certificates, and announced the scheme will be closed to new cooks while its future is examined.

The proposed change will mean that, while it is examined whether the scheme can revive in a tightened form or be permanently abolished, cooks who are not already lawfully resident in the Netherlands under this scheme can no longer successfully invoke it.

De voorgenomen wijziging zal inhouden dat het, terwijl wordt onderzocht of de regeling in aangescherpte vorm kan herleven of definitief komt te vervallen, niet meer mogelijk is voor koks die niet reeds op grond van deze regeling rechtmatig in Nederland verblijven, om een geslaagd beroep te doen op de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over signalen van ondernemers m.b.t. de derden- en accountantsverklaring bij de vaststelling van de NOW-regeling

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about SME complaints over the costs and complexity of derden- and accountantsverklaringen required to settle NOW wage subsidies, and how many firms are affected. The Minister answered that roughly 10% of NOW1 applicants need an accountant's statement, that the requirement and thresholds are kept with some relief measures, and that the ministry will reduce administrative burdens while retaining controls.
I have not yet received signals that significantly more companies will have to submit an accountant's statement than previously estimated.
Ik heb nog geen signalen ontvangen dat significant meer bedrijven een accountantsverklaring zullen moeten overleggen dan voorheen was ingeschat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over berichtgeving van de NOS over het uitkeren van winst in het buitenland na ontvangst van NOW-subsidie

An MP asks the minister why multinational parent companies receiving NOW wage subsidy may still pay dividends abroad, and whether a ban on profit distributions by parent companies would cost jobs. The minister answers that the bonus and dividend ban applies to the applicant entity and not to foreign group members, that he did not engage those companies directly, and that he intends to add an agreement-with-works-council condition to NOW4.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over het artikel 'Tozo-uitkering is halve sigaar uit eigen doos'

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs and the State Secretary of Finance about how child maintenance is treated as income under the Participatiewet and tax law, the legal basis for Belastingdienst tax assessments on Tozo benefits paid to partners, and whether those assessments should be scrapped. The minister defended the current treatment, said the Tozo is a household benefit with a legal basis for the tax assessments, and declined to offer a general solution, citing the lack of a legal basis for waiving the assessments.
There is no legal basis for waiving that levy.
Voor het achterwege laten van die heffing bestaat geen wettelijke basis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de zorgen van marktkooplieden en specifiek de zorgen van marktkooplieden in de non-food sector

An MP asked the government about the hardship faced by non-food market traders during the lockdown, the adequacy of COVID support schemes (TVL, TOZO), and calls for compensation, restart plans, tax leniency and municipal fee relief. The State Secretary answered that the support package is generic and cannot cover all cases, that no extra compensation or special restart scheme for market traders is planned, that a round table with large private creditors will be held, and that municipal fee relief is up to municipalities.
The cabinet sees no grounds to create an exceptional position for market traders and to provide additional compensation.
Het kabinet ziet geen grond om een uitzonderingspositie voor marktkooplieden te creëren en aanvullende compensatie te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Peters over "studenten met een beperking die nog steeds te weinig studietoeslag krijgen"

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the individual student allowance (IST) for students with disabilities, noting only eleven of the 25 largest municipalities pay the promised 300 euro and few students know of it. The minister said the allowance is municipal responsibility, pointed to a pending bill (Breed Offensief) to harmonise the amount, committed to talks with student organisations and a reminder to municipalities to pay 300 euro from age 21.
The implementation and setting of the amount of the IST is the competence and responsibility of the college of mayor and aldermen.
De uitvoering en het bepalen van de hoogte van de IST is de bevoegd- en verantwoordelijkheid van het college van B&W.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en De Neef over de Zembla-uitzending dat spoorwerkers al ruim 10 jaar worden blootgesteld aan gevaarlijk kwartsstof

Two VVD MPs asked ministers about a Zembla broadcast reporting that rail workers have been exposed to carcinogenic quartz dust for over ten years, asking about legal duties, inspection history, ProRail reports and station safety. The ministers answered in detail on the legal framework and past inspections, acknowledging ProRail's reports and ongoing investigations, but largely pointed to employer responsibility and did not commit to new measures beyond referring to existing inspection work.
ProRail had not shared these studies with the Inspectorate SZW until recently, but did so following the Zembla broadcast.
ProRail had deze onderzoeken tot voor kort niet met de Inspectie SZW gedeeld, maar heeft dit naar aanleiding van de uitzending van Zembla wel gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Ginneken over het bericht ‘'Gluurapparatuur' in trek door thuiswerken, vakbonden bezorgd’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Ginneken asked the Minister of Social Affairs about employers using monitoring equipment on home workers and the protections for workers' privacy. The minister answered that the same strict rules on monitoring apply whether work is done at home or in the office, and pointed to the works council's consent rights, the AVG, and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and Inspectie SZW roles.
It does not matter whether work takes place at home or at the workplace. The rules for monitoring employees are the same in both cases.
Het maakt niet uit of het werk thuis of op de werkplek plaatsvindt. De regels voor controle van werknemers zijn in beide gevallen gelijk.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het nieuwsbericht 'Gluurapparatuur» in trek door thuiswerken, vakbonden bezorg'

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Social Affairs about union concerns that employee monitoring of home workers was increasing during the pandemic, and whether employers' use of intrusive surveillance such as spyware should be discouraged. The minister replied that monitoring is allowed only under strict GDPR conditions that apply equally at home and in the workplace, that the government has no direct role in employer-employee monitoring agreements, and that 14 complaints about home-work monitoring were received by the Data Protection Authority in 2020.
In some cases it is permitted to monitor employees, but strict conditions have been set to safeguard employees' privacy.
Het is in sommige gevallen toegestaan om werknemers te controleren, maar hieraan zijn wel strikte voorwaarden gesteld om de privacy van werknemers te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de opkomst van digitale monitoring tijdens het thuiswerken

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about digital monitoring of employees during home working, union concerns, complaints to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, and whether the Inspectie SZW can act. The minister answers that monitoring is subject to strict GDPR conditions, that the AP rather than the Inspectie oversees this, that few complaints have been filed, and that employers and employees should agree on monitoring themselves.
There is no overview of how ministries, government agencies or implementing organisations use monitoring software.
Er is geen overzicht van de wijze waarop ministeries, overheidsinstanties of uitvoeringsorganisaties gebruik maken van monitoringsoftware.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over het bericht dat er meer ‘gluurapparatuur’ wordt ingezet

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of increased use of workplace monitoring software during telework, the scale of oversight by the Inspectorate and the Data Protection Authority, backlogs at the AP, and planned measures. The minister answers that monitoring is only allowed under strict conditions, that the AP is responsible for GDPR enforcement and complaints, that the Inspectorate lacks a legal basis, that the AP prioritises complaints, and promises the policy response to the Rathenau report before the summer recess.
Supervision of compliance with the GDPR lies with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP).
Het toezicht op de naleving van de AVG ligt bij de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Romke de Jong over de TONK

MPs Van Weyenberg and Romke de Jong (D66) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the TONK emergency living-cost support, including its scope relative to the TOZO, uneven municipal implementation, low payouts and strict conditions, and requested a comparison table of municipal rules. The minister replied that TONK covers necessary costs after income loss, that municipalities are being urged to apply it generously and are loosening rules with the extra budget, and that a comparison table is attached as a snapshot.
I have held constructive discussions with municipalities on several occasions about the objectives of TONK and the wish of the House of Representatives and the cabinet to apply TONK generously.
Ik heb op meerdere momenten constructieve gesprekken met gemeenten gevoerd over de doelstellingen van TONK en de wens van Tweede Kamer en kabinet om ruimhartig met de TONK om te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Alkaya over het bericht dat ProRail Spoorwerkers jarenlang heeft blootgesteld aan kankerverwekkend kwartsstof

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Infrastructure how ProRail and the labour inspectorate allowed rail workers to be exposed to carcinogenic quartz dust for years, and what will be done about enforcement, compensation and immediate remedies. The ministers answered that the inspectorate was aware of the risk since 2008, that ProRail and contractors acknowledged duty-of-care failures, that an inspectorate investigation into ProRail is ongoing, and that a compensation scheme for occupational disease victims is being prepared.
The Inspectorate SZW has started an investigation into ProRail's compliance in its role as employer and client and is in discussion with ProRail about improvements in its safety and health policy.

De Inspectie SZW is een onderzoek gestart naar de naleving door ProRail in haar rol als werkgever en als opdrachtgever en is met ProRail in gesprek over verbeteringen in het veiligheids- en gezondheidsbeleid van ProRail.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Boulakjar over het bericht 'Zembla: spoorwerkers worden al ruim 10 jaar blootgesteld aan gevaarlijk kwartsstof'

D66 MPs asked the government about reports that railway workers were exposed to carcinogenic quartz dust for over a decade, whether ProRail ignored advice to change ballast stone, whether ProRail should have reported its studies to the Labour Inspectorate, and related questions on enforcement and ProRail's status. The ministers said ProRail has commissioned studies, is following TNO advice to exclude three stone types temporarily, shared the studies with the inspectorate, and that the inspectorate enforces violations without size distinction.
The Ministry of IenW has received ProRail's research reports.
Het Ministerie van IenW heeft de onderzoeksrapporten van ProRail ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat veel bezwaren tegen de vaststelling van de NOW1-steun worden afgewezen

MP Stoffer asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that many objections to final NOW1 wage subsidy assessments are rejected and some firms must repay all support, and about how UWV handles repayment terms and objections. Minister Koolmees answers at length: repayment terms are extended and interest-free, objections are assessed individually with limited room for case-by-case flexibility, and figures on repayments and objection outcomes are provided.
Employers can now also agree online with UWV on a longer repayment period.
Werkgevers kunnen inmiddels ook online met UWV afspraken maken over een langere terugbetaaltermijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het bericht "Meldpunt toegang tot schuldhulpverlening voor ZZP’ers"

An MP asked the minister about the Nationale ombudsman's complaints point for self-employed people (ZZP'ers) denied debt assistance, and about support for municipalities, communication, and preparation if steun measures end. The minister replied that municipalities are responsible, cites guides, subsidies, campaigns and Belastingdienst's changed approach, but gives no figures and cannot guarantee non-refusal in every case.
This is a responsibility of municipalities. The Ministry of SZW has no data on this.
Dit is een verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten. Het Ministerie van SZW heeft hier geen gegevens over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het bericht ‘Kabinet: Voedselaanbod voor de voedselbanken op peil houden’

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs about expected growth in food bank demand, how it relates to ESF funding, and the social impact model for food production. The minister said demand growth is not yet clearly measured but a 7% rise was seen in 2020, that 3% of ESF+ funds will go to food aid with details still being negotiated, and that gemeenten are responsible for minima support.
On average VBNL saw a growth of 7% in 2020, with strong regional differences.
Gemiddeld zag VBNL een groei van 7% in 2020, met hierin sterke regionale verschillen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over de keuringsstop bij het UWV

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that UWV has effectively stopped carrying out first-year sick-leave assessments (EZWb), leaving thousands of employees and employers in limbo, and asks about backlog size, criteria, damage and remedies. The Minister confirms the backlog (about 23,473 EZWb cases, up 61% on 2020), admits only about 75% of assessments were carried out in early 2021, attributes this to a staff mismatch, and promises a two-year trial of new working methods without a concrete deadline for clearing the backlog.
In 25% of cases employees went through the entire waiting period without an EZWb assessment taking place.
In 25% van de gevallen hebben werknemers de gehele wachttijd doorlopen zonder dat er een EZWb heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over schadelijke beleggingen van pensioenfondsen

An MP from GroenLinks asks ministers whether pension funds investing in harmful sectors such as weapons, alcohol, cannabis and firms linked to land rights violations breach statutory duties on sustainability and beneficiary preferences, and whether the IMVB covenant is adequate. The minister replies that funds decide their own investments, points to the IMVB covenant, the Pensioenwet and IORP II reporting duties, and EU non-financial reporting reform, and promises no new binding measures.
Pension funds decide for themselves what they invest in; the cabinet does not decide that.
Pensioenfondsen bepalen zelf waarin zij beleggen, daar gaat het kabinet niet over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Omtzigt over het te veel uitkeren van kindgebonden budget aan arbeidsmigranten

Two CDA MPs asked why the Tax Administration pays the single-parent supplement of the child budget to migrant workers whose partners live abroad, and why the problem has persisted despite earlier warnings. The government acknowledges structural data gaps for non-resident partners, describes partial fixes and ongoing work, admits it cannot count affected migrant workers, and postpones the answers.
It is known that a total of about 5,000 single parents whose child does not live in the Netherlands were granted the child budget.
Wel is bekend dat in totaal aan circa 5.000 alleenstaande ouders waarvan het kind niet in Nederland woont kgb is toegekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat honderden Jumbo-medewerkers op zoek moeten naar een nieuwe baan

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about Jumbo's reorganisation eliminating jobs, pay gaps between cashiers and executives, workload, the cao negotiations and winstdeling legislation. The minister answered that reorganisation and pay are matters for the company and social partners, that the works council was consulted, that no forced dismissals are currently planned, and that the minimum wage decision is left to a future cabinet.
However, the cabinet is not responsible for the remuneration of executives of private companies.
Het kabinet gaat echter niet over de beloningen van bestuurders van private ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Belastingdienst weer in de fout: veel te veel toeslag voor arbeidsmigranten’

Two VVD MPs asked why the Tax Administration keeps granting the child-related budget with the single-parent supplement to migrant workers whose foreign partners are not registered, despite known errors since 2015. The government admits the verification process is complex, lists partial fixes since 2015 and promises proposals this year, but gives no count of affected migrants and no firm date for a structural solution.
It is not known in how many cases the Tax Administration wrongly assumes there is no partner.
Het is niet bekend in hoeveel gevallen er door de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen onterecht van wordt uitgegaan dat geen sprake is van een toeslagpartner.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het ongevraagd uitkeren van een te hoog kindgebonden budget

Two SP MPs asked why the Tax Administration over-pays the child-related budget (kindgebonden budget) to migrant workers and why these people face large recoveries, and how many cases are known. The ministers answer that the system relies on BRN/BSN partner data which is often missing for partners abroad, describe partial fixes and planned improvements, and say they will review collection policy and make some changes but do not quantify harm or commit to individual redress.
It is not known in how many cases the Tax Administration wrongly assumes there is no partner.
Het is niet bekend in hoeveel gevallen er door de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen onterecht wordt uitgegaan dat geen sprake is van een toeslagpartner.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over nieuwe fouten met de uitkering van toeslagen

Snels (GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Social Affairs about new errors in child-related allowance payments to migrant workers who are wrongly treated as single parents because their partner lives abroad, including delays, repayments and whether the Belastingdienst acts on evidence. The government acknowledged the structural difficulty in verifying foreign partner data, described the verwantschapsquery, the stopknop for refugees and new partner-submission forms, and said improvement proposals are expected this year, while declining to give figures on affected migrant workers.
It is not known how many migrant workers have reported that they wrongly received the single-parent supplement.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel arbeidsmigranten hebben aangeven dat zij onterecht een alo-kop hebben ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over gemeenten die bijstandsontvangers fors meer willen laten bijverdienen dan de Participatiewet toestaat

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about municipalities such as Amsterdam and Arnhem wanting to let welfare recipients earn up to 500 euro per month permanently, exceeding the Participatiewet limits, and whether this misuses the activation premium and conflicts with the wage-work incentive. The minister answered that the law does not allow this without reducing benefits, that the activation premium is legal only if aimed at labour integration and not structural, that Amsterdam has no concrete plans yet, and that he will inform municipalities via Gemeentenieuws and engage with them if signals of rule-breaking arrive.

If a municipality does not stay within the legal framework, a situation of legal inequality may arise. If I receive signals about this, I will consult with the municipality or municipalities concerned.

Indien een gemeente niet binnen de wettelijke kaders blijft, kan de situatie ontstaan dat rechtsongelijkheid wordt gecreëerd. Mochten mij daarover signalen bereiken, dan zal ik met de betreffende gemeente(n) in overleg treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Ceder over vastlopende hersteloperatie toeslagenschandaal

MPs Grinwis and Ceder asked whether the childcare benefit scandal restitution operation is stalling, why rejection letters after the light check lack a objection clause, whether the Catshuisregeling compromises care, and about moratorium, dossier access, and compensation capacity. The State Secretary answered that the operation is not stalling despite high workload, that the letter was amended to include an objection reference, and that all parents get an integral assessment with the moratorium and dossier processes described.
As a result, the letter was amended and the full legal remedies reference was included.
Naar aanleiding hiervan is de brief aangepast en is de volledige rechtsmiddelverwijzing wel opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Peters over het bericht ‘Kloosters vragen om compensatie, want ook broeders bijten in coronatijd op houtje'

MPs asked whether monasteries whose income from abbey shops and guesthouses fell due to COVID-19 can access compensation, and whether they should be treated like shops and hospitality businesses. The government answered that these organisations can use the generic COVID schemes (NOW, Tozo, TVL) if they meet the conditions, and it does not plan additional measures specifically for them.
The cabinet is not currently planning to introduce additional support measures specifically for this group, beyond the existing generic support measures.
Het kabinet is vooralsnog niet voornemens om, naast de bestaande diverse generieke steunmaatregelen, aanvullende ondersteuningsmaatregelen te treffen specifiek voor deze groep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de grote verschillen tussen hoe gemeenten omgaan met de TONK

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why the TONK emergency cost support differs strongly by municipality in amount and duration, and whether a minimum amount or common criteria would be set. The Minister answered that TONK runs under the special assistance framework, giving municipalities policy discretion, that the government urged generous application and doubled the budget, and that binding conditions are not appropriate given the decentralised nature of the scheme.
I cannot and do not want to set further conditions here; that does not fit the decentralised character of the TONK.
Nadere voorwaarden kan en wil ik hierbij niet stellen; dat past niet bij het decentrale karakter van de TONK.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kwint over een column van Rosanne Hertzberger in de NRC over de orthodox-Joodse school Cheider in Amsterdam

MPs Van Dijk and Kwint asked about alleged abuse at the Cheider school following a newspaper column, including corporal punishment, sexual abuse and a knife threat, and why the Inspectorate had not intervened. Minister Slob replied that recent inspections found no such incidents, that the school was under intensive supervision with sanctions imposed and suspended by a court, and that a bill to expand the Inspectorate's instruments is expected after the summer.
The inspectorate maintains intensive supervision of the school and has imposed two funding sanctions this school year on my behalf.
De inspectie houdt intensief toezicht op de school en heeft in dit schooljaar (2020/2021) namens mij twee bekostigingssancties opgelegd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Tjeerd de Groot over vertragingen bij de herbeoordeling van TVL-aanvragen

MPs Romke de Jong and Tjeerd de Groot asked about delays in re-assessing TVL aid objections caused by SBI-code problems, including progress, the Q4 2020 backlog, sailing-vessel skippers, and the application form. The State Secretary answered that 97.5% of re-assessments are done, the remainder will follow shortly, RVO has added capacity to prioritise these cases, and the system was adjusted so entrepreneurs see the correct SBI code.
The objections relating to the SBI problem are being handled with priority, also because of the effect on an application in the next application period.
De bezwaren die betrekking hebben op de SBI-problematiek worden met voorrang opgepakt, ook vanwege het effect op een aanvraag de volgende aanvraagperiode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over registratie etniciteit universitair personeel

An FvD MP asked the ministers whether ethnicity is registered for university staff, how the CBS Barometer Culturele Diversiteit defines and operationalises it, and what data universities use. The minister answered that the barometer uses only pseudonymised existing records (birth date, sex, postcode, salary scale and similar) to derive migration background in aggregate, that employees are not asked to answer questions, and that employees can opt out by email.
Employees do not have to answer any questions for the Barometer Culturele Diversiteit, in line with the answer to your question 2.
Medewerkers hoeven, in lijn met het antwoord op uw vraag 2, in het kader van de Barometer Culturele Diversiteit geen vragen te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het artikel 'Hoe je door de TOZO-regeling als ZZP’er in de schulden belandt'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about self-employed people who had to repay TOZO support despite initially qualifying, asking for leniency, access to TONK, and a longer repayment term without interest. The minister acknowledged confusion over alimony and student finance rules, urged municipalities to apply leniency, pointed to TONK as a local option, and said the cabinet is still considering the loan terms.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Renkema over de berichten dat mensen die niet thuis werken zich onveilig voelen op de werkvloer

MPs Smeulders and Renkema asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that non-home workers feel unsafe at work and fear COVID-19 infection, and what the government will do to ensure safe work, including inspection capacity and enforcement. The minister answered that employers have a duty of care, that workers should raise concerns with employers or works councils and can report to the Inspectorate SZW, and that the inspectorate has extended enforcement powers and capacity, but no new concrete commitments beyond existing measures were made.
With the Temporary COVID-19 Measures Act, the Inspectorate SZW has been given more powers to enforce.
Met de Wet tijdelijke maatregelen COVID-19 heeft de Inspectie SZW meer bevoegdheden gekregen om te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat de rechtbank opnieuw bevestigt dat Deliveroo-bezorgers gewoon werknemers zijn

An MP asked the minister whether the court ruling confirming Deliveroo couriers are employees would lead to enforcement against platform companies, and how the Tax Authority would act. The minister answered that the ruling is civil, workers can claim employment contracts, a legal presumption for platform workers is being prepared, and the Tax Authority assesses cases individually and cannot disclose information about individual taxpayers.
The Tax Authority does not make statements about individual taxpayers on the basis of its duty of confidentiality (article 67 of the General State Taxes Act).
De Belastingdienst doet over individuele belastingplichtigen geen uitspraak op grond van zijn geheimhoudingsplicht (artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Koerhuis over het bericht dat arbeidsmigranten onterechte kosten betalen voor huisvesting

MPs Wiersma and Koerhuis asked why the Roemer advisory team did not examine reports that migrant workers pay unlawful extra housing costs via intermediaries, and how supervision works. The minister answered that a landlord permit scheme is being prepared, that information initiatives exist, that the Inspectorate SZW and municipalities supervise within their own remits, and that no complete data on such practices is held.
At present I am preparing a law that would allow municipalities, if they wish, to impose nationally uniform rules on landlords.
Op dit moment ben ik bezig een wet voor te bereiden waarmee gemeenten desgewenst landelijk geüniformeerde voorschriften kunnen instellen voor verhuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘TONK steun veel minder aangevraagd dan verwacht’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that few people applied for the TONK support, whether municipalities apply a means test contrary to a motion, and how the scheme is monitored. The minister answered that municipalities have discretion within special assistance law, urged generous implementation, promised monitoring and continued consultation, and said it is too early to draw conclusions.
In a letter to municipalities I conveyed the wish of the House and the cabinet to apply this generously.
In een brief aan gemeenten heb ik de wens van de Kamer en het kabinet om hier ruimhartig mee om te gaan overgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de staking bij kolencentrale op de Maasvlakte

An SP MP asks the Economy and Climate minister why the owner of the Onyx coal plant requested a 238 million euro closure subsidy while allocating little for staff, and how the subsidy conditions and works council procedures protect employees. The minister replies that the subsidy is conditional on an adequate social plan and WOR procedures, that no agreement on the social plan exists yet, that the financial assessment and EU state-aid approval are pending, and that the minister is not a party to the social plan negotiations.
If the proposal submitted by Power Plant Rotterdam does not meet the stated requirements, the subsidy for the proposal will not be granted.
Als het voorstel dat door Power Plant Rotterdam is ingediend niet voldoet aan de gestelde eisen, wordt de subsidie voor het voorstel niet verleend.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Raan over de activiteiten van de KLM Flight Academy (KFA)

MP Van Raan asked about the rise in training flights at Groningen Airport Eelde in 2020 by the KLM Flight Academy, its turnover, NOW wage subsidy receipt of EUR 1.56 million, noise and environmental effects. The minister confirmed the 23% rise in movements, largely from training flights merged with Martinair, said turnover is booked per student progress and cannot be shown separately as it is confidential, and stated operations stay within noise limits and opening hours enforced by the ILT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over toezeggingen om in gesprek te gaan met Bureau Krediet Registratie

The MP asks whether the promised talks with BKR on shortening the registration period, especially for corona-related cases, have taken place, and whether people who have restored their finances are wrongly denied credit. The minister says talks occurred at official level, but sees no reason to shorten the five-year retention period because it protects against over-indebtedness, and points to kredietverstrekkers' individual assessment and the Geschillencommissie for disputes.
Given its importance, I currently see no reason to request shortening of the registration period used by BKR.
Gelet op het belang hiervan zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding te vragen om verkorting van de door BKR gehanteerde registratietermijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de uitvoering van toezeggingen en moties van het notaoverleg 'In Nederland beslis je over je eigen leven'

An MP from the VVD asked the ministers about implementation of motions and commitments on honour-related violence, forced marriage protection, female genital mutilation registration and the possible criminalisation of hymen restoration. The State Secretary replied that the government is following up on these motions through action programmes, investigations and working groups, with most results promised in later progress letters.
I informed your House on 18 March 2021 about the progress of the action agenda on harmful practices.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 18 maart 2021 geïnformeerd over de voortgang van de actieagenda schadelijke praktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie en het bericht 'Koolmees: geen aparte steunregeling voor sekswerkers'

An MP asked the ministers how people in prostitution can access income support and TONK during the COVID-19 crisis, including differences between municipalities and the status of a motion on exit support. The government replied that several schemes may apply depending on status, that TONK is locally implemented with variation, that municipalities are being engaged, and that a motion study will be answered in spring 2021.
The cabinet has asked municipalities to apply TONK generously.
Het kabinet heeft gemeenten verzocht de TONK ruimhartig toe te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over berichtgeving van de NOS over het uitkeren van winst in het buitenland na ontvangst van NOW-subsidie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether it is acceptable that companies receiving NOW wage subsidy have parent companies paying out dividends and bonuses, including abroad, and requested overviews, totals and job-loss figures. The minister defended the design of the ban (applying to the applicant entity and, for subsidiaries, the group), said the data on which parent companies paid out cannot be provided before final settlement, and that job-loss figures are unknown and not collected.
Dergelijke gegevens kan ik u niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de enorme schuld die de SVB een 80-jarige man heeft laten opbouwen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an 80-year-old man who was asked to repay nearly 5,000 euros after the SVB took a year to investigate a changed living situation, and whether similar cases exist. The minister explained that home visits were suspended during COVID, 14 comparable cases were identified and are being reassessed individually, and telephone investigations have since replaced home visits to prevent such delays.
In the case described in the Stentor, the assessment mistakenly did not follow the new work instructions.
In de casus zoals beschreven in de Stentor is de beoordeling abusievelijk niet conform de nieuwe werkinstructies verlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Palland over het bericht ‘Werkgevers: creatieve oplossing nodig voor meer stageplekken mbo’ers’

Two CDA MPs asked ministers whether creative solutions such as more trainees per company, variable internship length and retired supervisors could ease the shortage of MBO internship places, and what the SBB action plan has achieved. The minister answers that these options are already possible under the service document, cites about 20,000 students still seeking placements, and promises continued pressure on schools and employers and further action if needed.
If I find that this is not yet sufficient, I will work with SBB and other partners to ensure that the additional room from the service document is used as much as possible.
Als ik merk dat dit nog niet volstaat, zal ik mij samen met SBB en andere partners inspannen om te zorgen dat de extra ruimte uit het servicedocument zoveel mogelijk wordt benut.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de coronabesmetting van minister Ollongren

An SP MP asked why the car used by minister Ollongren had no partition screen between driver and passenger, whether the protocol covered a minister who learns they are infected, and whether the 25 March incident was evaluated. The government answered that RIVM rules are followed, screens can be fitted on request and some cars have them, a protocol for ministerial transport exists and the driver was supported and the protocol reinforced.
Following what happened, FMHaaglanden provided the driver in question with extra support.
Naar aanleiding van hetgeen is gebeurd heeft FMHaaglanden de betreffende chauffeur extra begeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over de zorgen bij Wajongers

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Social Affairs how many Wajong beneficiaries have lost income despite the guaranteed amount, why this was not examined earlier, and whether beneficiaries can choose their reference period and when they will learn their guaranteed amount. The minister acknowledges the signals, commits to an urgent UWV analysis and to informing parliament, rejects a self-chosen reference period as unworkable, and gives a timeline that delays guaranteed-amount decisions for self-employed beneficiaries until at least 2022.
I take the signals we receive about deterioration seriously. That is why I am now conducting an urgent analysis with UWV into the reasons why Wajongers are losing income.
