Ik neem de signalen die we ontvangen over achteruitgang serieus. Daarom voer ik nu met UWV met urgentie een analyse uit naar de redenen waarom Wajongers er op achteruitgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de zorg dat Wajongers erop achteruitgaan

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether Wajong recipients are losing income under the new law despite the guarantee amount, and about delays and the union FNV's warnings. The minister says UWV is urgently analysing possible unintended causes of income loss, reports that about 10,000 of 20,000 delayed guarantee amounts are now set, and says extra staff is not the solution while migration conversations are postponed to the second half of 2021.
I am carrying out an urgent analysis with UWV into the reasons for income loss.
Ik voer samen met UWV met urgentie een analyse uit naar de redenen van inkomensverlies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Zorgmedewerkers ervaren vaccinatiedruk'

MPs Palland and Van den Berg asked whether healthcare workers experience pressure to be vaccinated against COVID-19 from employers or colleagues, and what the government is doing about it. The ministers answered that vaccination must remain voluntary, that about 20 reports of perceived pressure reached unions while the inspectorates received almost none, and that the government relies on persuasion and advice rather than coercion.
Due to the confidentiality of the reports, they cannot provide further information about these reports.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van de meldingen kunnen zij geen nadere info verschaffen over deze meldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Kent over "de crisissteunmaatregelen voor amateursportverenigingen"

MPs Van Nispen and Van Kent asked why amateur sports clubs filing nil payroll returns for June 2020 are excluded from NOW 3.0 wage support while others get a fallback month, and asked for a fix. The minister says the rules are not unjust, points to the TASO scheme as a compensation route, and says the government is examining widening TASO for the first two quarters of 2021 without changing the NOW reference month.
In addition, it is being examined whether the TASO scheme for the first and second quarters of 2021 can be widened to support sports associations as appropriately as possible with wage costs.
Daarnaast wordt onderzocht of de TASO-regeling voor het eerste en tweede kwartaal van 2021 kan worden verruimd om sportverenigingen zo passend mogelijk te ondersteunen in de loonkosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Tielen over een bericht op Nu.nl met de titel ‘Sportclubs lopen miljoenen euro’s mis door ‘weeffout’ in NOW regels’

MPs Heerema and Tielen asked whether the NOW 3 wage-subsidy rule, which uses June 2020 as the reference month, unfairly excludes sports clubs and seasonal employers, and whether it can be fixed as was done for NOW 1 and 2. The minister defends June as the reference month to limit abuse and operational risk, says changing it now is not feasible, notes that some sports clubs can claim through the TASO scheme instead, and does not provide the requested data on rejected applications.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Von Martels over "amateurvoetbalverenigingen die in financiële problemen komen vanwege een bureaucratische regel van de overheid"

Two CDA MPs asked why amateur football clubs miss NOW 3.0 wage compensation because June 2020 was chosen as the reference month, when many clubs have no trainers on payroll during the summer break. The minister acknowledges the problem but says no fix is possible without undue risk, points clubs to the TASO scheme, and says the government is looking at extending TASO for the first and second quarters.
The cabinet hopes in this way to meet the amateur clubs.
Het kabinet hoopt hiermee de amateurclubs tegemoet te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Bromet, Kröger en Buitenweg over misstanden in de transportsector

MPs asked whether TLN and PostNL tried to influence a study into criminal abuse and labour exploitation in the transport sector, and what the government will do with its findings. The minister answered that TLN commissioned the study, that the ministry only co-sat on the steering group and held a subsidy, that the methodology was judged sound, and that a cabinet response will follow in spring.
I will study the outcomes and discuss them with TLN and the Minister of SZW, among others.
Ik ga de uitkomsten bestuderen en onder meer met TLN en de Minister van SZW bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat sekswerkers tijdens de lockdown met meer geweld te maken krijgen

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked why sex workers, many outside the income-support schemes during the lockdown, face more violence and financial distress and whether a special support measure and police assurances for victims are planned. The minister acknowledged the concern, explained which schemes (Tozo, WW, NOW, bijstand, TONK) may apply depending on employment status, said the police will not fine victims reporting crime, and promised to raise the signals with municipalities.
The cabinet has asked municipalities to apply the TONK generously.
Het kabinet heeft gemeenten verzocht de TONK ruimhartig toe te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat een D66-campagnefoto zes voorpagina’s heeft gehaald

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked about a D66 campaign photo that appeared on six front pages, asking whether photo credits matter for photojournalism, whether political control over journalistic images is desirable, the status of minimum rates for journalists, and the position of freelance photojournalists during COVID-19. The minister answered that source attribution is important, that journalistic independence must be respected, that binding fair practice rules now apply to public broadcasters and talks on a publishing-sector code are ongoing, and that COVID support measures were available to freelancers, without committing to new action.
Journalistic independence is a great good and a strong pillar of our democratic society, in which journalists act as a sound counterweight to politics and government.
Journalistieke onafhankelijkheid is een groot goed en een sterke pijler van onze democratische samenleving, waarin journalisten als een gedegen tegenmacht van politiek en overheid fungeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Aartsen over “signalen van kleine werkgevers die recht hebben op compensatie voor de transitievergoeding, maar niet in staat zijn de transitievergoeding vóór te financieren”

MPs Tielen and Aartsen asked the Minister of Social Affairs about small employers unable to prefinance the transition payment (transitievergoeding) for dismissals after long-term illness, and whether UWV could advance compensation. The Minister acknowledged the problems but refused to change the compensation schemes or allow UWV advance payments, citing legal and administrative complications, and said the start date of the illness-based scheme is not yet known.
However, it is not yet possible at this time to indicate when the compensation scheme for business termination due to illness of the employer can enter into force.
Het is op dit moment echter nog niet mogelijk om aan te geven wanneer de compensatieregeling bedrijfsbeëindiging wegens ziekte in werking kan treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Aartsen over ''pensioenfondsen die hurende ondernemers het vel over de oren halen''

MPs Amhaouch and Aartsen asked whether pension funds that own shops and restaurant premises are pressing tenant entrepreneurs hit by the COVID crisis with rent increases and indexation, and what the government will do. The minister says pension funds generally do not own such property, that most tenants reached individual accommodation deals, that pain should be shared fairly, and that the government keeps talking with the parties but leaves negotiations to private actors.
It is not centrally recorded how many and which pension funds own shop and restaurant premises, or how many and which invest in shop and restaurant property.
Er wordt niet centraal bijgehouden hoeveel en welke pensioenfondsen eigenaar zijn van winkel- en horecapanden en hoeveel en welke pensioenfondsen beleggen in winkel- en horecavastgoed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het artikel 'Pensioenfonds Levensmiddelen wil af van dreigende korting'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a planned pension cut at the Levensmiddelen sector pension fund for supermarket workers, arguing it is hard to justify alongside corporate profits, executive bonuses and state aid. The minister answered that the cut is about 0.85% per year, that the fund's own estimate puts most retirees at about 2 euro per month or less, that the 90% coverage floor under the temporary exemption is a limit he will not loosen, and that a specific fund exemption would need DNB review.
I consider it undesirable to amend the exemption scheme I published at the end of last year.
Ik vind het onwenselijk de vrijstellingsregeling die ik eind vorig jaar heb gepubliceerd aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over ''experimenten met pensioenregelingen voor zelfstandigen''

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the risk that many self-employed people save too little for retirement and about the scope of planned experiments opening second-pillar pension schemes to them. The minister answered that the experiments are part of the upcoming pension bill, that the four-year duration and opt-in design were chosen for reasons of scope and legal consistency, and that options such as opt-out, data sharing, withdrawals and tax changes are still being studied.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over grootschalige en onrechtmatige verzameling van data van burgers door de krijgsmacht, de politie, de Belastingdienst, de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten en andere overhei

An MP from D66 asked several ministers about large-scale and unlawful data collection on citizens by the armed forces (LIMC), police systems, UWV (SONAR), the Tax Service, and COA-police data sharing, including whether these comply with GDPR and oversight rules. The ministers acknowledged shortcomings, described remediation steps such as stopping LIMC collection pending an internal review, phasing out SONAR, and ending COA data sharing, while deferring some matters to ongoing investigations and to a future cabinet on AP funding.
If it turns out that government organisations are not or insufficiently able to do so, the cabinet will discuss this with the relevant body.
Indien blijkt dat overheidsorganisaties hier niet of onvoldoende toe in staat zijn, dan gaat het kabinet hierover met het desbetreffende onderdeel in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat president Erdogan een grote rol speelt in opkomst salafisme in Nederland

An MP asked ministers about reports that Erdogan plays a major role in the rise of Salafism in the Netherlands, citing a leaked confidential NCTV analysis. The minister declined to discuss the draft analysis's content, pointed to existing government positions and a forthcoming analysis, and described existing measures against online terrorist content.
As indicated, I cannot go into the content of the draft analysis.
Zoals aangegeven kan ik niet ingaan op de inhoud van de conceptanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over werkzaamheden onder Europese aanbestedingsregels bij Schiphol

D66 MP Van Weyenberg asked ministers whether Schiphol's security tendering under EU rules, with contracts of at least four years and a change of providers in December 2020, shifts the collapse in passenger-related demand onto security firms who cannot claim the NOW wage subsidy, and whether Schiphol as a state-owned company should take responsibility. The ministers answered that Schiphol handled the tender and rebalancing under EU rules, that the NOW wage subsidy does not cover staff not on the payroll and the firms' eligibility rules apply, and that Schiphol says security remains adequately guaranteed and works with the firms to manage capacity risks.
Schiphol tenders the work under the European procurement rules and thereby takes responsibility for properly tendering the security work at Schiphol, as may be expected of a state-owned company.

Schiphol besteedt de werkzaamheden aan via de Europese aanbestedingsregels en neemt daarmee de verantwoordelijkheid voor het juist aanbesteden van de beveiligingswerkzaamheden op Schiphol zoals van een staatsdeelneming mag worden verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over deeltijd-WW

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about implementing the adopted motion on a deeltijd-WW (partial unemployment benefit) scheme, UWV capacity, timelines and stakeholder involvement. The minister answered that a structural scheme is being explored with UWV, that the 2008-09 model cannot simply be reinstated due to 2015 WWZ changes, that UWV capacity is limited until around 2022, that the scheme will take several years and be left to the next cabinet, and that social partners will be consulted.
However, I leave the elaboration of, and decision-making on, such a scheme to the next cabinet.
De uitwerking van – en besluitvorming over – een dergelijke regeling laat ik echter over aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Geheime ‘Turkije analyse’ NCTV lekt uit: grote rol Erdogan bij opkomst salafisme in Nederland'

MPs Becker and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked the government about a leaked confidential NCTV analysis linking Erdogan to the rise of salafism in the Netherlands, and about follow-up on related motions. The Minister declined to discuss the draft analysis's contents, referred to existing policy and a forthcoming final analysis, and answered the remaining questions largely by pointing to ongoing work and existing frameworks.
At this moment I cannot address the questions posed by your House about the content of the draft analysis.
Ik kan op dit moment niet ingaan op door uw Kamer gestelde vragen over de inhoud van de conceptanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over door NOW gratis overwerken

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether employers may force workers to make up hours lost to COVID closures, whether this is permitted, whether the Labour Inspectorate will act, and whether NOW wage subsidies should be tightened retroactively. The minister replied that employers bear the wage risk and generally cannot compel make-up hours unless a collective agreement provides otherwise, that enforcement is for social partners or courts, and that tightening NOW retroactively is neither possible nor desirable.
It is not possible and not desirable to tighten the scheme on this point with retroactive effect.
Het is niet mogelijk en niet wenselijk om de regeling op dit punt met terugwerkende kracht aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de coronabesmetting van minister Ollongren

An SP MP asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Health about Minister Ollongren entering her official car with driver shortly after learning she had COVID-19, and about whether driver and workplace protections were followed. The government answers that the protocol for official transport was followed, the minister tested as a contact and did not need quarantine, and the driver's employer met its duty of care, while withholding further driver details on privacy grounds.
For reasons of privacy, no further information is provided about the driver.
Vanwege privacy wordt geen verdere informatie verstrekt over de chauffeur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat een directeur zijn eigen journalisten wil volgen met een geheime camera

An MP asked whether a regional broadcaster director may covertly camera-monitor and read the e-mails of his own journalists, and whether the government will investigate and intervene. The minister answered that covert camera surveillance is in principle prohibited and e-mail reading is limited by GDPR and works-council consent, that the director withdrew his plans, and that the matter is an internal one for L1 now before the Enterprise Chamber.
In principle this concerns an internal matter of L1.
In beginsel betreft dit een interne aangelegenheid van L1.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het artikel ‘Union busting in de polder’

An MP from the Labour party asked the minister whether unilateral 2.5 percent wage increases agreed among supermarket employers, bypassing unions and stalled collective agreements, conflict with ILO conventions and competition law. The minister answered that wage-setting is for social partners under freedom of contract, that ILO oversight and court review are the relevant avenues, and that the competition authority ACM has started an exploratory investigation whose outcome it will await.
I am not aware to what extent the supermarket employers or employer organisations concerned agreed on this among themselves.
Het is mij niet bekend in hoeverre de betreffende supermarktwerkgevers dan wel werkgeversorganisaties daar onderling afspraken over hebben gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over 'onveilige distributiecentra'

MPs Van Kent and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that seven in ten distribution centres violated COVID and safety rules, and about enforcement, sanctions and worker safety. The minister acknowledged the concern, described Inspectorate SZW's inspections, enforcement tools and the temporary shutdown power, but declined to provide a list of individual violations and gave no exact figures for migrant workers infected at work.
I cannot make statements about individual companies or ongoing investigations, nor provide lists.
Over individuele bedrijven of lopende onderzoeken kan ik geen uitspraken doen of lijsten aanleveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over marktkooplieden in de non-food sector, die nog steeds niet open mogen

An MP asked the Justice, Social Affairs and Economic Affairs ministers why non-food market traders may still not reopen, why they are excluded from click & collect, NOW and TVL support, and whether the Tozo partner-income test and market fees can be relaxed. The minister answered that epidemiological conditions do not yet allow reopening, that the partner-income test will be kept for capacity and equality reasons, and that municipalities decide on market fees without a separate compensation scheme.
The cabinet does not intend to abolish the partner income test in the Tozo.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens de partnerinkomenstoets in de Tozo af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over de Tozo en belastingaangifte

MP Smeulders asked whether Tozo-1 income support for self-employed persons, paid as a household allowance, could be clawed back via income tax, leaving recipients below welfare level, and whether recipients were informed. Minister Koolmees answered that clawback is limited to partner income unaccounted for, cannot push recipients below the welfare level, that recipients were informed via municipalities, and pointed to Belastingdienst payment deferral options.
Self-employed persons were already informed about this during Tozo 1 via municipalities, the central government website and organisations for self-employed persons.
Zelfstandigen zijn hierover al tijdens Tozo 1 geïnformeerd via gemeenten, de site van de rijksoverheid en via organisaties voor zelfstandigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smals over de uitzending van RTL Boulevard over Stichting SIGNI van zondag 28 februari 2021

MP Smals asks the Minister of Social Affairs about an RTL Boulevard broadcast and a fine imposed by the Inspectorate SZW on volunteer search foundation SIGNI for diver safety violations, asking about the effect on volunteer initiatives, the legal basis for volunteer diving, and dialogue. The minister confirms the fine is under objection, says volunteers are covered by safety rules for hazardous work, and offers talks with SIGNI.
The Inspectorate SZW always looks at the facts and circumstances of the individual case when determining sanctions.
De Inspectie SZW kijkt bij het bepalen van sancties altijd naar de feiten en omstandigheden van het individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Terpstra over het uit zijn huurhuis zetten van een bejaarde man door sociale woningcorporatie Stek in Lisse

MPs Peters and Terpstra asked whether housing corporation Stek should refrain from evicting a 76-year-old man from his social rental home in Lisse, given the COVID-19 agreement not to evict tenants, and what instruments the government has to enforce it. The minister replied that the case falls outside the agreement because the eviction rests on persistent nuisance rather than rent arrears, that an alternative temporary housing solution has been found, and that the eviction was postponed to 5 April.
The specific situation you ask me about falls outside the scope of the agreements in the statement.
De specifieke situatie waar u mij over bevraagt, valt daarmee buiten de reikwijdte van de afspraken in het statement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Jong over de boete die is opgelegd aan Stichting SIGNI Zoekhonden

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers why a EUR 4,800 fine was imposed on the volunteer search foundation SIGNI Zoekhonden under working conditions rules and whether it would be withdrawn or the rules changed. Minister Koolmees answered that the fine concerns diver safety rules, that the objection procedure is ongoing and proportionality will be reassessed, that the fine has been paid, and that he is willing to discuss the rules with the foundation but will not change them now.
In the Inspectorate SZW's judgment the foundation initially provided insufficient evidence, so there was no reason to reduce the fine.
Naar het oordeel van de Inspectie SZW heeft de stichting initieel onvoldoende bewijs aangeleverd, waardoor geen reden bestond om de boete te matigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Smeulders over de onderbetaling van medewerkers bij de Coronacallcenters

MPs Smeulders and Kröger asked why the government again contracted Teleperformance for the corona callcenters, whether working conditions and pension accrual were tender criteria, and whether the government would intervene on underpayment and pensions. The minister replied that GGD GHOR chose Teleperformance because no other party could deliver in time, that the contract required compliance with labour law and any applicable CAO, and that the government is not the formal employer so it will not intervene or meet Teleperformance.
As far as I am aware, there are no signals that Teleperformance does not comply with the applicable laws and regulations or fails to apply any applicable CAO.
Voor zover mij bekend zijn er geen signalen dat Teleperformance niet voldoet aan de geldende wet-en regelgeving en een eventueel geldende cao niet toepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat dak- en thuislozen in Breda gekort worden op hun uitkering omdat de 'financiële prikkel' ontbrak

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that Breda cut social assistance for homeless people to create a financial incentive to leave homelessness, and whether this is acceptable and whether it has helped anyone. The minister answered that municipalities may lower the assistance norm when housing costs are absent or low, that individual assessment applies, that scrutiny of Breda is for the municipal council rather than the national government, and that no national change is planned.
The municipal council is primarily responsible for monitoring the municipal executive in this matter, not the national government, which should not pass judgment on it.
Het is primair de gemeenteraad die de bevoegd- en verantwoordelijkheid heeft om het college van B&W in deze te controleren, en niet aan het Rijk om hier een oordeel over te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het IMVB-convenant Pensioenfondsen

An MP asked the ministers about the slow implementation of the IMVB pension fund covenant, including the monitoring commission's findings, passive investments and accountability. The minister acknowledged the shortfall, attributed it partly to the late toolkit, promised an action plan and enhanced support, and said the covenant has no legal consequences.
Failing to meet the agreed commitments has no legal consequences.
Het niet halen van vastgelegde afspraken heeft geen juridische consequenties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het artikel 'Tozo-uitkering is halve sigaar uit eigen doos'

An MP asks whether the Tozo self-employment benefit, by counting toward a partner's income, forces families to repay tax credits and loonheffing and whether child maintenance should be excluded. The Minister replies that partner income was not counted in Tozo 1 for speed, that repayments are limited to the partner's share, that the Tozo is calculated under the Participatiewet and no changes are planned.
I therefore see no reason to change this.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om dit aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Zonder kleding voor de klas in nieuw NPO-Zappprogramma’

An MP asked the ministers whether a children's NPO Zapp programme showing nude adults to primary-school pupils is pedagogically acceptable, whether it conforms to the Kijkwijzer classification and parental consent, and whether the broadcast should be stopped. The minister replied that media content is for the public broadcaster and parents to judge, that the programme was classified 'Alle Leeftijden' by NICAM with Rutgers input and consent obtained, and that the government cannot ask the NPO to refrain from broadcasting because prior review is prohibited.
It is therefore not appropriate for the government to appeal to the NPO or the broadcasters to refrain from broadcasting.
Het past dan ook niet dat de overheid een appél doet op de NPO of de omroepen om van uitzending af te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over sociale ondernemingen die niet alle coronasteun ontvangen

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether social enterprises such as De Oude Keuken, which may have an incorrect SBI code, are excluded from COVID support and whether extra aid will be given. The State Secretary replied that TVL support is now open to all sectors regardless of SBI code, that the HVA surcharge applies only to SBI code 56, and that businesses can appeal to RVO.nl, while noting ongoing consultation with Social Enterprise Nederland.
From the fourth quarter of 2020, all sectors can use the TVL (except financial institutions) regardless of the SBI code.
Vanaf het vierde kwartaal 2020 kunnen alle sectoren gebruik maken van de TVL (met uitzondering van de financiële instellingen) ongeacht de SBI-code.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over hulp aan onverzekerden

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether damage suffered by a bystander who gave emergency aid to an uninsured homeless person can be recovered, and whether a guarantee fund for civilian first responders should be explored. The state secretary answered that volunteers are generally covered by municipal insurance and other avenues exist, so no guarantee fund is needed.
For civilian first responders who have registered as volunteers, such as the 225,000 civilian first responders registered through the HartslagNu alert system, a guarantee fund is not necessary.
Voor burgerhulpverleners die zich hebben aangemeld als vrijwilliger, zoals de 225.000 burgerhulpverleners die zich hebben aangemeld via het oproepsysteem HartslagNu, is een waarborgfonds niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat de FNV met stakingen dreigt op Schiphol

MPs Laçin (SP) asked the ministers whether they would respond to FNV threats of strikes at Schiphol, the number of ground handlers, wage competition, living wages and the motion on social establishment requirements. The minister answered that strikes are a legal right, that a study into social establishment requirements and handler numbers is underway with results expected in spring, and that wages and contracts are primarily the responsibility of companies and collective bargaining partners.
I am awaiting the outcomes of the study.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van het onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'Schuifdakenfabrikant Inalfa Venray zet zeker 190 mensen op straat'

MPs Amhaouch and Palland (CDA) asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Social Affairs about the planned loss of at least 190 jobs at Inalfa Venray, the regional impact, and industrial policy. The minister answered that no direct government contact with Inalfa occurred before the reorganisation, that the regional labour market can help affected workers, that the R&D subsidy scheme will open by 15 May 2021, and that a regional SWOT analysis is not considered necessary.
To date there has been no direct contact between the central government and Inalfa about the impending reorganisation at the company.
Er is tot op heden geen direct contact geweest tussen de rijksoverheid en Inalfa over de op handen zijnde reorganisatie bij het bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over blootstelling van werknemers aan vervuilde en schadelijke lucht op luchthaven Schiphol

Two MPs (Lacin and Van Kent, SP) asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Social Affairs about workers' exposure to jet exhaust and ultrafine particles at Schiphol, including use of Copenhagen-style push-back, single-engine taxiing, an inspectorate review, and worker involvement in the measurement programme. The ministers answered that employers are responsible for protective measures, that TNO's measurement programme was delayed by Covid-19 and will start in Q2 2021 with a worker sounding board, and that they decline to adopt the Danish approach or to ask the Inspectorate to investigate now.

The measurement programme that TNO, in consultation with RIVM, formulated on the basis of scientific insights and considerations, will be presented and discussed in this sounding board before the measurements are carried out.

Het meetprogramma dat TNO in overleg met het RIVM op basis van wetenschappelijke inzichten en afwegingen heeft geformuleerd, wordt vóór de metingen uitgevoerd in deze klankbordgroep gepresenteerd en besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over het bericht dat Maersk 24 Nederlandse werknemers op straat zet

MPs Laçin and Van Kent asked ministers about Maersk removing 24 Dutch seafarers' ships from the Dutch flag and whether the company was replacing them with cheaper foreign workers. The minister regrets the reflagging but says it is an internal company matter, that the flag state governs crew conditions, and that social dumping through flag choice would be regarded as undesirable, while declining to comment on the union agreement or intervene with Maersk.
Since this concerns individual company policy, it is not for me to form a judgement on this choice.
Aangezien het hier om individueel bedrijfsbeleid gaat, is het niet aan mij om een oordeel over deze keuze te vormen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het delen van een Europees advies over de Tozo

MP Palland asked whether the European Commission requested an advice on the Tozo from MoveS network experts, whether it would be shared with the Chamber, and when answers to earlier questions on the Tozo for cross-border entrepreneurs would be sent. The minister confirmed the Commission provided two opinions (June and July 2020) at SZW's request, released them anonymised and with consent, stated they are not the Commission's position, and gave the date the earlier answers were sent.
The European Commission made the advice available at the request of SZW and agreed to its publication.
De Europese Commissie heeft het advies op verzoek van SZW beschikbaar gesteld en heeft ingestemd met openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar, Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het herleven van een studieschuld na afronding van een WSNP

SP MPs asked why people who exited a debt-restructuring (WSNP) procedure received letters demanding resumption of student loan repayments at amounts unaffordable on a modest income, and whether DUO would soften this. The minister explained repayment is frozen during the procedure, admitted the letters can be unexpected and too high before income-based assessment, and said DUO will now phone debtors first where income is unknown and clarify the letters.
After consultation with DUO, it has therefore been decided no longer to announce the resumption of collection solely by letter.
Na overleg met DUO is dan ook besloten om niet langer uitsluitend per brief aan te kondigen dat de inning wordt herstart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het maximum SV-loonbedrag in de NOW

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why the planned reduction of the NOW wage-subsidy ceiling was reversed, how this fits with stricter support for self-employed, in which sectors such wages occur, and whether the ceiling will be lowered. The minister answered that the lockdown extension makes a cut undesirable, explained the sector breakdown from the November 2020 payment data, declined a company-level breakdown on workload grounds, and refused to lower the ceiling.
Breaking down by company is very labour-intensive and given the workload I did not ask UWV to do this.
Het uitsplitsen in bedrijven is zeer arbeidsintensief en gezien de werkdruk heb ik UWV dit niet gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht 'Pensioenfondsen vrezen verlaging van pensioenen in de komende jaren'

MP Van Brenk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about pension funds fearing pension cuts after 2021, including the discount rate, monetary policy effects and the transition to the new pension system. The minister answered that transition rules may require cuts for some funds but aim to ease them, and defended the current discount-rate framework while acknowledging the trade-offs.
My main starting point for the transition FTK is the move to the new pension system.
Mijn belangrijkste uitgangspunt bij het transitie-ftk is de overstap naar het nieuwe pensioenstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over de steunmaatregelen voor schoonheidsspecialisten

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the government will give extra COVID support to beauty specialists, many of whom face bankruptcy, and whether the partner test in the Tozo excludes self-employed beauticians from aid, and asked to meet their trade body Anbos. The government replied that the sector benefits from the TVL and NOW expansions, that self-employed beauticians may apply for Tozo, that the new TONK may help those excluded by the partner test, and that it is willing to talk with Anbos.
I am of course willing to talk with Anbos about the support and recovery package and the specific situation of beauty specialists within it.
Ik ben uiteraard bereid om met de Anbos in gesprek te gaan over het steun- en herstelpakket en de specifieke situatie van de schoonheidsspecialisten daarin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Alkaya en Jasper van Dijk over het SchuldenLabNL

MPs asked why the government appointed former finance minister Zalm, who is under OM investigation for money laundering, as chair of SchuldenLabNL, and whether private creditors would cooperate on debts of parents in the childcare benefits affair. The state secretary replied that SchuldenLabNL is an independent foundation the cabinet had no role in appointing its board, that the board is unpaid, and that talks with public and private creditors are ongoing to give affected parents a fresh start.
The cabinet has no involvement whatsoever in appointing Mr Zalm as chair or in appointing the other board members of SchuldenLabNL.
Het kabinet heeft geen enkele bemoeienis met het benoemen van de heer Zalm als voorzitter alsmede met de benoeming van andere leden van het bestuur van SchuldenlabNL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over ondernemers in Groningen en Fryslân die knel komen te zitten

MPs Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk and Moorlag asked whether start-up businesses hit by COVID-19 measures, such as hairdressers and hospitality firms without a reference turnover, are adequately compensated and whether the schemes could be changed. The State Secretary replied that a new Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme will cover start-ups' fixed costs, that monthly turnover calculations are not feasible, and that fully closed sectors get up to 85% fixed-cost subsidy.
With the new Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme, the cabinet wants to give these entrepreneurs a reasonable subsidy for their fixed costs.
Met de nieuwe regeling Tegemoetkoming Starters wil het kabinet deze ondernemers een redelijke subsidie bieden voor hun vaste lasten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat ondernemers een fors deel van de NOW-steun plus een ‘boete’ moeten terugbetalen

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether NOW wage-subsidy recipients must repay extra 'fines' when payroll falls or January payroll was high, hurting small firms. The Minister denies any fine exists, explains the payroll-correction mechanism, rejects individual or systematic relief, but extends the claims window and offers longer repayment terms.
There is no question of a fine.
Er is geen sprake van een boete.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het artikel ‘Monique kreeg coronasteun en moet nu fors terugbetalen’

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that entrepreneurs must repay part of their NOW corona wage subsidy advances, sometimes without fraud, and about how UWV calculates repayments. The minister explains the calculation logic, defends not reversing the system, rejects sanctions without fraud, and offers extended repayment terms and an open window for final assessments, while refusing to pause final assessments.
It is incorrect that entrepreneurs must pay a sanction if the wage bill has fallen for a reason outside their control or if turnover proves higher than estimated in advance.
Het is onjuist dat ondernemers een sanctie moeten betalen als de loonsom is gedaald door een reden die buiten hun invloedssfeer ligt of als de omzet hoger blijkt te zijn dan vooraf ingeschat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen, Tielen en Nijkerken-De Haan over problemen die ondernemers ervaren bij het lopende steun- en herstelpakket

Three VVD MPs asked the government about business complaints over implementation problems in the COVID support packages (TVL, NOW, starters, TONK), including quarterly calculation, excluded starters, events and retail schemes, and capacity. The State Secretary answered that the government is aware of gaps, lists sector consultations and adjustments made, explains why monthly calculation and full starter support were not feasible, and promises further information and wider publicity on the TONK.
At present the cabinet has no insight into the size of this group or exactly which businesses fall under it.
Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen zicht op de grootte van deze groep en welke bedrijven hier precies onder vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Wörsdörfer over signalen over problematiek samenhangend met de overgang van statushouders van een AZC naar de gemeente

VVD MPs asked how status holders are transferred from asylum reception centres to municipalities, what factors guide placement, what funding and information municipalities receive, and whether their care needs and municipal difficulties are being addressed. The State Secretary explained the COA-to-municipality matching and information-sharing process, noted some information gaps and a review underway, and stated that funding and care needs are handled under the same criteria as other residents, with an Ombudsman investigation into unaccompanied minors pending.
Your House will be informed about this shortly.
Uw Kamer wordt hierover op korte termijn geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Wiersma over het artikel 'Soms blijkt een diploma van leerfabriek NCOI bitter weinig waard'

MPs Tielen and Wiersma (VVD) asked the ministers of Education and Social Affairs about a Trouw article on the limited value of NCOI diplomas, the scarcity of modular adult education, NVAO and inspectorate roles, and corona rules for distance learning. The minister answered that flexibilisation measures are underway, that the inspectorate is investigating NCOI's diploma claims with results expected before summer 2021, and that modular accreditation questions are deferred to a later cabinet.
Supervision of compliance with laws and regulations is after all assigned to the inspectorate.
Het toezicht op naleving van wet- en regelgeving is immers belegd bij de inspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Van Weyenberg over instroom in de WIA van mensen met ME/CVS

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Van Weyenberg asked whether people with ME/CVS who cannot work are not classed as fully incapacitated, whether WIA reassessments rely on outdated assessments, and about appeals, regional inflow and the Raemakers motion. Minister Koolmees answered that UWV assesses earning capacity case by case, that a fresh WIA claim assessment is always done by an occupational physician, that the Raemakers motion is being implemented, and gave appeal and regional inflow figures.
An insured person with ME/CVS may be eligible for a reassessment if the occupational physician found at the previous assessment that the insured person had not done enough to recover.

Een verzekerde met ME/CVS komt mogelijk in aanmerking voor een herbeoordeling indien de verzekeringsarts bij de vorige beoordeling heeft vastgesteld dat de verzekerde niet voldoende gedaan had aan zijn herstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het rapport 'Houding en gebruik MKB-ontzorg-verzekering'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about low uptake of the MKB sick-pay insurance product, its higher premiums, the effect of shortening the sick-pay period, and whether support for small employers will work. The minister answered that the product is in a start-up phase, that uptake is expected to grow, and that the alternative package of measures is being implemented, while defending the product and noting the premium effect of shorter sick pay is an estimate from insurers.
There are no figures available that give insight into the use and awareness of the MKB sick-pay insurance across the different sectors.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend die inzicht geven in het gebruik en de bekendheid van de MKB verzuim-ontzorg-verzekering tussen de verschillende sectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat er mogelijk bezuinigd gaat worden op de kinderbijslag

An SGP MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs why families with children must fund extra costs at the UWV and SVB through non-indexation of child benefit, and whether this fits a reliable government in a crisis. The minister answers that the cuts fund a strengthening of implementation agencies, that the income effect is limited (median -0.1% cumulatively), and that overall family support has been increased.
The cabinet proposes to partly cover this investment by not indexing child benefit in 2022 and 2023, and partly in 2024.
Het kabinet stelt voor om een deel van deze investering te dekken door de kinderbijslag in 2022 en 2023 niet, en in 2024 deels niet te indexeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Postma over het bericht "Thuiswerken met peuter of baby? Dat is een illusie''

MPs Palland and Postma asked the minister about parents struggling to combine work, schooling and childcare during the lockdown, and about calls for a temporary corona leave scheme like those in Belgium, Germany, Austria and Norway. The minister says the situation has improved since reopening, relies on employer-employee agreements and collective labour agreements, and says no feasible extra corona leave scheme was found in talks with social partners, promising to inform the House further.
I will inform you further about this in response to the Smeulders/Van Weyenberg motion of 28 January 2021.
Ik zal u hierover nader informeren als reactie op de motie Smeulders / Van Weyenberg van 28 januari 2021
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de afgebroken CAO-onderhandelingen bij de supermarkten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the record supermarket turnover in 2020 and early 2021 justifies a wage increase for supermarket staff, and whether the minister would appeal to employers and raise the minimum wage. The minister answered that wage bargaining in the supermarket CAO is for the social partners, declined to intervene or make a moral appeal, and said he does not intend to raise the statutory minimum wage in the remaining cabinet term.
It is up to the employers' and employees' organisations involved to negotiate the working conditions and conclude a collective agreement.
Het is aan de betrokken werkgevers(organisaties) en werknemersorganisaties om te onderhandelen over de arbeidsvoorwaarden en een cao af te sluiten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het korten van de WIA-uitkering voor Nederlanders die in België werken en waarvan de werkgevers een beroep doet op het stelsel vantijdelijke werkloosheid wegens overmacht in Be

Palland (CDA) asked whether Dutch WIA recipients working in Belgium or Germany and receiving Belgian temporary unemployment-for-force-majeure benefits, or NOW-type wage support, are wrongly having their WIA benefit reduced, and whether that is acceptable. Minister Koolmees answered that these payments are treated as earnings from work offset against the WIA benefit, so recipients keep the same WIA amount as before the crisis, and he sees no reason to change this.
I therefore see no reason or need to do this differently.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden of noodzaak om dit anders te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het mislopen van noodsteun

An SP MP asks whether the government will provide a remedy for a startup hospitality entrepreneur excluded from COVID emergency support, and whether it will prevent forced closure. The government responds that a new Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme will cover startups founded between October 2019 and July 2020, with separate subsidy and expanded loan facilities.
That is why the cabinet chose to introduce a new Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme as part of the recent expansion of the support and recovery package.
Daarom heeft het kabinet ervoor gekozen om bij de recente uitbreiding van het steun- en herstelpakket een nieuwe regeling Tegemoetkoming Starters te introduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht ‘Nauwelijks coronasteun voor startende ondernemers: 'Ik hou het nog drie maanden vol'’

MPs Amhaouch and Palland asked why businesses founded in 2020 cannot access the NOW and TVL COVID support schemes, and what alternatives were considered. The State Secretary answered that a separate Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme will use Q3 2020 as reference revenue, with about 180 million euro budgeted, after alternatives such as constructed reference revenue and flat payments were rejected for fairness and feasibility reasons.
To be able to support businesses that started in the period from 1 October 2019 through 30 June 2020, the cabinet will develop a separate scheme for starters.
Om ondernemingen die zijn gestart in de periode vanaf 1 oktober 2019 tot en met 30 juni 2020 te kunnen ondersteunen, zal het kabinet een separate regeling voor starters ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Palland en Bruins over signalen vanuit de Industriecoalitie m.b.t. de regelingen Leven Lang Ontwikkelen (LLO)

MPs Tielen, Palland and Bruins asked whether the government is aware of the Industriecoalitie's signals that LLO schemes are fragmented, favour surplus sectors over shortage sectors, and are hard to scale or combine with modular training. The minister acknowledged the consultations and defended the existing complementary schemes, promising evaluation and sector-led plans without committing to a structural redesign.
The starting point is that people can receive support depending on their position and needs.
Het uitgangspunt is dat mensen, afhankelijk van hun positie en behoefte, ondersteuning kunnen krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Tielen over het bericht ‘Zzp’ers verbaasd over minieme betalingskorting Belastingdienst’

MPs Lodders and Tielen (VVD) asked why the payment discount on the 2021 provisional income tax assessment was almost nil, since it is tied to the temporarily lowered collection interest rate. Staatssecretaris Vijlbrief answered that the link is set by law, that the Belastingdienst cannot decouple it without a system change not possible before 2023, that the rate returns to 4% from 2022, and that the communication could have explained the reason more clearly in the letter.

It would have been better to state directly in the text, after the sentence 'When paying the total assessment in one go you receive a payment discount of (PM)', why the discount is lower this year than normal.

Het was beter geweest meteen in de tekst, na de zin «Bij betaling in één keer van de totale aanslag krijgt u een betalingskorting van (PM)» aan te geven waarom de betalingskorting dit jaar lager is dan normaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht 'DNB slaat negatief advies over renteverlaging in de wind'

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether he requested DNB to lower the long-term interest rate in the uniform scenario set despite negative academic advice, what the effects are, and why the change was pushed through. The minister answers that signals from pension providers prompted him to alert DNB, that DNB as independent supervisor decided on a temporary adjustment after a due process, and that the change does not affect the transition scenario set or investment policy.
I asked DNB to take measures where necessary within the powers DNB has for this, with the advice of the Commission Parameters 2019 as the starting point.
Daarbij heb ik aan DNB gevraagd zo nodig maatregelen te nemen binnen de bevoegdheden die DNB daarvoor heeft, waarbij als uitgangspunt het advies van de Commissie Parameters 2019 geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over "hedge funds en vermogensbeheerders die NOW steun ontvangen"

An MP asked whether hedge funds and asset managers receive NOW wage-subsidy support, whether bonuses to non-board traders are paid with public money, and whether support should be restricted or clawed back. The minister replied that eligibility is sector-neutral, no separate register of such firms exists, the bonus ban covers only management and board, and no clawback or new restrictions are planned beyond existing rules.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over payrollbedrijven die misbruik maken van de Tijdelijke Noodmaatregel Overbrugging voor Werkgelegenheid (NOW)

Gijs van Dijk (PvdA) asked the minister whether payroll firms are abusing the NOW wage-subsidy scheme despite revenue losses unrelated to COVID-19, and whether the state will recover such funds. The minister answered that firms qualify with 20% revenue loss versus 2019 without needing to prove COVID causation, that no distinction by firm type is possible, that unlawful subsidies would be recovered, and that the ABU was urged to remind members of responsible use, but declined to rule out further checks or answer within a week.
Such a distinction cannot be made within the NOW applications.
Dergelijk onderscheid kan niet worden gemaakt binnen de aanvragen voor NOW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht 'Pensioenen AVH toch naar PGB, ondanks tweede rechtszaak'

An MP from 50PLUS asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the collective transfer of AVH pension fund to PGB despite a negative advisory council opinion and court rulings, questioning the handling of participants' rights and the works council's role. The minister answers that the legal safeguards and court review functioned as intended, that the board may depart from a negative advice if it motivates the decision, and that the Ondernemingskamer found the board acted reasonably.
The system of protective norms and judicial review has, in my view, worked.
Het systeem van beschermende normen en toetsing door de rechter heeft wat mij betreft gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Veldman over het voorkomen en bestrijden van genitale verminking

MPs Becker and Veldman (VVD) asked the ministers about preventing and combating female genital mutilation (FGM), including prevalence data, the role of GPs and the care chain, Veilig Thuis reporting, reconstructive surgery coverage, integration course content, Schiphol controls and a reporting obligation. The state secretary answered that preventive and chain policy exists and is being evaluated, that data are limited or not monitored, that some measures (Schiphol controls) have no fixed timeline, and that a mandatory reporting duty is under study with Raad van State reservations.
The number of women who report to their GP because they are victims of FGM is not monitored.
Het aantal vrouwen dat zich meldt bij de huisarts omdat zij slachtoffer zijn van VGV wordt niet gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Ondanks 55,8 miljoen aan staatssteun toch gedwongen ontslagen bij Holland Casino'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Holland Casino, state-owned and receiving NOW wage subsidies, should avoid forced layoffs, guarantee work for dismissed staff, and how it would be helped back to work. The minister replied that the NOW scheme discourages layoffs, that NOW-3 imposes a best-efforts obligation on employers to help staff find new work without a job guarantee, and that existing mobility measures and temporary corona jobs are available.
Because of the broader possibilities to reduce the wage bill, NOW-3 contains an obligation of effort for employers to actively work on move-to-work guidance.
Vanwege de ruimere mogelijkheden om de loonsom te laten dalen, zit in de NOW-3 een inspanningsverplichting voor werkgevers om zich actief in te zetten voor van werk naar werk begeleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Wiersma over het bericht 'Gemeenten: uitstel nieuwe inburgeringswet teleurstellend'

MPs Becker and Wiersma asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the postponement of the new civic integration law after municipalities criticised the delay, including the timeline, DUO's implementation assessments, and financial and practical consequences. The minister answered that the postponement was necessary for responsible implementation, that DUO's assessments flagged feasibility risks, that consultation with municipalities and partners is ongoing, and that several questions (financial impact, costs) are still being mapped.
My ministry is currently mapping the total financial consequences of the postponement and I am in discussion about this with the VNG and other chain partners.
Mijn ministerie brengt op dit moment de totale financiële gevolgen van het uitstel in kaart en ik ben hierover in gesprek met VNG en andere ketenpartners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de sluiting van Niemeyer

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the planned closure of BAT Niemeyer in Groningen, its job losses, a Berenschot scenario, the loss of the Royal warrant, and whether the government would intervene. The minister acknowledged the regional job impact and the works council's alternatives but said closure strategy is the company's responsibility and declined to mediate, noting only UWV's role in unemployment support.
I see no general role for me, as Minister of Social Affairs and Employment, to actively intervene in that, and see no reason in this specific case to deviate from this line.
Ik zie in het algemeen geen rol voor mij, als Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid, om mij daar actief in te mengen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Nijkerken-de Haan over de arbeidsmarkt in Limburg

MPs Tielen and Nijkerken-de Haan asked about support for around 750 VDL Nedcar workers facing dismissal in Limburg, including reemployment, training and regional labour-market coordination. The minister answered that UWV, the regional labour-market partners and staffing agencies are supporting workers, that extra crisis reemployment funds and regional mobility teams are being set up, and that platforms and training schemes are available.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de notitie 'Position paper juridische aspecten pensioenakkoord deel II'

Van Brenk (50PLUS) asked the minister whether the compulsory participation scheme for Dutch sector pension funds, and its EU-law justification, is discriminatory, and whether a separate EU-law test should be done. Minister Koolmees rejected the discrimination and EU-violation claims, said the Lutjens analysis was a research assignment, and declined an extra EU-law test, pointing to the Council of State advice.
The Council of State's advice will be taken into account in the bill that will be submitted for parliamentary consideration.
Het advies van de Raad van State zal worden betrokken in het wetsvoorstel dat voor parlementaire behandeling zal worden ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge en Futselaar over coulanceregelingen en maatwerk in toelatingseisen voor mbo-, hbo- en wo-studenten

MPs Van den Berge and Futselaar asked whether newcomers who started higher education without their NT2 diploma will be deregistered, whether institutions can show leniency and offer case-by-case flexibility, and about NT2 exam waiting times. The minister answers that students are not deregistered if they pass before 1 September 2021, that institutions have legal room for hardship exceptions, that she remains in talks with sector bodies, and that waiting times are not known.
It is not known what the average time newcomers must wait before they can take the Staatsexamen NT2 is.
Het is niet bekend wat de gemiddelde tijd is die nieuwkomers moeten wachten voordat zij het Staatsexamen Nt2 kunnen afleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘UWV schendt privacy cliënten‘

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that UWV's SONAR system exposes clients' personal data, including former clients, to many officials and about possible unauthorised access. The minister acknowledged the privacy and information-security shortcomings, said logging does not allow unauthorised access to be ruled out, and committed to deleting data of clients inactive for five years or more in Q1 2021, improving logging and monitoring, and phased replacement of SONAR.
Due to the technically limited logging and monitoring of the SONAR system, it cannot be determined which employees viewed which data at what time.
Door de technisch beperkte logging en monitoring op het systeem SONAR, kan niet achterhaald worden welke medewerkers op welk moment welke gegevens hebben ingezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Becker over subsidie aan de organisatie Islamic Relief

MPs Weverling and Becker asked the ministers why Islamic Relief was selected for Power of Voices subsidy despite alleged links to the Muslim Brotherhood and German funding being stopped, and what the government would do about subsidies to organisations opposing integration. The minister answered that no subsidy will be granted to Islamic Relief Worldwide, that the Dutch intelligence services assess the Muslim Brotherhood's presence in the Netherlands as limited, and that municipalities decide their own subsidies, with the Rijk informing them of problematic conduct.
Based on the information available to me, however, I have decided not to grant Islamic Relief Worldwide a subsidy.
Op basis van de mij beschikbare informatie heb ik evenwel besloten om Islamic Relief Worldwide geen subsidie te verlenen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Tielen over het bericht 'NBBU en SoloPartners dringen er bij zorginstellingen op aan de zorgbonus voor uitzendkrachten en zzp’ers alsnog ter beschikking te stellen'

MPs Regterschot and Tielen asked whether the COVID-19 care bonus is genuinely open to temporary agency workers and self-employed care workers, and whether institutions are being pressed to apply for them. The ministers answer that the bonus is contract-neutral, that GGZ Nederland's earlier advice was a misunderstanding, that about a third of applicant institutions applied for third parties, and that the application window was extended.
The final figures will be compiled in the coming weeks.
De definitieve cijfers worden de komende weken opgemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over "het gebruik van NOW in de eredivisie"

MPs Van Kent and Jasper van Dijk asked whether Eredivisie clubs spending 74 million euros on transfers while receiving NOW wage subsidies was acceptable, and about the club aid package, adviser Klaas Dijkhof's role, and bonuses. The minister answered that the NOW uses a 20% revenue-loss threshold and group-level assessment, that transfer figures could not be verified because they are confidential, that further support is only a last resort after clubs exhaust their own options, and that bonuses are barred under NOW rules, with the minister referring the adviser question to Dijkhof himself.
Since this involves commercially sensitive information, it is not possible to verify the stated amounts.
Aangezien het hier bedrijfsgevoelige informatie betreft, is het niet mogelijk om de genoemde bedragen te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht 'Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn stapt na miljardenverlies uit oliemarkt'

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether pensioner fund PFZW speculated on oil prices through futures and whether reports of it exiting the oil market were accurate. The minister answered that pension funds may use derivatives only for hedging or efficient portfolio management, that speculation is not allowed, that PFZW was already winding down its commodity holdings, and that DNB supervises this.
Speculative use of derivatives is not allowed.
Speculatieve inzet van derivaten mag niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Gijs van Dijk en Bruins over geweld en agressie tegenover arbeidsmigranten en vakbondsmedewerkers

MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a violent assault on a FNV union employee at a bungalow park housing migrant workers, whether the incident would be investigated, and how union and inspection access to such housing can be guaranteed. The minister condemned the violence, said the police handle the criminal complaint, stated that the Labour Inspectorate has access to migrant housing and can be threatened or refused access in isolated cases, and pointed to ongoing government programmes on migrant worker protection.
I cannot comment on this specific case. It is up to the police to investigate this matter following the complaint of assault.
Over dit specifieke geval kan ik geen uitspraken doen. Het is aan de politie om deze zaak, naar aanleiding van de aangifte van mishandeling, te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Van den Berg, Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over het bericht 'Misstanden bij koeriers zijn eerder regel dan uitzondering'

MPs asked the Social Affairs minister about reports of widespread abuses at parcel and courier firms, including WW recipients working as couriers, workers without valid residence papers and sham constructions, and how these can persist. The minister acknowledged the serious findings from Inspectie SZW, described its sector programme and enforcement, and said the Inspectorate will confront major clients and evaluate in 2022 whether further measures are needed.
I attach great importance to fair, healthy and safe work for all employees.
Ik hecht groot belang aan eerlijk, gezond en veilig werk voor alle werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Koerhuis over het bericht 'Steen door de ruit en dreigbrief Molukse wijk in Elst'

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about reports of a stone through a window and a threatening letter in a Moluccan neighbourhood in Elst, and about the allocation policy giving Moluccans priority for housing in such neighbourhoods. The government explained the historical basis of the arrangements, said they exist in about 45 municipalities, denied that tensions are a recurring pattern, and said it sees no reason to revisit the agreement.
Apart from the incidents reported by the Gelderlander and the NOS, I am not aware of any signals so far that give cause to revisit this agreement.
Buiten de incidenten waarvan de Gelderlander en de NOS melding hebben gemaakt, zijn mij vooralsnog geen signalen bekend die aanleiding geven tot een herijking van deze afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het pensioenakkoord

An MP asked the minister whether the transition framework of the pension agreement would give existing contribution schemes with age-rising premiums a longer phase-out, and whether that transitional arrangement would also extend to directly insured defined-benefit schemes. The minister confirmed a longer phase-out because compensation for switching to flat premiums could not be made cost-neutral, and agreed to extend the transitional rule to directly insured defined-benefit schemes, with the option to keep progressive premiums until 2026.
The Hoofdlijnennotitie on elaborating the Pensioenakkoord therefore chose a longer phase-out over time.
In de Hoofdlijnennotitie uitwerking Pensioenakkoord is daarom gekozen voor een langere uitfasering in de tijd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'FrieslandCampina schrapt duizend banen vanwege coronacrisis. Mogelijk ontslagen op locaties Bedum, Marum en Noordwijk'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that FrieslandCampina may cut 1,000 jobs during the coronavirus crisis, including possible dismissals, and asked about NOW support, rapid job placement, retraining and budget. The minister replied that FrieslandCampina does not appear in the NOW registers, that the company hopes to absorb job losses through attrition and redeployment though forced dismissals cannot be excluded, and listed existing reemployment, retraining and mobility-team measures and budgets.
To answer this question I checked the public registers of NOW recipients.
Voor het beantwoorden van deze vraag heb ik de openbare registers met NOW-ontvangers bekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over onderbetaling bij de RVO

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether USG Legal's contracting arrangement with RVO amounts to unlawful temporary labour hire under the WAADI, whether workers should receive equal pay, why RVO refused to share pay data, and whether other agencies are affected. The minister answered that contracting is legitimate, that the Inspectorate found the pay-ratio norm was breached but courts must decide civil claims, and that departments are themselves responsible for their contracting, with the matter raised with colleagues.
It is up to the court to judge whether the pay-ratio norm was in fact complied with.
Het is aan de rechter om te oordelen of er feitelijk al dan niet sprake was van naleving van de loonverhoudingsnorm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Tielen over NL Leert Door

MPs Smeulders and Tielen asked why the NL Leert Door development-advice scheme filled almost 50,000 applications within a day of reopening, what criteria and follow-up data exist, and how to avoid a gap in provision. Minister Koolmees answered that demand is high, an effect evaluation starts in 2021, budget covers 77,000 trajectories, and alternative routes (SLIM, sectoral schemes, a structural scheme from 2022) will fill gaps.
During 2021 an effect evaluation will be started to determine the effects, efficiency and effectiveness of the various measures in the NL Leert Door package.

In de loop van 2021 zal er een effectevaluatie worden gestart om in beeld te brengen wat de effecten, doelmatigheid en doeltreffendheid van de verschillende maatregelen uit het pakket NL leert door zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Weyenberg over het bericht “Ophef over lokale quota voor huisvesting arbeidsmigranten”

Two MPs asked the Social Affairs minister whether municipal quotas limiting housing for migrant workers conflict with EU free-movement law and what the government will do. The minister agreed such quotas conflict with EU law, said the ministries will contact the VNG, and pointed to regional housing agreements and funding instead.
Limiting the housing of migrant workers through quotas specifically aimed at this group is at odds with the free movement of Union citizens, which permits no distinction by nationality.

De huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten beperken door middel van het instellen van quota die specifiek op deze groep gericht zijn, staat op gespannen voet met het vrij verkeer van Unieburgers dat geen onderscheid naar nationaliteit toestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie een Europees minimumloon wil

Two SGP MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the European Commission's plan for a directive on adequate minimum wages, questioning its proportionality, legal basis and possible wage-raising effects. The minister said the Netherlands considers the directive partly proportionate, prefers a Council recommendation, reads the legal basis as leaving the minimum wage level a national competence, and will seek clarification in negotiations.

Given the importance of safeguarding the division of competences between the EU and the Member States, and because this subject may become a point of discussion, the government will ask additional questions during the negotiations.

Het kabinet zal hier wel, gezien het belang van het waarborgen van de bevoegdheidsverdeling tussen de EU en de lidstaten en het feit dat dit onderwerp van discussie zal kunnen worden, tijdens de onderhandelingen aanvullende vragen over stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Bruins over schijnconstructies en wanpresterende uitzendbureaus

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about sham subcontracting schemes at Veka Shipyard and underpaid Romanian workers, the slow enforcement, weak remedies, and the role of employment agencies. The minister acknowledged the problem, explained existing liability and inspection tools, pointed to proposals under consideration and to ongoing exploration, but committed to no concrete new legal change now.
Under Article 3:305a of the Civil Code, trade unions have the possibility to bring a collective action on behalf of employees.
Op grond van artikel 3:305a BW hebben vakbonden de mogelijkheid om een collectieve actie in te zetten voor werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Smeulders en Buitenweg over Coronatestlijn

MPs from GroenLinks asked the ministers about reports that staff of the coronavirus testing helpline could access personal data beyond what their tasks required, about WhatsApp data sharing, training, outsourcing to Teleperformance, unpaid hours and working conditions. The government answered that access is necessary for the job, that logging and confidentiality agreements safeguard privacy, that GGD-GHOR is responsible, and that labour conditions are for employers and social partners, with the Inspectie SZW available for complaints.
Care in handling personal data is of course of great importance.
Zorgvuldigheid is bij het omgaan met persoonsgegevens uiteraard van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over onderbetaling bij de RVO

MPs Van Dijk and Moorlag asked why externally hired staff at RVO, via detacher USG Legal, receive lower pay than colleagues doing the same work, and what the government will do about it. The minister says RVO is not the formal employer, the contractor's own terms apply under a results-based contract, the Inspectie SZW found the wage-ratio norm was breached, and that the government will respond to the advisory team's recommendations on temporary work agencies.
However, article 27 of the General Government Terms for Services (ARVODI), which apply to the framework agreement, provides that the staffing agencies as formal employers must act as good employers.

Wel is in artikel 27 van de Algemene Rijksvoorwaarden voor Diensten (ARVODI) die van toepassing zijn op de raamovereenkomst bepaald dat de detacheringsbureaus als de formele werkgevers zich als goed werkgever gedragen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent, Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over vrachtwagenchauffeurs die hun cabine niet meer uitkomen

SP MPs asked whether truck drivers confined to their cabins during COVID measures lack humane conditions, such as access to toilets and showers, and what structural fix the government will provide. The State Secretary answered that employers must cover rest facilities, that the government relies on calls to petrol stations and rest areas to keep sanitary facilities open, and that talks with the sector are ongoing, without committing to a structural solution.
In addition, the Ministry of IenW keeps a close watch on industry organisations, so that any signals about the availability of sanitary facilities for drivers can be picked up in time.
Daarnaast houdt het Ministerie van IenW de vinger aan de pols bij brancheorganisaties, om eventuele signalen over de beschikbaarheid van sanitair voor chauffeurs tijdig op te vangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een werkbezoek aan Park Droomgaard in Kaatsheuvel en hotel Friends in Waalwijk

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about conditions for migrant workers at Park Droomgaard in Kaatsheuvel and Hotel Friends in Waalwijk, including excessive rent deductions, fines, bedbugs, a union visit being refused, and relocation to Venlo. The minister answered that rent deductions are capped under rules, that the housing is SNF-certified and monitored, that municipalities and the Labour Inspectorate handle the issues, that a visit is not desirable under COVID-19, and that the government will respond to the Roemer task force advice by mid-December.
The Labour Inspectorate is responsible for supervision and enforcement of the labour laws.
De Inspectie SZW is verantwoordelijk voor het toezicht en de handhaving van de arbeidswetten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht '181.000 banen weg bij bedrijven die coronasteun kregen'

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about job losses at firms that received NOW corona wage subsidies, the adequacy of the NOW1 and TOFA schemes for flex workers, and whether the sector is being checked for misuse. The minister defends the design of the schemes, reports UWV figures on terminated employment relationships and dismissal requests, says no fines have yet been imposed, and declines a separate investigation into the temp-agency sector.
That is more than one in three workers in the Netherlands.
Dat is meer dan één op de drie werkenden in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Nico viel 5 meter bij hijswerk, ongeluk was wake-upcall voor bedrijf'

An MP asked the Social Affairs minister about a news report on a workplace fall and whether the Inspectorate's new national approach to minor workplace accidents, which lets firms draft their own improvement plans instead of facing fines, should extend to serious accidents. The state secretary defended the pilot approach, said it will stay limited to minor injuries for now, and promised to inform parliament after a year of experience.
I will inform your House about that in more detail.
Ik zal uw Kamer daarover nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Bruins over "tempo maken bij aanpak jeugdwerkloosheid"

MPs Van Dijk and Bruins asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the slow pace of tackling youth unemployment during the coronavirus crisis, including stages, apprenticeships, municipal job-search waiting periods and youth organisations' involvement. The minister answered that extra funds and regional approaches are in place, that the four-week waiting period is relaxed and extended to July 2021 with exemptions, and that municipalities have discretion over individual cases.
No information is available on that.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Terpstra over het bericht 'Migranten in Westland wonen in tenten en hutjes door gebrek aan huisvesting'

MPs Palland and Terpstra (CDA) asked ministers about reports that migrant workers in Westland live in tents and shacks due to lack of housing, including agreed bed-space targets and national support instruments. Minister Koolmees answered that the municipality reports about 4,500 people housed rather than 'barely any', that Den Haag is responsible for the tent images, and that the government will act on the Aanjaagteam advice and inform parliament by 16 December.
The cabinet is working on this and hopes to inform the House of Representatives about it by 16 December.
Het kabinet is hiermee aan de slag en hoopt voor 16 december daarover de TK te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Raemakers over het artikel ‘Buitenlandse Artsen in Nederland: ‘Ik denk dat niemand mij zal bellen’

MPs Paternotte and Raemakers asked the ministers about a press article on foreign-trained doctors facing long, costly re-qualification procedures and about the abolition of the supervised-practice scheme. The minister said patient safety comes first, promised to explore streamlining the procedure with the CBGV and VBGA, and gave historical and procedural explanations.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over “de hoge marginale druk over een pensioenuitkering ineens en het feit dat het van je geboortedatum afhangt of je soms 20% extra belasting moet betalen over een uitkering ineens

MP Omtzigt asked whether the marginal tax burden on a lump-sum pension payment depends on the recipient's birth month, with rates up to 55% for those reaching AOW age in December versus 19-28% for January, and whether this is justified and legally sound under age-discrimination rules. The minister confirmed the mechanism, defended it as inherent to the tax system and as a voluntary option, and acknowledged the burden varies but declined to see it as unjust.
It is important to emphasise that the lump-sum amount is an optional choice.
Het is belangrijk hierbij te benadrukken dat het bedrag ineens een keuzemogelijkheid is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over het recht op partnerpensioen op risicobasis na beëindiging dienstverband
