MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked the Social Affairs minister about survivors' pension rights after a switch from capital-based to risk-based partner pension, the requirement of informed consent, and limitation periods. The minister answered that compensation depends on the case, that a dynamic incorporation clause requires good information, and that no standardised claims procedure is needed because hardship clauses in pension schemes provide a route.

In my view, this ruling does not mean that in all cases where there was no conscious consent to the switch from a survivors' pension on accrual basis to one on risk basis, the survivor is entitled to compensation.

Mijns inziens betekent deze uitspraak niet dat in alle gevallen waarin geen welbewuste instemming is geweest met de overgang van een nabestaandenpensioen op opbouwbasis naar een nabestaandenpensioen op risicobasis, recht bestaat op een schadevergoeding voor de nabestaande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over “het mislopen van inkomsten door moskeeën als gevolg van het coronavirus”

Azarkan (DENK) asked whether mosques facing financial losses from COVID-19 should receive state support to protect their social role and maintenance of buildings. The minister answered that religious communities are financially responsible themselves, pointed to existing general schemes (NOW, Tozo, Nationaal Restauratiefonds loans) and said the cabinet cannot offer other funding.
The cabinet cannot offer any funding other than the various generic (emergency) schemes currently available.
Het kabinet kan geen andere financiering bieden dan de diverse generieke (nood-)regelingen die op dit moment beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Jasper van Dijk en van Kent over cashen op kosten van de belastingbetaler

SP MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Rechtsbescherming about a case where a business owner allegedly used NOW wage subsidies, let a company go bankrupt, dismissed staff and profited, and whether bailiffs' market structure should be reversed. The minister replied that individual bankruptcies are for the courts and the independent curator and BFT supervisor, that UWV paid wages after the bankruptcy request and will recover via the curator, and that the government will not reverse market competition for bailiffs, though it will correct tariffs and ban price agreements that endanger independence.
It is not for me to judge bankruptcies in individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over faillissement in individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen vande leden Smeulders en Bromet over het bericht ‘Coronaregels overtreden maar Van Rooi Meat krijgt geen straf: gemeenteraad wil opheldering’

MPs Smeulders and Bromet asked why the safety region did not sanction Van Rooi Meat for exceeding COVID-19 staffing limits, whether the Labour Inspectorate was involved, and whether slaughterhouses are treated leniently. The minister answered that the company received a warning rather than a sanction because it had not reported the actual number of workers, that the Labour Inspectorate made an unannounced visit and found no irregularities in Helmond, and that a national cooperation platform was set up in September 2020.

The chair of the safety region weighed the matter and decided to give the company a warning and impose no sanction for failing to report in advance the actual number of persons present at the inspection.

De voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio heeft een afweging gemaakt en besloten het bedrijf een waarschuwing te geven en geen sanctie op te leggen voor het feit dat er vooraf geen melding is gemaakt van het daadwerkelijk bij de controle aanwezige aantal personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Slootweg over "de effectiviteit van het tijdelijk verlagen van de btw en het invoeren van een kinderbonus"

MP Slootweg (CDA) asked the ministers whether a German study showing a child bonus is more effective than a VAT cut for stimulating consumption applies to the Netherlands, and whether the CPB should be asked to do similar research. The minister answered that extra costs for households with children are limited and varied, that the government will not add a child bonus but raises the child-related budget for large low-income families, and that CPB evidence favours income tax cuts over VAT cuts or transfers.
Given the findings from the German study, it is relevant that the Dutch cabinet has allocated funds for the purchase of digital learning materials to make home schooling accessible to all children.

Gelet op de bevindingen uit het Duitse onderzoek is relevant dat het Nederlandse kabinet middelen heeft vrijgemaakt voor de aanschaf van digitale leermiddelen om thuisonderwijs voor alle kinderen toegankelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over de loonkloof tussen mannen en vrouwen

MPs Ploumen and Gijs van Dijk asked the government how it responds to the European Committee of Social Rights finding that the Netherlands falls short on closing the gender pay gap, and what measures are being taken. The state secretary answers that the ECSR found shortcomings on pay transparency and effective measures, that the gap is narrowing only slowly, points to the Actieplan Arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie, the diversity-in-top measures and a forthcoming study on public-sector pay gaps, and says a certification scheme and other transparency measures are still being studied.

The cabinet will come with a position on the private member's bill this autumn, now that the proposal and the response to the Council of State's advice have been submitted to the House of Representatives.
Het kabinet zal dit najaar met een standpunt komen over het initiatiefwetsvoorstel nu het voorstel en de reactie op het advies van de Raad van State is ingediend bij de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'gemeente Venlo zoekt naar andere locatie voor beachveld'

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Venlo municipality plan to relocate a beach volleyball pitch after objections from a nearby mosque, including questions framing Muslim demands as incompatible with Western culture and proposing that the mosque be moved abroad. The minister answered that the matter is local, rejected the framing of objections as 'gezever' and of Islam as making 'demands', and declined to intervene.
No, this concerns a local matter.
Nee, het betreft hier een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over "flexibele premie"

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the minister whether a flexible pension premium proposed by PGGM experts fits the pension agreement, and whether it would ease employer transitions, build support for collective schemes, or lead employers to DC plans. The minister answered that such a flexible premium is permitted within the agreement, is left to decentral social partners, and does not make transitioning easier, while declining to commission new studies.
The PGGM research confirms the long-standing economic theory that any increase in risk-bearing capacity, for example through a flexible premium, makes a positive contribution and raises welfare.

Het PGGM-onderzoek bevestigt de al langer bestaande economische theorie dat iedere vergroting van het risicodraagvlak, bijvoorbeeld door een flexibele premie, hieraan een positieve bijdrage levert en welvaartsverhogend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht dat de scholingspot van 'NL leert door' leeg is

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that the 'NL leert door' training scheme ran out of funds and the advice portal closed, and about how training budgets are targeted by education level and shortage sectors. The minister confirmed 22,000 advice applications, said the portal reopens on 1 December 2020, and explained the budget logic and planned communication, without committing to sector or education-level targets.
At this moment there is still no insight into the occupational level of the participants or the sectors in which they work.
Op dit moment is er nog geen inzicht in beroepsniveau van de deelnemers of de sectoren waarin zij werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het bericht dat het maximum aantal ontwikkeladviezen is bereikt

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why the maximum of 22,000 development advice trajectories under NL leert door was reached so quickly, whether the budget will be increased and the portal reopened, and what the capacity problems are. The minister explains the demand was underestimated, announces extra funding for 2021 (about 50,000 advice trajectories, EUR 37 million) and reopening of the portal on 1 December, while stating the agency UVB lacks capacity to process more applications now.
That is why the cabinet has decided to make additional funds available for development advice in 2021.
Daarom heeft het kabinet besloten om voor 2021 extra middelen beschikbaar te stellen voor ontwikkeladviezen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de persverklaring van Hizb ut Tharir dat vervolging voor de aanbeveling tot vrouwenbesnijdenis een poging zou zijn om moslims te criminaliseren

MPs Becker and Yesilgoz-Zegerius asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about a Hizb ut Tahrir press statement calling prosecution for recommending female genital mutilation an attempt to criminalise Muslims, and asked whether the government would act against the group, ban it, or have the task force examine it. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the statement is unacceptable, that FGM is criminal and prosecuted, that Hizb ut Tahrir is a radical movement not calling for violence but he sees no reason for further measures now, that a dissolution bill is before parliament, and that the task force will monitor developments.
I currently see no reason to take further measures against the organisation.
Ik zie momenteel geen aanleiding nadere maatregelen te treffen tegen de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over terugvordering door het UWV

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about large UWV reclaims of benefits (e.g. a 27,000 euro claim with six weeks to repay), how such overpayments arise and go undetected, repayment terms, protocols, and numbers of claims. The minister answered in detail on claim volumes, the statutory six-week payment term, available payment arrangements and debt relief, and said he is willing to examine extending the one-year repayment term.
I am therefore willing to examine whether it is opportune to extend this term.
Ik ben daarom bereid te bezien of het opportuun is deze termijn te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht Camping kreeg duizenden UWV-brieven voor onbekende Polen. ‘Dit is gewoon uitkeringsfraude’ en ‘massale uitkeringsfraude op camping’

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that a holiday park received thousands of UWV letters addressed to unknown Polish residents, raising suspicion of benefit fraud. The minister replies that the letters largely reached the park through address and postal errors, that an ongoing criminal and administrative investigation prevents disclosing fraud findings, and that UWV will be asked to pay closer attention to returned post.
Regarding this ongoing investigation, I cannot make further statements in the interest of the investigation.
Over dit – lopende – onderzoek kan ik in het belang van het onderzoek geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht dat een camping 20.000 UWV-brieven heeft ontvangen voor onbekende Polen

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that a holiday park received about 20,000 UWV letters for unknown Polish residents, suggesting benefit fraud, and asks whether this points to fraud and why it went unnoticed. The minister explains the misdelivery largely stems from missing house-number additions, describes an ongoing criminal and administrative investigation that prevents disclosure of details, and outlines fraud-prevention measures and a broader address-check programme.
Regarding this ongoing investigation, I cannot provide further information in the interest of the investigation.
Over dit – lopende – onderzoek kan ik in het belang van het onderzoek geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht 'Accountants verwachten dat bedrijven een aanzienlijk deel noodsteun moeten terugbetalen'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that accountants expect firms to repay a large part of NOW wage-support subsidies after applying at group rather than subsidiary level. The minister acknowledged problems where subsidiaries applied at the wrong level, announced a planned amendment to NOW-1 and NOW-2 allowing a subsidiary-level settlement and deferring two conditions to the settlement stage, but could not say how many applications were affected.

Therefore I am preparing an amendment to NOW-1 and 2 that makes it possible for these firms, when applying for settlement, to still qualify for the subsidy being set at subsidiary rather than group level.

Daarom bereid ik een wijziging van de NOW-1 en 2 voor die het mogelijk maakt dat deze bedrijven bij de aanvraag van vaststelling alsnog ervoor in aanmerking komen dat de subsidie niet op het niveau van het concern maar op het niveau van de werkmaatschappij wordt vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘‘Ga naar Holland’ is trending als homofobe sneer in Turkije’

Two MPs (Becker and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, VVD) asked the ministers about a Turkish religious official's remarks linking homosexuality to population decline, the hashtag campaign that followed, threats, and Diyanet's influence in Dutch mosques. The minister condemned the remarks, said no criminal complaint was filed, referred to existing integration, monitoring and diaspora-policy measures, and declined to change those measures on the basis of this single statement.
A single statement by Mr Erbas in Turkey, however reprehensible, is not for the cabinet a reason to revise this approach at this moment.
Een enkele uitspraak van de heer Erbas in Turkije, hoe verwerpelijk dan ook, vormt voor het kabinet geen aanleiding om deze aanpak op dit moment te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht 'COA plaatst Nigeriaans slachtoffer homohaat over naar ander azc'

MP Becker asked the State Secretary and Integration Minister, after reports that a Nigerian victim of anti-gay violence at an asylum centre was moved rather than the perpetrators, how incidents are prevented, recorded and punished, and whether asylum seekers can be required to sign equality principles or be placed in a handhavings location. The government answered that perpetrators are addressed through COA measures and police referral, victims may be moved at their own choice, no incident statistics are kept and mandatory pre-integration was rejected, while promising a policy response to a COA audit.
As you know, I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Zoals u bekend, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht 'Arbeidsmigrant reist steeds verder' en het bericht 'Goedkope arbeidsmigrant komt van steeds verder'

MP Palland (CDA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that temporary labour migrants from outside the EEA are increasingly employed in the Netherlands via A1 posting arrangements, where contributions are paid abroad, and whether this creates unfair competition and fraud risks. The minister answered that the arrangements are lawful within EU rules but premium-shopping is unacceptable, that data on non-EEA workers under A1 are not recorded, and that enforcement is shared among several bodies with further measures pending.
From the data currently available to us, it cannot be deduced how many workers from outside the EEA have been employed in the Netherlands via A1 posting in recent years.
Uit de ons thans ter beschikking staande gegevens valt niet af te leiden hoeveel arbeiders van buiten de EER in de afgelopen jaren via een A1-verloning in Nederland te werk zijn gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over premieshoppen

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that staffing agencies use posted-worker A1 certificates and third-country workers to cut labour and social-security costs (premium shopping). Minister Koolmees condemned premium shopping and abuse, described enforcement and EU-level measures, but gave no firm new commitments and said the EU coordination regulation negotiations are stalled.
I will inform the House if there is progress.
Ik informeer uw Kamer als er voortgang is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over de impact van coronabeperkingen op visumverlening aan buitenlandse geliefden van Nederlanders

MPs asked the government about the impact of COVID-19 restrictions on visa processing for foreign partners of Dutch nationals, including closed embassies, cancelled civic integration exams abroad, and whether alternative routes such as online exams or post-arrival testing are possible. The minister answered that most posts now offer the basic integration exam, that online testing is ruled out to prevent fraud, that post-arrival testing is incompatible with the MVV process, and that the government will keep working with posts and EU partners but cannot quantify affected families.
There is no insight into figures on the number of Dutch nationals currently forced to live apart because their partner cannot take the basic civic integration exam abroad.
Er is geen inzicht in cijfers van het aantal Nederlandse staatsburgers dat op dit moment gescheiden moet leven vanwege het niet kunnen afleggen van een basisexamen inburgering buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over 'De uitzending 'Vermalen door instanties' van het televisieprogramma Hollandse Zaken'

MP Palland (CDA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Hollandse Zaken broadcast on UWV practices, including the opaque CBBS job-matching system, the 'kapdatum' cut-off date, incorrect dates in letters, advising claimants to switch from WW to ZW benefits, maatmanloon calculations, file reference numbers and signature requirements for medical assessments. The minister answered that claimants can verify CBBS matches with the case worker and request printouts, that the Stichting van de Arbeid advice on transparency will be discussed with social partners and UWV with a report before year-end, and that the other matters are explained as routine UWV procedure with recourse via objection and appeal.
I will discuss this with the social partners and UWV. I will inform you of the outcome of these discussions before the end of this year.
Ik zal hierover in gesprek gaan met de sociale partners en UWV. Over de uitkomst van deze gesprekken zal ik u voor het einde van dit jaar informeren.
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Kwint over diverse berichten aangaande ontslagen bij poppodia en andere culturele instellingen

An MP asked ministers about reports of layoffs at Dutch music venues and cultural institutions during the COVID-19 crisis, and whether support schemes such as NOW, TOZO and TVL would be extended. The minister replied that support measures would be continued for nine months and that a range of additional funding, loan and fieldlab arrangements exist, while stating that not every organisation can be saved.
As I indicated in the debate of 29 June, I want to prevent bankruptcies as much as possible.
Zoals ik heb aangegeven in het debat van 29 juni jl. wil ik faillissementen zoveel mogelijk zien te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over signalen van bedrijven die vastlopen in de NOW-procedure, terwijl de regeling wel voor hun bedoeld lijkt te zijn

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Social Affairs about businesses that got stuck in the NOW emergency wage subsidy procedure, including startup rules, administrative mismatches and long objection waiting times. The minister said some problems are being fixed, but defended the automated process, rejected a separate counter for hardship cases, and pointed to the objection procedure and UWV monitoring.
Nevertheless, such problems cannot be prevented because it is not possible for UWV to check for every employer from which moment revenue was actually generated.
Het is evenwel niet mogelijk dergelijke problematiek te voorkomen omdat het voor UWV niet mogelijk is om voor elke werkgever na te gaan vanaf welk moment daadwerkelijk omzet is gegenereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Tielen over het artikel ‘Zzp’er in de zorg niet duurder dan medewerker in loondienst

MPs Regterschot and Tielen asked whether they agree that self-employed (zzp) care workers cost institutions no more than employees, and why the government is negative about zzp'ers, along with questions on care labour shortages, a motion on worker involvement, and a bonus for self-employed workers during COVID-19. The minister answers that cost comparisons rest on unsubstantiated assumptions and that balance between flexible and permanent staff matters, promising further study, a progress report in September, and a bonus application window opening 1 October 2020.
In my view, this balance is currently insufficient.
Naar mijn mening is deze balans er momenteel onvoldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Raan en Wassenberg over het NOW-register en controversiële steun

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether NOW wage-support should go to firms linked to controversial sectors and to firms with animal-welfare, COVID-compliance or dividend controversies, and asked for sector data and new ethical criteria. The minister said the scheme is deliberately generic to be fast and broad, that the register cannot show sector activities, and that no new criteria will be added.
To provide income protection and preserve employment, the measure must be generic.
Om inkomensbescherming en behoud van werkgelegenheid te bieden, moet er sprake zijn van een generieke maatregel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Omtzigt over mensen die van tafel en bed gescheiden zijn, dezelfde mantelzorgregels van toepassing voor de Algemene Ouderdomswet (AOW) als op mensen die niet getrouwd zijn

CDA MPs Slootweg and Omtzigt asked whether separated-from-bed-and-board spouses face the same AOW pension cohabitation rules as unmarried people, including the two-dwelling rule, and why website information on this is lacking. Minister Koolmees answered that married persons who live separately are assessed like married couples on whether they live durably apart, that the two-dwelling rule applies only to unmarried people, and that the ministry will explore simplifying the cohabitation rules and has updated the SVB website, but gave no evaluation of the checks.
No evaluation of the approach to checking durable separate living is available.
Er is geen evaluatie van de aanpak van controle van duurzaam gescheiden leven beschikbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Jasper van Dijk over verontrustende berichtgeving met betrekking tot de As Soennah Moskee en de reactie van de burgemeester van Den Haag op het handhavingsverzoek van Femmes for

MPs Becker and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the Justice Minister could take enforcement action against the As Soennah mosque after Femmes for Freedom's enforcement request, which the Hague mayor rejected and an appeal is pending. The minister answered that enforcement is for the mayor and the courts, that the anti-terrorism measures law does not apply, and that he will not intervene or revisit joint enforcement.
It is up to the mayor to assess such an enforcement request and decide on it after weighing all relevant facts and circumstances.
Het is aan de burgemeester om een dergelijk handhavingsverzoek te beoordelen en daarop, na afweging van alle relevante feiten en omstandigheden, een beslissing te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus

An MP asks the government to justify continued COVID-19 restrictions, their proportionality, effects on mental health, economy and poverty, and the scientific basis for distancing and ventilation advice. The ministers respond that restrictions remain necessary to control the virus, describe the OMT and BAO advisory process and support measures, and state that herd immunity was never a goal.
The decision whether the measures proposed by the OMT are implemented is then up to the cabinet.
De afweging of de maatregelen die het OMT voorstelt worden uitgevoerd, is vervolgens aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ‘een werkgever en een uitzendbureau die hun werknemer in de steek lieten na een ernstig bedrijfsongeval’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an employer and temp agency that allegedly abandoned an injured migrant worker after a workplace accident, including delayed care, a missing report and a missing care pass. The state secretary said the Labour Inspectorate knows of the accident and is investigating, could not judge the specific case or give details while the investigation is ongoing, and pointed to the government's response to the migrant-worker task force recommendations.
The Labour Inspectorate does not make statements about an individual company and/or ongoing investigation.
Over een individueel bedrijf en/of lopend onderzoek doet de Inspectie SZW geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Hoe een Haagse moskee een verzamelplaats voor jihadisten werd,’

Two PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister why a The Hague mosque allegedly became a gathering place for jihadists, whether the municipality's radicalisation approach is evidence-based, and whether the mosque should be closed and administrative detention introduced. The minister defended the persoonsgerichte aanpak as evidence-supported, declined to name individuals, rejected closing the mosque and rejected administrative detention as incompatible with the rule of law.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Regterschot over intensivecare-verpleegkundigen (ic) naar aanleiding van het artikel in de Gelderlander van 18 juli 2020: ‘Ruim 10 procent ic-verpleegkundigen Radboudumc Nijmegen

MPs Tielen and Regterschot (VVD) asked ministers about the high departure rate of intensive care nurses at Radboudumc, whether it is an outlier, and about projected nurse outflow, training places, returning former staff and anaesthesia workers. Minister De Jonge replied that a 10% employer outflow is normal and national, that the figures are not comparable to the reported ones, and pointed to the Capaciteitsplan, retention measures, returning-staff schemes and a pending study and advice.
De gedeeltelijke AOW-opbouw van in Nederland wonende mensen met een Surinaamse achtergrond.

MPs Van Weyenberg and Slootweg asked whether courts have only tested the legality of residence-based distinctions in AOW pension accrual, whether existing schemes target Surinamese and Antillean residents, whether the SVB informed Surinamese migrants about buying back AOW years, and whether the government will examine legal options to repair partial AOW accrual for 1957-1975. The minister answers that courts have found objective justification for residence-based distinctions, that a repair would create precedent and unequal treatment of other groups, that the only specific scheme is the civil-servant pension supplement, that the SVB ran buy-back campaigns with low uptake, and that the government has examined the issue at length and sent a letter to the House.

The question is whether there is an objective justification for treating Surinamese Dutch people as residents of the Netherlands while they lived in Suriname, and not treating other citizens who were not residents for a period under comparable circumstances the same way.

Het is immers de vraag of er een objectieve rechtvaardiging is om Surinaamse Nederlanders wel te behandelen alsof ze ingezetene waren in Nederland, terwijl ze in Suriname woonden, en andere burgers die een bepaalde periode onder vergelijkbare omstandigheden geen ingezetene waren, niet zo te behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Vrijdaggebed van de krappe moskee naar een ruim bemeten voetbalveld’

Two PVV MPs asked whether Muslim public prayer gatherings should be banned during the coronavirus period, whether all municipalities should be told to stop them, and when all mosques will be closed. The Minister answered that freedom of religion, assembly and expression apply equally to all religious gatherings, that the government will not ban or close all mosques, and gave no commitment to action.
The same rules therefore apply to all types of religious gatherings in the Netherlands; no distinction is made based on religious belief.
Voor alle soorten religieuze samenkomsten gelden dan ook dezelfde regels in Nederland, er wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt naar religieuze overtuiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het op dubieuze gronden afwijzen van een Tozo-uitkering

An MP asked why some sex workers in Alkmaar were refused Tozo benefits, including over stays abroad longer than 28 days, and whether municipalities' discretion creates arbitrariness. The minister replied that individual assessment applies, appeal to the independent court is open, the 4-week foreign stay rule of the Participatiewet applies, and that a toolkit has been provided to municipalities without changing their discretion.
When someone disagrees with a refusal, objection and possibly appeal to the independent administrative court are open.
Wanneer iemand het niet eens is met een afwijzing staan bezwaar en eventueel beroep bij de onafhankelijke bestuursrechter open.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat festivalorganisator Thuishaven steun van de overheid ontvangt, maar toch niet alle medewerkers doorbetaalt

MP Van Kent (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether festival organiser Thuishaven, which received NOW wage subsidy, may choose not to pay flexible workers, and whether the government will intervene. The minister replied that NOW subsidy is calculated on the January 2020 payroll and reduced if payroll falls, that employers decide how to allocate the funds, and that UWV will review compliance afterwards without a specific review of this firm announced.
For every employer that has applied for and received NOW, the UWV determines the final subsidy amount afterwards, assessing whether and how the conditions of the NOW have been met.

Voor iedere werkgever die NOW heeft aangevraagd en ontvangen geldt dat UWV de definitieve hoogte van de subsidie achteraf vaststelt, waarbij wordt beoordeeld of en hoe aan de voorwaarden van de NOW is voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Hijink over het bericht dat bij een slachthuis in Helmond werknemers, al dan niet in opdracht van de werkgever, ziekteklachten verzwegen

MPs Futselaar and Hijink asked the government about reports that workers at a Helmond slaughterhouse concealed COVID-19 symptoms and falsified forms, and about enforcement, GGD inspections, NVWA oversight and sector culture. The ministers said such conduct is unacceptable, pointed to Inspectie SZW powers and planned extra enforcement powers, and described NVWA and GGD actions and a sector review.
I intend to give the Inspectorate SZW more legal powers to enforce effectively
Ik heb het voornemen om de Inspectie SZW meer wettelijke mogelijkheden te geven om effectief te kunnen handhaven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'Piek ziekteverzuim zet ondernemers voor het blok'

Conservative MP Tielen asked the Minister of Social Affairs about news reports of record sick-leave in the first quarter of 2020, asking about non-illness absences, responsibility of employers and social partners for COVID-era work arrangements, premium effects, and costs for SMEs. The minister answered that no central data exist on non-illness absences (a TNO survey is planned), that employers, employees and sector bodies share responsibility under the Working Conditions Act, that premiums are only indirectly affected, and that central cost data are unavailable.
There is currently no figure data available on the number of sick notifications and other reasons for being unable to work as a result of the corona crisis.
Er is momenteel echter geen cijfermateriaal beschikbaar van het aantal ziekmeldingen en andere redenen voor het niet kunnen werken als gevolg van de coronacrisis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over "het vereenvoudigen van betaling pensioenpremie bij faillissement"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether workers losing jobs through bankruptcy must themselves request unpaid pension premiums from UWV, and whether pension funds should be allowed to file such claims on their behalf. The minister confirmed that workers must apply via UWV, which checks for unpaid premiums in the same claim, but declined for now to allow pension funds to file directly, citing unclear need and effects on UWV practice.
I of course remain willing to discuss the problem identified by the Pensioenfederatie and a targeted and appropriate solution where necessary.
Ik blijf uiteraard graag in gesprek over het door de Pensioenfederatie geconstateerde probleem en een gerichte en gepaste oplossing daarvoor waar noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht 'Meer ontslagen na invoering nieuwe Arbeidsmarktwet'

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the rise in dismissal applications in early 2020, linked to the new WAB labour market law, disproportionately affects older workers and whether it was intended. The minister answered that the increase is likely a temporary anticipation effect, that data on age is not kept, and that the WAB aims to make permanent contracts more attractive, while pointing to existing support programmes for older jobseekers.
For dismissal applications on economic grounds or long-term incapacity, UWV does not keep statistics on age.
Bij de ontslagaanvragen wegens bedrijfseconomische redenen of langdurige arbeidsongeschiktheid worden door UWV geen statistieken bijgehouden over leeftijd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over werknemers die buiten het flexvangnet vallen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about flex workers excluded from the TOFA emergency income scheme because of timing of pay (holiday pay in April, late February salary payments) and whether UWV could let them prove exceptions. The Minister acknowledged arbitrary outcomes, agreed UWV would handle objections coulantly, extended the application period and said the scheme was sufficiently publicised.
For the situation where holiday pay raises the social insurance wage above 550 euros in the policy administration, I agreed with UWV that UWV will act leniently.
Over de situatie waarin door uitbetaling van vakantiegeld een sv-loon hoger dan 550 euro in de polisadministratie staat, heb ik met UWV afgesproken dat UWV coulant handelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Bromet over de berichten 'Coronabesmettingen bij VION in Boxtel nog altijd aan de orde van de dag'

MPs Smeulders and Bromet asked whether the ongoing COVID-19 infections at the Vion slaughterhouse in Boxtel, and the company's claim that its workplace is safe, warrant closure in light of a parliamentary motion. The Staatssecretaris replied that closure decisions lie with the regional safety board chair on GGD advice, that the plant resumed production on 2 June with extensive measures, and that a national coordination platform is being set up, while stating no signals currently show the measures are ineffective.
The chairs of the safety regions are, under the Public Health Act, the Safety Regions Act and emergency ordinances, the competent authority to take measures at regional level.

De voorzitters van de veiligheidsregio's zijn op basis van de Wet publieke gezondheid, de Wet op de Veiligheidsregio's en Noodverordeningen het bevoegd gezag in deze om op regionaal niveau maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over een uitspraak van de hoogste Franse rechter over platformorganisatie Uber

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a French Cour de cassation ruling treating Uber drivers as employees, its relation to EU Court case law, comparability with Dutch law, and EU-level engagement. The minister answered that the French ruling resembles Dutch criteria but legal systems differ, that EU developments will be followed, and that the government is pursuing clarity on employee-versus-self-employed status through a consultation, a web module and a forthcoming response to an advisory commission.
The demarcation between employees and self-employed has priority for the cabinet.
De afbakening tussen werknemers en zelfstandigen heeft namelijk prioriteit voor het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over uitbuiting van Uber-chauffeurs

MP Gijs van Dijk asks the ministers whether Uber drivers are exploited, whether they are employees entitled to labour law and the taxi CAO, whether the Tax Authority has examined bogus self-employment in taxis, and whether municipalities can limit the number of taxis. The government answers that employment status is for courts to decide case by case, that the Tax Authority does not publish sector-specific findings or disclose individual cases, and that municipalities have existing instruments; it commits to a pilot giving municipal enforcers some Wp2000 powers and to further talks, but declines to comment on individual cases.
Whether in individual cases such as those described in the question there is entrepreneurship, I cannot assess; that is for the courts.
Of in individuele gevallen zoals in de vraag wordt geschetst, sprake is van ondernemerschap, kan ik niet beoordelen, dat is aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Groothuizen en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Geef kennismigranten en internationaal talent meer zekerheid tijdens de coronacrisis’

Three D66 MPs asked whether knowledge migrants and international students in the Netherlands should get more legal certainty during the COVID-19 crisis, including relaxed study-progress rules, extended job-search periods, and deadlines. The government answered that it will not impose consequences on temporary salary-criterion breaches under the Wtv scheme, offers flexibility on study progress and language tests, and is only exploring a broader interpretation of job-search rules, with no firm extension of the search period.

When insufficient study progress is caused by the coronavirus crisis, institutions can treat this as an excusable reason for the study delay, and this has no consequences for the student's residence permit.

Wanneer onvoldoende studievoortgang is veroorzaakt door de coronacrisis, kunnen instellingen dit aanmerken als een verschoonbare reden voor de studievertraging en heeft dit geen gevolgen voor de verblijfsvergunning van de student.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Nijkerken-de Haan over uitspraken van het Hof van Justitie van de Europese Unie m.b.t. grensarbeid

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the implications of recent EU Court of Justice rulings, notably Vester, for cross-border workers' disability benefits and pension/income gaps. The Minister answered that UWV will shorten the WIA waiting period where a Vester-type income gap arises, and will consult Belgian and German authorities on age-related gaps, but gave no figures on how many are affected.
No figures are available on the number of cross-border workers resident in the Netherlands who face one of the aforementioned income gaps.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar betreffende het aantal in Nederland woonachtige grensarbeiders dat geconfronteerd wordt met een van de voormelde inkomenshiaten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke vragen over het bericht dat de Technische Unie de stakingsregels breekt

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a 50,000 euro advance payment from employers to the union AVV, which they say is not a member of the relevant social fund, breaches ILO Convention 98 and whether any supervision of such arrangements exists. The minister answered that cao parties may structure employer contributions freely within law, that whether this case breaches the ILO convention is not for him to judge, and described ILO and national supervisory mechanisms.
Whether there is a conflict with the ILO convention in this case, for example because a payment was made in advance, is not for me to assess.
Of in deze casus sprake is van strijdigheid met het ILO-verdrag, bijvoorbeeld omdat er een betaling vooraf is gedaan, is niet aan mij om te beoordelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht ‘Ondernemingsraad in Enschede zegt vertrouwen op in Vredestein-directie’ en het bericht ‘Bedenkelijke praktijken rond Hongaarse subsidie aan eigenaar V

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about the Apollo Vredestein plant closure in Enschede, the works council's loss of confidence in management, and questions about Hungarian subsidy practices and EU notification. The minister answered that the matter is for the parties themselves, that the Hungarian government and the Commission must decide on further investigation, and that the government is working with the province and municipality to limit job losses.
It is for the Hungarian government to assess whether investigation is needed.
Het is aan de Hongaarse overheid om te beoordelen of onderzoek nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het onderzoek naar mogelijk AOW-fraude bij duurzaam gescheiden koppels

MP Slootweg (CDA) asks the Minister of Social Affairs about AOW pension fraud investigations targeting couples living apart together, including home visits, water-use checks, and whether grandparents' visits are used as evidence. The minister answers that investigations are risk-based and proportionate, reports 2019 figures (622 corrections, 122 retroactive reductions, about EUR 7.2 million handling costs), and promises an official review of the living-arrangement system.
No data are available on the number of people who entered the AOW in 2019 in combination with data on supplementary pension.
Er zijn geen data beschikbaar over het aantal mensen dat in 2019 in de AOW zijn ingestroomd in combinatie met gegevens over aanvullend pensioen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'Utrechtse arbeidsmarkt minder hard geraakt dan andere regio’s'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a news report saying the Utrecht labour market was less hard hit by COVID-19 than other regions, and asked for regional UWV data, explanations, past research, regional NOW/Tozo use, and regional involvement in support platforms. The minister answered substantively, providing the UWV publication, sector and structural explanations, lessons from past crises, a regional NOW overview, a note that Tozo cannot yet be broken down regionally, and a description of the NLWerktDoor and NL Leert Door platforms.
The use of the Tozo cannot yet be made regionally transparent at this time.
Het gebruik van de Tozo is op dit moment nog niet regionaal inzichtelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over de verplichte Marokkaanse nationaliteit

Two SP MPs asked ministers whether they would support Dutch-Moroccans seeking to renounce their compulsory Moroccan nationality, whether consular support and Moroccan consular influence in the Netherlands would be addressed, and whether they would negotiate with Morocco and EU partners. The government sympathised with the wish for choice in nationality, said it would raise the issue with Morocco, which pointed to its existing law, and said it would address undesirable foreign influence under its existing approach, without committing to new concrete steps.
The cabinet has understanding for this wish for freedom of choice.
Het kabinet heeft begrip voor deze wens tot keuzevrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Koopmans en Wiersma over het artikel ‘Marokkaanse Nederlanders bevrijd ons van de dubbele nationaliteit’

MPs from the VVD asked the government how it responds to Moroccan-Dutch citizens who want to renounce dual nationality, whether Morocco's diaspora institutions interfere in the Netherlands, and what practical help and EU position apply. The ministers answer that renunciation rights should be respected abroad, that foreign interference is handled under the 2018 unwanted-interference approach, and that the Moroccan and Turkish nationality rules are the responsibility of those states.
There can be no question of undesired influence on the individual lives of Dutch nationals and the choices they make.
Er kan geen sprake zijn van ongewenste beïnvloeding op de individuele levens van Nederlanders en de keuzes die zij maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp en Van Weyenberg over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor vrouwen

MPs Bergkamp and Van Weyenberg asked the ministers of Education, Culture and Science and Social Affairs about the economic and care impacts of the coronavirus crisis on women, including gender-impact checks on support measures. The minister answered that the evidence is mixed, that no specific gender-targeted policy is currently needed, and that the government will monitor and evaluate labour-market measures with attention to gender differences.
The cabinet will monitor and evaluate the effects of labour market measures and inform the House about them.
Het kabinet zal de effecten van arbeidsmarktmaatregelen monitoren en evalueren en de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berge over inburgering van mensen met een beperking

MP Van den Berge asks whether inburgeraars with disabilities, especially blind newcomers, can access Dutch language learning and why medical exemption is the main route, and asks about pilots and monitoring. The minister answers that 499 people were exempted on medical grounds in 2019, that no breakdown by disability type is kept for privacy reasons, that a VISIO pilot started in April 2020, and that partial exemptions will be made possible in the new inburgering law.
No overviews are kept of the type of disability due to privacy legislation.
Er worden geen overzichten bijgehouden van het type beperking vanwege privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht dat "Tata Steel onveilig omgaat met gevaarlijke stoffen en inspecteurs probeert te omzeilen"

MP Van Esch (PvdD) asked whether Tata Steel's handling of hazardous substances is unsafe, whether inspectors are undermined by management, and whether top officials communicate directly with Tata Steel over inspectors' heads. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate's concerns were from 2018, that the company has since improved but intensive supervision continues, and that the inspectorate's coordination and interventions are internally agreed, rejecting the suggestion of improper management interference.
It is up to the Inspectorate SZW to determine how it fulfils its supervisory tasks.
Het is aan Inspectie SZW om te bepalen op welke wijze zij haar toezichtstaken invult.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over ondernemers die tussen wal en schip vallen bij het aanvragen van de NOW-regeling

MPs asked whether entrepreneurs who changed legal form, took over a business or started in early 2020 fall through the cracks of the NOW wage-subsidy scheme, and whether affected firms can be compensated and included in a second package. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the scheme cannot be adapted to every case, refuses to quantify affected firms, and declines to extend eligibility to businesses without a full reference month of turnover.
I am aware of the problem of businesses that had not yet generated a full month of turnover before March.
Ik ben op de hoogte van de problematiek van bedrijven die voor maart nog geen hele maand omzet hebben gedraaid.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de nadere uitwerking van de NOW-regeling waaruit blijkt dat een horecaondernemer niet 10 procent van de loonkosten zelf moet doorbetalen maar ruim 35 procent

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a hospitality entrepreneur who found that under the NOW scheme he must bear over 35 percent of wage costs himself instead of the 10 percent communicated, and whether the scheme should be applied more generously. The Minister answered that the 30 percent flat-rate surcharge is a standardized, not sector-specific, approximation, that the scheme was communicated as tied to revenue loss, that no individual adjustment is feasible, and that the flat-rate surcharge was raised to 1.4 percent for the second NOW.
No, as already explained above, it is unfeasible to do justice to specific cases.
Nee, zoals hierboven al toegelicht is het ondoenlijk om recht te doen aan specifieke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Macron gaat buitenlandse imams weren’

MPs Becker, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Heerema asked the government about France's plan to restrict foreign imams, about radical religious influence in Dutch neighbourhoods, closing institutions, foreign-trained imams, an imam certification system, an imam training programme, informal education oversight and French-language rules in schools. The minister answered that the government will act against antidemocratic conduct without targeting any religion, points to a taskforce and a bill on dissolving legal persons, and promises an exploratory report on informal education before summer.
Due to signals of possible antidemocratic or intolerant elements within a number of organisations offering informal education, I have announced a broad exploration.
Vanwege signalen van mogelijke antidemocratische of onverdraagzame elementen binnen een aantal organisaties die informele scholing aanbieden, heb ik een brede verkenning aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de ondersteuning van mkb-bedrijven tijdens de Corona-crisis

Member Stoffer (SGP) asked the government about support for SMEs during the COVID-19 crisis, covering BMKB loan guarantees, TOGS and NOW subsidy eligibility, payment terms, and tax payment relief. The minister answered most questions with concrete measures such as lower BMKB provisions, extended loan terms, expanded TOGS sector lists, and an extension of the tax payment deferral to 1 October 2020, while declining to make blanket changes such as broad rate alignment or suspending labour law obligations.
The cabinet has decided to extend the term of the BMKB-C to 4 years.
Het kabinet heeft besloten om de looptijd van de BMKB-C te verlengen tot 4 jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over strenge voorwaarden aan staatssteun voor de luchtvaartsector in het perspectief van een sector die stevig moet krimpen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked ministers why state aid to KLM is not conditioned on shrinking aviation to within climate limits, and about stranded assets, Lelystad Airport, job losses and the closed briefing on state holdings. The government answered that conditions for KLM aid are still under negotiation, that climate targets and noise measures will be pursued regardless of aid, that the state's Air France-KLM shares lost value, and that the closed briefing was justified by the company's listed status.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Futselaar over arbeidsmigranten in een vleesfabriek in Groenlo die moesten doorwerken ondanks een corona-uitbraak

MPs Van Dijk and Futselaar (SP) asked whether meat-plant workers, mostly migrant workers, were forced to keep working during a COVID-19 outbreak at Vion Groenlo and why the plant closed late. The minister answered that the plant closed after a GGD sample showed over 20% infection, that closures are the responsibility of safety-region chairs, and that the labour inspectorate is inspecting slaughterhouses and enforcing workplace safety duties.
The labour inspectorate started on 8 June 2020 a project on slaughterhouse inspections for corona and will inspect a number of preselected slaughterhouses in the coming weeks.
De Inspectie SZW is op 8 juni 2020 gestart met het project «inspecties slachterijen – corona« en zal de komende weken een aantal voorgeselecteerde slachthuizen inspecteren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Van Weyenberg over “de steunmaatregelen voor sekswerkers”

D66 MPs Bouali and Van Weyenberg asked whether sex workers, including opting-in workers without employee premiums, can access COVID-19 support schemes (Tozo, WW, NOW), how many are affected, and why sex work may only resume on 1 September. Minister Koolmees answered that lawfully resident persons may claim Tozo, WW or general assistance if they meet criteria, that opting-in workers cannot claim WW or NOW, that sex work reopening on 1 September follows the cabinet route map and expert advice, and that he sees no way to reopen earlier.
It is not known how many sex workers there are in the Netherlands.
Niet bekend is hoeveel sekswerkers er in Nederland zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat voetbalclubs met succes een beroep deden op de regeling waarbij de overheid maximaal 9.538 euro van een maandsalaris betaalt

Van Raan (PvdD) asked whether the NOW wage subsidy, capped at twice the maximum daily wage, gave pro football clubs excessive compensation compared with support for self-employed workers, and about pay levels in football. The minister answered that NOW is a wage subsidy to employers to preserve jobs, not individual compensation, that the cap applies equally to all sectors, and that the government lacks detailed salary data for football, giving medians instead.
The UWV, which implements this scheme, does not have information at this level of detail.
Het UWV, dat deze regeling uitvoert, beschikt niet over informatie op dit detailniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over "arbeidsmigranten met corona"

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked the ministers about COVID-19 risks for migrant workers, including dismissals, working while sick, Labour Inspectorate complaints and returns home. The minister replied that employers must keep workers safe, reported 1,210 corona complaints (169 about migrant workers) with 109 investigated, and described an interdepartmental taskforce and EU guidance on free movement.
The Labour Inspectorate supervises compliance with the Working Conditions Act.
De Inspectie SZW houdt toezicht op de Arbowet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over “uitsluiting van studenten en jongeren voor de Tijdelijke overbruggingsregeling zelfstandig ondernemers”

An MP asked why young self-employed people under 21 receive only the youth benchmark under the Tozo and why students are excluded entirely. The state secretary explained that the youth norms follow the Participatiewet and parental maintenance duty, and that students are excluded because studiefinanciering counts as a prior provision, while committing to no retroactive change.
Due to the decentralised implementation of the Tozo, I do not have the requested data.
Vanwege de gedecentraliseerde uitvoering van de Tozo beschik ik niet over de gevraagde gegevens.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Kerstens, Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over gedupeerde studenten van niet-erkende beroepsopleidingen in de zorg

MPs asked why UWV referred students to non-accredited care training run by Quadrant, whether UWV and the government will prevent this and whether they will help affected students. The minister answered that UWV only checked accreditation and that the contract was ended, promised tighter voucher rules and periodic talks with trainers, but said no diploma can be issued outside accredited schools and offered only a conversation with affected students.
UWV is working on an adjustment of the procurement framework that sets out the contractual obligations of a trainer.
UWV werkt aan een aanpassing van het inkoopkader waarin de contractuele verplichtingen van een opleider zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Kent over de toepassing van werktijdverkorting en de economische gevolgen van de coronacrisis

MPs Alkaya and Van Kent asked about the uptake and processing of werktijdverkorting applications, UWV capacity, payment delays, and compensation for self-employed workers during the coronavirus crisis. Minister Koolmees answered that the wtv scheme was withdrawn in favour of the NOW scheme run by UWV, that 130,000+ employers had applied, that WW payments remain on time, and that self-employed workers are covered via the Tozo.
Therefore it was decided to withdraw the wtv scheme and to work on introducing and opening the new temporary Emergency Measure for Bridging Employment Retention (NOW).
Daarom is besloten om de wtv-regeling in te trekken, en te werken aan de invoering en openstelling van de nieuwe tijdelijke Noodmaatregel Overbrugging voor Werkbehoud (NOW).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over vrouwenonderdrukking

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked about oppression of women in marriages with migrants, including a case where a woman was killed shortly after arriving, and about isolation of partners of knowledge migrants. The government says such practices are unacceptable, points to the action agenda on harmful practices and the Rotterdam pilot, but declines a national study and says it cannot bar sponsors from bringing partners under EU family reunification rules.
Because every case of forced isolation is one too many, it has not been chosen to set up a national study into the extent of forced isolation of marriage migrants.
Omdat elk geval van gedwongen isolement er één te veel is, wordt er niet voor gekozen om een landelijk onderzoek in te stellen naar de omvang van gedwongen isolement van huwelijksmigranten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Jasper van Dijk over het onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat verhoging van het minimumloon weinig banen kost

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about a CPB update finding that raising the minimum wage costs fewer jobs than previously thought, and whether the government would reconsider its opposition to a substantial minimum wage increase. The ministers welcomed the study, said the job losses are smaller but still substantial when the benefit link is kept, and saw no reason to change their position or raise the minimum wage now.
At this moment I see no reason to revise the response to the initiative note and raise the minimum wage.
Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding om de reactie op de initiatiefnota te herzien en het WML te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Tielen over de toepassing van de NOW bij payrollbedrijven

MPs Van Weyenberg and Tielen asked the Minister of Social Affairs how the NOW wage subsidy applies to payroll and temp agencies whose workers cannot work because of COVID-19 closures, including dismissal procedures, invoicing of closed-sector clients, and possible contract dissolution. The minister confirmed payroll firms can apply for NOW as employers with 20% or more turnover loss, explained UWV assesses dismissal requests based on conditions at the client, and largely left invoicing and contract issues to the parties themselves, calling on them to talk.
Due to the sector classification used in the wage declaration, it is not possible to determine how many payroll companies have applied for a NOW subsidy.
Door de sectorindeling die in de loonaangifte geldt is het niet mogelijk om na te gaan hoeveel payrollbedrijven een NOW-subsidie hebben aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over onrust onder werknemers over arbeidsomstandigheden en behoud van baan

SP MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that employees are pressured, dismissed or made to work in unsafe conditions during the coronavirus crisis, and about employer obligations, sick leave rights, forced holiday, and NOW wage subsidy conditions. The government answered that such treatment is unacceptable, that employers must follow emergency rules and safety duties with enforcement by Inspectie SZW and police, and that NOW conditions and dismissal consequences apply, while declining to comment on individual cases and pointing to other bodies or existing rules.
I cannot judge individual reports, but in general I find it unacceptable that employees are pressured, dismissed or made to work in unsafe conditions in connection with the coronavirus.

Ik kan niet oordelen over individuele meldingen, maar in algemene zin vind ik het niet acceptabel dat werknemers in verband met het coronavirus onder druk worden gezet, ontslagen of onder onveilige arbeidsomstandigheden moeten werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘islamitische school hoort erbij’

PVV MPs asked whether an Islamic secondary school in Rotterdam should be denied funding, questioning the government's support for it and calling for all Islamic education to be abolished. The minister replied that the school's application met the statutory conditions under the WVO and that freedom of education is constitutionally protected, so neither revoking the permit nor abolishing Islamic education would be done.
The request from the Stichting voor Islamitisch Voortgezet Onderwijs Rotterdam (SIVOR) was assessed against the applicable laws and regulations.
Het verzoek van de Stichting voor Islamitisch Voortgezet Onderwijs Rotterdam (SIVOR) is getoetst aan vigerende wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het niet naleven van coronavoorschriften op vliegveld Eindhoven

Two SP MPs asked whether Eindhoven Airport charter flights carrying Eastern European workers were ignoring corona rules, whether this was an economic offence, and why the flights were not halted. The minister answered that the flights cannot be refused under EU free movement, that the airline and airport have taken measures such as multilingual information and extra staff, and that no economic offence applies.
There are no restrictions on air traffic from European member states, and therefore the flights to Eindhoven are not refused.
Er zijn geen beperkingen voor het vliegverkeer vanuit Europese lidstaten en daardoor worden de vluchten naar Eindhoven niet geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de brief van Pensioenfonds PFZW aan de voormalige deelnemers van de Accent-regeling

MP Van Brenk asks the minister about a PFZW letter to former Accent-scheme members reporting a recalculation of pensions with a retirement age of 67 and a correction, and whether this is lawful and consistent with prior commitments. The minister answers that the collective actuarially neutral recalculation raises pensions, that the correction was not caused by it and has been reversed, that administrative errors may be corrected, and that disputes belong with the fund, the Pensions Ombudsman or the courts.
It is not for me to intervene in this.
Het is niet aan mij om hier te interveniëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Kuik en Kuiken over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie

MPs asked the government about the consequences of the COVID-19 crisis for people in prostitution, including unregistered workers without income support, bed-bath-bread shelter, exit programmes, police raids, and online advertising for physical services. The minister answered that sex workers can access existing support schemes and municipal shelters, that a ban on prostitution applies under the emergency ordinance, that exit demand has not yet grown substantially, and that the ordinance may be amended to address online advertising.
Such possibilities are currently being examined.
Op dit moment worden zulke mogelijkheden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sneller over het bericht ‘Verzekeringsreus Aon vraagt personeel om loonoffer van 20% vanwege corona’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Sneller asked whether the government finds it acceptable that insurer Aon requests a 20% pay cut from staff due to COVID-19 while still paying dividends, and what role works councils and unions play. The minister declined to judge individual companies, explained that employees can refuse such requests and that works councils have only advisory or consent rights in limited cases, and noted that pay levels affect NOW subsidies and unemployment benefits.
I do not think it appropriate to go into individual cases.
Ik vind het niet passend om in te gaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over "mogelijke ondersteuning van AOW-gerechtigde zelfstandig ondernemers die in de knel komen door de coronacrisis"

An MP asked why self-employed people who have reached the AOW pension age are excluded from the Tozo income support and whether this age distinction is justified. The Staatssecretaris answered that a pension-age safety net (AOW and AIO) guarantees income up to the social minimum, so the age distinction is justified, while such entrepreneurs may still access business-capital loans.
Self-employed persons who have reached the AOW-entitled age therefore do not qualify for living-cost assistance under the Tozo.
Zelfstandige ondernemers die de AOW-gerechtigde leeftijd hebben bereikt, komen om die reden niet in aanmerking voor bijstand voor levensonderhoud op grond van de Tozo.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Bruins over het bericht dat arbeidsmigranten met hun baan ook hun bed kwijt raken

MPs Van Dijk and Bruins asked the ministers whether the government would prevent employers from evicting migrant workers who lose their jobs and charge excessive rent for housing. The minister answered that the NOW scheme encourages keeping staff employed, that housing charges are capped by law, that a task force on migrant worker protection has been set up, and that no data exists on how many workers lost housing.
There is currently no data available on the basis of which I can make concrete statements about the number of migrant workers affected by the crisis.
Er zijn echter op dit moment geen data beschikbaar op basis waarvan ik concrete uitspraken kan doen over de aantallen arbeidsmigranten die zijn getroffen door de crisis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de financiële gevolgen en regelingen voor sportverenigingen

An SP MP asked the Ministers of Health and Social Affairs why sports clubs using central payroll service bureaus cannot apply for the NOW wage subsidy, whether they should be excluded, and whether rules and accountant requirements should be changed for clubs with non-calendar fiscal years. The Minister of Social Affairs replied that the bureau is the formal employer and that changing the system is not feasible given speed and volume, pointing instead to a EUR 120 million sports support package and promising only that accountant-certificate thresholds are being examined.
Currently it is being examined below which threshold an accountant's statement is not required.
Momenteel wordt bezien onder welke grens een accountantsverklaring niet is vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over welke bedrijven er een beroep doen op de Tijdelijke Noodmaatregel Overbrugging Werkgelegenheid (NOW)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about which firms, sectors and sizes applied for the NOW wage subsidy, the contract types, subsidy percentages and the cost effect of a lower wage ceiling. The minister reported 114,049 applications and 103,737 grants by sector and firm size, but said contract-type data is unavailable and wage-distribution questions can only be estimated from CBS data.
What type of employment contract (permanent, temporary, on-call/substitute and zero-hour) did those applications relate to, broken down by sector and firm size?
Op wat voor type arbeidscontract (vast, tijdelijk, oproep/inval en nuluren) hadden die aanvragen betrekking, uitgesplitst naar sector en bedrijfsgrootte klein, middelgroot, groot en zeer groot?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het verminderde recht op toeslagen als effect van de afbouw van de algemene heffingskorting

SP MPs asked why the phase-out of transferability of the general tax credit to the lower-earning partner pushes single-earner households above the minimum wage, causing loss of allowances and reduced net income, and why the Nationale ombudsman's 2016 concerns have not been resolved. The minister explains the cause of the case, sets out a range of solution directions that are rejected as too costly or disproportionate, and promises to explore options and inform parliament by end 2020.
The cabinet wants to explore options that ensure households with an income at the social minimum always receive the maximum allowance amount for the relevant allowances.
Het kabinet wil de mogelijkheden verkennen die ervoor zorgen dat huishoudens met een inkomen op het sociaal minimum altijd het maximale toeslagenbedrag aan de voor hen relevante toeslagen ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Moorlag en Nijboer over de voorwaarden voor steun aan bedrijven

MPs Gijs van Dijk, Moorlag and Nijboer asked whether Booking.com's dividends and share buybacks should bar it from state support, whether NOW wage subsidies allow dismissals, what conditions apply to support, and whether it uses tax schemes. The state secretary answered that companies are responsible for their dividends, that support will generally exclude dividends, bonuses and buybacks, and that tax secrecy prevents comment on Booking.com's tax position, while promising further anti-avoidance work.
Due to the statutory tax secrecy obligation, the cabinet cannot make statements about the tax position of an individual taxpayer such as Booking.com.
Door de wettelijke fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht kan het kabinet geen uitspraken doen over de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige als Booking.com.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht dat keuringen voor de WIA en Wajong telefonisch worden afgehandeld

An MP asked the minister whether UWV disability assessments for WIA and Wajong are being done by phone during the Covid-19 crisis, and whether this risks wrongful decisions and people left without income. The minister answered that most assessments still include a physical consultation with exceptions, that UWV decides substantively where possible and otherwise postpones assessments without advances for WIA claims, and that safeguards include supervision by registered physicians.
To guarantee continuity and income security, UWV chooses where possible to issue substantive decisions.
Om continuïteit en inkomenszekerheid te garanderen kiest UWV er voor om waar mogelijk inhoudelijke besluiten af te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Peters over het bericht ‘MBO Raad waarschuwt: nieuwkomers moeten snelle toegang houden tot mbo’.

MPs Kuik and Peters asked ministers about the COVID-19 impact on language courses and MBO access for newcomers, and whether the government would act. Minister Koolmees answered that remote learning rules were relaxed, the integration deadline extended, MBO schools may admit students without full entry requirements, and no separate budget is planned for now, while monitoring the situation.
I will continue to closely monitor the situation and the effects of the measures taken.
Ik blijf de situatie en de uitwerking van de genomen maatregelen nauwgezet monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het vervallen van de AOW-partnertoeslag tijdens de coronacrisis

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the AOW partner allowance should lapse when a younger partner temporarily returns to work in healthcare during the coronavirus crisis, and whether a temporary concession would be made. The minister agreed and said the SVB was asked to deviate from current rules and revive the partner allowance after such work ends, for as long as the COVID-19 emergency measures apply.

Following this, I have asked the SVB, in the case where a younger partner of an AOW recipient has started (more) working in a critical profession as a result of the coronavirus crisis and this work lasts longer than three months, to deviate from the current policy rules and to revive the right to partner allowance after the work ends.

Naar aanleiding hiervan heb ik de SVB verzocht in het geval een jongere partner van een AOW-gerechtigde als gevolg van de coronacrisis (meer) is gaan werken in een cruciaal beroep en deze werkzaamheden langer dan drie maanden voortduren, af te wijken van de huidige beleidsregels en het recht op partnertoeslag na de beëindiging van de werkzaamheden te laten herleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘UWV-artsen weigeren afleggen ambtenareneed’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV medical assessors' objection to an oath of office that pledges not to harm the UWV's reputation, and whether it conflicts with the medical oath. The minister answered that the wording was revised to say the employee will do nothing with the aim of harming UWV's reputation, that the oath does not conflict with the medical oath or the public interest, and that he will not withdraw the oath.
The UWV did this based on various examples from municipalities and the oath for national civil servants.
Het UWV heeft dat op basis van verschillende voorbeelden van gemeenten en de eed voor Rijksambtenaren gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over “de coronacrisis en gevolgen voor ondernemers in de grensregio”

An MP asked the ministers whether cross-border entrepreneurs living in one country but registered as businesses in another face a precarious situation, when clarity on support will come, and whether residence or establishment requirements could be waived. The government answered that a ministerial regulation now lets such self-employed people claim living-cost or business-capital support in the country where they live or work, and that cross-border employers can use the NOW wage subsidy for Dutch-insured staff.

Therefore it is provided that the self-employed person who lives in the Netherlands and has their business or practises their self-employed profession outside the Netherlands can claim living-cost assistance, and vice versa.

Daarom wordt erin voorzien dat de zelfstandige die in Nederland woont en buiten Nederland zijn bedrijf heeft c.q. zijn zelfstandig beroep uitoefent, aanspraak kan maken op bijstand voor levensonderhoud en andersom
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de gevolgen van de Wet arbeidsmarkt in balans (WAB) voor werknemers die gevraagd worden om als zzp’er verder te werken

MP Van Weyenberg asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Finance about reports that workers were asked to continue their work as self-employed contractors after the WAB took effect, and about enforcement via the Belastingdienst and where affected workers can report it. The minister answered that no trend data exists yet, a quick scan is underway, that employers may generally structure relationships within law but cannot force self-employment against an employee's will, and pointed to inspection and reporting channels, with a half-yearly enforcement report promised.
I expect to be able to inform your House about this in May or June.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer hierover in mei of juni te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Van Ojik , Van der Lee, Özütok, Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Westerveld over de coronacrisis

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about COVID-19 measures, including drug shortages, ventilator procurement, religious gatherings, Hungary's emergency law and EU funds, tourism in the Wadden area, sex workers' access to support, and charity funding. The government answered most questions substantively, declining to ban religious gatherings in non-public places for lack of legal basis and deferring some matters to EU or regional bodies.
The cabinet emphasises that there is currently no reason to ban religious gatherings of fewer than thirty people.
Het kabinet stelt voorop dat er thans geen aanleiding is voor een verbod op religieuze bijeenkomsten van minder dan dertig personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het niet naleven van coronavoorschriften

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about police and municipalities not prioritising checks on overcrowded vans carrying migrant workers, and whether economic interests overrode safety rules. The minister said RIVM rules must be followed, that employers are responsible for safe transport, and that the government is consulting social partners and municipalities on practical solutions.

We are in discussion with social partners, municipalities, provinces and other parties to look at practical solutions to organise shared transport so that the chance of coronavirus infection is as small as possible.

We zijn in gesprek met sociale partners, gemeenten, provincies en andere betrokken partijen, om te kijken naar de praktische oplossingen die kunnen worden geboden om het gezamenlijk vervoer zo in te richten dat de kans op besmetting met het coronavirus zo klein mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over het bericht 'Afhandelaars Schiphol eisen steunpakket van 25,5 miljoen euro'

Two SP MPs asked why five ground-handling companies at Schiphol, facing 3,000 possible layoffs, were not helped by the NOW wage subsidy, and whether the government would investigate market structure and wages in ground handling. The minister said NOW conditions prohibit layoffs for economic reasons, that losses may be too small and January payroll is used as reference, and declined a separate study of ground handling, citing the ongoing EU review of Directive 96/67.
Question 5: Are you willing to investigate the organisation of ground handling at Schiphol?
Vraag 5 Bent u bereid om onderzoek te doen naar de inrichting van grondafhandeling op Schiphol
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berge over gevolgen van het opschorten van Staatsexamens Nt2 voor statushouders en andere nieuwkomers

An MP asked whether suspending the Nt2 state exams, due to COVID-19, would block asylum holders and other newcomers from starting education in September, and whether the government would talk with education institutions about solutions. The minister agreed the situation is undesirable and reported agreements with the VH, VSNU and MBO Raad allowing conditional admission for students who cannot yet show the required Dutch language level, subject to proof of level before 1 January.
I have already spoken with VH, VSNU and the MBO Raad.
Ik ben reeds in gesprek gegaan met VH, VSNU en de MBO Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Groothuizen over de positie van arbeidsmigranten tijdens de coronacrisis
