Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the position of migrant workers during the COVID-19 crisis, covering worker testing, complaint routes, dismissals, housing, travel and harvest labour shortages. The minister answered substantively on most points, stating that employers must follow RIVM rules and that complaints can go to the Inspectie SZW, while stating that no unified figures exist on evicted or travelling migrant workers.

Although these developments have our continuous attention, there are currently no unambiguous figures on the number of migrant workers who have travelled home or lost their housing as a result of the corona crisis.

Hoewel deze ontwikkelingen onze continue aandacht hebben, zijn er op dit moment geen eenduidige cijfers over het aantal arbeidsmigranten die naar huis zijn gereisd of die als gevolg van de coronacrisis hun huisvesting kwijt zijn geraakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat uitzendbureau Fides arbeidsmigranten oproept zich niets aan te trekken van het coronavirus

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a staffing agency's social media posts urging Polish migrant workers to ignore coronavirus risks were acceptable and whether it would be contacted or referred to the labour inspectorate. The minister said the agency removed the posts after the sector association intervened, that the inspectorate can act on complaints, and that RIVM information is available in several languages.
Fides took immediate action on the signal and removed the post.
Fides heeft op grond van het signaal direct actie ondernomen en de uiting verwijderd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat werkgevers in zee gaan met kleine vakbonden om cao’s te sluiten met voor hen gunstige voorwaarden

MP Van Kent (SP) asked whether the government would act on reports that employers are signing collective agreements with small, employer-friendly unions such as AVV, LBV and Qlix, and whether representativeness tests should be introduced. Minister Koolmees replied that concluding collective agreements is a matter for employers and unions, that current satisfaction data give no reason for structural reform, and that he is willing to put the issue on the agenda with social partners.
I am willing to place the subject on the agenda with the social partners and discuss it with them.
Daarom ben ik bereid het onderwerp te agenderen bij de sociale partners en met hen hierover in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over de huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs Beckerman and Jasper van Dijk asked the ministers about housing and safety of migrant workers during the coronavirus crisis, including infection risks, information provision, and evictions. The government answered that employers share responsibility, that information is distributed in several languages, that municipalities can close recreational sites with exemptions, and that agreements were made to prevent evictions.
No data are known to me on this.
Hierover zijn mij geen gegevens bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht ‘Nabestaandenpensioen in gevaar door coronavirus‘

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether negative travel advice over COVID-19 could lead insurers to refuse survivors' pensions and other policies, and whether uncertainty about this was acceptable. The minister replied that employers must follow RIVM and travel advice, that the insurers' association confirmed deaths from the virus will not affect payouts, and that the association's website addresses these questions.
The Verbond van Verzekeraars has confirmed that a death caused by the coronavirus has no consequences for payouts under life insurance, funeral insurance and survivors' pensions.

Door het Verbond van Verzekeraars is bevestigd dat het feit dat iemand overleden is door het coronavirus geen gevolgen heeft voor de uitkeringen uit hoofde van levensverzekeringen, uitvaartverzekeringen en nabestaandenpensioen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Krol, Sazias, Van Brenk en Van Otterloo over alle berichtgeving omtrent het coronavirus

Four 50PLUS MPs asked a range of questions about COVID-19 coverage, care for the elderly and family carers, unemployment benefits, the economy and EU financing, and emergency powers and enforcement. The government answered most questions substantively, commits to several concrete steps, and declines to say whether a state of emergency will be declared, pointing instead to ordinary crisis structures.
The cabinet took a decision on this on Tuesday 31 March.
Het kabinet heeft hier op dinsdag 31 maart jl. een besluit over genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over nieuwe fraude met UWV-uitkeringen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported fraud with sickness benefits (ZW) and export unemployment benefits (WW) by migrant workers, including UWV home visits in Poland, the reliability of Polish doctors' certificates, enforcement figures, and intermediaries. The minister acknowledged fraud cannot be ruled out, disputed parts of the reporting, gave detailed enforcement statistics, released a withdrawn internal report, and noted ongoing risk audits and talks with Poland.
I am hereby sending the report to your House.
Het onderzoek stuur ik hierbij aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Peters, Paternotte en Segers over het zo snel mogelijk invoeren van de inburgeringsplicht van Turkse asielstatushouders

Four MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Turkish asylum status holders can be made subject to civic integration duties from 1 May 2020 before the new law takes effect, and how COVID-19 measures apply to civic integration. The minister confirmed the duty will apply from 1 May 2020, the opt-in scheme will lapse for new holders, and the civic integration deadline is extended by two months for everyone due to the crisis.
Yes, I will act on this from 1 May 2020.
Ja, ik zal hier per 1 mei 2020 gevolg aan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Bruins over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie

MPs Van der Graaf and Bruins asked about the effects of the coronavirus crisis on sex workers, including exit programmes, income support, closure rules, online advertising, and shelter. The government answered that exit demand is being monitored, that municipalities bear responsibility for shelter and most support, and that it advises against forcing websites to block physical-service advertising.
In parallel, I have asked the RUPS organisations about the requests for help they have received since the start of the coronavirus crisis and the nature of these requests.
Parallel daaraan heb ik bij de Rups-organisaties een uitvraag gedaan naar de hulpvragen die zij sinds het begin van de coronacrisis ontvangen en wat de aard is van deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in armoede, voedselbanken en sociale werkvoorzieningen

An SP MP asked the Minister and State Secretary of Social Affairs about food banks, poverty, flex and zero-hour workers, debt enforcement, sheltered employment and migrant housing during the coronavirus crisis. The State Secretary answered that a temporary food bank fund of four million euros is provided, that income support schemes (NOW, Tozo) exist, that enforcement restraint is agreed with landlords and bodies, and that migrant housing is being addressed, mostly by referring to existing measures and further letters.
A one-off subsidy of four million euros is made available by the cabinet as a safety net for the calamity fund.
Er wordt eenmalig een subsidie van vier miljoen euro als vangnet voor het calamiteitenfonds beschikbaar gesteld door het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat bij een reorganisatie bij bandenfabriek Apollo Vredestein in Enschede 750 medewerkers op straat staan

MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a planned reorganisation at Apollo Vredestein in Enschede that would cost 750 jobs, and whether the government would intervene. The minister said the decision is a business-economic choice still subject to works council and union review, that officials are in contact with the province, municipality and company, and that the company and UWV handle job-to-job support and a social plan.
It is up to the entrepreneur himself to organise his business and to decide at which location he has the production of various products carried out.
Het is aan de ondernemer zelf om zijn bedrijf in te richten en te besluiten op welke locatie hij de productie van verschillende producten laat uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat “een aantal gemeenten grenzen stelt aan de komst van arbeidsmigranten”

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about municipalities limiting the influx of labour migrants and their concerns about housing, liveability and displacement of local workers. The minister says municipalities have instruments to address problems, opposes quotas in favour of regional agreements, reports research finding little average displacement, and promises to respond to a related action plan and D66 proposal later.
Quotas on the number of labour migrants are not the way forward, in my view.
Quota aan aantallen arbeidsmigranten vind ik niet de weg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht "Deeltijdbaan met bijstand werkt niet"

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports that part-time work combined with social assistance is hard to make work, including the option to widen income disregards and to pay allowances monthly. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, pointed to the Simpel Switchen project, the planned calculation tool and the IBO Toeslagen review, and did not commit to new legislation or a set timetable.
That is why I am working with Divosa and municipalities in the Simpel Switchen project on solutions to make part-time work alongside supplementary social assistance less complex.

Daarom werk ik in het project Simpel Switchen in de Participatieketen samen met Divosa en gemeenten aan oplossingsrichtingen om deeltijdwerken met een aanvullende bijstandsuitkering minder complex te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palland, Amhaouch, Wiersma, Verhoeven, Bruins, Gijs van Dijk, Van Kent en Stoffer over het aangekondigde massaontslag bij Apollo Vredestein in Enschede

MPs asked the government about the announced loss of 750 jobs at Apollo Vredestein in Enschede, a new Hungarian plant that received subsidies, and whether EU state aid rules were breached, and whether the government would press the Commission or the company. The minister replied that the Commission judged the Hungarian aid compatible with the internal market, saw no reason to contact the Commission or Hungary, said there were no prior warnings of reorganisation in contacts with the owner and the Enschede management, and left the social plan to the company while pointing to a regional deal.
Should further study of the case give cause for it, I will bring this to the attention of the Commission and my colleagues involved.
Mocht er na verdere bestudering van de casus aanleiding toe zijn dan zal ik dat bij de Commissie en mijn collega's die hierbij zijn betrokken onder de aandacht te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat van 2,3 miljoen migranten onbekend is waar zij zich bevinden

An SP MP asked the ministers why the government cannot track the addresses of about 2.3 million non-resident migrants with a citizen service number, which hampers inspection and enforcement against exploitation. The minister replied that many of these registrations are not migrants at all (e.g. cross-border workers), that address verification requires other data, that a plan to improve registration is being prepared, and that a further letter will follow.
Not being able to access contact details of a migrant worker hinders the Inspectorate in carrying out its tasks, both in supervision and in investigation.
Het niet kunnen beschikken over contactgegevens van een arbeidsmigrant belemmert de Inspectie dus in haar taakuitvoering, zowel bij toezicht als opsporing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de conclusie van de minister dat de inburgeringsplicht vanaf 2011 gecontinueerd had moeten worden voor Turkse asielstatushouders

An MP asked why Turkish asylum status holders were exempted from the civic integration obligation after a 2011 Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling, how many obtained permanent residence or citizenship without integrating, and whether municipalities could be asked to require them to integrate. The minister explained the exemption followed from that ruling on equal treatment and standstill rules, gave permanent residence figures without citizenship, said bijstand data is not available, and pointed to municipal responsibility and existing options under the new integration system.
This decision was based on the ruling of the Central Appeals Tribunal (CRvB).
Aan deze beslissing lag de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep (CRvB) ten grondslag
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kerstens, Van Dijk, Moorlag en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het Coronavirus

MPs from the Labour party (PvdA) asked the ministers of health, social affairs, economic affairs and the state secretary of justice about IC bed capacity, care for budget holders, immigration detention during the coronavirus crisis, temporary worker and self-employed income support, Schiphol security staff conditions, childcare leave and state support for firms. The minister answered most questions substantively, describing measures and plans, while declining to commit to a fixed IC bed scenario beyond referring to earlier letters and saying the 40-hour norm and PBM supplies were still under review.
I refer you to that for brevity.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over “de toestemming van DNB voor de fusie tussen Optas en Aegon”

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about DNB's approval of the Optas-Aegon merger, including whether policyholders were harmed by the loss of a tax benefit and whether they could have objected. The minister answered most questions, explaining DNB's position that policyholders are not parties to the decision, the publication steps taken, and that court proceedings are pending, while declining to rule on matters before the court or to have DNB verify objection counts.
In this case it is not for me to pass judgment on DNB's conduct.
Het is in onderhavig geval niet aan mij om een oordeel uit te spreken over de handelwijze van DNB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over Belastingdienst en UWV verliezen miljoenen door faillissement payrollbedrijf

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about tax and UWV losses from the bankruptcy of payroll firm Stipt, including worker losses, detection failures, the SNA quality mark and whether licensing for temp agencies should be introduced. The minister answered that individual tax debts are confidential, outlined UWV wage guarantee rules, said the SNA mark and its tax indemnity will remain while public-private cooperation is extended, and that licensing is not currently under consideration.
No statements can be made about individual tax debtors on the basis of the duty of confidentiality.
Over individuele belastingschuldigen kunnen op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Diertens over de gevolgen van het coronavirus voor de culturele sector

Two D66 MPs asked how the government will cushion the coronavirus fallout for the cultural sector, given many freelancers and self-employed artists, and what support schemes exist. The minister answered that the sector can use general economic relief measures, that rent and subsidy leniency has been agreed with several bodies, that a new self-employed benefit scheme without means test is being set up, and that consultations with the sector are ongoing.
Depending on developments, the cabinet will take necessary and appropriate follow-up measures if the situation calls for them.
Afhankelijk van de ontwikkelingen, zal het kabinet noodzakelijke en passende vervolgmaatregelen treffen indien de situatie daartoe noopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Bruins over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie

MPs Van der Graaf and Bruins asked about the impact of the COVID-19 crisis on people in prostitution, including which guidelines apply to various sex work sectors, income support, exit programmes and housing. The State Secretary answered that emergency ordinances close brothels, window prostitution, sex clubs and sex theatres while street work, escort, home prostitution and porn are not covered, that self-employed sex workers may qualify for a temporary income scheme run by municipalities, and that exit-programme capacity will be reviewed after the crisis.

I am willing, after the peak of the coronavirus crisis, to examine whether there is a significantly higher inflow of clients into the exit programmes, and whether more funds are needed and can become available.
Ik ben bereid na de piek van de coronacrisis te bezien of er significant hogere toestroom van cliënten bij de uitstapprogramma's is, en of er meer middelen nodig zijn en beschikbaar kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over een tegemoetkoming vanwege de Coronamaatregelen aan werkenden en mensen met een uitkering

MP Van Kent (SP) asked the minister whether people already on benefits, flex workers, self-employed people, WW and WIA recipients could receive crisis support, with extended benefit periods and wage-level benefits. The minister answered that the measures target workers and businesses, that the NOW wage subsidy is being designed, that WW and WIA extensions are not currently considered, and that benefit application procedures will be sped up.
Once the scheme is in place, I would gladly discuss it with you.
Zodra de regeling er is ga ik daar graag met u over in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher, Gijs van Dijk, Moorlag en Nijboer over ‘de economische gevolgen van het coronavirus’

MPs from the PvdA asked the government about the economic effects of the coronavirus, including supply and demand shocks, short-time work, public investment, support for small businesses, and comparisons with Germany and Italy. The government answered that it is monitoring the situation, has announced a noodpakket of support measures (NOW wage subsidy, BMKB loan guarantees, tax deferrals, self-employed support), says a robust forecast is not yet possible, and defers further details to a CPB scenario publication.
The cabinet of course closely monitors economic developments.
Het kabinet houdt de economische ontwikkelingen vanzelfsprekend nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Hof: deelnemer houdt recht op onvoorwaardelijke indexatie‘

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a court ruling that a participant keeps an unconditional right to indexation of pensions built up with an insurer, and about implications for the new pension contract and collective transfer. The minister said the ruling is consistent with the Pensioenwet, that collective invaren and protection of existing rights will be addressed in a forthcoming policy letter, and declined to answer some questions in detail.
I am not aware of how many collective labour agreements contain arrangements on unconditional indexation of pensions.
Het is mij niet bekend in hoeveel cao’s afspraken staan over onvoorwaardelijke indexatie van pensioenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over de televisie-uitzending van Rambam ‘Heel Holland coacht’

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Health and Social Affairs about a rise in self-described coaches, the lack of self-regulation and a possible national quality register for coaches, citing professional concern about a 'wildgroei'. The government replied that coaching is not a protected profession or part of mental health care, so it declines to judge the sector or take on a regulatory role, pointing responsibility to the profession and clients.
Coach is not a protected profession and not a function within (mental) health care.
Coach is geen beschermd beroep en geen functie binnen de (geestelijke) gezondheidszorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema, Smeulders, Westerveld en Özütok over het coronavirus (COVID-19)

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about its whole-of-government approach to COVID-19, equipment and ICU capacity, school decisions, Caribbean Netherlands coordination, economic measures like part-time unemployment benefit, accessibility of public communication, and intensified publicity. The minister answered that broad measures are in place, outlined capacity expansions and procurement steps, and committed to letters on decision-making and a school decision framework.
During the debate of Thursday 5 March I committed to inform you about this by letter.
Ik heb tijdens het debat van donderdag 5 maart toegezegd u hierover per brief te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over een toeslag vanwege samenvallende diensttijd voor gepensioneerden bij het ABP

Omtzigt asked the Minister about the ABP supplement for overlapping service years (samenvallende diensttijd), covering eligibility, how pensioners were informed and reminded, amounts, transfers to other funds, widows' rights, the PTT privatisation, and the number of recipients and unpaid entitlements. The Minister answered that ABP has now informed pensioners more clearly, that about 6,600 entitled pensioners were not yet paid and will receive back payments before 1 July 2020, and that ABP is checking roughly 3,500 more cases.
ABP will grant and pay the supplements to this group in the coming months and no later than 1 July 2020, with retroactive effect.
ABP zal de aanvullingen voor deze groep in de komende maanden en uiterlijk voor 1 juli 2020 met terugwerkende kracht toekennen en uitbetalen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Jasper van Dijk over verontrustende berichtgeving met betrekking tot de As Soennah Moskee en de reactie van de burgemeester van Den Haag op het handhavingsverzoek van Femmes for

MPs Becker and Van Dijk asked about reports on the As Soennah mosque advocating female genital mutilation and violence against women, and about the Hague mayor's response to an enforcement request from Femmes for Freedom. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the prosecutor is pursuing incitement charges, that enforcement lies with the mayor in an ongoing procedure, that the TWBMT cannot be applied without terrorism-related conduct, and that the municipality is already in contact with the mosque.
It is therefore not for me to make statements about this now, nor about the existence of limits for the college of mayor and aldermen when it comes to enforcement.
Het is dan ook niet aan mij om hierover nu uitspraken te doen, noch over het bestaan van beperkingen voor het college van burgemeesters en wethouders als het gaat om handhavend optreden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Becker over het bericht ‘Cartoonist Ruben L. Oppenheimer: “Ik radicaal? Ik hecht aan mijn vrijheid” en het bericht ‘Cartoonisten: “We zijn kanonnenvoer op de eerste ri

Two VVD MPs asked the government about threats against cartoonist Ruben Oppenheimer, apparent foreign pressure from Turkey and China, and whether the state will investigate undue foreign influence. The Minister of Justice and Security replied that the reports were noted, that the police are investigating his complaints, that press freedom is protected under the Constitution and existing protocols, and that the government opposes foreign interference but sees no direct link between a Turkish block and threats in the Netherlands.
Mr. Oppenheimer's complaints are known and under investigation by the police.
De aangiften van de heer Oppenheimer zijn bekend en bij de politie in onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Regterschot over het bericht ‘Vrouwen willen wél meer werken in de zorg: oplossing voor personeelstekort?’

MPs Tielen and Regterschot asked the ministers about a report showing many part-time care workers want more hours, and whether employers and government are doing enough to act on this instead of only recruiting. Minister De Jonge answered that increasing part-time hours is one solution direction, that the government supports the Het Potentieel Pakken foundation, and that a response to the motion on temporary contract-hour expansion will follow in the IBO Deeltijdwerk reaction due this winter.
A response to the motion of MPs Tielen and Van Weyenberg will follow in the cabinet response to the IBO Deeltijdwerk.
Een reactie op de motie van de leden Tielen en Van Weyenberg zal volgen in de kabinetsreactie op het IBO Deeltijdwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over overheidssteun aan de Grijze Wolven

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he agrees that ten municipalities subsidise the Grijze Wolven-linked Turkish Federation and whether such funding should be stopped. The minister answered that subsidy is a municipal competence, that municipalities must apply their own criteria, and that the government will act through appropriate channels if democratic-legal boundaries are crossed.
Subsidy provision is an independent competence of municipalities. The cabinet in principle does not interfere in this.
Subsidieverstrekking is een eigenstandige bevoegdheid van gemeenten. Hierin mengt het kabinet zich in principe niet.
Antwoord op de eerste drie vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg, Kuik en Van Helvert over het coronavirus (COVID-19), dat nu in Noordrijn-Westfalen is vastgesteld, vlakbij Limburg

CDA MPs asked ministers for an update on new COVID-19 infections near the Dutch border, whether German schools had closed, and what advice applies to Dutch schools, firms and travellers. The Minister of Medical Care answered that contact tracing is ongoing in Germany with no need for extra Dutch measures, that German schools closing is noted, and that Dutch schools and workplaces can stay open.
The situation is being closely monitored and measures will follow if necessary.
De situatie wordt op de voet gevolgd en indien nodig volgen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over de arbeidsproductiviteit van zelfstandigen

MP Tielen asked the Minister of Social Affairs about CBS findings that the growth of self-employed workers lowers labour productivity, and about whether productivity should be measured the same way for firms with employees and for the self-employed. The government answered that productivity is a general efficiency measure, that the slowdown reflects a range of factors such as the end of catch-up growth and weaker investment, and that it has no forecasts for future productivity but will pursue a long-term growth strategy.
Future developments in labour productivity are not mapped.
Toekomstige ontwikkelingen in de arbeidsproductiviteit worden niet in kaart gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Van Otterloo over het bericht ‘Ouderen onwetend over huurtoeslag; ANBO schiet te hulp’

Two 50PLUS MPs asked the ministers about reports that many seniors do not claim housing and care allowances and whether the government has acted on the 2018 Krol motion. The minister says non-take-up is being addressed through information campaigns with pensioner organisations, expects a reaction to the IBO report in Q1 2020, and says CPB models do not account for non-take-up.
From the Ministry of BZK an information text will be distributed to various organisations with the request to pay attention to it via their own websites and magazines.

Vanuit het Ministerie van BZK zal een voorlichtingstekst naar verschillende organisaties worden verspreid met het verzoek hier via bijvoorbeeld de eigen websites en magazines aandacht aan te besteden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over angstcultuur en doorgeslagen flexwerk bij de gemeente Rotterdam

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of a fear culture and excessive temporary agency work in Rotterdam's Work and Income unit, including non-renewal of agency contracts after a petition and alleged corruption. The minister answered that personnel policy is a municipal matter, that Rotterdam says it takes signals seriously and is in dialogue with council, and declined to take further action.
Personnel policy is a local matter for the municipality of Rotterdam.
Het personeelsbeleid betreft een lokale aangelegenheid van de gemeente Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "stijgende instroom arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkering"

An SP MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether abolishing early-retirement schemes, which removed the healthy-worker effect, was foreseen, and whether the rise in WIA inflow should prompt reviewing those schemes. The minister acknowledges the inflow rise is larger than expected, says selection effects were likely not explicitly considered, promises further analysis via motion Brenk/van Dijk, but refuses to revise the early-retirement policy in line with the Pensioenakkoord.
Following motion Brenk/van Dijk, I will examine whether further analyses are possible to explain the rise in WIA inflow.
Naar aanleiding van de motie Brenk/van Dijk 5 zal ik onderzoeken of er nog nadere analyses mogelijk zijn om de stijging van de WIA-instroom te verklaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over "de toename van het aantal mensen met een arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkering (WIA)"

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the rising inflow into the WIA disability benefit, including whether early-retirement schemes should be reinstated and why the number of disabled people is growing. The minister attributes the rise to a stronger labour market, the higher pension age and rising employment of older workers, says there is a shortage of occupational physicians, and declines to reinstate early-retirement schemes beyond the pension agreement.
The final quantitative figures on WIA benefits for 2019 are not yet known at this time.
De definitieve kwantitatieve cijfers over de WIA-uitkeringen voor 2019 zijn op dit moment nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over “tientallen illegale slaapplekken van arbeidsmigranten".

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about 48 illegal sleeping places for migrant workers in a church parish house in The Hague, including fire-safety risks, minors housed there, and who is responsible. The minister answered that the municipality is investigating responsibilities, that the staffing agencies had no direct role in housing, that no exploitation was found, and that he will respond to the SP/ChristenUnie action plan in March.
The main focus of enforcement now lies with the municipality of The Hague.
Het zwaartepunt van de handhaving ligt nu bij de gemeente Den Haag.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Tielen over de brief getiteld ‘Kamervragen van het lid Van Kent (SP), het lid Gijs van Dijk (PvdA) en het lid Van Weyenberg (D66) over het bericht dat het concurrentiebeding

MPs Wörsdörfer and Tielen asked the Minister of Social Affairs how a planned study of non-compete clauses would weigh employer interests against employee freedom, including small innovative firms, and whether it could break down use by sector and function and assess their value qualitatively. The minister confirmed the study will cover both perspectives and possibly sector breakdowns, but said its concrete design was still under discussion with employer and employee organisations.
I have promised your House to examine not only whether more conditions can be attached to the non-compete clause, but also how extensive the problem surrounding the non-compete clause is.

Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd niet alleen te onderzoeken of er meer voorwaarden kunnen worden verbonden aan het concurrentiebeding, maar ook hoe omvangrijk de problematiek rondom het concurrentiebeding is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over het bericht dat de Technische Unie de stakingsregels breekt

MPs Van Dijk and Van Kent asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a Technische Unie strike was being undermined by temporary staff, whether the Inspectorate was investigating, and about employers refusing talks with FNV and the allowance paid to AVV. The Minister answered that Waadi bans temporary replacement workers during strikes, the Inspectorate has begun an inspection whose details he cannot disclose, and that collective bargaining and courts, not the Minister, judge compliance.
I cannot provide further information about the timing and content of ongoing investigations.
Over de termijn en de inhoud van lopende onderzoeken kan ik geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Futselaar  over medewerkers van Sandd die geen baan krijgen bij PostNL

Two SP MPs asked why most of Sandd's 16,000 staff lose their jobs when PostNL takes over, whether PostNL's job offers were adequate, and what is done for franchisee workers and those underpaid below minimum wage. The Secretary of State replies that PostNL made offers to all postal workers, that about 60% of interested postal workers accepted, that the civil courts handle franchisee contract disputes, and that the Inspectorate's fine concerned unverifiable hours.
It is not for me to intervene in individual contracts between Sandd and these franchisees.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in individuele contracten tussen Sandd en deze franchisenemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Rekenrentes in andere EU-landen dalen licht’

MP Van der Linde (VVD) asks Minister Koolmees about reports that discount rates in other EU countries are falling slightly, and how Dutch pension funds compare under the EIOPA method, including Denmark, Sweden and Belgium, and the effects of the EIOPA stress test. The minister answers each question, explaining that the discount rate alone does not explain funding gaps, that differences reflect other fundamental factors, that the EIOPA method adds future indexation and a risk margin, and that the stress test has no direct consequences for Dutch pensions.
Yes, I am aware of the article.
Ik ben bekend met het artikel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Ziengs over de berichten ‘Trein stilgezet vanwege vrouw met nikab, politie geeft weer geen boete’ en ‘Conducteur aan schandpaal door nikabfans'

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers how the NS and police handled a train stopped for a woman wearing a niqab who was not fined, whether the conductor was supported, and whether action was taken against online harassment of the conductor. The government defended the professionals' discretion, said the police acted in line with agreed procedures, condemned the social media campaign against the conductor, and noted that the NS reported no other incidents since the ban took effect.
It is for the police and the Public Prosecution Service to decide what criminal follow-up is given to a violation.
Het is aan politie en Openbaar Ministerie om te bepalen welk strafrechtelijk vervolg aan een overtreding wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Becker over de collectieve zorgverzekering van Zilveren Kruis met Milli Görüs

MPs Veldman and Becker (VVD) asked whether the Zilveren Kruis collective health insurance with Milli Görüs, which they link to Erdogan's AK party and Turkish diaspora politics, is appropriate and what care-related benefit it offers. The minister answers that the government has no evidence of unwanted foreign interference, that insurers may make collective agreements, and that the collective is under review for genuine care-related added value.
The cabinet has no information showing that the choice of this collective insurance discount involves any form of unwanted foreign interference.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie die aantoont dat er via de keuze voor deze collectiviteitskorting van de zorgverzekering sprake is van een vorm van ongewenste buitenlandse inmenging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over supermarkt Picnic weigert werknemers volgens de cao te betalen

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether the supermarket Picnic's refusal to apply the supermarket collective agreement (cao) through separate subsidiaries, upheld by a court, is acceptable, and what can prevent such evasion via algemeen verbindend verklaring (avv). The minister says he does not judge court rulings, sees splitting companies to evade a cao as undesirable, but notes the scope of a cao is set by the social partners and that he cannot act as mediator unless all parties request it.
Splitting up a company merely to avoid applying a sector cao is not something I consider a good thing.
Het enkel opknippen van een bedrijf om zodoende de toepassing van een bedrijfstak-cao te voorkomen vind ik geen goede zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over de radio-uitzending van AvroTros Radar op 9 november 2019

MP Van der Linde asked the minister whether disabled workers are leaving about two billion euros of pension money unclaimed, whether UWV has an automation or organisational problem, and how pension funds can trace affected members. The minister said he lacks the data for an estimate, placed primary responsibility for claiming disability pensions with pension funds, and saw no reason for further measures.
I do not have the relevant data to give an answer to this.
Ik beschik niet over de relevante data om hier een antwoord op te kunnen geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de gevolgen van de Wet arbeidsmarkt in balans (WAB) voor payroll en detacheringscontracten

The MP asks whether workers moved from secondment to temporary-agency contracts under the WAB are a choice by employers, how payroll and agency contracts differ, where workers can complain, and whether the minister will talk to the sector federations. The minister says payroll-qualifying secondments cannot simply be converted to agency contracts, lists cost differences, points workers to the kantonrechter and Inspectie SZW, and says he will discuss with ABU and NBBU if concrete signals arise.
An employer cannot simply unilaterally change a contract.
Een werkgever kan niet zomaar eenzijdig een contract wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol en Van Brenk over het plenaire debat inzake het bericht dat het UWV ten onrechte uitkeringen verstrekt aan gevangenen (d.d. 4 september 2019)

MPs Krol and Van Brenk asked why fully non-accountable tbs patients in forensic care can keep their social security benefits, how many receive them, and whether the government will fix this. The minister says current law and Centrale Raad van Beroep case law require continuation in such cases, the number is not recorded, and the absence of a co-payment will be included in the evaluation of the Wfz, with a possible solution if unjust situations are found.
This is not known / cannot be determined.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "het bericht dat het Lage-inkomensvoordeel (LIV) een kapitaal kost per extra werkende persoon"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about SEO research suggesting the Lage-inkomensvoordeel (LIV) wage subsidy costs a large sum per additional worker, and whether it and the youth LIV should be scrapped or redirected. The minister acknowledged a modest employment effect, said costs may not outweigh the jobs created, and announced talks with employers on a more effective use of the Wtl instruments, with results to be reported in early 2020.
That is why the pension agreement provides for examining with employers a more effective use of the full set of instruments in the Wet tegemoetkomingen loondomein (Wtl).
Daarom is in het pensioenakkoord afgesproken om met werkgevers een effectievere invulling van het geheel aan instrumenten in de Wet tegemoetkomingen loondomein (Wtl) te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht 'Grote zorgen Tweede Kamer na onderzoek salafistische moskeescholen'

An MP asked the ministers about reports that salafist mosque schools and informal weekend schools are indoctrinating children, and what the government will do about it, including the role of inspection, funding and prosecution. The government answered that it is working through a taskforce and a study of informal education, pursuing transparency of foreign funding and a bill to widen the power to ban associations, but declined to rule on specific cases or prosecutions and said inspection of informal education is not fitting.
It is not appropriate to the task and mandate of the Inspectorate of Education to supervise such forms of informal education.
Het is niet passend bij de taak en opdracht van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs om op dergelijke vormen van informeel onderwijs toezicht te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Diks en Van Ojik over de investeringen van Nederlandse pensioenfondsen in controversiële wapenhandel

MPs Smeulders, Diks and Van Ojik asked the government about a PAX report showing Dutch pension funds invest over 1 billion euros in arms companies supplying Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Egypt, and what the government can do about it. The minister answered that pension investment policy is for funds and supervisors (AFM, DNB), that arms export rules were tightened for Saudi Arabia and the UAE, and that compliance with the IMVB pension covenant is voluntary but monitored.
It is not my task to supervise the investment policy of pension funds. That is for the supervisors, the Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM) and De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).
Het is niet mijn taak om toezicht te houden op het beleggingsbeleid van pensioenfondsen. Dat is aan de toezichthouders Autoriteit Financiële Markt (AFM) en De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht 'Concurrentiebeding wordt vaak oneigenlijk gebruikt'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that non-compete clauses are often misused, including their prevalence, how often employers invoke them, and whether compensation should be required. The minister answered that data on prevalence and enforcement are limited, that courts weigh justified business interests case by case, and that a review of conditions including mandatory compensation will be undertaken per a motion.
As indicated in the answer to question 4, it is not known how often employers invoke the non-compete clause
Zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 4 is het niet bekend hoe vaak werkgevers zich beroepen op het concurrentiebeding
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat het concurrentiebeding vaak oneigenlijk wordt gebruikt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether employers misuse non-compete clauses to retain staff in a tight labour market, and whether Dutch law should require compensation as in several other European countries. The minister acknowledged possible misuse, noted the Wwz rule requiring serious business interests for temporary contracts and judicial power to award compensation, provided court case figures showing no rise, and said he will study whether to impose conditions including mandatory compensation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Middeleeuwse toestanden in Heino

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about poor living conditions of migrant workers at a holiday park in Heino, including advice from staffing agencies not to register in the municipal registry, weak municipal control, the package-deal dependency, rent levels, SNF certification and permanent use of holiday homes. The minister acknowledged the seriousness of the problems, said housing complaints should first be resolved by landlord, agency and municipality, called non-registration undesirable, and promised an integrated approach to be reported by year end.
I am certainly of the view that abuses must be tackled.
Ik ben zeker van mening dat misstanden moeten worden aangepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over oneigenlijk gebruik van het non-concurrentiebeding

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about misuse of non-compete clauses in employment contracts, including how many lawsuits and settlements occur, their economic effects, and whether the rules should be modernised or abolished. The minister gave data on lawsuits and prevalence, defended the possibility of non-competes with safeguards, and promised further research into conditions for their use and possible compensation.
Following the motion by you and MP Van Weyenberg adopted during the SZW budget debate, I will investigate the desirability of setting further conditions on the use of the non-compete clause.

Naar aanleiding van de motie van u en het lid Van Weyenberg die is aangenomen bij de begrotingsbehandeling SZW zal ik onderzoek doen naar de wenselijkheid van het stellen van nadere voorwaarden aan het gebruik van het concurrentiebeding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over kwijtschelding van gemeentelijke belastingen voor AOW-gerechtigden

MP Leijten asked whether the VNG's municipal tax-remission norms for AOW pensioners are adequate, given that the maximum norm can fall below the single AOW benefit, and whether the VNG and municipalities should be pressed to change them. Minister Knops answers that the norms follow national rules, municipalities have discretion and may set the maximum at 100% of AOW plus a fixed amount, and that the norms will be considered in the local tax review, with consultation if warranted.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat er een miljardenstrop dreigt voor de overheid door de nieuwe zzp-wet

Van Kent (SP) asked the Minister whether the planned self-employment declaration could cost the state billions in premium and tax revenue, why no study had been done, why it is needed, and how it is enforced. The Minister replied that effects are complex to model, a labour-market study is under way and will be sent to parliament with the bill, and that the Belastingdienst and UWV supervise the declaration while the Inspectie SZW has no role.
At the VAO on labour market policy of 4 September, I committed to sending the results of this labour-market effects study to your House at the same time as the bill is submitted.

Ik heb tijdens het VAO arbeidsmarktbeleid van 4 september jl. toegezegd uw Kamer de uitkomsten van dit arbeidsmarkteffectenonderzoek gelijktijdig met de indiening van het wetsvoorstel te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Smals over het artikel 'Vraag naar personeel met mbo-opleiding stijgt snel op banensites'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Education about a news report on rising demand for mbo-trained workers on job sites, including labour market forecasts, shortage sectors, retraining of jobseekers and the flexible-work link. The minister answered that demand for mbo workers has risen with the economy, described forecasting and retraining instruments, and rejected the idea that mbo graduates are mostly trained for unemployment.
It has never been the case that mbo graduates are in many cases trained for unemployment.
Het is nooit zo geweest dat mbo'ers in veel gevallen worden opgeleid voor werkloosheid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Nijkerken-de Haan over de artikelen ‘Data arbeidsbeperkte werkzoekenden ontbreken massaal bij UWV’ en ‘UWV-manager Astrid Hendriks legt uit hoe de onlinekaartenbak mislukte’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister and state secretary about press reports that data on candidates with work limitations were missing from UWV's candidate finder, and about the tool's failure, including the completeness of candidate profiles and the Mediatest evaluation. The government acknowledges the tool's value as one channel, says profile completeness is an ongoing challenge shared with municipalities, and points to the broader Breed Offensief and Doe agenda measures without a concrete new step on the tool itself.
The report was enclosed with the answers and thereby shared with the House.
Het rapport is meegezonden als bijlage bij de antwoorden en daarmee gedeeld met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Palland over het ontbreken van data van arbeidsbeperkte werkzoekenden in de kandidatenverkenner van het UWV

Two CDA MPs asked why the UWV candidate browser for people with work limitations is not working due to missing data, and why so few such people were helped into work despite IT investment. The minister and state secretary replied that complete profiles are a long-standing challenge, that about 8% of profiles are available for work, that many profiles are incomplete, and that additional measures such as Perspectief op Werk and regional agreements are being taken.

Question 4: Is it true that the makers of the candidate browser system already knew that many necessary data were missing and reported this to the UWV top in 2016, but that nothing was done with this notice?

Vraag 4 Is het juist dat bij de makers van het systeem van de kandidatenverkenner al bekend was dat veel noodzakelijke gegevens ontbreken en dat zij dit in 2016 ook hebben gemeld bij de UWV-top, maar dat met deze mededeling niets is gedaan?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat jonge kinderen betaald krijgen om reclame te maken

MPs Kwint and Van Dijk asked how child labour rules apply to children paid to advertise brands on YouTube and social media, and how enforcement and transparency of sponsored content work. The Secretary of State answered that child labour rules apply when children work under authority or under a contract, including payment in kind, that children up to 12 need an Inspectorate exemption, and that the Inspectorate handles reports that are directly fineable, with a review planned for 2020.
It is conceivable that young vloggers and influencers who talk about a product they have received enter the commercial sphere, so that the ban on child labour applies.

Het is denkbaar dat jonge vloggers en influencers die iets vertellen over een product dat ze hebben gekregen daarmee in de commerciële sfeer raken, waardoor het verbod op kinderarbeid van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de mogelijkheid van pensioenoverdracht uit het buitenland

An MP asked whether people with foreign pensions can transfer them under Dutch law, and on the criteria, the obligations of Dutch pension providers, and the options when a new Dutch employer's provider refuses. The minister answered that transfers are possible under the 2015 policy decision and Article 91/92 Pensioenwet, that Dutch providers are obliged to cooperate only for transfers from EU or EEA-based insurers meeting listed conditions, and that transfers to a provider other than the new employer's are not possible.
A transfer to a pension provider other than that of the new employer is not possible.
Een waardeoverdracht naar een andere pensioenuitvoerder dan die van de nieuwe werkgever is niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Allah verafschuwt seks tussen mensen van het eigen geslacht’

MPs Wiersma and Rudmer Heerema asked the Minister about reported Islamic school teaching materials that reportedly condemn same-sex relations, questioning whether the Inspectorate of Education should have acted and whether it has sufficient expertise and powers. The Minister answers that the Inspectorate has been asked to investigate, that schools must operate within democratic rule-of-law values with sanctions possible, but largely defers judgment until the Inspectorate's report and notes the publisher will review the method with external experts.
Following the reporting, I informed your House that I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to conduct further investigation into this case.
Naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving heb ik uw Kamer laten weten dat ik de Inspectie van het Onderwijs (hierna: inspectie) heb gevraagd om nader onderzoek te doen naar deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over huurtoeslag en het minimumloon

Two SP MPs asked why the rent-subsidy (huurtoeslag) rent ceiling is lower for under-23s, how many young tenants miss out, and whether the age limit should be lowered to 18 and the youth minimum wage raised. The minister answered that the lower ceiling is deliberate to keep young people's housing affordable, that raising it would push up rents, and that no change is planned, while noting the government's stance on the youth minimum wage.
All things considered, there is currently no reason to lower the age limit of 23.
Alles overziend is er op dit moment geen aanleiding om de leeftijdsgrens van 23 jaar te verlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over WAO-aanvullingsprogramma’s

An MP asked the minister about private WAO supplementary disability insurance products that end at age 65 despite the raised AOW age, asking how many people are affected and whether the risk should be borne by insurers. The minister replied that these private products fall outside government responsibility, data is largely unavailable, the statutory WAO runs to the AOW age, and no intervention in the private market is planned.
These supplementary products are concluded in the private sphere and I do not concern myself with that.
Deze aanvullingsproducten worden in de private sfeer afgesloten en daar ga ik niet over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Palland over het rapport van de Algemene Rekenkamer 'Ouderdomsregelingen ontleed'

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Court of Audit report on old-age schemes, which found 34,000 to 51,000 entitled households not claiming the AIO, and about the SVB's ability to address non-take-up using pension-register data and records of incomplete AOW accrual. The minister acknowledged the non-take-up as undesirable, accepted responsibility for the scheme's functioning, promised further research and a possible proportionate data-sharing proposal, and admitted an earlier commitment on self-employed disability insurance was not met.
I consider the scale of non-take-up reported by the Court of Audit significant and undesirable.
Ik vind de omvang van het door de Algemene Rekenkamer gerapporteerde niet-gebruik fors en onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van der Molen over “de ANW-hiaatverzekering”

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers whether insurer Loyalis actively marketed ANW gap insurance, supplementary survivors' pension and IPAP disability cover to public-sector employees, whether their end dates tied to age 65 or the AOW age were disclosed, and whether the Pensioenkamer and the minister should act on policyholders left uninsured after the AOW-age increase. The minister answered that Loyalis responded to client requests and employer requests, informed affected policyholders and offered choices, and that the ministers have no responsibility for a private insurer, so they decline to convene the Pensioenkamer.
The Ministers of SZW and BZK have no responsibility for a private insurer.
De Ministers van SZW en BZK hebben geen verantwoordelijkheid voor een private verzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Smals over ‘de Nieuwsuurreportage over arbeidsmigranten’

MPs Tielen and Smals asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Nieuwsuur report on migrant workers, including inspection complaint figures, enforcement capacity, EU posted-worker rules, and labour market matching. The minister answered that complaints rose from 1182 in 2015 to 1817 in 2018, described inspection priorities and the extra funding, and outlined EU-level and domestic measures while largely restating existing policy.
The number of complaints and signals increased from 1182 in 2015 to 1307 in 2016, 1382 in 2017 and 1817 in 2018.
Het aantal klachten en signalen is toegenomen van 1182 in 2015 naar 1307 in 2016, 1382 in 2017 tot 1817 in 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kerstens over het bericht dat door Oost NL gesteunde Chinese spookbedrijven verdacht worden van uitbuiting van illegale werknemers

MPs Van Dijk and Kerstens asked whether government-backed regional agency Oost NL supported Chinese companies suspected of exploiting illegal workers, and what action will be taken. The minister acknowledged serious labour-law violations found by the Inspectorate SZW, said Oost NL will pause expansion support and that municipalities decide on closures, and largely deflected responsibility to the companies, the inspectorate and municipalities.
Because this information is commercially confidential, RVO.nl does not disclose specific company information for tax schemes, guarantees, indirect financing arrangements and suretyships.

Vanwege de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid van deze informatie geldt voor fiscale regelingen, garantstellingen, indirecte financieringsregelingen en borgstellingen dat RVO.nl geen specifieke bedrijfsinformatie openbaar maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Meer meldingen rond arbeidsmigranten: Cowboybedrijven omzeilen de wet’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about rising reports of Wav violations (illegal foreign workers), whether the posting notification duty and Inspectorate capacity will curb abuse, EU priority-labour-market tests, Polish work permits, and Dutch firms recruiting in Poland. The minister answered that reports rose from 1,182 in 2015 to 1,817 in 2018, that the Inspectorate is being expanded by over 400 FTE, and that EU law limits national conditions on posted workers, with supervision mainly the responsibility of the country where work is performed.
The number of complaints and signals increased from 1,182 in 2015 to 1,307 in 2016, 1,382 in 2017 and 1,817 in 2018.
Het aantal klachten en signalen is toegenomen van 1.182 in 2015 naar 1.307 in 2016, 1.382 in 2017 en 1.817 in 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Bruins over uitbuiting van arbeidsmigranten

MPs Van Dijk and Bruins asked the Minister of Social Affairs about exploitation of labour migrants, including whether Polish-registered firms bring non-EU workers to the Netherlands and whether cross-border posting rules should be tightened. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to the Wab, the Europese Arbeidsautoriteit and planned regulatory reviews, but said the free movement of services limits restrictions on work permits.
I share Mr Elzinga's view that avoiding taxes and social premiums, through sham constructions or otherwise, must be tackled.
Ik deel de mening van de heer Elzinga dat het ontwijken van belastingen en sociale premies – via schijnconstructies of anderszins – moet worden aangepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Nijboer over “de uitzending van Radar over ANW-hiaatverzekeringen”

MPs Slootweg and Nijboer asked about a Radar broadcast on ANW survivor-gap insurance that ABN AMRO stopped paying at age 65 despite policy terms tying payments to the AOW age, and about how widespread this is, how UPO and Mijn Pensioenoverzicht display the AOW change, and how to enforce compliance. The minister said ABN AMRO corrected the case and reviewed similar cases, that sector data on policy numbers is insufficient, that supervision by DNB and AFM is risk-based and will act on structural signals, and that complaints go through internal procedures and alternative dispute bodies, while calling on insurers to explain payment durations clearly.
This led ABN AMRO Levensverzekering to acknowledge that this woman was not correctly informed and ABN AMRO Levensverzekeringen has remedied this.
Dit heeft ertoe geleid dat ABN AMRO Levensverzekering heeft erkend dat deze mevrouw niet correct is voorgelicht en ABN AMRO Levensverzekeringen dit heeft hersteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een Zwartboek naar aanleiding van erbarmelijke omstandigheden voor arbeidsmigranten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a FNV blackbook on poor housing for migrant workers in Ter Aar, including rent levels, landlord-employer dependence, and enforcement. The minister acknowledged the problems, said housing is mainly a municipal and regional responsibility, pointed to existing rules and the SNF certification route, and promised an integrated approach by year end.
How housing for migrant workers is best distributed within a region and in which forms it can be provided must be decided at regional and local level.
Hoe de huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten binnen een regio het beste past qua verdeling en in welke woonvormen deze kan worden gerealiseerd, moet op regionaal en lokaal niveau worden bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Paternotte over de Kerncijfers asiel en migratie, juni 2019

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about language provision for asylum seekers from several countries (Yemen, Syria, Eritrea, Turkey, Iran, Iraq), the link to long IND waiting times, and whether same-day language lessons are possible as the coalition agreement promises. The State Secretary answered that Syrians, Eritreans and stateless people already receive NT2 lessons at procedure centres, that the eligible group will be widened by 1 January 2020 based on recognition rates and numbers, and that the Flexibilisering Asielketen programme is developing a framework to prioritise likely-admissible claims.
As soon as possible for implementation, and at the latest by 1 January 2020, the group of asylum seekers who receive an offer will be updated.
Zo snel als mogelijk voor de uitvoering, uiterlijk per 1 januari 2020 wordt de doelgroep van asielzoekers die een aanbod krijgen, geactualiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Uitzendkracht komt amper rond’

The MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about temp workers struggling to make ends meet, their income insecurity, agency profits, the use of temp work only for peaks and sick-replacement, and whether to restrict the maximum term and introduce a licensing regime. The Minister answers that agency profit is legitimate, points to on-call rights from 1 January 2020, and says the temp-regime evaluation, licensing dialogue and proposals on term limits will be reported before summer 2020 without committing to specific changes now.
At national level there are no recent figures on whether temp workers can make ends meet.
Op nationaal niveau zijn er geen recente cijfers bekend over of uitzendkrachten kunnen rondkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Peters over het eindvonnis in zaaknummer UTR 18/3505

Two MPs asked the minister about a court ruling in case UTR 18/3505, where a Turkish refugee challenged being denied a loan available to other refugees for integration courses, and whether the EU-Turkey association law applies to refugees. The minister agreed that Turkish newcomers should integrate quickly and learn Dutch, and concluded that the integration obligation should have applied to Turkish asylum status holders from 2011, referring to a separate letter to parliament.
Based on the current situation, I conclude that the integration obligation should already have applied from 2011 to Turkish asylum status holders.
Op basis van de huidige situatie kom ik nu tot de conclusie dat de inburgeringsplicht reeds vanaf 2011 had moeten gelden voor Turkse asielstatushouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht 'Zó raakt de nieuwe benchmarkrente Ester pensioenfondsen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about how the switch from EONIA to €STR as benchmark rate affects pensions funds' swap valuations, the EURIBOR outlook, collateral disputes, coverage ratios and swap hedging. The minister answered that EURIBOR remains usable after EMMI's reform and FSMA licence, that the effect on coverage ratios cannot yet be estimated, and gave hedging-ratio figures for the largest funds.
It is currently not possible to make an estimate of this, as it depends on interest rate developments and developments in the swap market.
Het is op dit moment niet mogelijk om hier een inschatting van te maken, aangezien dit afhangt van de renteontwikkeling en de ontwikkelingen in de markt voor swaps.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Bruins over leegloop en braindrain in Oost-Europa

MPs Van Dijk and Bruins asked the Minister of Social Affairs about labour emigration and brain drain from Eastern Europe, citing a World Bank warning, and whether rich countries should refrain from recruiting workers and what the EU is doing about it. The minister acknowledged the World Bank's concerns but defended free movement as a fundamental right, said member states should improve conditions at home and that the EU has no coordinated response yet, promising to raise the issue within the European Semester.

At present there is no coordinated European effort in this area, but it is clear that if brain drain is seen as a serious problem in a growing number of member states, it must also be explored at European level how to address this challenge.

Op dit moment bestaat er geen gecoördineerde Europese inzet op dit gebied, maar duidelijk is wel dat als braindrain in een groeiend aantal lidstaten als een ernstig probleem wordt gezien, ook op Europees niveau verkend moet worden hoe aan deze uitdaging het hoofd geboden kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over "de uitkomsten van het nieuwe pensioencontract bij een blijvend lage rente"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the pension outcomes under the new pension contract at a persistently low interest rate, including the yield curve, accrual rates, replacement rates and whether pensions remain inflation-proof. The minister answered that the yield curve is published by DNB, that CPB modelling is underway, and that a concrete outcome depends on premiums and returns, promising to answer further after the modelling is completed.
At the request of the steering group, the CPB will make further calculations of the contracts agreed in the accord, also examining pension outcomes under a prolonged low interest rate.

Op verzoek van de stuurgroep zal het CPB nadere doorrekeningen maken van de contracten die zijn afgesproken in het akkoord, waarbij ook zal worden gekeken naar de pensioenresultaten bij een langdurige lage rente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Bromet over de rol van pensioenfondsen bij dierenwelzijn

MPs Smeulders and Bromet asked whether pension funds such as ABP, which invests in food companies allegedly failing animal welfare standards, should change their investment policy and how the government would respond. The minister replied that ABP invests about 1.7 billion euro in 17 such companies, found no known law violations, and that the government relies on the voluntary but monitored IMVB covenant and exploring greater member control over investments.
The IMVB covenant focuses on embedding the OECD guidelines and UN Guiding Principles in pension funds' policy.
Het IMVB-convenant richt zich op de inbedding van de OESO-richtlijnen en United Nations Guiding Principles (UNGP's) in het beleid van pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het  lid Van Brenk over  de sociale staat van Nederland 2019

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the SCP finding that objective and subjective quality of life stagnated despite economic growth since 2008, and what the government will do about it. The minister acknowledges the findings, points to existing policies and measures on opportunity, housing and tax relief, and largely refers back to earlier answers without attributing the trends to policy.
The SCP does not make a statement on the extent to which policy is responsible for these developments.
Het SCP doet geen uitspraak over de mate waarin beleid verantwoordelijk is voor deze ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong, Tony van Dijck en Wilders over het bericht 'Korten kan niet wachten'

Three PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about DNB calls for pension cuts, questioning DNB's stance and its president's fitness, and asked for cuts to be taken off the table. The minister rejected these views, defended DNB's independence and advisory role, and acknowledged that some pension entitlements may need to be reduced while promising a ministerial regulation to soften the MVEV cut.
Following the pension agreement of 5 June 2019, I do intend to draft a ministerial regulation that can soften the so-called MVEV cut by giving pension funds more time to meet the MVEV requirement.
Voortvloeiend uit het pensioenakkoord van 5 juni 2019 ben ik wel voornemens om een ministeriële regeling uit te werken die de zogenoemde MVEV-korting kan verzachten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht ‘Ouderen komen amper uit de bijstand’

Member Van Brenk (50PLUS) asks whether the small decline of over-45s on welfare and their low exit to work signal failure of labour market policy for older workers, and whether the government will intensify support. The ministers answer that the decline is lagged behind the economic upturn, point to existing plans (Perspectief voor vijftigplussers, Perspectief op Werk, STAP budget) and to a planned exploration of non-voluntary offers by municipalities, but reject calling it a defeat or a lost generation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht ‘Gepensioneerden metaalfondsen gaan korting sneller voelen’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Social Affairs about metal-sector pension funds (PME and PMT) cutting pensions faster rather than spreading cuts over ten years, asking about costs, the FTK's purpose, and whether the government would intervene. The minister declined to intervene, saying funds have discretion, gave the requested financial figures, and said the pension agreement's adjustment mechanism will be worked out by a steering group.
The board of a pension fund has discretionary authority over how pension cuts are implemented.
Het bestuur van een pensioenfonds heeft een discretionaire bevoegdheid wat betreft de wijze waarop pensioenkortingen worden doorgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Blauwe moskee wil gebedsoproepen met luidsprekers versterken’

Two MPs from the PVV asked whether mosques should be closed given their alleged danger to democracy and minority rights, and what action the government would take against Friday prayer calls amplified by loudspeakers. The minister answered that founding mosques falls under religious, association and expression freedoms so closing all mosques is not an option, and that prayer calls are permitted under the Wet openbare manifestaties, with municipalities able to set rules on duration and volume.
To protect these important hard-won freedoms, the government will never resort to closing all mosques in the Netherlands.
Ter bescherming van deze belangrijke verworven vrijheden zal de overheid nooit overgaan tot het sluiten van alle moskeeën in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Jasper van Dijk over de vermogenstoets voor kwijtschelding van lokale belastingen

MPs Van Raak and Van Dijk asked whether the asset limit for remission of local taxes should be raised to reduce debt problems and the poverty trap. The minister answered that the limits mirror national rules, acknowledged an earlier letter wrongly suggested a single figure, and declined to raise the limit because a higher threshold would worsen the poverty trap.
However, if the remission limit were raised to be closer to or equal to the social assistance norm, this would increase the poverty trap.
Echter, indien de kwijtscheldingsnorm zou worden opgehoogd om dichter of gelijk aan de bijstandsnorm te staan, zou dit de armoedeval vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over absurde uitzendtarieven in het onderwijs

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked about excessive temp-agency rates in education, how much school staffing money goes to agencies, and whether the government will ban such agencies or engage the sector. The minister says the spending is undesirable, DUO is piloting better data on non-employed staff, schools are making collective agreements, and a ban on high rates is not possible since agencies set their own tariffs.
I do not know the exact spending on temp agencies in primary education.
De exacte uitgaven aan uitzendbureaus in het primair onderwijs ken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over kosten gerelateerd aan de sociale zekerheid van personen met een migratieachtergrond

An MP asked the minister, for the second time in a decade, for a full financial breakdown of social security costs attributable to non-Western migrants, including benefits, remigration payments and workers' insurance. The minister answered with CBS data on benefit use by migration background and said total cost attribution cannot be made one-to-one, though some figures were given.
The CBS has no data on the costs of social security use broken down by persons with and without (non-Western) migration background.
Het CBS heeft geen gegevens over de kosten van het gebruik van de sociale zekerheid uitgesplitst naar personen met en zonder (niet-westerse) migratieachtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het vereenvoudigen van het belastingsysteem

An FvD MP asked whether the Dutch tax, premium, allowance and benefit system could be replaced by a near flat tax plus a household standard allowance, and whether the CPB should check the author's calculations and extend them to self-employed, pensioners and students. The minister acknowledged the complexity and cited a marginal-pressure study and ongoing reform work, but said simplification always has a trade-off and that parties may ask the CPB to model proposals themselves.
Political parties are free to have proposals costed by the CPB.
Het staat politieke partijen vrij om voorstellen door het CPB te laten doorrekenen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de toekomst va het pensioenstelsel in relatie tot zijn uitspraak ‘Als de rente heel lang nul blijft, hebben we met zijn allen een probleem in een kapitaalgedekt stelsel’

MP Van Brenk (50PLUS) asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the sustainability of Dutch funded pensions under prolonged low interest rates, comparing EU member states, reserves, discount rates, indexation, macroeconomic stabilisation and the current account. The minister answers at length with EIOPA comparisons, explains that funded and pay-as-you-go systems have trade-offs, defends prudent valuation rules, and commits to researching a hybrid system and to informing the House via a roadmap.
I want to examine the advantages and disadvantages of a hybrid system.
Ik wil de voor- en nadelen van een hybride stelsel onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 50

MP Wiersma asks the minister about NCTV warnings that jihadist families and their children may pose future threats, whether municipalities are informed and funded to act, what tools they have, and the status of an evidence-based radicalisation prevention toolkit. The minister answers that multidisciplinary case consultations handle such cases, that municipalities are responsible for implementation with reinforcement funding, and that the toolkit was launched on 26 August 2019.
The NCTV will, in the coming period, look together with municipalities and other partners at what additional measures may be needed.
De NCTV gaat de komende periode samen met gemeenten en andere partners kijken wat eventueel aanvullend nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Özütok over het bericht ‘Wildgroei flexmakelaars baart zzp'ers zorgen’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that flex intermediaries are multiplying and may be used to shift risk and cut rates, and about the central government's own use of such intermediaries. The minister acknowledges misuse risks, says procurement emphasises quality over price, and says the government does not track how many people work via intermediaries, while promising further research into triangular relationships.
How many people per year work via flex intermediaries at the ministries cannot therefore be derived from these figures.
Hoeveel mensen per jaar via flexbemiddelaars bij de ministeries werken is derhalve niet uit deze cijfers af te leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de rechterlijke uitspraak dat Deliveroo zijn medewerkers pensioen moet betalen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a court ruling that Deliveroo must pay pension contributions for its workers, and whether the government would act on platform worker status and pension rights. The minister declined to comment on individual companies or pending cases, said the ruling concerns the scope of a pension obligation rather than employment classification, and pointed to ongoing appeals, existing rules and planned measures on self-employment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht ‘Wildgroei flexmakelaars vormt toenemend risico voor zzp’ers’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the rapid rise of intermediary brokers for freelancers and the risks this poses, including the ING/TCP non-payment case and BAM's freelancer constructions. The minister acknowledges abuses in triangular relationships, announces a study of agency work and triangular relations, and describes planned measures and the DBA-law replacement, while declining to assess the number of brokers or the adequacy of the Bovip quality mark.
As I previously committed to your House, I am exploring on several points which measures are needed to prevent abuse arising from labour intermediation.
Zoals ik eerder aan uw Kamer heb toegezegd ben ik op een aantal punten bezig te verkennen welke maatregelen nodig zijn om misbruik als gevolg van arbeidsbemiddeling te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Middendorp over leeftijdsontslag in het licht van het pensioenakkoord

MPs Van der Linde and Middendorp asked how the slower rise of the AOW age under the pension agreement affects civil servants' forced retirement at the AOW age, pension accrual, ABP communication, and whether discretion or exceptions should apply. The ministers answered that early retirement numbers and pension effects were calculated, that employers and employees decide on working on, and that the government stays politically restrained on collective agreement content.
Whether or not to keep working after the AOW age is a decision for the employer and the employee.
Het wel of niet langer doorwerken na de AOW-leeftijd is een beslissing van werkgever en werknemer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Graaf over berichten ‘Invloed IS op Haags jeugdwerk’ en ‘De Marokkanen nemen in de buurthuis de boel over’
