PVV MPs asked the ministers about reports of IS influence in Hague youth work and Moroccan takeover of a neighbourhood centre, and proposed measures including dismissals, closures, preventive detention, denaturalisation, mosque closures and ending diversity policy. The minister rejected the far-reaching proposals as disproportionate or contrary to the rule of law, while confirming a youth worker with radical views was dismissed and that deradicalisation funding continues.

Administrative detention, in the sense of a kind of preventive detention, is not one of the cases listed in Article 5 of the European Convention on Human Rights in which deprivation of liberty is possible.

Administratieve detentie, in de zin van een soort preventieve detentie, is niet één van de in artikel 5 van het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens (EVRM) genoemde gevallen waarin vrijheidsontneming mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over "de onrust onder bezorgers van Deliveroo na een tariefwijziging"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about unrest among Deliveroo couriers after a tariff change and whether the government would act. The minister declined to comment on individual companies, stated that contractual freedom applies, and said the planned minimum tariff for self-employed workers is still being developed.
First, I would like to note that I do not make statements about individual companies.
Vooraf wil ik opmerken dat ik geen uitspraken doe over individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de mogelijkheden van zzp’ers om deel te nemen aan UWV Marktplaats

Two MPs (Van Weyenberg, D66) asked whether freelancers (zzp'ers) can only join UWV Marktplaats if their KvK registration meets the Waadi registration duty, and how this fits with UWV's website and EU procurement rules. The minister answers that this is a misunderstanding: a sole trader acting as a natural person is not subject to the Waadi, the wording on the UWV website was wrongly aimed at suppliers and has been corrected, and freelancers can participate and have a fair chance under EU rules.
No, this is not correct. When a freelancer participates in UWV Marktplaats as a natural person, the Waadi does not apply to them.
Nee, dit klopt niet. Wanneer een zzp'er als natuurlijk persoon deelneemt aan UWV Marktplaats is de Waadi op hem of haar niet van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over de race naar de bodem van beveiligers op Schiphol

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked whether Schiphol's security tender, split among seven companies and excluding the sector CAO, risks a race to the bottom on security guards' pay and whether the state as shareholder should intervene. The minister replied that Schiphol's management is responsible for operations and labour conditions, that he will not pressure Schiphol, and gave Schiphol's reasons for multiple contractors and quality-based awarding.
It is not for me to call Schiphol to account on this.
Het is niet aan mij om Schiphol hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat ouderen nauwelijks geld overhouden

An MP asked the health and social affairs ministers about reports that older people have little money left after paying care costs, including Regioplan findings, example budgets, the earlier start of the high own contribution, and whether financial reasons push people away from thuis care into nursing homes. The minister disputes the Regioplan scope, gives partial calculations as percentages of disposable income, says the situation is hard to quantify, and promises an advisory report from a committee at end 2019.
It is impossible to determine exactly how much money older people have left, because this amount depends heavily on the personal preferences and choices of the individual client.
Het is hierbij onmogelijk te bepalen welk bedrag ouderen precies overhouden, omdat dit bedrag sterk afhankelijk is van de persoonlijke voorkeuren en keuzes van de individuele cliënt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over “het probleem dat in België wonende grensarbeiders die in Nederland werken, maar werkloos worden, tussen hun 65e levensjaar en hun AOW-leeftijd noch recht op WW-uitkering uit

Parliamentary questions by MP Smeulders ask whether cross-border workers living in Belgium who become unemployed in the Netherlands between age 65 and the AOW age receive neither Belgian unemployment benefit nor Dutch AOW, and whether the Netherlands must act under EU loyalty and free-movement case law. The minister acknowledges the gap caused by differing pension ages, says EU coordination leaves national systems in place, argues the Leyman-type case law does not directly apply, and will contact Belgium about the 15-year condition in its new rule.
My ministry will contact the relevant Belgian ministry to discuss this subject and the measure taken by the Belgian government.
Mijn ministerie zal contact zoeken met het betrokken Belgische ministerie om dit onderwerp en de door de Belgische regering getroffen maatregel te bespreken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over "Buffereisen Nederlandse CDC-fondsen onwettig"

MP Van Brenk asks whether Dutch CDC pension funds are exempt from buffer requirements under the IORP directive, and whether the Dutch government implemented the directive wrongly. The minister replies that Dutch funds always cover biometric risks, so the IORP minimum own-funds rules apply to CDC funds too, with no exemption, and that the implementation is correct.
I do not share the claim that the article puts forward.
Ik deel de stelling die in het artikel wordt ingenomen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de sociale ontwrichting als gevolg van arbeidsmigratie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about social disruption from labour migration, including housing, exploitation, municipal burdens and registration of migrant workers. The minister acknowledged problems and pointed to enforcement, the Goed Verhuurderschap trajectory, registration studies and a planned action plan, while rejecting that migrants are mainly a cost.
The cabinet is examining ways to encourage labour migrants to register timely as residents in the Personal Records Database (BRP).
Het kabinet onderzoekt de mogelijkheden om te bevorderen dat arbeidsmigranten zich tijdig als ingezetene registreren in de Basisregistratie Personen (BRP).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht 'Nieuwe probleemgroep: meer jonge mannen kunnen of willen niet werken'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that the share of men aged 25-45 who cannot or will not work has nearly doubled over ten years, and about benefit receipt, sickness benefit growth, UWV reach, and measures. The minister acknowledges the rise (4.9% to 8.1% from 2009 to 2019), notes it is still relatively low compared with women and older men, attributes part of it to the crisis, says data on sickness benefit trends are incomplete, and promises to monitor the group and pursue labour-market measures.
We are therefore closely monitoring the labour participation of this group (as for other groups) to see whether extra action is needed.
We houden de arbeidsparticipatie van deze groep (net als voor andere groepen) dan ook nauwlettend in de gaten om te bezien of extra actie nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over de gevolgen van een harde Brexit voor de Nederlandse werkgelegenheid.

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the government would take extra measures, such as short-time work, to cushion a hard Brexit's job losses, after a KU Leuven study estimated 73,200 Dutch jobs at risk. The ministers replied that existing contingency measures, support tools and social security are sufficient, that the study has important caveats, and that the government will not intervene in UK policy.
For these reasons, the cabinet currently sees no reason to deploy additional instruments to absorb the negative consequences of a no-deal Brexit.
Het kabinet ziet om die redenen op dit moment geen aanleiding voor de inzet van additionele instrumenten om de negatieve gevolgen van een no deal Brexit op te vangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma, Laan-Geselschap, Ziengs en Nijkerken-De Haan over de berichtgeving over gezichtsbedekkende kleding in het openbaar vervoer

VVD MPs asked the government whether it supports a bus driver who refused to continue with a niqab-wearing passenger, whether the face-covering ban is being applied consistently in public transport, hospitals and other institutions, and what steps will be taken to clarify enforcement with police and operators. The minister answered that operators and staff should first ask the person to remove the covering or leave, that police should be called if needed, that the practice is being clarified with sector bodies, and that the government will keep monitoring implementation.

The cabinet supports compliance with the law by institutions, paying attention to how the procedure is designed so that it takes account of safeguarding a safe public task and the roles that employer and employee have in compliance with this law.

Het kabinet ondersteunt de naleving van de wet door de instellingen, met aandacht voor de invulling van de werkwijze die rekening houdt met het zorgen voor een veilige publieke taak en de rol die de werkgever en werknemer bij deze wet met betrekking tot de naleving hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat bezorgers van online supermarkt Picnic de noodklok luiden over de arbeidsomstandigheden

An SP MP asked the government about reports that Picnic delivery workers complain about working conditions, unsafe delivery vans, dismissals of workers in contact with FNV, reliance on temp agency staff, and whether Picnic falls under existing collective agreements. The state secretary replied that employers are responsible for safe conditions, that the Inspectorate SZW monitors the sector through a risk-based programme and investigates complaints, that Picnic reports improvements and an electric cart pilot, that dismissals for union contact are not valid grounds, and that collective agreement coverage is for social partners to decide.
Whether an investigation is ongoing at a specific company is not public information.
Of bij een specifiek bedrijf wel of niet een onderzoek loopt, is geen openbare informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het bericht dat bezorgers van online supermarkt Picnic de noodklok luiden over de arbeidsomstandigheden

An MP asked the government about reports that Picnic online supermarket couriers raised alarms over working conditions, including alleged dismissals for union contact, precarious temp workers, safety, and whether an e-commerce CBA is needed. The state secretary answered that employers must ensure safe work, complaints can go to the Inspectie SZW, dismissal for union contact is not a valid reason, and CBA interpretation is for the social partners.
I have no information on whether this occurs or how often.
Ik heb geen informatie of en zo ja, hoe vaak dit voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht ‘Dure blunder van het UWV’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a UWV error in which reclaim notices (stuitingsbrieven) for benefits recovery were not properly evidenced, leading to claims lapsing, and about five years without enforcement action. The minister acknowledged the pre-2016 administrative gap (2,425 claims worth EUR 11.8 million at risk), described the enforcement process and planned digital and extra safeguards, and committed to raising the issue in the Fraud Council and with other departments.
The risk that earlier-sent reclaim letters from before 2016 are judged by the court to be insufficient, causing the claims to lapse, is however not excluded.
Het risico dat eerder verzonden stuitingsbrieven van voor 2016 door de rechter als onvoldoende worden beoordeeld, waarmee de vorderingen alsnog komt te vervallen, is hiermee echter niet uitgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Omtzigt over het artikel in de Volkskrant ‘Vijf jaarsalarissen als nabestaandenpensioen’

Two MPs asked the Social Affairs minister about a Volkskrant report that social partners are developing a survivor's pension of five annual salaries, and about related data. The minister said the Stichting van de Arbeid advice is not yet ready, that the requested statistics are not available to the ministry or to DNB, the Pensioenfederatie or the Verbond van Verzekeraars, and that the cabinet will respond after the advice in early autumn.
I have made inquiries with DNB, the Pensioenfederatie and the Verbond van Verzekeraars. The parties concerned have indicated that they likewise do not have this data.
Ik heb navraag gedaan bij DNB, de Pensioenfederatie en het Verbond van Verzekeraars. De betreffende partijen hebben aangegeven eveneens niet over deze gegevens te beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over "automatische waardeoverdracht van kleine pensioenen”

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about DNB's view that automatic transfer of small pensions is only lawful after a job change, and about pension funds' ability to identify job changes and to transfer small pensions left behind after collective termination. The minister answered that the conditions are set out in law, that exact transfer figures are not yet available, that he is considering in principle a positive response to an industry request to extend automatic transfer to left-behind small pensions while weighing the interests of employees.
I do not currently have exact figures; this will only be addressed in the evaluation of the law planned for 2021.
Ik beschik nu niet over exacte cijfers, dit zal pas in de evaluatie van de wet aan de orde komen die is voorzien voor 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over uitbuiting van arbeidsmigranten in Zeewolde

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported exploitation of migrant workers in Zeewolde, including housing conditions, wage deductions, and the role of inspectorates and private certification bodies. The minister acknowledged the problems, cited existing rules and inspection responsibilities, and promised further talks with stakeholders, but declined to confirm specific inspections and deferred some matters to municipalities.
The Labour Inspectorate does not comment on whether investigations are or will be conducted at specific companies.
De Inspectie SZW laat zich niet uit over de vraag of bij bepaalde bedrijven onderzoek is of wordt gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Wilders en Emiel van Dijk over het aantal personen met een migratieachtergrond

MPs Fritsma, Wilders and Van Dijk asked how many people with a non-Western migration background live in the Netherlands, whether third and fourth generations should be counted, whether dual nationality registration should be reinstated, and whether diversity is obscured by current categories. The minister answered with CBS figures (about 2.31 million, 13.4%), said estimating deeper generations is not policy-relevant, declined to reinstate nationality registration citing the Wet BRP conclusion that no obstacles had arisen, and disagreed that the categories hide diversity.
I also see no policy reason to make estimates of how many persons have at least one of their four grandparents, or even one of their eight great-grandparents, originating from abroad.

Ik zie verder ook geen beleidsmatige reden om schattingen te maken van hoeveel personen minstens één van de vier grootouders, of zelfs één van de acht overgrootouders, afkomstig is uit een buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol en Van Brenk over de grenseffecten van de Wet normalisering rechtspositie ambtenaren (Wnra)

MPs Krol and Van Brenk asked about cross-border social security effects of the Wnra civil service law reform, including how many civil servants would switch social security regimes, sick-pay obligations, Article 16 agreements, and notification of Belgian and German authorities. The minister answered that effects depend on individual circumstances, estimated 450 to 550 university staff might face a switch, explained the applicable rules, and said the SVB will handle Article 16 requests under existing policy and foreign authorities will be informed via the Administrative Commission.
The Minister of Education, Culture and Science is in contact with the employers' organisations and will follow developments.
De Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap is in contact met de werkgeversorganisaties en zal de ontwikkelingen volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de "gevolgen van een langdurig lage en/of negatieve rente voor Nederlandse pensioenfondsen"

An MP asked the ministers about the effects of prolonged low and negative interest rates on Dutch pension funds, including the cost of pension payouts, the role of ECB policy, and whether scenario studies exist. The ministers answered that low rates are largely structural, that ECB policy contributes but its impact is hard to quantify, and that scenario analysis and further study will be addressed in a later letter on the pension accord roadmap.
I am willing to comply with that request.
Ik ben bereid om aan dat verzoek te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het bericht ‘Groot onderzoek naar Poolse WW-fraude in Helmond: ‘Voor zeker tonnen aan onterechte uitkeringen betaald’’

An MP asked the minister about a reported criminal investigation into Polish unemployment-benefit fraud in Helmond, including what was found in raided homes, recovery of benefits, the employers and agencies involved, and cross-border cooperation. The minister answered that the criminal investigation is ongoing, so details on findings, amounts and other cases cannot be disclosed, while explaining the detection process, that UWV will recover benefits after the investigation, and the European investigation order channels used to cooperate with Poland.
Regarding exactly what was found in the premises during the searches, I cannot make statements since it concerns an ongoing criminal investigation.
Over hetgeen tijdens doorzoekingen exact in de panden is aangetroffen, kan ik geen uitspraken doen aangezien het een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht ‘ABP ontdekt deelnemers met recht op arbeidsongeschiktheidspensioen’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether other pension funds face the same problem as ABP, which found members entitled to unpaid disability pensions, and whether all funds should actively search for such members. The minister said similar issues may exist elsewhere, called on all pension administrators to adopt active search policies, and noted the Ombudsman's recommendation on reparation, while stating no immediate measures of his own were needed.
I call on all pension administrators, insofar as still necessary, to adopt an active search policy.
Ik roep voor zover nu nog nodig alle pensioenuitvoerders op een actief zoekbeleid te hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over de grote klappen voor de werkgelegenheid in Groningen

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked the ministers about reported job losses in Groningen (about 180 jobs at the RUG) and healthcare access caused by the revised higher-education funding model. The minister answered that there is no forced internal reallocation, that RUG funding changes are small (0.0% in 2020-2021, -1.1% in 2022, -0.9% in 2023), that healthcare access is unaffected, and that the government is committed to Groningen's employment and liveability.
It is the responsibility of the institution's board to allocate the government contribution internally.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het bestuur van de instelling om de rijksbijdrage intern te verdelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de kosten van pensioenen en de mogelijkheden van het in rekening brengen van te hoge kosten bij individuele rekeningen

MP Omtzigt asked the minister about Australian pension fee scandals, whether an independent advisory review should be commissioned to prevent similar abuses in Dutch defined-contribution schemes, and the AFM's findings on variable pension payouts. The minister answered that fee research will be commissioned with results by end of year, that DNB and AFM already supervise costs, and that the AFM's concerns about variable payouts will be addressed by industry improvements and possible legislative measures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Kent over het bericht 'AOW en zwaar werk'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about employers' calls for early AOW retirement for heavy-work occupations, a Austrian-style list of arduous jobs, exemption from AOW premiums, linking AOW age to years worked, and CPB and life-expectancy forecasts. The minister rejects a generic heavy-work scheme as unworkable, points to pension-deal measures for sector-level early retirement, says a study on linking to 45 years of service will finish next year, and states the CPB variant study is no longer needed.
Abolishing the AOW premium obligation for people in heavy occupations will not be feasible given the demarcation questions described above.
Het laten vervallen van de premieplicht AOW voor mensen met een zwaar beroep zal gelet op de hiervoor beschreven afbakeningsvragen niet uitvoerbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘De voorzitter van moskeekoepel CMO houdt er alweer mee op’

MPs Van Dam and Gijs van Dijk asked how the government engages with the Contactorgaan Moslims en Overheid (CMO), its membership, representativeness and agenda, after reports that its chairman was stepping down. The ministers answered that the CMO is the government's contact body for Muslim communities, lists its member organisations, and state that the government has no specific agenda with the CMO and that representation is up to the organisations themselves.
The cabinet has no specific agenda in advance for contact with the CMO.
Het kabinet heeft op voorhand geen specifieke agenda voor het contact met de CMO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over de berichten “Werkende is kind van de rekening” en “Hoe kan dat: krapte op de arbeidsmarkt én dalende lonen?”

MP Wiersma asks the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports on falling real wages despite labour scarcity, probing causes, the labour income share, sectoral wage growth, and whether data on failed collective bargaining are kept. The minister attributes weak wage growth mainly to slowing productivity growth, says the government sets no wage target, declines to monitor all bargaining or to ask the SER for a fresh inquiry, and notes a rising wage trend.
The cabinet plays no direct role in wage developments or in stimulating wage growth.
Het kabinet speelt geen directe rol in de loonontwikkeling of in het aanwakkeren van loonstijging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over de gebrekkige aanpak van mensenhandel en arbeidsuitbuiting

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked why human trafficking and labour exploitation cases so rarely lead to convictions, whether the rules on what counts as exploitation should be clearer, and what steps follow the National Rapporteur's report. The government says it is exploring clearer criteria for the grey zone between bad employment practices and trafficking, will send a cabinet response before autumn, and declines to comment on individual cases such as the fatal accident involving Romanian workers.
I will not go into individual cases. The Public Prosecution Service decides on prosecution.
Ik ga niet in op individuele zaken. Het Openbaar Ministerie gaat over de vervolgingsbeslissing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over zorgverlof voor ouders van kinderen met kanker

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether leave arrangements for parents of children with cancer should be expanded, given reports that many such parents call in sick because they cannot manage care leave. The minister acknowledged the difficulty but declined to widen statutory leave, pointing to existing options and promising a handbook for employers and engagement with social partners.
I understand the call for longer-lasting leave, but I am not considering an expansion of the leave possibilities.
Ik begrijp de oproep voor langer durend verlof, maar een uitbreiding van de verlofmogelijkheden heb ik niet in overweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over verruiming van het zorgverlof voor ouders met ernstig zieke kinderen

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the short care leave for parents of seriously ill children is too limited, whether the government should widen it, and whether it should study options abroad and free up budget. Minister Koolmees answered that employers and employees must handle such cases case by case, that the government will work with social partners on a guidance handbook for employers, and that he sees no financial room to expand leave now.
At this moment I see no financial possibilities to proceed to expanding leave possibilities.
Op dit moment zie ik geen (financiële) mogelijkheden om over te gaan tot uitbreiding van verlofmogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Laçin over "Een tankstationhouder die af wil van zijn "wurgcontract"

MPs Van Kent and Laçin asked whether franchise contracts between oil companies and petrol station operators can amount to disguised employment, and whether the Labour Inspectorate checks them. The minister answered that parties have full contractual freedom, the government has no view on the contracts, and the Inspectorate does not currently see franchising as a priority risk, though it will monitor reports.
These concern agreements between two private parties. I therefore have no view of them.
Dit betreffen overeenkomsten tussen twee private partijen. Daarop heb ik dus geen zicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Veldman en Wiersma over het aantrekken van personeel door startups

MPs Wörsdörfer, Veldman and Wiersma asked whether startups face barriers in recruiting foreign talent, including income requirements, the partner labour market access and BTW registration for foreign entrepreneurs. The government answered that a pilot residence scheme for essential startup staff with a lower salary threshold will be created, that partner labour market access is being arranged, and that foreign entrepreneurs do not need to register physically at the tax office.
It was chosen to create a separate residence scheme in the form of a pilot rather than to adjust the knowledge migrant scheme.
Er is gekozen voor een aparte verblijfsregeling in de vorm van een pilot en niet voor aanpassing van de kennismigrantenregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het afbreken van het overleg over een nieuwe inburgeringswet in de week dat het aantal statushouders in bijstand onverminderd groot blijkt

An MP asks why consultations on the new integration act (Wet inburgering) were broken off with the VNG, what it means for the timeline, and what is being done about the large number of status holders on welfare. The minister says concerns about municipal financing led to a CPB independent review with results expected mid-October, that the start date is not yet affected, and that new municipal arrangements on sanctions and welfare follow-up are still under discussion.
At the administrative consultation on 27 June I agreed with the VNG to jointly ask the CPB for an independent review of the financial consequences for municipalities.
Tijdens het bestuurlijk overleg op 27 juni jl. heb ik met de VNG afgesproken om samen het CPB te vragen om een onafhankelijke toets te doen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Eritreeër verdacht van verkrachting in Oisterwijk: ‘Het is opgelost, we gaan trouwen’'

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Justice and Security Minister about a news report on an Eritrean suspect in a rape case in Oisterwijk, including whether such cases are common and whether the suspect should be prosecuted and expelled. The Minister condemned sexual violence, noted police capacity, declined to comment on the ongoing case, said figures on comparable cases are not registered, and left prosecution decisions to the Public Prosecution Service.
It does not befit me as Minister to make statements about the case at this time.
Het past mij als Minister niet op dit moment uitspraken te doen over de betreffende zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht dat er op een basisschool in Tilburg ramadanvoorlichting wordt gegeven aan kinderen door de GGD

Three PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a Tilburg primary school's GGD-provided Ramadan information for children should be stopped, and about the societal costs of Ramadan and measures to keep Islam-related promotion out of health care, education and public media. The minister confirmed the facts, said schools may organise such activities under freedom of education and religion, referred the GGD question to the health minister, declined to quantify costs, and stated that Islam enjoys the same protections as other religions.
I see no reason to look into this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om hiernaar te kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Wiersma over het bericht ’Lerarentekort? In Brabant zitten 300 basisschoolleraren in de WW’

MPs Heerema and Wiersma asked why hundreds of qualified primary-school teachers in Brabant are on unemployment benefits while schools face a teacher shortage, and whether UWV should be obliged to match them to vacancies. The minister acknowledges the problem, describes re-integration efforts via the Participatiefonds and regional coordinators, provides a provincial table, and says a research report will be sent before summer without committing to a UWV obligation.
I agree that employers and job seekers must be able to find each other and that the parties with a role in the education labour market must do everything to ensure this happens.

Ik ben het met u eens dat werkgevers en werkzoekenden elkaar moeten kunnen vinden en dat de partijen die een rol vervullen op de onderwijsarbeidsmarkt er alles aan moeten doen om ervoor te zorgen dat dit ook gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Smeulders over de eerlijke betaling van kunstdocenten

MPs Ellemeet and Smeulders asked about fair pay, social security and working conditions for arts teachers, many of whom now work as self-employed freelancers, and about the state's role in arts education. The government answered that it facilitates the sector's labour market agenda and Fair Practice Code, points to planned statutory measures for self-employed workers, gives partial data on freelancers and insurance coverage, and says it will inform parliament about progress in the autumn.
I am aware that workers, and in particular self-employed workers, in the cultural sector often work under unfavourable conditions.
Ik ben me ervan bewust dat werkenden, en met name zelfstandigen, in de culturele sector vaak werken onder ongunstige voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Betoging Pegida in Eindhoven opnieuw verboden'

Two PVV MPs asked why a Pegida demonstration in Eindhoven was banned again and whether all mayors would be reminded that Dutch law, not sharia, applies. The minister answered that protest management is a mayoral responsibility, that demonstrations may only be banned as a last resort and never because of their content, and that no letter to all mayors is planned.
Banning or ending a (peaceful) demonstration is a last resort and only applies when necessary to protect public health, traffic, or to prevent or combat public disorder.

Daarbij geldt dat het verbieden of beëindigen van een (vreedzame) demonstratie een uiterst middel is en uitsluitend aan de orde is als dat noodzakelijk is ter bescherming van de volksgezondheid, in het belang van het verkeer of ter bestrijding of voorkoming van wanordelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over pensioenen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether pension valuation rules should differ depending on the purpose of reporting (transfer of liabilities versus meeting obligations over time), and whether the risk-free rate and 97.5% security standard in the FTK are appropriate. The minister answered that the reports serve different purposes but that for a funded pension system the aims are not separable, that the 97.5% standard is not linked to transferring liabilities, and that the risk-free curve is appropriate regardless of security level, without committing to any change.
Valuing on the basis of the risk-free interest rate term structure is separate from the degree of certainty with which these pension entitlements will be met in the future.
Het waarderen op basis van de risicovrije rentetermijnstructuur staat los van de mate van zekerheid waarmee deze pensioenaanspraken en -rechten naar de toekomst worden nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Becker over het bericht ‘Staatsvijand nummer één deradicaliseert maar niet’

VVD MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about press reports that a convicted jihadist (Samir A.) was not deradicalised despite a government-supported trajectory, and about how agencies coordinate, who leads, whether financing of terrorism is prosecuted, and what happens to those who are not receptive. The minister acknowledged the trajectory failed, defended the TER team's effectiveness, described the coordination mechanisms and roles, and stated that prosecution is an opportunity decision for the OM, but gave no concrete new commitment.
When in 2015 it appeared that the intended goal, demonstrable deradicalisation of A., was not achieved, the deployment of this expert was ended.
Toen in 2015 bleek dat het beoogde doel, aantoonbare deradicalisering van A., niet werd behaald, is de inzet van deze expert beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Becker over het bericht ‘Blauwe Moskee biedt podium aan radicale prediker’

Two VVD MPs asked the government whether it could bar a Dutch-national hate preacher from speaking at the Blue Mosque in Amsterdam, whether his hateful statements could be prosecuted or sanctioned, and how the Blue Mosque could be sanctioned for hosting him. The Minister of Justice replied that Dutch nationals cannot be excluded from the Netherlands, that the government relies on a three-track approach with municipalities, that the Public Prosecution Service decides on prosecution, and that a bill to expand the ban on radical organisations is being prepared.
In general, it is not possible to exclude Dutch citizens from the Netherlands.
In het algemeen geldt dat het niet mogelijk is Nederlandse staatsburgers te weren uit Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Smeulders over "het bericht 'Rouwbegeleiding op het werk vaak onvoldoende'”

MPs Stoffer and Smeulders asked the government about reports that bereavement support at work is often inadequate, sick leave among the bereaved is higher than necessary, and there is no statutory right to bereavement leave. The minister answered that bereavement is individual and that a guidance handbook for employers will be developed, while arguing that a statutory right to bereavement leave is not appropriate and that the evidence cited is not representative.
A statutory right to bereavement leave is currently not on the agenda.
Een wettelijk recht op rouwverlof is nu niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Gijs van Dijk over het dreigende faillissement van Utrechts Centrum voor de Kunsten en gevolgen voor diens medewerkers

MPs Asscher and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the Utrecht municipality is deliberately steering the Utrecht Centre for the Arts toward bankruptcy, leaving about 200 staff without transition pay, and whether the government will act on this. The ministers answered that the municipality has the power to end subsidies, that the courts rather than the government should judge bankruptcy motives and any disguised self-employment, and that they would not intervene in the municipality's decision.

The municipality of Utrecht has the authority to end subsidies. It is not for us as Ministers of Social Affairs and Employment and of Education, Culture and Science to judge practical situations like this.

De gemeente Utrecht heeft de bevoegdheid subsidies te beëindigen. Het is niet aan ons als Ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap te oordelen over praktijksituaties als deze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de berichten ‘Werkgevers investeren te weinig in ouderen’ en ‘Oudere werkende genegeerd’

An MP from 50PLUS asks the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports and a NETSPAR study finding employers invest less in older workers in training, and whether this amounts to age discrimination and what policy follows. The minister acknowledges lower training participation among older workers, attributes it to both employer and employee factors, and points to the lifelong learning approach, the STAP budget and the Wet Arbeidsmarkt in Balans, without committing to new concrete measures beyond ongoing consultation.
With the cabinet's LLO approach we want to encourage and support employers and employees to shift from repairing to looking ahead.
Met de kabinetsaanpak LLO willen wij werkgevers en werknemers stimuleren en ondersteunen om de omslag te maken van repareren naar vooruitkijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht dat het basisonderwijs het meest seizoengevoelige beroep in de Werkloosheidswet (WW) is

Parliamentary questions from MP Van Meenen (D66) ask about a UWV finding that primary school teachers show the strongest seasonal unemployment pattern, with a summer peak, and whether dismissals at summer's start and contract types contribute. The minister attributes the summer peak mainly to school-year changes, notes it fell 38% in 2018, says data on contract types and WW-entry is limited, and rejects legal measures, leaving pay arrangements to employers and unions via the CAO.
I do not intend to take legislative measures.
Ik ben niet van plan om wettelijke maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Geleijnse over het bericht ‘De Autoriteit Consument en Markt heeft geen gelijk, wettelijke bescherming geldt voor meer zzp’ers’

Two MPs from 50PLUS asked the ministers whether the competition authority ACM applies EU competition rules to self-employed workers too strictly, preventing them from negotiating collective rates, and whether this fosters social dumping. The state secretary answered that the ACM follows the Court of Justice's FNV KIEM ruling, that it is preparing a revised guideline on collective tariff agreements for self-employed workers around summer 2019, and that the Commission on the regulation of work will report by 1 November 2019.
The ACM has indicated that it aims to consult on the new guideline around summer 2019.
De ACM heeft aangegeven dat zij ernaar streeft om de nieuwe leidraad rond de zomer van 2019 te consulteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht dat te weinig leraren getraind zijn in de aanpak van radicalisering

MPs Becker and Rudmer Heerema (VVD) asked whether the government agrees that too few teachers have been trained to recognise and address radicalisation, given few school reports and concerns from NCTV and AIVD. Minister Slob replied that about 5,000 education professionals have been trained via SSV and 2,000 via ESS, that the government will focus training on priority municipalities and promote it, but will not make teacher training mandatory.
I do not intend to oblige teachers to follow a training.
Ik ben niet voornemens docenten te verplichten een training te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Van Kent over het bericht ‘Bedrijven maken al plannen om de payrollwet te omzeilen’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he finds it worrying that companies are already devising schemes to circumvent the new payroll law, and how he will monitor such constructions. The minister answered that the law's boundary between payrolling and temp work is sufficiently clear, that enforcement rests mainly with firms, clients, unions and courts, and that he will keep a close watch and has already written to parliament on contracting.
Of course I always want to keep a finger on the pulse to prevent new constructions involving unfair competition on employment conditions.
Natuurlijk wil ik altijd vinger aan de pols houden om nieuwe constructies waarbij sprake is van oneigenlijke concurrentie op arbeidsvoorwaarden te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over uitbuiting van arbeidsmigranten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about exploitation of migrant workers, including Polish workers, the Labour Inspectorate's capacity and risk-based approach to complaints, temp agencies, housing and fines, and a complaints office. The minister answered that the Inspectorate is being expanded, that complaints are assessed on a risk basis, that the government will send a letter on the subject before the summer recess, and that most questions were answered with policy descriptions or responsibility assigned to municipalities.
I will send a letter before the summer recess in response to the NRC article.
Ik zal voor het zomerreces met een brief komen in reactie op het NRC-artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over achterblijvende lonen

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether wage increases have lagged inflation, whether the government will raise wages or the minimum wage, and whether it will reverse the VAT increase. The minister answered that wage growth is gradually rising, that the government sets no wage target and leaves wage policy to social partners, that a minimum wage rise is not desirable, and that the VAT shift is a deliberate choice.
The cabinet does not choose to raise the minimum wage because it is not the instrument to force higher wages.
Het kabinet kiest er niet voor om het minimumloon te verhogen omdat dit niet het instrument is om hogere lonen af te dwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht 'Jihadboeken in bajesbieb/Haatlectuur op bestelling'

Three PVV MPs asked whether Islamic books inciting hatred and violence are available in prisons, how many Islamic chaplains and Muslim prisoners there are, and whether Islamic books should be banned and imams dismissed. The minister answered that detainees may read religious literature unless it threatens order or security, that the director may refuse books inciting discrimination or violence, that DJI employs 43 FTE Islamic chaplains without central registration of detainees' religion, and rejected banning books or dismissing imams.
Detainees are not centrally registered by religion or belief.
Gedetineerden worden niet centraal geregistreerd op religie of levensbeschouwing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Beckerman over arbeidsmigranten die een goudmijn zijn voor verhuurders

MPs Van Dijk and Beckerman asked about reports that holiday bungalows in Ewijk are used to house migrant workers as a profitable model, the adequacy of oversight of exploitation and housing conditions, and what legal tools exist against exploitative landlords. The minister called such use undesirable in principle, said the Inspectorate SZW cannot judge exploitation from press reports, described lokal housing inspection and inter-agency cooperation, and pointed to pilots against bad landlords and forthcoming measures.
I cannot assess from the press reports whether there is exploitation or judge the specific housing conditions, partly because the expertise to assess this is assigned to other organisations.

Ik kan op basis van de berichtgeving niet beoordelen of er sprake is van uitbuiting of oordelen over de specifieke woonomstandigheden, mede omdat de expertise om te beoordelen of hier sprake van is bij andere organisaties is belegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘AIVD: zorgen over radicalisme bij naschoolse Arabische lessen’

MPs Becker and Laan-Geselschap asked about AIVD concerns over radicalism at informal Arabic-language after-school lessons and whether supervision of such informal education should be broadened. The minister answered that the government lacks full insight into informal schooling, will commission an independent exploration in three stages including possible supervision and intervention options, and pointed to the evaluation of the Wet op de Jeugdverblijven due in summer 2019.
Therefore the cabinet will commission an exploration of forms of informal schooling in the Netherlands to gain more insight into their nature and scope.
Daarom gaat het kabinet een verkenning laten uitvoeren naar vormen van informele scholing in Nederland om meer inzicht in aard en omvang ervan te verkrijgen.
Àntwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Van Eijs en Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘800.000 Nederlanders kregen kanker, na ‘genezing’ houden zij problemen’

Three D66 MPs asked the health, finance and social affairs ministers about reports that many cancer survivors face lasting problems, including ongoing fatigue, lack of aftercare and advice, difficulties returning to work, and problems obtaining mortgages and insurance. The ministers answered that care providers should be doing more, that existing initiatives such as a no-risk insurance pilot and a Taskforce Cancer Survivorship are underway, and that the government sees little need for its own intervention, while promising to review mortgage and insurance issues with the sector.

In preparation for the next Platform meeting in 2020, I will ask how lenders handle the life insurance requirement and whether parties experience other bottlenecks in mortgage provision to (ex-)cancer patients.

Ik zal in voorbereiding op de volgende Platform bijeenkomst in 2020 uitvragen hoe kredietverstrekkers omgaan met de overlijdensrisicoverzekering en of partijen andere knelpunten ervaren op het gebied van hypotheekverstrekking aan (ex)kankerpatiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een onvoldoende voor het UWV

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the minister about a poor UWV quality assessment, why parliament was not informed earlier, whether internal reports would be shared, and whether errors in disability assessments would be corrected and affected people compensated. The minister acknowledged concerns about caseworker quality, said the impact on benefits could not be established, announced confidential inspection of the documents for parliament, and ruled out an independent appeal commission.
I will make the documents requested by newspaper Trouw under the Open Government Act available for confidential inspection by your House.
Ik zal de documenten die op grond van een beroep op de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur door dagblad Trouw zijn opgevraagd ter vertrouwelijke inzage leggen bij uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over leegloop en braindrain door arbeidsmigratie binnen de EU

An SP MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about emigration and brain drain from EU countries caused by intra-EU labour mobility, and whether free movement should be regulated. The minister acknowledges concerns, defends free movement as a fundamental right while noting its downsides, points to recent EU labour rules and a stronger European Semester, and makes no commitment to a concrete legislative proposal.
I am in favour of free movement, but I consider it important that there are rules to address its negative consequences.
Ik ben voorstander van het vrij verkeer, maar vind het van belang dat er regels zijn om negatieve gevolgen ervan aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Veldman over het bericht dat er op basisschool de Stelaertshoeve in Tilburg door de GGD voorlichting wordt gegeven over de ramadan

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Health about GGD health education on Ramadan given at a Tilburg primary school, including its purpose, whether it is GGD policy, how widespread it is, and whether other religious practices get similar attention. The State Secretary answered that the GGD advises schools on request within the Healthy School approach, that the Ramadan advice was tailored to exam or CITO test periods and given to a school and some parents, and that no other religious-holiday requests have been received.
For the whole of the Netherlands this question cannot be answered. No registration takes place.
Voor geheel Nederland kan deze vraag niet beantwoord worden. Er vindt geen registratie plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat een niet-bewezen effectieve therapie bij ADHD wel door zorgverzekeraars vergoed wordt

MPs Raemakers and Van Weyenberg asked the ministers whether insurers, municipalities and UWV fund horse therapy for ADHD and other treatments not proven effective. The minister replied that such therapy is outside the basic package, that insurers set their own supplementary coverage, that UWV buys horse-coaching as Werk-Fit activation with success monitoring, and that the Jeugdwet and PGB rules apply to municipalities without a full list of funded treatments.
We therefore do not have a (complete) overview of which treatments or therapies are reimbursed from the supplementary package.
Wij beschikken dan ook niet over een (totaal)overzicht van welke behandelingen of therapieën uit het aanvullende pakket vergoed worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Rudmer Heerema en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht dat meisjes met een migratie-achtergrond al in de basisschoolleeftijd worden ontvoerd en uitgehuwelijkt

MPs Becker, Rudmer Heerema and Van Wijngaarden asked whether girls with a migration background are abducted and married off from primary school age, how many cases exist, how schools report them, and what legal and consular tools exist. The minister answered that no 2018 reports involved primary-school-age victims, gave case counts, pointed to existing reporting and court-intervention routes, and promised further steps in a June progress report.
Exact figures on the abandonment of minors abroad are currently not available, as figures on this specific subject cannot be derived from the current registration system.

Exacte cijfers over achterlating van minderjarigen in het buitenland, zijn momenteel niet beschikbaar aangezien cijfers over dit specifieke onderwerp niet te herleiden zijn uit het huidige registratiesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht dat de politie in Limburg negen islamitische nachtmaaltijden organiseert

Two PVV MPs asked whether it is absurd that the Limburg police organise nine Islamic night meals and whether these should be cancelled in favour of fighting crime. Minister Grapperhaus answered that police units decide locally on community activities across many groups, that police should remain neutral and connected to all groups, and that he supports such activities as strengthening community ties and authority.
The way in which policy can best be given form locally and which activities accompany it, I leave to the police units themselves.
De wijze waarop het beleid lokaal het beste vorm gegeven kan worden en met welke activiteiten dat gepaard gaat, laat ik aan de politie-eenheden zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Becker over het bericht ‘Islamitische Haga Lyceum van plan meer omstreden predikers uit te nodigen’

MPs Heerema and Becker asked the government about a school inviting controversial preachers, asking whether it can refuse entry, act through EU-level lists, and use the proposed changes to article 2:20 BW against such schools. The minister called the invitations undesirable, said entry bans on EU citizens are unrealistic and EU blacklists undesirable due to the ban on censorship, and said dissolution of organisations under 2:20 BW is case-dependent for the courts.
Under article 2:20 of the Civil Code, the court may, at the request of the Public Prosecution Service, declare a legal entity whose activities conflict with public order prohibited and dissolve it.
Op basis van artikel 2:20 BW kan de Rechtbank op verzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie een rechtspersoon waarvan de werkzaamheid in strijd is met de openbare orde, verboden verklaren en ontbinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over elke week een maaltijdbezorger gewond naar het ziekenhuis

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the frequent serious accidents involving meal delivery workers, their piece-rate pay, uninsured status, and whether the Labour Inspectorate will investigate. The State Secretary said worker safety is a SZW concern, that minimum wage law still applies to platform workers, that the Inspectorate runs risk-based oversight and a meal-delivery project, and that accident notification duties exist but the Inspectorate has not launched a dedicated sector investigation.

The Labour Inspectorate exercises risk-based supervision of compliance with labour legislation and uses instruments such as information campaigns, sector influencing, client approaches and inspections.

De Inspectie SZW houdt risicogericht toezicht op de naleving van de arbeidswetgeving en gebruikt instrumenten als voorlichtingen, branchebeïnvloeding, opdrachtgeversaanpak en het uitvoeren van inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht 'Moslimdocenten wilden mij weg hebben'

MPs from the PVV asked whether a teacher's criticism of Islam, immigration and climate policy outside school is permitted, whether other teachers were pushed out for criticising Islam, and whether school managers should face consequences for how a teacher was treated by Muslim colleagues. The minister confirmed a teacher may voice criticism outside school, said no similar cases are known, and declined to judge the individual school situation, leaving it to school leadership.
It is not appropriate for me to pass judgment on that based on a newspaper article.
Het past mij niet om daarover op basis van een krantenartikel een oordeel te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Groen licht voor islamitisch meisjesinternaat in Blerick’

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a Blerick Islamic girls' boarding school should be closed and whether all Islamic boarding and weekend schools should be shut, given sharia-based teaching. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, rejected closure, and said supervision of youth boarding facilities lies with the municipality, whose mayor can close one only on a well-founded suspicion of an offence or serious threat to a minor's development.
After the youth residence opens, the institution falls under the supervision established by the Youth Residences Act.
Na opening van het jeugdverblijf valt de instelling onder het toezicht dat is gerealiseerd met de Wet op de jeugdverblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht 'Haatpreek wint terrein'

Two VVD MPs asked ministers about salafist hate preachers in mosques and online, and about counter-strategies, sanctions and closing mosques. The government answered that it applies criminal prosecution, travel bans, the Twbmt, a planned civil-law route to ban radical organisations, and an integrated approach, while declining to comment on specific individuals or to commission a further investigation into online platforms.
I cannot make statements about possible ongoing actions against the spiritual leaders mentioned in the article.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over mogelijk lopende acties tegen de in het artikel genoemde voormannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat Shell van plan is stakers te korten op hun salaris

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Shell's plan to cut striking workers' wages at Pernis and Moerdijk is consistent with the right to strike, and whether the company should be called to account. The minister confirmed that strikes are a social right and that employers may not dismiss or otherwise punish strikers, but may withhold pay for strike hours under Dutch civil law, leaving disputes to the courts and declining to intervene in the collective bargaining.
Strikes are a matter between employers and trade unions. It is up to them to conduct collective negotiations and give substance to the right to collective action. I play no role in this.
Stakingen zijn een zaak tussen werkgevers en vakbonden. Het is aan hen om collectieve onderhandelingen te voeren en invulling te geven aan het recht op collectief optreden. Ik speel hierin geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Onderzoek: deelnemers bereid in te leveren voor duurzaam beleggen’

MP Van Weyenberg asked the minister of Social Affairs about survey results showing that pension fund members want sustainable investing and influence over it, and about the Eerlijk Pensioenlabel ratings and standardisation of sustainability measurement. The minister responded that the fund boards remain responsible for investment policy, pointed to existing transparency rules and the IMVB convenant, and said the government would send an overview of EU developments before summer.
The investment policy of pension funds remains primarily the responsibility of the pension fund board.
Het beleggingsbeleid van pensioenfondsen blijft in de eerste plaats een verantwoordelijkheid van het pensioenfondsbestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie een inbreukprocedure tegen Nederland is gestart over de IORP 2 richtlijn

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that the European Commission had opened an infringement procedure against the Netherlands over the IORP II directive, including whether implementation was complete and why the EU website showed partial implementation. The minister answered that the directive was fully transposed into force on 13 January 2019, that the notification to the Commission was late and wrongly marked as partial, and that it has since been corrected.
I regret that a late and incorrect notification has caused confusion about the implementation status of the directive in the Netherlands.
Ik betreur het dat door een te late en onjuiste melding onduidelijkheid is ontstaan over de implementatiestatus van de richtlijn in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht ‘Patstelling aan cao-tafels’

MP Wiersma (VVD) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of a deadlock at collective bargaining tables, including the number of concluded CAOs, failed negotiations, alternative arrangements like Jumbo's, and the government's role. The minister answered that CAO numbers do not show a systemic breakdown, that failed negotiations are not recorded, that bargaining is for unions and employers, and that no government initiative is planned.
Data on the number of failed or broken-off CAO negotiations are not kept.
Gegevens over het aantal mislukte of afgebroken cao-onderhandelingen worden niet bijgehouden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over rijnvarenden, die grote persoonlijke naheffingen ontvingen van de Nederlandse belastingdienst voor sociale premies, die zij ook al in Luxemburg betaald hebben

MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked why Rhine boatmen face large Dutch social premium back-assessments already paid in Luxembourg, and what steps the authorities took to recover the debt from former employers and ensure only one country collects premiums. The government answered that the tax authority cannot pursue employers for individual income-tax debts, that refund claims lie with Luxembourg authorities under its law, that it will raise the issue with Luxembourg, and that payment arrangements are available, but gave no clear timeline for resolving the double premium problem.

Although the Netherlands is not a party to these requests, I will, together with the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment, actively and promptly raise the signals with the Luxembourg authorities.

Hoewel Nederland geen partij is bij deze verzoeken, zal ik met de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid, die verantwoordelijk is voor de vaststelling van de verzekeringsplicht, de signalen hierover actief en op korte termijn bij de Luxemburgse autoriteiten onder de aandacht brengen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Van der Linde en Koerhuis over de brief van de Ombudsman aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het opnieuw aandacht vragen voor de korte aanvraagtermi

VVD MPs asked why the Dutch Ombudsman's concerns about low awareness of the 'special situations' rent/benefit scheme and its six-week application deadline were not addressed, and what the government would change. The State Secretary answered that the Belastingdienst had expanded website information and would raise awareness via intermediaries, that the six-week term is set in regulation and sufficient in practice, and that changes await an IBO review due end 2019, while declining a coulance scheme.
From an implementation perspective, the six-week term is sufficient.
Vanuit de uitvoering gezien is de zeswekentermijn voldoende.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over "de rol van in Nederland werkzame vermogensbeheerders en beleggingsinstellingen bij grote financiële schandalen en het feit dat Nederlandse pensioenfondsen geheime overeenkomst

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about asset managers' role in financial scandals and whether pension funds sign secret agreements that effectively shield managers from liability for losses. The minister answers that he lacks data on DUFAS members' share of pension assets, is not familiar with the foreign investigations behind the media reports, says contractual liability limits for gross negligence are not valid under Dutch law, and leaves enforcement and supervision to DNB and the AFM.
It is up to the supervisory authority to supervise and, if necessary, take follow-up steps.
Het is aan de toezichthouder om toezicht te houden en indien nodig vervolgstappen te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht "problemen met onbegrensde arbeidsmigratie”

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about brain drain and population loss in lower-wage EU states caused by free movement of workers, and whether the Netherlands would introduce work permits for EU workers. The minister acknowledged downsides of labour mobility, pointed to EU-level convergence and the European Semester, and refused to introduce work permits for EU nationals as contrary to free movement.
Introducing work permits for workers from EU member states is contrary to the free movement of workers.
Het invoeren van tewerkstellingsvergunningen voor werknemers uit EU-lidstaten is in strijd met het vrij verkeer van werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht 'Ambtenaren met AOW mogen niet langer doorwerken'

MP Van Brenk asks whether the government is ending post-AOW-age working for civil servants, citing an ageing workforce, a NIDI study on labour displacement, and low-income pensioners who must keep working. The minister replies that from 2020 continued work after the AOW age will only be possible by mutual agreement under the cao Rijk, a change framed as consistent with the SPB 2025 policy, and that the affected group is small and the measure will not substantially rejuvenate the workforce.
The cao Rijk 2018–2020 agreed that continued work after the AOW-entitlement age from 1 January 2020 will only be possible in specific cases, based on agreement between employer and employee.

In de cao Rijk 2018–2020 is afgesproken dat doorwerken na de AOW-gerechtigde leeftijd vanaf 1 januari 2020 alleen mogelijk is in specifieke gevallen op basis van overeenstemming tussen de werkgever en de medewerker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over arbeidsmigranten in Gelderse schuren en stallen

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about migrant workers housed in barns and stables in Gelderland, whether the government shares responsibility, whether municipal legal and financial tools are sufficient, and whether Labour Inspectorate capacity is adequate. The minister acknowledges the problem as unacceptable, points to the Wage Act housing deduction rules, local responsibility for housing, Good Landlordship tools, municipal enforcement budgets, and extra Inspectorate funding, and promises a letter before the summer recess.
I find it unacceptable that migrant workers are housed in barns and stables under poor conditions.
Ik vind het onaanvaardbaar dat arbeidsmigranten in schuren en stallen onder slechte omstandigheden worden gehuisvest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht 'Opnieuw geschiedvervalsing in Nederlands schoolboek'

PVV MPs asked why a VMBO textbook allegedly omits Jewish history of Jerusalem and the Middle East and wanted the government to ensure historically accurate teaching. The minister replied that the content of teaching materials is for schools to assess under freedom of education, pointing to school complaint and participation routes and criminal law limits.

As I and my predecessors have already indicated to your House in many earlier written questions on this subject, it is not for the cabinet to assess the content of teaching materials, but for schools.

Zoals ik en mijn voorgangers aan uw Kamer in vele eerdere schriftelijke vragen hierover ook al hebben aangegeven, is het niet aan het kabinet om de inhoud van leermiddelen te beoordelen, maar aan scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over jongeren moeten volwassenloon krijgen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the European Committee of Social Rights' criticism that youth minimum wages are unfair should be accepted, and whether 18-year-olds should be treated as adults for wages, and whether a study on abolishing the youth wage would be done. The minister defended the phased youth minimum wage (full wage from 21 from July 2019), citing employment and schooling effects, and refused to abolish the youth wage.
I therefore do not intend to abolish the youth minimum wage entirely now.
Ik ben daarom niet voornemens om het minimumjeugdloon nu volledig af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Snels over het Eerlijk Pensioenlabel

MPs Smeulders and Snels asked ministers about the Eerlijk Pensioenlabel ranking of Dutch pension funds' sustainability policies, including the methodology, the poor grades, lagging disclosure, follow-up under the IMVB convenant, and whether climate reporting should be mandatory. The government defended the pension funds' own responsibility, pointed to the IMVB convenant and existing reporting duties, declined to assess the study's methodology, and said the sector would be given time to improve before any further regulation.
It is not for the government to assess the methodology of the research, nor to assess the outcomes of the research or come up with alternative grades.
Het is niet aan de overheid om de methodologie van het onderzoek te beoordelen, noch om de uitkomsten van het onderzoek te beoordelen of met alternatieve rapportcijfers te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Rechter moet tussenbeide komen bij ICT-ruzie binnen UWV’

MPs Wiersma and Middendorp (VVD) asked about reported internal conflict over UWV's ICT reorganisation, including new IV-director posts, decentralisation of ICT staff, software maintenance costs and coordination with other agencies. Minister Koolmees answered that the transition is UWV's own responsibility as an autonomous body, that the implementation is temporarily suspended for talks with the works council, and that no new management layer is added.
As an autonomous administrative body, however, the Executive Board of UWV is itself responsible for the proper organisation of the agency.
Als zbo is de Raad van Bestuur van UWV echter zelf verantwoordelijk voor een goede inrichting van de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat Hogeschool Utrecht het stakingsrecht ondermijnt

An MP asked the ministers whether Hogeschool Utrecht undermines the right to strike by having lessons during strikes covered by other staff, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister confirmed the right to strike is protected under the European Social Charter, said disputes are for the employer, staff and courts to resolve, and that the ministry has only raised the matter with the institution.
I explicitly brought the AOB article to the attention of Hogeschool Utrecht, but I play no role in this conflict.
Ik heb het artikel van de AOB nadrukkelijk onder de aandacht van de Hogeschool Utrecht gebracht, maar ik speel geen rol in dit conflict.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag, Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over de gevolgen van het faillissement van Intertoys

MPs Moorlag, Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked about reports that the owner of bankrupt Intertoys, as a pledge-holding creditor, would be paid ahead of other creditors, whether this shifts business risk onto the tax authority, UWV and staff, and how workers would be helped. The minister said the specific case is for the curator and courts, explained generally how pledges give priority, said the matter is being examined in the bankruptcy law review, and described UWV information sessions and support for workers.
It is not for me to comment on a specific practical situation.
Het is niet aan mij om in te gaan op een specifieke praktijksituatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over de brief van de minister ‘vernieuwing pensioenstelsel’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the proposed renewal of the Dutch pension system, covering funding ratios, indexation rules, the cross-subsidy problem, CPB projections, young people's trust, and lump-sum options. The minister answered all 22 questions on substance, explaining the proposed contract, rejecting some premises, and noting that negotiations reached no agreement.
Soon I will inform you about this proposal via a main-lines letter.
Binnenkort zal ik u via een hoofdlijnenbrief informeren over dit voorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het feit dat het ABP jarenlang uitbetaalde partnerpensioenen terugvordert

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about ABP's recovery of years of overpaid partner pensions, including whether affected pensioners could have known of the errors, whether disclaimers were missing, and what safeguards apply to recovery. The minister explained that SVB data errors caused the miscalculations, that recovery is mandatory under the pension rules, and that pension funds bear responsibility for fair recovery procedures and remedies.
Pension providers may not, however, adjust pension payments on their own initiative.
Pensioenuitvoerders mogen echter niet eigenstandig pensioenuitkeringen aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Becker over de dreigementen van de Turkse Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken richting Europese toeristen die Turkije zouden verraden

MPs Koopmans and Becker asked the Foreign and Social Affairs ministers whether Turkey's interior minister threatened to detain European tourists who attend certain meetings, and what this means for Dutch citizens criticising Turkey; they also asked about Turkish weekend schools and contacts with the Turkish embassy. The government answered that it does not change its position on free expression within the rule of law, that it knows of no policy change by Turkey, and that it will inform the House on the motion-Becker implementation before summer.
The cabinet will inform the House more fully before this coming summer about the implementation of the Becker et al. motion.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer voor aanstaande zomer nader informeren over de uitvoering van de motie Becker c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het onderzoek ‘Overstappen op de arbeidsmarkt’ Een onderzoek naar van Werk Naar Werk-beleid en - trajecten

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a study of the Van Werk Naar Werk (work-to-work) transition programmes, including its findings on older, low-educated and training-related outcomes, and what policy changes would follow. The minister answered that he cannot generalise the study's conclusions, outlined existing lifelong-learning and transition measures, and committed to no new concrete reform.

On the basis of these conclusions I cannot establish in general that redundant workers under 55 fare better than older redundant workers in Van Werk Naar Werk programmes, or that higher-educated workers make the transition to new work better than lower-educated ones.

Op grond van deze conclusies kan ik niet in zijn algemeenheid vaststellen dat in Van Werk Naar Werkbeleid en -trajecten boventalligen jonger dan 55 jaar beter af zijn dan oudere boventalligen en dat hoger opgeleiden de transitie naar nieuw werk beter maken dan lager opgeleiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over de berichten ‘FNV daagt onlinebezorger Picnic voor de rechter’ en ‘Picnic bijt van zich af in conflict met FNV’

MP Wiersma asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the FNV lawsuit against Picnic and whether a sector-specific collective agreement for e-commerce or mediation was needed. The Minister answered that collective bargaining is for employers and employees themselves, that the cao system needs no change, and that he would invite the parties for a conversation but would not mediate or intervene in the pending court case.
My role in this is limited, as I also indicated in my answer to question 2.
Mijn rol in deze is beperkt, zoals ik ook heb aangegeven in mijn antwoord op vraag 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het artikel ‘Werkgevers overstelpt met loonsancties UWV over uitvoering ziektewet’

An MP asks the minister whether UWV sanctions on private sick-pay self-insuring employers have risen sharply and whether UWV applies looser standards to employers who entrust the work to UWV, plus related questions on re-integration duties, level playing field and parliamentary follow-up. The minister says no separate figures exist, denies any change in policy, explains that self-insuring employers face stricter post-employment re-integration duties than UWV-administered cases, and says he sees no reason to change the rules while committing only to inform the House if needed.
UWV does record the number of sanctions, but in its regular policy and accountability information it does not distinguish between sanctions imposed on publicly and privately insured employers.

UWV houdt namelijk het aantal sancties bij, maar maakt in de reguliere beleids- en verantwoordingsinformatie geen onderscheid in sancties die zijn opgelegd aan publieke en privaat verzekerde werkgevers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht ‘Werkgevers overstelpt met loonsancties’

An MP asked the minister whether private self-insuring employers faced a sharp rise in UWV sanctions and whether UWV had tightened its guidelines, and how that squares with a level playing field and the coalition plan to lower their risks. The minister answered that no separate figures exist, that policy is unchanged apart from clarified guidance, and that the different re-integration duties follow from the Sickness Benefits Act, while agreeing to talk with private implementers.
Whether the number of sanctions imposed on private implementers has risen so sharply cannot be said.
Of het aantal sancties dat is opgelegd aan private uitvoerders zo fors is opgelopen kan niet gezegd worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Moorlag over honderden miljoenen die volgens de SER Overijssel nodig zouden zijn om de klappen van de veranderende arbeidsmarkt voor mbo’ers op te vangen

MPs Van den Hul and Moorlag asked the ministers whether SER Overijssel's claims about job losses from digitalisation and the hundreds of millions needed to retrain mbo graduates are accurate. Minister Van Engelshoven answered that jobs both disappear and emerge, cannot confirm the 230 million euro estimate, and pointed to joint government-business efforts and a forthcoming Leven Lang Ontwikkelen letter.
The amount of 230 million euro that is mentioned is an estimate that I cannot confirm.
Het bedrag van 230 miljoen euro dat wordt genoemd is een schatting die ik niet kan bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over huren in Hellevoetsluis

MPs Beckerman and Van Dijk (SP) asked about rising rents in Hellevoetsluis, housing conditions and possible exploitation of migrant workers, waiting times for social housing and data on migrant workers. Minister Ollongren answered that housing shortages drive up rents, that municipalities and the province are responsible for local supply, that exploitation questions fall to other bodies, and that updated migrant worker figures will follow later in the year.
I cannot judge from the reporting whether there is exploitation or assess the specific housing conditions, partly because the expertise to assess this lies with other organisations.

Ik kan op basis van de berichtgeving niet beoordelen of er sprake is van uitbuiting of oordelen over de specifieke woonomstandigheden, mede omdat de expertise om te beoordelen of hier sprake van is bij andere organisaties is belegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over vrouwenbesnijdenis

Rep. Van Dijk asked the government about a request to the Hague mayor to act against the As-Soennah mosque over alleged endorsement of female genital mutilation, whether reconstructive surgery after FGM should be covered by basic insurance, and the practice of hymen checks and hymen restoration. The minister replied that the enforcement decision lies with the mayor, that FGM is illegal and the government pursues an integrated chain approach, that reconstructive surgery cannot yet be added to basic insurance pending a Zorginstituut opinion, and that the government opposes hymen restoration done out of fear and will consult doctors and the NVOG.
The request to enforce is addressed to the mayor of The Hague.
Het verzoek tot handhaven is gericht aan de burgemeester van Den Haag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht 'Leerkracht geschorst na beledigen profeet'

PVV MPs asked the Education Minister whether a teacher's suspension after insulting the prophet shows that yielding to Islam is a pattern, whether intimidating pupils should have been punished instead, and whether the government will act to reinstate the teacher. The minister denied endorsing the premise, said school boards decide on suspensions within legal limits, and declined to intervene in the case.
