In practice it is up to the board, school leader, teachers, parents and pupils to make arrangements with each other, within the limits of the law, about the school culture.
In de praktijk is het aan het bestuur, schoolleider, leraren, ouders en leerlingen om met elkaar en uiteraard binnen de grenzen van de wet afspraken te maken over de invulling van een schoolcultuur
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Universiteit Utrecht is te wit'

MPs from the VVD asked whether Utrecht University's diversity policy is compatible with rule-of-law values after reports that men and women were seated separately at a student society lecture, and whether the university has rules to exclude events conflicting with those values. The minister answered that the society said seating was free, that gender equality is a core value, that the university's Code of Conduct prohibits discrimination and forced segregation, and that she sees no reason for further action.
Utrecht University has a Code of Conduct that describes the values guiding work and study at the university.
De Universiteit Utrecht heeft een Code of Conduct die de waarden beschrijft die richting geven aan het werken en studeren aan de universiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Rooijen en Van Brenk over koopkrachtcijfers van het Nibud

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether half of the Dutch population would lose purchasing power in 2019, whether the CPB's standard inflation figure fits all households, and whether Nibud should translate it into household-level impacts. The minister rejects the claim, citing CPB forecasts of about 95-96% of households gaining, and defends using representative averages and Nibud's example households as an appropriate approach.
The purpose of the purchasing power forecast is to make the effects of government policy on citizens' wallets visible, given the general economic picture.
Het doel van de koopkrachtraming is om de effecten van overheidsbeleid op de portemonnee van de burger inzichtelijk te maken, gegeven het algemeen economische beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Arno Rutte over het adverteren voor en meewerken aan maagdenvliesherstel in Nederland

The MPs Becker and Arno Rutte (VVD) asked whether the government would raise with Dutch gynaecologists the option of no longer issuing certificates of virginity, following a Belgian medical council ruling. Minister De Jonge answered that he is willing to raise it in his meeting with gynaecologists and will report on it in the next progress letter on the Geweld hoort nergens thuis programme.
Yes, I am willing to raise this during my conversation with gynaecologists in the Netherlands.
Ja, ik ben bereid om tijdens mijn gesprek met de gynaecologen in Nederland dit aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over ondersteuning bij werk in de Wet werk en inkomen naar arbeidsvermogen (WIA)

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether re-integration support under the WIA is available to people with WGA 80-99 or IVA benefits, and whether terminally ill people who want to work are supported. The minister answered that WGA recipients with current work options get active re-integration help, while IVA recipients have no re-integration obligation or right, though they can request reassessment or work facilities, and that no change to income offsetting for prognosis is planned.
For people who fall under the IVA, re-integration is in principle not an issue.
Voor mensen die onder de IVA vallen, is re-integratie in beginsel niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de Week zonder vlees

MP Ouwehand asked the government about its role in the Week zonder vlees (meatless week), including past ministry tweets, whether it will promote the week and shift ministry canteen meals toward plant-based food, and the external costs of meat production. The answer refers to the answers already published in Aanhangsel Handelingen 1896 and does not address the substance of the questions.
The written questions from MP Ouwehand (PvdD), question number 2019Z03357, on a week without meat, have been answered by way of Aanhangsel Handelingen, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1896.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD), vraagnummer 2019Z03357 , inzake een week zonder vlees, zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1896 .
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Bergkamp en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Deze gastarbeiders zijn oud in een land dat een tussenstop had moeten zijn’

D66 MPs asked the ministers of Health and Social Affairs about reports that older guest workers face poorer health, reduced AOW pensions, and low remigration uptake, and what support or follow-up is planned. The government answered that it cannot precisely estimate pension counts, that AOW reductions average about 32.5% falling to 27.8%, that care is meant to be person-centred with programmes like Langer Thuis and Een tegen Eenzaamheid, and that remigration uptake may be affected by pension levels, family ties and health care in the origin country.
I have instructed that the knowledge gained about what works and what does not be bundled.
Ik heb opdracht gegeven om de geleerde kennis over wat werkt en wat niet te bundelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Pieter Heerma en Van den Berg over de last onder dwangsom werkgeversportaal UWV

MPs Van der Molen, Heerma and Van den Berg (CDA) asked about the Dutch Data Protection Authority's penalty order against the UWV employer portal, the choice of eID assurance level (eHerkenning substantial versus eIDAS high), the role of UZI cards, and cost estimates for employers. The minister answered that UWV's 2018 risk analysis found the substantial level appropriate, that the cost estimates were not too low, and that the UZI card is only for patient identification.
I do not share the view that eHerkenning means were prescribed at the wrong level.
Ik deel niet de mening dat sprake is van het voorschrijven van eHerkenningsmiddelen op een verkeerd niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Van der Lee over de stijgende energierekening

MPs Snels and Van der Lee asked why the cabinet's estimate of a 108 euro rise in household energy bills differs from the CBS figure of 334 euro, and whether the cabinet will correct its distributional and purchasing-power estimates using CPB findings. The minister attributes most of the gap to market price assumptions and differing energy-use assumptions, says current inflation data give no reason to doubt the purchasing-power figures, and promises a CPB analysis of the Klimaatakkoord income effects and to improve information with PBL, CBS and others.
The cabinet considers it important to keep a clear view of how energy costs affect different households.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk om goed zicht te houden hoe de energielasten neerslaan bij verschillende huishoudens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Tielen over het diversiteitsbeleid bij de Universiteit Utrecht

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a reported Utrecht University diversity plan, including prayer rooms with separate entrances and Islamic holiday calendars, and whether such measures serve education quality. The minister answered that diversity and inclusion are the institution's own responsibility, that the university has no plans for separate entrances or a changed calendar, and that equal admission chances matter.
However, it is up to the institutions themselves to determine how they pay attention to this and which measures they take in this area.
Het is echter aan de instellingen zelf om te bepalen hoe zij hier aandacht aan besteden en welke maatregelen zij op dit gebied nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over “de werking van de WW”

An MP asked whether jobseekers with a signed contract or a small top-up WW benefit must keep searching, whether UWV can exempt them, and how scholarship and retraining rules work. The minister confirmed the job-search duty continues until two weeks before the new job starts, that UWV can exempt in special cases but does not record how often, and described the income-offset and training budget rules.
The precise circumstances in which this happens and how often UWV does so are not specifically recorded in the implementation administration.
De precieze omstandigheden waarin dit gebeurt en hoe vaak het UWV dat doet, worden niet specifiek bijgehouden in de uitvoeringsadministratie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over huiseigenaren die arbeidsmigranten in kamertjes proppen

MPs Beckerman and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked ministers about homeowners housing migrant workers in overcrowded rooms, the shortage of adequate housing, Hilvarenbeek's housing target, and the government's role. The minister answers that housing is a regional and local responsibility, points to the SNF quality mark and a forthcoming guide for municipalities, but declines to give a count of migrant workers without adequate housing and offers no national lead role.
How housing for migrant workers is best distributed within a region and in which forms it can be provided must be determined at regional and local level.
Hoe de huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten binnen een regio het beste past qua verdeling en in welke woonvormen deze kan worden gerealiseerd, moet op regionaal en lokaal niveau worden bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Arno Rutte over het adverteren voor en het meewerken aan maagdenvliesherstel in Nederland

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about hymen reconstruction clinics, medical practice and whether doctors should still cooperate, given WHO opposition and risks of coercion linked to honour-related pressure. The minister condemns the practice when driven by fear, says the NVOG 2004 guidance still advises against the operation unless counselling leaves no alternative, and commits to talks with doctors and the NVOG, reporting back later.
I will therefore enter into discussion with the doctors concerned and the Dutch Society for Obstetrics & Gynaecology (NVOG) about preventing hymen reconstruction in women.
Ik ga daarom met de betreffende artsen en de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Obstetrie & Gynaecologie (NVOG) in gesprek over het voorkomen van maagdenvliesherstel bij vrouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over het bericht "IND huurt onderbetaalde krachten in"

Two PvdA MPs asked why temporary staff hired via agencies at the IND are paid less than permanent colleagues doing the same work, and whether this will be remedied and enforced in future tenders. The minister answered that the Waadi equal-pay rule applies but can be set aside by collective agreement, that pay is a matter between the agency and the worker, that the IND requires compliance via the framework contract, and that no extra conditions are considered necessary.
In case of underpayment, the employee can of course claim the back pay from the employer (in this case the staffing agency).
In geval van onderbetaling kan de werknemer uiteraard bij de werkgever (in dit geval het detacheringsbureau) dat achterstallig loon vorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Van Kent over het bericht ‘Werkgever worstelt met transitievergoeding bij ontslag na langdurige ziekte’

MPs Wiersma and Van Kent asked the minister about employers' uncertainty over compensation for the transition payment when dismissing long-term sick workers, including which documents are required and where employers can get help. The minister answered that UWV is implementing the scheme from 1 April 2020, that documents and an information campaign will follow, and that a bank statement alone is not sufficient for compensation.
I will ensure together with UWV that information on the precise documents employers must provide to UWV from 1 April 2020 forms part of this information campaign.
Ik zal samen met UWV zorgen dat de informatie over de precieze documenten die werkgevers vanaf 1 april 2020 aan UWV moeten verstrekken onderdeel vormt van deze voorlichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over de berichten 'Robotisering noopt tot snelle omscholing' en 'Werkgevers zitten te springen om praktisch personeel'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that robotisation requires rapid retraining and that employers want practical staff, including the labour shortage across sectors and the position of SMEs in lifelong learning. The minister answered that labour shortages create opportunities, provided vacancy data and sector figures, and committed to €1.5 million for SME learning culture and to working on a parliamentary motion for €48 million.
I will get to work vigorously on elaborating this motion.
Ik ga voortvarend aan de slag met de uitwerking van deze motie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent, Smeulders, Renkema en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat de distributiecentra van Picnic niet veilig zijn

MPs from SP, GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports of high workload, unsafe equipment and poor pay at online supermarket Picnic, including whether the Inspectorate SZW would investigate, whether its risk assessment was in order, and whether it should fall under the supermarket collective agreement. The Minister answered that employers are responsible for safe work and workload, that the Inspectorate acts on complaints and risk-based priorities without commenting on specific investigations, that no company collective agreement is registered for Picnic and interpreting the scope of sector agreements is for the social partners, and that the government is taking measures against competition on labour conditions.
No statements are made about whether the Inspectorate SZW is conducting an investigation or not.
Er worden geen uitlatingen gedaan of de Inspectie SZW al dan niet onderzoek doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over uitzendbureaus die aanzetten tot fraude met de werkloosheidsuitkering (WW-fraude)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether staffing agencies were dismissing Polish migrant workers after 26 weeks to save pension costs and how UWV checks wrongful dismissal for WW benefits. The minister said such practices are undesirable, that UWV checks culpable unemployment on the contract and reasons given rather than how the employer refills the work, and that a broader evaluation of the agency regime including revolving-door constructions will follow.
I consider it undesirable if employers, purely for financial reasons, dismiss employees in order to then hire a new employee for the same work.
Ik vind het onwenselijk als werkgevers, louter om financiële redenen, werknemers ontslaan om vervolgens voor datzelfde werk een nieuwe werknemer aan te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Pieter Heerma over het bericht 'Werkgevers pompen Polen rond om kosten te besparen'

MPs Van Weyenberg and Heerma asked whether temp agencies send workers onto unemployment benefit (WW) to cut costs and whether this is structural. The minister says UWV, the Inspectorate and the sector bodies do not recognise the pattern, but finds such constructions undesirable, will examine revolving-door practices in a planned evaluation of the temp-work regime in 2020, and says the cost differences for temp workers are modest and that data analysis on WW fraud is forthcoming.
In the evaluation of the temporary employment regime in the Netherlands that I am going to start, I will therefore include revolving-door constructions in the temp sector.
In de evaluatie van het uitzendregime in Nederland die ik ga opstarten, zal ik draaideurconstructies in de uitzendsector dan ook meenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over het bericht ‘Minister Koolmees: 'Niet draaien aan aparte knoppen van pensioenstelsel'’

Member Van Rooijen (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about compensation for existing pension participants when the doorsneesystematiek is abolished, including government guarantees, the coverage ratio rules and redistribution. The minister answered that sociale partners must agree compensation, the government offers tax room and transition frameworks but no legal obligation or state backstop, and it will not adjust the discount rules or existing contract.
I am therefore not willing to start tinkering with separate levers within the existing contract, because this would disturb the intergenerational balance within the system.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid om aan aparte knoppen te gaan draaien binnen het bestaande contract, omdat dit het generatie-evenwicht binnen het stelsel verstoort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht ‘856.000 Nederlanders in loondienst bouwen geen pensioen op’

MP Van Kent asked whether around 35,000 call-centre workers building no pension is accurate, why temp workers avoid employment, how many collective agreements regulate no pension, how to extend pension coverage, and whether toilet restrictions in call centres harm health, and asked for a Labour Inspectorate investigation. Minister Koolmees confirmed the pension gap, said pensions are primarily for social partners, found nearly all major CAOs refer to a pension scheme, said working conditions are employers' responsibility and the Inspectorate will not investigate on media signals alone.
Media signals alone are insufficient grounds to ask the Labour Inspectorate to investigate working conditions and workload at call centres.
Enkel signalen in de media zijn onvoldoende aanleiding om de Inspectie SZW te verzoeken onderzoek te doen naar de arbeidsomstandigheden en werkdruk bij klantcontactcentra.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ICT-problemen bij UWV

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about claims on a podcast that UWV removed digital fraud-detection capabilities from the Polisadministratie, that UWV spent about 250 million euro on ICT in 2007, and whether earlier budget claims and spending were efficient. The minister denied that fraud-detection functions were removed, confirmed the 2007 ICT spending figure of 258 million, admitted ICT costs overran budget though not the total, and declined further investigation citing existing oversight reports.
I therefore see no reason to conduct further investigation.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding voor het doen van nader onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de behandeling van postnatale depressie (postpartum depressie) door UWV

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV failing to recognise postnatal depression as pregnancy-related, the role of treating physicians, notification deadlines, the three-month benchmark and whether the sickness-benefit rules should be changed. The minister answered that UWV assesses causality case by case under the guideline, that treating physicians' diagnoses are weighed but do not decide, that the three-month mark is not a fixed rule, and that no change to the guideline or the rules is planned.
It is up to the insurance physician to assess in the individual case whether a causal link exists between the pregnancy or childbirth and a depression occurring during or after it.
Het is aan de verzekeringsarts om in het individuele geval te beoordelen of er een causaal verband bestaat tussen de zwangerschap of bevalling en een daarbij of daarna optredende depressie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the government, in 21 questions, whether it agrees with and will respond to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, including whether it accepts co-responsibility for climate policy, whether it will commit to 1.5 degree-compatible measures and to changing its own ministry's practices. The joint government reply (on behalf of several ministers) was only a reference to an Aanhangsel and did not address the questions on substance.
The written questions from MP Van Raan (PvdD), question number 2018Z24284, have been answered by means of Appendix to the Proceedings, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1305.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Raan (PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24284 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Gijs van Dijk over uitbuiting van Roemenen in Nederland

MPs Jasper and Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of labour exploitation of Romanian workers in the Netherlands, including complaint figures, the reasons victims do not report, estimates of the scale, food safety risks, and enforcement. The minister answered that exploitation is unacceptable, described the Inspectorate's handling of complaints and the extra funding and programmes to intensify enforcement, but gave no nationality-specific figures and no new prevalence estimate.
The estimates of the National Rapporteur are not broken down by nationality.
De schattingen van de Nationaal Rapporteur zijn niet uitgesplitst naar nationaliteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht "856.000 Nederlanders in loondienst bouwen geen pensioen op"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that 856,000 employees have no pension accrual, including one in three temp agency workers despite the mandatory scheme, and about measures against employers not offering pensions. The minister acknowledges the problem stems largely from exempt groups and administrative lags, says the pension fund StiPP is responsible for enforcement, and promises a sector study on shortening the waiting period and further information to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over "het bericht ‘856.000 Nederlanders in loondienst bouwen geen pensioen op"

An MP from D66 asks the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that 856,000 employees build no pension, and about the causes (flex contracts, expats, uitzend sector waiting periods, administrative lag, the waiting period rule). The minister answers that the CBS figures reflect a new methodology, explains the composition of the white spot and the administrative processes in the temp sector, and says social partners are researching the waiting period and will report back.
I am in contact with the parties involved about progress and will inform the House of the outcomes.
Ik onderhoud contact met de betrokken partijen over de voortgang en zal uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Smeulders over het bericht dat jonge gehandicapten geregeld geen uitkering krijgen terwijl ze er wel recht op hebben

MPs Renkema and Smeulders asked about a report that young disabled people are often denied a Wajong benefit they are entitled to, and about a UWV internal study finding wrong conclusions in 21% of files. The State Secretary answered that the study could not confirm incorrect outcomes with certainty, that UWV introduced retraining and quality controls, that the 2018 risk fell to 7%, and that the internal report was not shared with the ministry.
The internal study report in question was not provided to me for information at the time.
Het bewuste interne onderzoeksrapport is destijds niet ter informatie aan mij aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de pensioenwet en de wet op de beroepspensioenfondsen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about outsourcing limits for pension funds under the amended pension law, including DUFAS model contract clauses on fiduciary managers, alleged fraud by DUFAS members, and whether supervision should be tightened. The minister acknowledged the outdated model contract was removed, stated pension fund boards remain responsible for investment policy, declined to give information on individual DUFAS members or compensation, and saw no need for additional supervisory action.
The pension fund board is at all times responsible for the investment policy and for supervising it.
Het pensioenfondsbestuur is te allen tijde verantwoordelijk voor het beleggingsbeleid en het toezien daarop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Tielen over anti-integratieve uitspraken rector islamitische universiteit Rotterdam

MPs Becker and Tielen asked the government how it would respond to statements by the rector of the Islamic University of Rotterdam that followers of Gülen may receive the death penalty, and whether it would use powers under the Wet bescherming namen en graden. The minister condemned the statements, said an independent advisory commission had been asked for advice under the step-by-step procedure, and said she is willing to use the law's options but will await the commission's advice before deciding.
With the commission's advice I will assess whether there is reason to intervene at the IUASR.
Met het advies van de commissie zal ik beoordelen of er aanleiding is om bij de IUASR in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht «Turkije gaat weekendscholen financieren in Nederland»

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports that Turkey would finance weekend schools in the Netherlands, asking about contacts with Turkey, the number of applications, oversight, and risks to integration. The minister answered that Turkey promised transparency and shared information, about 15 subsidy applications exist, weekend schools fall outside Inspectorate supervision and no specific rules apply, and the government has no full picture but cannot ban informal education, while raising concerns with Turkey.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht «Turkije gaat weekendscholen financieren in Nederland»

MPs De Graaf, Beertema and Wilders asked whether the government would bar Turkish-funded weekend schools in the Netherlands, given concerns about foreign influence on children's education, and whether they should be banned. The minister answered that such informal schools fall outside education law, so the Inspectorate has no powers and they cannot be banned, while the government shares concerns about integration and anti-democratic teaching and has raised them with Turkey, which promised transparency and information sharing.
At present the cabinet does not have full insight into the nature and scale of informal education at, among others, weekend schools.
Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen volledig zicht op de aard en omvang van het informeel onderwijs op onder andere weekendscholen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het gebruik van SyRI in Capelle aan den IJssel

An MP asked about the SyRI risk-profiling system in Capelle aan den IJssel, including how many cases were investigated, whether investigative powers were used against people without suspicion, and whether SyRI operations should be documented and reported annually. The state secretary said the 62 no-violation cases came from a separate collaboration rather than SyRI, that data were destroyed late, that risk reports are not proof, that SyRI methods will remain undisclosed, and that SyRI use is already documented with a possible mention in a semi-annual letter.
I maintain that the data files and analysis methods used by SyRI should not be made public.
Ik blijf van mening dat gebruikte databestanden en analysemethoden van SyRI niet openbaar moeten worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Jasper van Dijk over antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake het bericht "Jongerenreis naar radicale prediker"

MPs Becker and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the government knew of Milli Görüş youth trips to Turkey involving a radical preacher, and whether it would monitor, investigate or act on such trips and on the organisation's independence and funding. The minister answered that the government does not monitor organisations' trips or religious education, that intelligence matters cannot be disclosed, that Milli Görüş distanced itself from the preacher's statements, that a 2017 study found no proven Turkish control, and that municipalities did not know of the trips.
Social and religious organisations are free to organise foreign trips. The government does not supervise this.
Het staat maatschappelijke en religieuze organisaties vrij om buitenlandse reizen te organiseren. Hierop wordt door de overheid geen toezicht gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘Rookgordijnen rond Bilal L.’

An MP from the PVV asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers whether they would strip Bilal L. and Abderrazak A.O. of Dutch nationality and expel them, and whether they would clear the Stopera of Islamist criminal and jihad-facilitating elements. The Minister replied that nationality can be withdrawn only for terrorist convictions or threats to national security and not if the person would become stateless, and rejected the depicted picture, pointing to Amsterdam municipality's responsibility for the local jihadism approach.
I do not recognise the picture you have sketched. The municipality of Amsterdam is responsible for the Amsterdam local approach to jihadism and its implementation.
Ik herken me niet in het door u geschetste beeld. De gemeente Amsterdam is verantwoordelijk voor de Amsterdamse lokale aanpak jihadisme en de uitvoering daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht 'Zelfstandigen bouwen wel degelijk pensioen op, maar benutten belastingvoordeel te weinig'

An MP asked whether self-employed workers build pension savings but underuse the tax advantages, and whether they know about the tax-facilitated options. The minister answered that self-employed people do build old-age savings but often not in a tax-favoured form, that the tax rules are explained, and that awareness-raising and reforms such as abolishing the doorsneesystematiek are being considered.
I consider it important that all workers in the Netherlands build up an adequate old-age provision.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat alle werkenden in Nederland een toereikende oudedagsvoorziening opbouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘Examenlek nieuwkomers via besloten netwerken’

An MP from the PVV asked ministers whether participants in an alleged leak of exam questions via social media should be treated as criminals, deported, and whether asylum-route arrivals should be returned. The government answered that sharing recollections of exam questions is not criminal fraud, that deportation applies only under specific legal criteria after conviction, and that asylum status holders cannot generally be returned via safe countries.
Sharing information about the exam questions based on recollections does not qualify as fraud in the criminal sense.
Dit delen van informatie over de examenopgaven, gebaseerd op herinneringen, kwalificeert zich niet als fraude in de strafrechtelijke betekenis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over "Examens in inburgering uitgelekt"

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether exam questions for Dutch language and civic integration tests leaked via social media, how long this lasted, and whether candidates who benefited should lose their integration status and loan forgiveness. The minister acknowledges leaked recollections of exam items, says the leaks are not criminal fraud, has removed affected items and postponed the state exams to January 2019, and states he has no powers to sanction the people who shared them.
Sharing recollections of previously taken exam questions is not punishable, and I have no powers to sanction the persons who shared the descriptions.
Het delen van herinneringen aan eerder gemaakte examenopgaven is niet strafbaar en ik heb geen bevoegdheden de personen die de beschrijvingen hebben gedeeld, te sanctioneren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over fraude met inburgeringsexamens

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about leaked and fraudulently shared inburgering exam questions on Facebook, YouTube and other channels, the handling of fraud at language schools, and whether exams were adequately protected. The minister said the Facebook group is no longer active, some YouTube questions were removed, the investigation into an Amsterdam language school is ongoing, and detailed information on question sets is withheld to protect exam integrity.

Information on how many questions or versions of the various exam components exist and how often they are renewed cannot be shared, because doing so would increase the risk of undermining the integrity of the exams.

Informatie over hoeveel vragen dan wel versies er van de verschillende examenonderdelen zijn en hoe vaak deze worden vernieuwd kan niet gedeeld worden omdat daarmee het risico op aantasting van de integriteit van de examens vergroot wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het minder in dienst nemen door de Rijksoverheid van oudere werknemers

An MP asked the ministers whether the central government spent 68 million euro in 2016 to encourage employers to hire older workers, and why its own hiring of workers aged 50 and over has allegedly fallen relatively. The ministers confirmed the 68 million for the action plan 'Perspectief voor vijftigplussers', gave hiring figures showing that the number of hires aged 50+ rose from 298 in 2013 to 877 in 2017, and said the evaluation will be sent to parliament in early 2020 while the government aims for a balanced workforce.
The evaluation of the action plan will be completed at the end of 2019. The results will be sent to your House in early 2020.
Eind 2019 wordt de evaluatie van het actieplan afgerond. De resultaten worden begin 2020 naar uw Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de manier waarop pensioenfondsen de CO2-voetafdruk van hun beleggingsportefeuille berekenen en hierover intern en extern rapporteren

An MP from D66 asked how pension funds, notably ABP, calculate the CO2 footprint of their investments, in particular whether excluding scope-3 emissions gives a distorted picture and why ABP has not included them despite its participants' requests. The minister answered that scope 1 and 2 give a good picture for individual companies, that a distorted picture is never desirable but no serious distortion is currently evident, that scope 3 may be added later, and that the ABP board has primacy over investment policy within its governance structure.
The ABP board has primacy over the implementation of the pension scheme, including investment policy.
Het ABP-bestuur heeft het primaat van de uitvoering van de pensioenregeling, inclusief het beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Koopmans over de intenties van de Turkse ambassade om bij te dragen aan de integratie van de "Turkse gemeenschap" in Nederland

MPs Becker and Koopmans asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Social Affairs whether the Turkish ambassador's stated aim of bringing the Turkish community together for integration is acceptable, and whether Turkish diaspora politics should be raised with Turkey. The government answered that integration policy is its own responsibility, that Turkey may maintain voluntary ties with its diaspora within the limits of the rule of law, and that it will raise concerns with Turkey if those limits are exceeded.
The Cabinet sees no role in this for diplomatic representatives of other countries.
Het Kabinet ziet hierin geen rol voor diplomatieke vertegenwoordigers van andere landen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat de belastinginspecteur besloten heeft om de RVU-boete voor de gouden handdrukken van bijna 200 miljoen aan de belastingdienst kwijt te schelden

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary about reports that the Tax Authority was waived an RVU penalty of nearly 200 million euros on golden handshakes, and about how the Supreme Court ruling of June 2018 is applied, the consequences for the state, and rights of other employers. The government answered that the inspector applied the Supreme Court criteria, that about 95 million euros is expected to be refunded in 2019, that old policy decrees will be withdrawn, and that the Ministry of Defence will object to its own RVU levy, though it answered late and did not meet the one-week deadline.
Why did you not clearly inform the House about the major consequences for the RVU scheme paid by the state?
Vraag 6 Waarom heeft u de Kamer niet duidelijk geïnformeerd over de grote gevolgen voor de door de staat betaalde RVU-regeling?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over de uitzending ‘Kwetsbare werknemers als verdienmodel?’ van de Monitor

A member of the Green Left party asked the minister whether contract takeovers of redundant public-sector workers, used as a revenue model by placement agencies, should be curbed and whether the arrangement invites benefit fraud. The government answered that such arrangements are undesirable where they shift unemployment costs to the market-sector unemployment fund, that public employers must scrutinise agencies, and that it will act against fraud with UWV, while noting existing safeguards in the national government's contract with POSG.
Constructions or arrangements whereby unemployment costs are deliberately shifted by public employers onto the market-sector unemployment funds are, in the cabinet's view, not desired.
Constructies of afspraken waarbij werkloosheidslasten door overheidswerkgevers doelbewust worden afgewenteld op de WW-fondsen in de marktsector, zijn wat het kabinet betreft niet gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Pieter Heerma over het bericht 'Heya! Kilo’s knallen!'

MPs Van Weyenberg and Heerma asked the Minister of Social Affairs about working conditions, agency staffing, pension and WW-benefit practices, hygiene training and inspection in the meat processing sector, following a press report. The Minister responded that the picture from the article is not reflected in complaints to the Inspectorate, pointed to existing collective agreements, complaint routes and prevention projects, and did not commit to new action.
The picture in the article regarding the working conditions of migrant workers is not something I recognise in the complaints and reports submitted to the Inspectorate SZW.
Het beeld dat naar voren komt in het artikel waarbij het gaat om de arbeidsomstandigheden van arbeidsmigranten zie ik niet terug in klachten en meldingen die worden ingediend bij de Inspectie SZW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Van Dam over het bericht ‘So werden Erdogan-Kritiker in Deutschland per App denunziert’

MPs Heerma and Van Dam asked whether a Turkish police reporting app used to denounce Erdogan critics in Germany is also used in the Netherlands and whether it can be banned from app stores. The government said it is unknown whether the app is used this way in the Netherlands, that such use would be unacceptable, that Turkey would be addressed if it encouraged it, and that app store vetting is primarily the providers' responsibility.
If the app is indeed used for this purpose, it is totally undesirable.
Als de app inderdaad voor dit doeleinde wordt gebruikt, dan is dit volstrekt onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het 'uitrusten' van werknemers met microchips

An SP MP asked ministers whether employers may require or request workers to have microchips implanted, citing a UK case, and how such practices relate to GDPR, bodily integrity and the role of supervisors. The minister said such practices must respect privacy and bodily integrity, that the case is hypothetical for the Netherlands, that implanting microchips would likely be unlawful given the employer-employee relationship and biometric data rules, and that workers can complain to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and Inspectie SZW.
Privacy, human dignity and protection of bodily integrity are fundamental rights that must also be protected in a rapidly digitalising work environment.
Privacy, menselijke waardigheid en de bescherming van de lichamelijke integriteit zijn fundamentele rechten die ook in een snel digitaliserende werkomgeving beschermd moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Gijs van Dijk over het stuklopen van het pensioenakkoord

MPs Asscher and Gijs van Dijk asked about the collapse of the pension agreement, its contents (including RVU levy cuts, a contribution of about 7 billion euros, reduced AOW-age increase, and easier pension saving for self-employed), and whether memos were shared with MPs. The minister answered that no agreement was reached, describes the proposed package and its costs in general terms, and states that the government shared no separate memos beyond coalition-internal consultation.
Therefore there is no pension agreement.
Er is dan ook geen pensioenakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over de brief van de Minister inzake “geen akkoord over vernieuwing pensioenstelsel”

An MP from 50PLUS asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the collapse of the draft pension reform deal, focusing on fund coverage ratios, indexation prospects, and immediate cuts below 100% coverage. The Minister answers that the new contract would have indexed faster above 100% and cut slower below it, that current rules would limit indexation, and that cuts under current rules could be spread over ten years.
Because the funds, on average, do not currently have the required buffers, limited indexation is expected in the coming years.
Doordat de fondsen nu – gemiddelde genomen – niet beschikken over de vereiste buffers, kan er de komende jaren naar verwachting beperkt geïndexeerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Gijs van Dijk over het mislukken van een pensioenakkoord

Opposition MPs Asscher and Gijs van Dijk asked about the failed pension agreement, including whether the government was ready to decouple AOW age from life expectancy, the effect on fiscal sustainability, RVU-levy cuts and support for self-employed pension building. Minister Koolmees answered that the decoupling would have been studied by an external commission, that the measures would weaken the sustainability balance, that the RVU cut was only an ultimate offer, and that no mandatory pension for self-employed had political support because no total package was agreed.
Since it was not possible to reach agreements on this within a total package, it is not opportune to go further into possible coverage measures.
Aangezien het niet is gelukt om binnen een totaalpakket hierover afspraken te maken, is het niet opportuun om verder in te gaan op mogelijke dekkingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over de brief van de president van De Nederlandsche Bank

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about De Nederlandsche Bank's letter on pension indexation, the discount rate, and premium setting under the Pensioenwet. The minister replied that many funds can index, that the Pensioenwet imposes no nominal guarantee, that the risk-free rate must be used for valuation, and that premium setting and a new pension system are under consideration.
As I indicated in the cabinet response to the evaluation of the financial assessment framework, such a situation is at odds with the requirement of a balanced weighing of interests.
Zoals ik heb aangegeven in de kabinetsreactie op de evaluatie van het financieel toetsingskader, staat een dergelijke situatie op gespannen voet met de eis van een evenwichtige afweging van belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Bergkamp en Sneller over het bericht dat de Nederlandse cultuur rond vrouwemancipatie en deeltijdwerken achterhaald is

MPs from D66 asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Education and Finance about a report that Dutch culture on women's emancipation and part-time work is outdated, covering women's access to extra hours, sector shortages, McKinsey's estimate of GDP gains, parental role models, pay gaps and childcare flexibility. The minister answered that the government is studying part-time work through an interdepartmental policy review, cites measures such as tax changes and parental leave, and says concrete outcomes depend on individual employers and employees.
The cabinet has commissioned an interdepartmental policy review on part-time work (IBO Deeltijdwerk).
Het kabinet heeft opdracht gegeven tot een interdepartementaal beleidsonderzoek deeltijdwerk (IBO Deeltijdwerk).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over het bericht 'Privacyregels bedreigen duizenden pensioenen'

MP Van Rooijen asks whether GDPR privacy rules hinder pension funds from tracing former members with 'forgotten' pensions and whether legal changes are needed. The minister agrees finding these pensions is good, stresses privacy protection must be balanced, promises talks with the sector and says a legal change may be proposed in 2019 if necessary.
I will shortly enter into discussions with the sector to find a suitable solution for the bottlenecks experienced.
Ik zal op korte termijn in gesprek gaan met de sector om een passende oplossing te vinden voor de knelpunten die worden ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Arbeidsdeelname mannen 25 tot 45 lager dan voor crisis’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the falling labour participation of men aged 25 to 45 compared with before the crisis, including causes, whether it is structural, and whether it is also seen in other countries. The minister answered that the decline is partly cyclical and partly structural (lower-educated men, more schooling, more illness-related inactivity), that CPB research is underway, and that the decline is also visible across OECD countries.
The CPB is currently conducting research at the request of the Ministry of SZW into the development of labour supply in the Netherlands.
Het CPB doet momenteel op verzoek van het Ministerie van SZW onderzoek naar de ontwikkeling van het arbeidsaanbod in Nederland
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Syriërs sturen kinderen naar weekendscholen'

VVD MPs Becker and Rudmer Heerema asked about reports that Syrian refugees send children to weekend schools teaching their own language and culture, asking for data, content oversight, and whether such schools undermine integration and Dutch values. The government answered that it has no information on the content or numbers of these weekend schools because they are not schools under education law and fall outside Inspectorate oversight, while stating that informal education is free but should not obstruct integration or promote anti-democratic views.

At present the cabinet has no information on the nature and scope of the education at weekend schools focused on language, culture and religion, because weekend schools are not schools within the meaning of education legislation.

Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen informatie over de aard en omvang van het onderwijs op onder andere weekendscholen die zich richten op taal, cultuur en religie, omdat weekendscholen geen scholen zijn in de zin van de onderwijswetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht “Syriërs sturen kinderen naar weekendscholen”

PVV MPs asked the government about Syrian weekend schools (informal Islamic/Koranic education), whether they should be closed and funded organisations dissolved, and whether all Syrian asylum seekers and status holders should be returned to Syria. The minister answered that this is informal education not covered by education law, that the government lacks structural oversight of it, and that closing it or returning refugees is rejected.
At present the cabinet has no structural insight into the nature and scale of education at, among others, weekend schools.
Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen structureel zicht op de aard en omvang van het onderwijs op onder andere weekendscholen
Antwoord op  vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Turkse weekendscholen

An MP asked the government whether Turkey is funding weekend schools in the Netherlands, how many subsidy applications exist, and whether the government will control lesson content and prevent foreign influence on children. The government answered that Turkey promised transparency and information sharing, that about 15 applications were reportedly made, and that informal weekend education cannot be banned because inspectors lack legal powers, though it opposes education that hinders integration or promotes anti-democratic views.
At present the cabinet does not have full insight into the nature and scope of informal education at weekend schools.
Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen volledig zicht op de aard en omvang van het informeel onderwijs op onder andere weekendscholen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over VNO en het klimaatbeleid

An MP asked the ministers whether VNO-NCW's opposition to stronger climate policy, including arguments about carbon leakage that resemble a Business Europe lobbying strategy, undermines the Klimaatakkoord, and whether the government sees VNO-NCW as an obstacle. The minister acknowledges VNO-NCW's concerns about competitiveness and carbon leakage as shared points of attention, rejects the characterisation of the Klimaatakkoord as sabotaged, and states that the draft is on track to the 49% target with further elaboration needed.
I note that VNO-NCW calls attention to the international competitiveness of Dutch business and carbon leakage effects of CO2 emissions.
Ik constateer dat VNO-NCW aandacht vraagt voor de internationale concurrentiepositie van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven en weglekeffecten van CO 2 -uitstoot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over het bericht ‘Digitalisering van stroomnet loopt gevaar’

MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Social Affairs about reports that a shortage of technical staff endangers digitalisation of the power grid and the energy transition, and what measures, cooperation with municipalities and UWV, and use of refugee status holders are planned. The minister answers that the government is continuing the Techniekpact, the Klimaatakkoord task group on labour market and training, a labour-market programme (VIA) and a heat-pump training Green Deal, while acknowledging that no specific grid-digitalisation initiative has been launched.
Yes, I recognise the signals from the grid operators.
Ja, ik herken de signalen van de netbeheerders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over onderdekse arbeidsomstandigheden op riviercruiseschepen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about working conditions on river cruise ships (Argos broadcast alleging exploitation and long hours), and whether exploitation or labour-law violations are occurring and why inspection enforcement is not prioritised. The minister acknowledges the practices are very troubling, reports fines and ongoing investigations, says the Inspectorate SZW's priorities need not be revised, and points to the Wet aanpak schijnconstructies and EU posted-workers reform as the way forward.
I therefore see no reason to ask the Inspectorate to revise its prioritisation.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om de Inspectie te vragen haar prioritering te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het artikel 'De keerzijde van 100.000 zzp’ers in de bouw: ‘Meer dan tien procent is fake, arm en kwetsbaar’'

An MP asked the minister about a press article claiming 10,000 of the 50,000 construction freelancers are fake, poor and vulnerable, and about a firm that set up 530 sole proprietorships for Polish horticulture workers. The minister said the figures are unknown to them, cited prior estimates of 2-17% disguised self-employment, said the Tax Authority cannot act against individuals due to confidentiality, and pointed to Inspectie SZW enforcement and forthcoming measures on low-rate contracts.
The Tax Authority cannot address individual taxpayers due to its statutory confidentiality duty under article 67 AWR.
Op individuele belastingplichtigen kan de Belastingdienst op grond van zijn geheimhoudingsplicht van art. 67 AWR niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel 'De keerzijde van 100.000 zzp’ers in de bouw: ‘Meer dan tien procent is fake, arm en kwetsbaar’'

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Cobouw report that 10,000 to 20,000 of the 100,000 construction freelancers are disguised employees, mostly older, uninsured workers, and about enforcement, insurance age limits and pensions. The minister cited research estimating 3 to 5% disguised self-employment in construction, said the Tax Authority and Labour Inspectorate handle reports without naming individuals, and promised talks with insurers and a pension reform.
I do not make any statements about possible ongoing investigations by the Inspectorate.
Over eventuele lopende onderzoeken van de Inspectie doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en El Yassini over het bericht ‘Sociale partners belemmeren duurzame inzetbaarheid scholing en training van flexwerkers in de bouw’

MPs Wiersma and El Yassini asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Education about a construction-sector collective agreement clause that allows apprenticeship (bbl) contracts only with direct employees, excluding temp agency workers, and whether this harms flexworkers and bbl places. The ministers answer that sectoral social partners may set such terms, that they expect more bbl places in the tight labour market, and that the government is promoting bbl places but sees no reason to reopen talks with the social partners.
The registration of the SBB cannot show how many bbl students were placed at a training company via a temp agency construction.
Uit de registratie van de Samenwerkingsorganisatie Beroepsonderwijs Bedrijfsleven (SBB) kan niet worden afgeleid hoeveel bbl-ers via een uitzendconstructie bij een leerbedrijf zijn geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over toename van werkende armen

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the ministers about the rising number of working poor, including the SCP findings, self-employed low-rate workers, flexible and on-call contracts, and municipal outreach. The government acknowledged the concern, pointed to planned measures such as the ALT contract and the Arbeidsmarkt in balans bill, and committed to talks with municipalities and the VNG.
The cabinet will discuss the report with the VNG to examine how municipalities can better reach and support working people with low incomes.
Het kabinet gaat met de VNG over het rapport in gesprek, om te bezien hoe gemeenten werkenden met een laag inkomen beter kunnen bereiken en ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Becker over het bericht ‘IS-gangers welkom in El Tawheed-moskee’

MPs Rutte and Becker asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about reports that jihadist-linked persons were welcome at the El Tawheed mosque in Amsterdam, and whether police access and enforcement could be ensured. Minister Grapperhaus answered that no criminal offences have been established, that police may enter a place of worship only in limited circumstances under the Constitution and the Algemene wet op het binnentreden, that seven travellers' Dutch nationality was revoked, and that Amsterdam will inform the council of any decisions.
During a religious service, the police may only enter a mosque upon discovery in the act (on the spot).
De politie mag tijdens een religieuze dienst alleen een moskee binnentreden bij ontdekking op heterdaad
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat VNO-NCW is aangesloten bij een machtige lobbygroep die het verhogen van de Europese klimaatambitie actief tegenwerkt

MP Van Raan asked the government about reports that employers' federation VNO-NCW belongs to Business Europe, which lobbies against raising the EU 2030 climate target, and whether this conflicts with the coalition goal of 55% reduction and with the Dutch Climate Agreement talks. The minister acknowledged the notes, said the government works constructively with VNO-NCW, committed to pursuing 55% at EU level with allied member states, and declined to warn negotiators or officials specifically about the lobbying strategy.
Both government representatives in contact with VNO-NCW and the parties at the Industry table are aware of the international context in which industry operates.
Zowel overheidsvertegenwoordigers die in contact staan met VNO-NCW als de partijen aan de Industrietafel zijn zich bewust van de internationale context waarbinnen de industrie opereert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Gemeenten volgen 160 radicale moslims'

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers how the government handles hundreds of jihadists and thousands of sympathisers not under monitoring, why administrative detention is not introduced, how deradicalisation success is measured, how many are placed in work or schooling obligations, and expected costs. Minister Grapperhaus answered that local multidisciplinary case consultations and existing criminal and administrative tools suffice, that administrative detention without reasonable suspicion is not justified and will not be introduced, that deradicalisation programmes are evaluated but numbers are too small for conclusions, and that the local approach receives about EUR 6.5 million annually.
Case law and treaty obligations show that administrative detention, meaning preventive detention without reasonable suspicion, is not a justified deprivation of liberty.

Uit de rechtspraak en verdragsrechtelijke verplichtingen volgt dat administratieve detentie, in de zin van preventieve detentie zonder dat sprake is van een redelijke verdenking, geen gerechtvaardigde vrijheidsontneming is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over de berichten ’26.488 bijstandsklanten maar niemand wil of kan trucker worden’, ‘Bestuurslid Ondernemend Venlo: ‘Venlose werklozen willen niet werken’ en ‘Omscholen? Deze beroep

Wiersma (VVD) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports claiming benefit recipients refuse jobs such as truck driving despite labour shortages, and about proposals for a learning-work obligation. The Minister answered that jobseekers must actively seek work under the Participatiewet and WW rules, outlined training and reintegration funding, and said a study of successful municipal approaches will be published in spring 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over "de oproep van Belgische minister Peeters aan Ryanair om te voldoen aan Belgisch arbeidsrecht"

An MP asks the government about a Belgian minister's letter to Ryanair demanding compliance with Belgian labour law, precarious self-employment of pilots, and whether Dutch labour and social security law applies to Dutch-based crew. The minister answers that Dutch courts decide on applicable law, Dutch social security applies to Dutch-based crew, and a joint letter to Ryanair is being prepared with other EU states.
It is therefore for the Dutch court to determine under which circumstances Dutch labour law applies, and not for the Dutch government.
Het is dus aan de Nederlandse rechter om te bepalen onder welke omstandigheden het Nederlandse arbeidsrecht van toepassing is, en niet aan de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de nieuwe ontslagwet slecht is voor werknemers

The SP MPs Van Kent and Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the new dismissal law harms employees, citing an Inspectorate SZW report on UWV's business-economic dismissal review, including claims that employers replace dismissed staff with cheaper flex workers and supply false information. The minister rejects the claim that the law is bad for workers, notes that the Inspectorate's findings rest on perceptions that may differ from reality, and announces better information for employees on the re-employment condition and UWV follow-up.
UWV acts carefully by checking the information supplied by the employer for completeness and consistency.
Het UWV handelt zorgvuldig door de door de werkgever aangeleverde informatie te controleren op volledigheid en consistentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over de tweede nota van wijziging bij wet 34 934

MP Van Rooijen asks why the distinction between domestic and cross-border pension transfers is compatible with EU free movement rules and whether the directive conflicts with the TFEU, and questions the two-thirds approval requirement in the second amendment. The minister answers that purely internal situations fall outside the freedoms, that the Council of State raised no legal objections, and that a two-thirds majority is permitted under the directive and appropriate.
The distinction was moreover already included in the bill submitted to the Council of State's Advisory Division.
Het onderscheid was bovendien reeds opgenomen in het wetsvoorstel dat is voorgelegd aan de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Smeulders en Van Kent over onderbetaling journalisten door payrolling

MPs Van Dijk, Smeulders and Van Kent asked the ministers about public broadcasting journalists being underpaid through payrolling, including questions on pensions, the regeringsakkoord, zzp collective bargaining and flex allowances. The ministers answered that the Wab bill will extend equal pay and adequate pensions to payroll workers, that broadcasters must set their own budgets and wage terms under the cao, and declined to research the effects on journalistic quality.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Raemakers over het bericht ‘Honderdduizenden senioren lopen risico geld te laten liggen’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Raemakers asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Social Affairs about research showing many 55-plus households may miss out on healthcare and rent allowances, and about outreach to eligible seniors and Wajong beneficiaries. The government answered that non-take-up is known (about 17% for rent and healthcare allowance in earlier studies), that outreach exists, and that the issue will be examined in an upcoming IBO study with conclusions to inform further action.
Regarding the group of older migrants and single elderly, which you refer to in your question, no data are available in the aforementioned studies.
Over de groep oudere migranten en alleenstaande ouderen, waar u in uw vraag aan refereert, zijn in voornoemde onderzoeken geen gegevens voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Rooijen en Van Brenk over het bericht dat bijna een kwart miljoen senioren het risico lopen zorg- of huurtoeslag te missen

Two MPs from 50PLUS asked whether a Regioplan report showing that many seniors may be missing out on healthcare or rent allowances is accurate, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary says the percentages cannot be confirmed, names causes of non-take-up and promises an interdepartmental policy study of the allowance system, without committing to specific measures.
The cabinet recognises that there are citizens who do not use allowances although they may be entitled to them.
Het kabinet herkent en onderkent dat er burgers zijn die geen gebruik maken van toeslagen terwijl ze er mogelijk wel recht op hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over pensioenvlucht naar België

MP Omtzigt asked the minister whether he was aware of a Belgian report showing a 50%+ rise in cross-border pension fund assets in 2017, and how much pension capital had moved abroad via cross-border transfers in 2016-2018 and how many DNB approvals were given. The minister confirmed awareness, reported that DNB assessed five cross-border collective transfers (four to Belgium, one to Luxembourg) totalling about 4.3 billion euro, with no grounds to prohibit any, and promised to answer by 8 October.
Between 1 January 2016 and 4 October 2018, DNB assessed 5 cross-border collective value transfers, four to Belgium and one to Luxembourg.
Tussen 1 januari 2016 en 4 oktober 2018 heeft DNB 5 grensoverschrijdende collectieve waardeoverdrachten beoordeeld, vier naar België en één naar Luxemburg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over hoge bonussen bij pensioenuitvoerders

An MP asked the minister about high bonuses at pension administrators and whether pension funds should be allowed to pay them while pensions are not indexed, and whether participants can influence those bonuses. The minister answered that pension fund boards are responsible for outsourcing and remuneration choices, that participants already have voice through representative bodies, and that it is not for the minister to call boards to account.
It is not for me to call pension fund boards to account for the management of the pension fund and the execution of their work.
Het is niet aan mij om pensioenfondsbesturen aan te spreken op hun beheer van het pensioenfonds en de uitvoering van hun werkzaamheden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Arno Rutte over het bericht 'Jongerenreis naar radicale prediker'

MPs Becker and Rutte asked whether Milli Görüs organised trips of young people to a radical preacher in Turkey, who funds them, whether security services are aware, and whether mosque financing and imam training should be supervised. The government says such trips are lawful and not monitored, that it is unacceptable to radicalise youth but no concrete action on the trips is announced, and that the imam training falls outside higher education supervision.
If persons or organisations, through their aims or activities, give rise to a serious suspicion that they pose a threat to national security, the AIVD can conduct an investigation.

Indien personen of organisaties door de doelen die zij nastreven, dan wel door hun activiteiten aanleiding geven tot het ernstige vermoeden dat dat zij een gevaar vormen voor de nationale veiligheid, dan kan de AIVD onderzoek doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat jongeren via moskee-organisatie Milli Görüs in Nederland op "trainingskamp' gaan naar een omstreden Turkse imam die de gewapende jihad steunt

An MP asked whether youths were taken by Milli Görüs to Turkey to be taught by a radical imam who supports armed jihad, and what the government would do about it. The minister said such trips are legal for civil society organisations, that the government will not propose measures to prevent foreign trips, and that financing of such trips is unknown.
Social and religious organisations are free to organise foreign trips.
Het staat maatschappelijke en religieuze organisaties vrij om buitenlandse reizen te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht ‘Werkgevers: langer doorwerken ondergeschoven kind in cao-overleg’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about employers' and unions' failure to make concrete collective agreements keeping older workers employable, and about training, age-related exemption measures and a proposed personal work check. The minister acknowledged room for improvement, cited cao data and existing subsidy schemes, and said social partners must decide on concrete measures.
The cabinet therefore strongly focuses on improving the labour market position of workers aged fifty and over.
Het kabinet zet daarom stevig in op het verbeteren van de arbeidsmarktpositie van vijftigplussers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Salafisten op sleutelposities'

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a press report on Salafists in key positions, including whether the government would investigate Rotterdam mayor Aboutaleb's role and contacts with Waqf, whether diversity policy is a route for Islamic influence, whether the Muslim Brotherhood would be investigated, and how to reverse 'islamisation'. The minister declined the investigations, saying the report relied on anonymous sources and Rotterdam's council denied the claims, and stated the government takes a neutral position on religion.
I note that the information provided in the reporting comes from anonymous sources and that there are no verifiable statements.
Ik constateer dat de verstrekte informatie in de berichtgeving afkomstig is van anonieme bronnen en dat er geen sprake is van toetsbare verklaringen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het niet kunnen treffen van een persoonlijke betalingsregeling voor gedupeerde ouders in verband met de door de eigenaar van kinderopvang 'de Parel' gepleegde fraude met kindero

An MP asked whether parents defrauded through the childcare fraud at 'de Parel' could obtain a personal payment arrangement from the Tax Authority, after some parents were refused. The State Secretary answered that 15 of 50 requests were granted, refusals depended on individual circumstances such as intent or gross negligence, and the Tax Authority would adjust its notification letter for those refused.
Parents who do not qualify for a personal payment arrangement, for example because of intent or gross negligence, may possibly use the measure for offsetting childcare allowance.

Ouders die niet in aanmerking komen voor een persoonlijke betalingsregeling, omdat er bijvoorbeeld sprake is van opzet of grove schuld, kunnen mogelijk wel gebruik maken van «de maatregel bij verrekening van de kinderopvangtoeslag».

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht 'Bom onder poldermodel leggen was geen vooropgezet plan’ en ‘FNV vreest tweede ‘Jumbo-debacle’ bij marktleider Albert Heijn.’, en ‘Meer cao’s zonder handtekening FN

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about Jumbo's use of a workplace conditions arrangement agreed with the works council instead of a collective labour agreement, and about FNV's criticism of it. The minister answered that such arrangements are legally distinct from CAOs, that the choice belongs to the parties within legal limits, and declined to comment on negotiating positions or media statements.
It is not for me to assess why the need for this has arisen or may arise.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen waardoor de behoefte hieraan is ontstaan of kan ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) opnieuw privégegevens lekt

MP Van Kent (SP) asked the minister about a UWV data leak exposing personal data of 2,400 clients in Noord-Holland, and whether UWV's explanation, systems, GDPR compliance and past promised measures are adequate. The minister attributes the leak to human error, describes apology letters, a technical measure to block certain file types in Q2 2019, and admits earlier measures were insufficient.
UWV will introduce a technical measure in the second quarter of 2019 that makes sending certain files, such as xcel files, impossible.
Het UWV zal in het tweede kwartaal 2019 een technische maatregel invoeren die het verzenden van bepaalde bestanden, zoals xcel bestanden, onmogelijk maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht ‘Schreeuwende tekorten, maar scholing van flexwerkers is voor bedrijven geen prioriteit.’

An MP asked the ministers of Education and Social Affairs about ROA research showing flex workers receive far less work-related training than permanent staff, and about the planned individual learning account. The minister acknowledges the gap, says employers and employees bear primary responsibility, and promises a letter to parliament before the October committee meeting on lifelong learning.

On the policy to achieve a breakthrough in strengthening the Dutch learning culture, including the design of the individual learning account, parliament will be informed by letter before the October committee meeting.

Over het beleid om te komen tot een doorbraak bij de verdere versterking van de Nederlandse leercultuur, waaronder de vormgeving van de individuele leerrekening, wordt uw Kamer voorafgaand het algemeen overleg in oktober per brief geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het loonbod van 7% voor de CAO-Rijk (2018-2020) en de ontwikkeling van het Wettelijk minimumloon

Independent MP Van Brenk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the 7% wage offer for the civil service CAO and whether the statutory minimum wage (WML) should be adjusted faster to contract wage growth, asking about its history and evaluation. The minister replied that the WML is indexed twice yearly to contract wage developments under existing rules, that no delay in indexation exists, that the next evaluation is in 2019, and that past evaluations found no reason for a special adjustment.
The next evaluation of the WML under Article 14, thirteenth paragraph, is foreseen in 2019.
De eerstvolgende evaluatie van het WML conform art. 14, dertiende lid wordt voorzien in 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over het bericht dat consultant Aon in België goedkeuring heeft gekregen voor een eigen regelkader voor pensioenfondsen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that consultant Aon obtained approval in Belgium for its own prudential framework for pension funds, and whether Dutch funds relocating there would gain higher funding ratios and indexation, and what measures would prevent such moves. The minister said the Belgian framework is more principle-based so effects on funding ratios cannot be generalised, that the government sees no evidence of mass relocations to evade supervision, and that the matter is for employers and social partners, while pointing to pension reform work within the SER.
For now, the government has no indications that this is the case.
Vooralsnog heeft de regering geen aanwijzingen dat hiervan sprake is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over de verhuizing van een pensioenfonds van AON naar België en het feit dat de dekkingsgraad enkel door de verhuizing met 11% stijgt vanwege het verschil in toezicht

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked whether a Dutch pension fund moving to Belgium gains about 11 points of funding ratio from looser supervision, whether DNB may block such transfers, and how a 3.5% discount rate can be prudent. The minister answered that Belgian principle-based supervision differs, that DNB must approve cross-border transfers under IORP rules, and that the government considers avoidance-driven transfers undesirable but has no evidence of it.
For completeness, it should be noted that there is no relocation, i.e. transfer of seat, of a Dutch pension fund.
Voor de volledigheid wordt nog opgemerkt dat er geen sprake is van een verhuizing, oftewel zetelverplaatsing, van een Nederlands pensioenfonds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Becker over het bericht ‘'Duitse inlichtingendienst getipt dat Jawed S. radicaliseerde'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security and Social Affairs ministers whether German intelligence had warned about the radicalisation of an asylum seeker, whether information sharing with foreign services is adequate, how Dutch and German authorities cooperate on asylum radicalisation, and whether such information reaches municipalities. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the person did not appear in German threat systems, described existing international intelligence-sharing channels and migration-chain reporting structures, and said information can be shared with municipalities as permitted by the WIV 2017.
In the context of counterterrorism, information is shared internationally fully and quickly.
In het kader van contraterrorisme wordt informatie internationaal volledig en snel gedeeld.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Basisscholen missen 1300 leraren, na de zomer dreigt lesuitval’

Two VVD MPs asked about reports of 1,300 missing primary school teachers, including the extension of the chain-employment rule, use of the supplementary unemployment benefit pool, part-time and retired teachers, and vakleerkrachten for physical education. The minister answered that the chain-rule exemption for substitutes took effect in August 2018, that re-integration results were not previously tracked but monitoring starts in September, and that several proposals (such as Vervangingsfonds coverage for self-employed teachers) are being reviewed or are not the government's responsibility.
As a result, data are currently lacking to factually answer how many benefit recipients return to teaching.
Hiermee ontbreken dus momenteel gegevens om de vraag feitelijk te kunnen beantwoorden hoeveel uitkeringsgerechtigden terug keren voor de klas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de gevolgen van arbeidsmigratie

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about housing shortages, employer-provided housing, wage deductions, registration and displacement effects of labour migration. The minister acknowledged the housing need, pointed to ongoing research and instruments, and said municipalities and employers bear responsibility, with EU free movement limiting language requirements and work permits.
It is up to municipalities, temp agencies, employers and housing providers to jointly take their responsibility and engage in discussion about quality housing for labour migrants.
Het is aan gemeenten, uitzendbureaus, werkgevers en huisvesters om gezamenlijk hun verantwoordelijkheid te pakken en het gesprek aan te gaan over kwalitatieve huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een vacaturesite die mogelijk discriminatie in de hand werkt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a job vacancy site allowing filtering on faith, appearance and political preference amounts to discrimination, and whether investigation and talks with the company are warranted. The state secretary condemned arbitrary filtering as contrary to government policy, noted that some distinctions are permitted under equal treatment law, said courts, the College voor de Rechten van de Mens and the Public Prosecution Service decide on violations, and promised to study the impact of algorithmic matching as part of a broader inquiry.
I intend to conduct research into this to assess what the impact could be on discrimination and how to anticipate this in the future.
Ik ben voornemens hier onderzoek naar te doen om te bezien wat de impact kan zijn wat betreft discriminatie en hoe hier op geanticipeerd moet worden in de toekomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Wiersma over het bericht van RTL Nieuws dat tientallen criminelen een uitkering ontvangen ondanks een openstaande celstraf

Two MPs asked why convicts evading an open prison sentence still receive benefits, and whether the state can recover them and tighten the law. The minister says the practice is unjustifiable, describes a CJIB-UWV data-matching process and a pilot letter scheme to meet Centrale Raad van Beroep rulings, and sees no need for a law change.
For this small remaining group, I am therefore, together with my colleague at SZW, taking an additional step to stop the benefit.
Voor deze kleine resterende groep zet ik daarom samen met mijn ambtsgenoot van SZW nog een extra stap om de uitkering stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong, Helder en Markuszower over het bericht 'Tientallen criminelen krijgen uitkering ondanks openstaande celstraf'
