PVV MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Justice why convicted criminals with outstanding prison sentences still receive benefits, how much this costs, and what will be done to stop and recover payments. The minister answers that benefits are terminated under a 2011 scheme, 837 benefits were withdrawn in 2016-2017, courts have in some cases ruled withdrawal unlawful, and a CJIB-UWV pilot with letters to offenders will continue.

To withdraw or refuse benefits of convicted persons with an outstanding prison sentence, benefit agencies match CJIB files of fugitives from the investigation register against files of benefit recipients.

Om de uitkeringen van veroordeelden met een openstaande vrijheidsstraf in te trekken of te weigeren, matchen uitkeringsinstanties CJIB-bestanden van voortvluchtigen uit het opsporingsregister met de bestanden van uitkeringsgerechtigden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Krol over de berichten: 'Discriminatie ouderen in vacatureteksten' en 'vacature sluit ouderen uit'

Two MPs from 50PLUS asked the government about reports that job advertisements still exclude older workers through age-related wording, and about enforcement, sanctions and possible criminal law. The State Secretary answered that age-related wording can be direct or indirect discrimination, pointed to the Inspectie SZW review, the 2018-2021 action plan and voluntary tools, and declined to commit to criminal prosecution or to a separate letter before Prinsjesdag.

As announced in my letter on tackling labour market discrimination in the temporary employment sector of 1 May 2018 and in the outline letter on the 2018-2021 Action Plan of 19 July 2018, among other effective alternatives, the possibilities to strengthen the enforcement role of the Inspectorate SZW in supervising discrimination in recruitment and selection are being explored.

Zoals is aangekondigd in mijn brief «Aanpak arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie in uitzendsector» 7 van 1 mei 2018 en in de «Hoofdlijnenbrief Actieplan Arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie 2018–2021» 8 van 19 juli 2018, wordt, naast andere effectieve alternatieven, verkernt wat de mogelijkheden zijn om de handhavende rol van de Inspectie SZW met betrekking tot toezicht op discriminatie bij werving en selectie te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Pieter Heerma over het lage-inkomensvoordeel

MPs Omtzigt and Heerma asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the effectiveness and transparency of the low-income benefit (LIV) paid to employers, including its use by staffing agencies, whether beschikkingen are public, and the sector breakdown. The minister argued the LIV lowers labour costs and raises employment per CPB, said no hard employment data exists yet, refused to publish firm-level figures on confidentiality grounds, and committed to a UWV baseline measurement and a report on the samenloop with the ET-regeling by year end.
A more detailed overview at employer level is not desirable because it would disclose confidential company data.
Een gedetailleerder overzicht op werkgeversniveau is niet wenselijk omdat het vertrouwelijke bedrijfsgegevens openbaar maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ernstige problemen na gezinshereniging van Eritrese vluchtelingen

An SP MP asked the ministers about serious problems (domestic violence, child abuse, health, integration) faced by Eritrean family reunification migrants and whether support, information and shelter are adequate. The government acknowledges the risks, points to existing guidance and Pharos research, promises to raise the issue with VNG, shelter and Veilig Thuis organisations, and says the residence permit type does not hinder seeking protection.

I will bring the Pharos exploration and the Argos article and broadcast to the attention of the VNG, the 35 centre municipalities for women's shelters, the women's shelter institutions and the national Veilig Thuis network.

Ik zal de verkenning van Pharos en het artikel en de uitzending van Argos onder de aandacht brengen van de VNG, de 35 centrumgemeenten vrouwenopvang, de vrouwenopvanginstellingen en het landelijk Netwerk Veilig Thuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over uitbuiting van vrachtwagenchauffeurs

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Laçin asked ministers about exploitation of truck drivers, including enforcement of the 45-hour weekend rest, the adequacy of ILT enforcement and fines, sham constructions with foreign subsidiaries, and truckers' hotel accommodation. The minister denies that the Netherlands has become Europe's parking lot, says enforcement is risk-based and targeted, defends the current fine policy, and refers to ongoing EU mobility package negotiations.
I do not consider it opportune to change the current fining policy.
Ik acht het niet opportuun om het huidige boetebeleid te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het bericht dat buitenlandse vrachtwagenchauffeurs oververtegenwoordigd zijn bij ongelukken en pechgevallen

MPs Van Dijk and Laçin asked whether foreign truck drivers are overrepresented in accidents and breakdowns, and what the causes, costs and measures are. The minister answered that the data cannot establish the nationality-linked causes or costs, that most incidents are technical or tyre-related, and that the new road safety plan will address freight transport risks.
To further specify the causes of the involvement of foreign drivers, detailed information on all incidents is necessary.
Om de oorzaken van de betrokkenheid van buitenlandse chauffeurs nader te specificeren is gedetailleerde informatie van alle incidenten noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over "Maaltijdbezorger Deliveroo ronselt minderjarigen"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Deliveroo recruits minors as couriers, whether this is tolerable, whether Deliveroo breaches OECD guidelines, and whether the Labour Inspectorate will investigate. The minister confirmed awareness, stated that child delivery work is prohibited under the Working Hours Act, placed primary responsibility on companies, declined to comment on concrete cases, and said the Inspectorate will focus on the platform economy without confirming any investigation.
I do not comment on any ongoing investigations by the Inspectorate.
Over eventuele lopende onderzoeken van de Inspectie doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Gijs van Dijk over het artikel ‘Trillende handen aan het bed’ (uitbuiting in de thuiszorg)

MPs Kerstens and Gijs van Dijk asked the ministers about exploitation of Bulgarian live-in home-care workers by Care4You and related firms, and about municipal underpayment for home care. The ministers said inspections are ongoing, enforcement rests with labour and care inspectorates, and reviews of the reasonable-price decree are underway with results due in 2019.
I have asked the care offices to further investigate the roughly ten cases in this case in which PGB care is purchased.
Ik heb de zorgkantoren gevraagd om het tiental zaken waarin in deze casus pgb-zorg wordt ingekocht nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Koolmees: Ondernemers flexibel genoeg om in te spelen op klimmende AOW-leeftijd'

The CDA MP Slootweg asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the AOW-gap faced by self-employed people and freelancers whose disability or early-retirement insurance ended at 65 after the AOW age was raised, and whether they can use the bridging scheme (OBR). The Minister answers that the OBR is available to self-employed people who meet its conditions, that the number affected is not known, and that the self-employed bear primary responsibility for insuring against disability risk.
It is not known how many self-employed people and freelancers with an early-retirement and/or disability insurance face an AOW-gap.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel zelfstandigen en zzp-ers met een prepensioen- en/of arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering geconfronteerd zijn met een AOW-gat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong en Wilders over het bericht ‘Pensioenfondsen dicht bij korten’

MPs De Jong and Wilders asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether pension funds with large buffers should avoid cuts, and whether a higher discount rate should be used to prevent them. The minister replied that funds lack sufficient buffers, that cuts may be needed in 2020 if finances do not improve, and that he will not raise the discount rate, while pointing to pension reform.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daar ben ik niet toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over minder snelle stijging van de AOW-leeftijd

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the speed of the AOW pension age increase, citing actuarial and CPB views that it may be rising too fast and questioning budget savings on the AOW. The minister answered that the AOW age will rise to 67 and is linked to life expectancy, that the lower projected AOW spending is partly due to temporary lower beneficiary numbers and revised estimates, and that the IOW unemployment scheme for older workers will be extended by four years.
I am in favour of a solid and solidary AOW for current and future generations.
Ik ben voor een solide en solidaire AOW voor huidige én toekomstige generaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Tielen over het bericht 'Nieuwe imamopleiding, nu van Milli Görüs'

Two VVD MPs asked whether the planned private imam training by Milli Görüs in Amsterdam will start in September 2018, how it relates to the VU programme, whether Dutch-rooted imams are preferred, and whether civic values and inspection oversight apply to it. The minister replies that the private training falls outside recognised higher education, so the government has no view on its start or content and the Inspectorate has no oversight, while the VU exploration proceeds and the government supports Dutch-rooted imams.
I cannot impose obligations on institutions outside the recognised higher education system.
Ik kan geen verplichtingen opleggen aan instellingen buiten het bestel van erkend hoger onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Segers over de berichten ‘Ander huis gezocht voor bedreigde christelijke Syriër’ en ‘Syrische christen uit Overijssel krijgt dreigbrief, van IS’

Two MPs asked how citizens threatened for their faith or views, such as a Syrian Christian receiving a threat letter, can obtain adequate protection quickly, and how such cases are registered and countered. The government answered that local authorities are responsible for protection and risk assessment, that threats should be reported to police and are registered as discrimination or threats, and that a local multidisciplinary approach to radicalisation exists.
The local authority generally bears responsibility for the safety and well-being of its citizens.
Het lokale gezag draagt in het algemeen zorg voor de veiligheid en het welzijn van haar burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat president Erdogan de Turkse Nederlanders per brief oproept om op zijn partij te stemmen

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the ministers whether Erdogan's letter urging Turkish Dutch citizens to vote for his party was acceptable, how Turkish parties obtained voter data, and what the government would do about it. The minister said the letter is inappropriate as an implicit voting recommendation but legal, that voter lists were lawfully obtained from Turkish authorities, and that the government would raise the matter with Turkey if diaspora politics crossed legal limits.
The cabinet considers it inappropriate that Dutch citizens receive a letter from the Turkish president calling on them to vote in the Turkish parliamentary and presidential elections.
Het kabinet vindt het ongepast dat Nederlandse burgers een brief ontvangen van de Turkse president met een oproep om te gaan stemmen voor de Turkse parlements-en presidentsverkiezing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke en Koopmans over de brief van de Turkse president Erdogan inzake de Turkse verkiezingen

MPs Becker, Ten Broeke and Koopmans asked the government about a letter from Turkish President Erdogan to Turkish voters in the Netherlands before the 2018 Turkish elections, including who supplied the address data, whether the Dutch data protection authority investigated, and whether Turkish election signs on Dutch motorways were justified. The government answered that the letter was not a literal voting instruction but was inappropriate, that address lists can be obtained in Turkey under Turkish law, that the data protection authority acted independently and the GDPR does not apply, and that local authorities handled the signs and no disclaimer will be added.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority is an independent supervisory body that itself determines which investigations it carries out.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder die zelf bepaalt welk onderzoek zij uitvoert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag op de werkvloer van artsen

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked how the government views a Medisch Contact survey finding that many doctors and medical students experienced sexual boundary-crossing behaviour at work, and why it persists, and what consequences it draws. The minister replied that such behaviour is unacceptable, that employers must have policies and complaint procedures, that few victims take further steps, and that the government will work with the sector on additional measures.
I will discuss with the sector further steps to address and prevent unwanted behaviour.
Ik ga met de sector nader in gesprek over aanvullende stappen om ongewenst gedrag tegen te gaan en te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Gijs van Dijk over reclame door verplichtgestelde pensioenfondsen

MPs Van Weyenberg and Gijs van Dijk asked whether a mandatory pension fund's national TV advertising campaign (EUR 1.3 million in 2018) is appropriate, how it is supervised and reported, and whether targeted letters would be cheaper. The minister confirmed no specific advertising rules exist beyond AFM supervision of information duties, said communication costs are not separately reported, and left the choice of media to the fund's board and works council.
In PFZW's annual report, communication costs are not listed separately.
In het jaarverslag van PFZW worden de communicatiekosten niet apart vermeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het online platform Temper dat zich wel degelijk als werkgever gedraagt

An SP MP asked the minister about the online platform Temper, which allegedly acts as an employer toward (pseudo-)self-employed hospitality workers through low rates, fees and restrictions, and whether it falls under the Waadi intermediary law and the government's enforcement tools. The minister answered that whether Temper is an employer or a temporary-work intermediary depends on facts that cannot be judged from a website, that courts decide, that the Inspectie SZW and Belastingdienst can investigate on complaint or risk-based supervision, and declined to comment on individual cases.
Whether this is the case at Temper depends on the facts and circumstances under which work is performed, which cannot be established solely on the basis of a text on a website.
Of dit bij Temper het geval is hangt af van de feiten en omstandigheden waaronder wordt gewerkt en dat kan niet worden vastgesteld alleen op basis van een tekst op een website.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat een chauffeur 34 uur onderweg was zonder fatsoenlijke pauze

The SP MPs Laçin and Van Dijk asked the ministers whether a Dutch truck driver who drove 34 hours without a proper break reflects a wider problem with tachograph tampering and enforcement, and who bears responsibility. The minister calls it unacceptable, describes ILT and ISZW risk-based enforcement and cross-border cooperation, says such a case was not previously encountered, and places primary responsibility on the employer and driver.
Exceeding driving and rest times occurs more often, but the ILT has not previously encountered a driver who was 34 hours on the road without a proper break.
Overschrijdingen van de rij- en rusttijden komen vaker voor, maar een chauffeur die 34 uur onderweg is zonder fatsoenlijke pauze, is de ILT nog niet eerder tegengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het rapport 'Vluchtelingen en Werk. Een nieuwe tussenbalans' van de Sociaal Economische Raad

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an SER report showing that few adult asylum seekers granted status in 2014 had paid work two and a half years later, and about follow-up actions. The Minister shares concern, points to the Taskforce Werk & Integratie, an evaluation framework, and a promised update in Q4 2018, but declines to inform parliament earlier.
No. It is easy to start experiments, but it requires careful preparation to set them up so that after evaluation they can actually say something about effectiveness.

Nee. Het is gemakkelijk om experimenten te starten maar het vergt een gedegen voorbereiding om experimenten zo in te richten dat ze daadwerkelijk na evaluatie iets over de effectiviteit kunnen zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat een in Rotterdam werkzame imam in Engeland is veroordeeld voor kindermishandeling

Two MPs asked whether a Rotterdam imam convicted in England of child abuse was known to his mosque board, whether a VOG should be required for imams, whether he could obtain one, and about links to the Hijaz community. The government said the mosque board claims it was unaware, that VOG is an employer responsibility with a recommended VOG for child-related work, that a foreign conviction would appear in Dutch records and normally block a VOG, and that it cannot judge specific links but relies on the driesporen approach and transparency measures on foreign funding.
We do not go into individual cases.
Wij gaan niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over de berichten 'Langdurig werklozen vaak onvindbaar systemen UWV' en 'Werkloze is te anoniem'

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that long-term unemployed people are hard to find in UWV systems and that anonymous CVs reduce job chances, including data on CV publication, exemptions from the job-search obligation, and matching improvements. The minister answers that most CVs are public, that anonymous CVs do not reduce job chances because employers can still contact jobseekers, and outlines ongoing ICT and matching improvements.
Since it is always possible to contact a jobseeker and because important information is visible to employers, posting an anonymous CV need not lead to fewer job chances.

Aangezien het altijd mogelijk is om in contact te komen met een werkzoekende en omdat belangrijke informatie voor werkgevers zichtbaar is, hoeft het plaatsen van een anoniem cv niet te leiden tot minder kansen op een baan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Jasper van Dijk over het uitsluiten van vrachtwagenchauffeurs van gelijk loon voor gelijk werk en de verkeersveiligheid op de Nederlandse wegen

Two MPs asked the ministers whether the EU Transport Committee's position excluding truck drivers from the posted workers directive and allowing longer driving-time flexibility threatens equal pay and road safety, and whether the Netherlands can still enforce posting rules. The minister answered that the exemption should be limited, that flexibilisation may endanger road safety, that the European Parliament had rejected the committee report as a negotiating basis, and that the Dutch enforcement position is unaffected.
The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management has consistently pointed out that too much flexibilisation can endanger road safety.
De Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat heeft steeds gewezen op het feit dat te veel flexibilisering de verkeersveiligheid in gevaar kan brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht 'Private uitvoerders sociale zekerheid eisen 'drastisch aangepaste rol' UWV'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a platform of private social security implementers demanding a drastically changed role for UWV and a more level playing field in the hybrid market for sickness and WGA benefits. The minister answered that he is in talks with UWV, the Tax Administration and private parties, will report on the hybrid market in autumn 2018, and had already met PPUSZ in April.
I will inform you in autumn 2018 by letter about the outcomes of this exploration of the hybrid market for the WGA and the ZW.
Ik zal u in het najaar van 2018 in een brief informeren over de uitkomsten van deze verkenning over de hybride markt voor de WGA en de ZW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over beleggingen van het pensioenfonds ABP

An SP MP asked ministers whether the ABP pension fund's rising fossil fuel investments, and its holdings in companies harming climate and environment, are acceptable for a fund serving public-sector workers, and what steps the government will take. The minister answered that ABP invests for employees rather than the state, that engagement with companies is the chosen approach, that IMVO covenants with the financial sector are being negotiated, and that the IORP directive will require more disclosure to members.
As also mentioned in the answer to question 1, ABP is the pension fund of the employees concerned and not of the government.
Zoals ook genoemd in het antwoord op vraag 1, is ABP het pensioenfonds van betreffende werknemers en niet van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht "15 arbeidsmigranten in één eengezinswoning”

MP Van Dijk asked the Minister whether housing fifteen migrant workers in one family home was lawful, whether rules should be tightened, and whether the labour inspectorate has enough capacity against overcrowding, exploitation and displacement. The Minister said housing is primarily a municipal matter, pointed to municipal tools and complaint routes, noted additional inspectorate capacity to be clarified in Q3 2018, and said national rules may be tightened through the Goed verhuurderschap process.
Housing policy is primarily a local matter and municipalities have a duty to ensure suitable housing for all their residents.
Het woonbeleid is primair een lokale aangelegenheid en gemeenten hebben een taak om te zorgen voor geschikte huisvesting voor al hun inwoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over de gevolgen van de uitspraak van de CRvB over de toepassing van het woonlandbeginsel

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether social benefits exported abroad should be adjusted to local cost levels after a Central Appeals Tribunal ruling on the residence-country principle, and why earlier warnings about twenty treaties did not reveal the problem sooner. The minister answers that adjustment is needed, that thirteen treaties must now change, that roughly 1.2 million euros in extra spending is at stake, and that renegotiations are ongoing with several countries, promising to inform parliament of progress and of any failure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Koopmans over het bericht dat de Turkse president Erdogan campagne wil voeren in het buitenland voor de Turkse presidents- en parlementsverkiezingen in juni

VVD MPs Becker and Koopmans asked whether Erdogan would campaign abroad before the June 2018 Turkish elections, how the Netherlands would prevent such campaign visits, and whether a German-style ban on foreign politicians campaigning could be introduced. The government said Erdogan attended a rally in Sarajevo, that visits by Turkish government members are unwanted, that municipalities decide on other campaign activities, and that it will explore a general line on foreign politicians' campaigning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Gijs van Dijk over de inwerkingtreding van de handhaving op schijnzelfstandigheid per 1 juli aanstaande

MPs Van Kent and Gijs van Dijk asked how the Tax Authority and Inspectorate SZW would enforce against sham self-employment from 1 July 2018, including evident bad-faith employers such as Deliveroo. The minister answered that enforcement continues only against the most serious cases within existing capacity, outlined a supervision plan with at least 100 client visits, and noted the heavy burden of proof and the lengthy appeal and criminal route.
Supervision and enforcement of the DBA Act take place within existing capacity.
Toezicht en handhaving van de wet DBA vindt plaats binnen de bestaande capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel in Trouw van 18 mei jl. “UWV onthield werkzoekenden begeleiding, om effect te testen”

MP Van Brenk asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether UWV withheld personal guidance from unemployed people with a 'wrong' BSN to test effects, and whether this amounts to genuine tailored service rather than cuts. The minister replied that tailoring is based on the Werkverkenner assessment, not the BSN; a random 20 percent control group is used only for a temporary effect evaluation, that cuts are not the reason, and that additional funding is planned from 2019.
Only for that temporary effect evaluation is the BSN used.
Alleen voor die – tijdelijke – effectmeting wordt het BSN gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, De Jong en Helder over het bericht 'Bizar probleem defensie: Schietende jassen'

MPs asked about a report that winter jackets issued to military and police personnel could accidentally fire weapons via loose cords, and about the injury, measures taken, the Inspectorate SZW investigation, and whether the jackets remain in use. The government said the injured soldier has recovered, the Marechaussee banned firing in these jackets, about 4000 soldiers still have them with elastic removal required, the police do not use them, and it announced a plan for a safer defence organisation while withholding the inspectorate's timing and dates.
Making working conditions safer is therefore a top priority for the coming years.
Het veiliger maken van de werkomstandigheden is dan ook topprioriteit voor de komende jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over “een Turks Festival in Arnhem dat een manifestatie is van de Turkse extreemrechtse Partij van de Nationalistische Beweging”

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Turkish festival in Arnhem allegedly linked to the Grey Wolves and a singer with nationalist, hateful lyrics. The minister said the municipality monitors the event, the singer will not appear, police and prosecutors act on any criminal conduct, and the government will act if integration or the rule of law is undermined, without directly answering whether Grey Wolves displays are acceptable.
If there is any question of criminal offences in words or conduct, the police are alert to this and will act against it.
Indien er sprake is van strafbare feiten in woord of gedragingen, is de politie daar alert op en zal daar tegen worden opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over "een lagere WIA-uitkering door dagloonbesluit".

MPs Van Dijk and Van Kent asked whether the daily-wage rules (Dagloonbesluit) unfairly lower a WIA benefit compared with the Ziektewet, and whether the rules should be repaired. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, explained the reference-period and daily-wage calculation, and said there is no reason to change the rules.
There is no reason to change the daily-wage rules for the WIA.
Er is geen aanleiding om de dagloonregels voor de WIA te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over de ongevallenverzekering voor Deliveroo bezorgers

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked whether Deliveroo's free accident insurance for couriers signals employer status and disguised self-employment, whether the Tax Authority will enforce, and whether clarity is needed to prevent a race to the bottom. The minister answered that employer status is for courts to decide case by case, that tax confidentiality bars comments on individuals, that the government will tackle disguised self-employment through new rules, and that enforcement against the most serious bad-faith cases continues, with a broader scope from 1 July 2018.
No statements can be made about individual taxpayers under article 67 of the General Tax Act.
Over individuele belastingplichtigen kunnen op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Kent over het ontduiken van het minimumloon door Sandd

MPs Alkaya and Van Kent asked whether postal company Sandd is evading the minimum wage by paying couriers on fixed norm hours rather than actual hours worked, and how the 80% employment norm was met. The minister answers that the minimum wage applies per hour worked, that the Inspectorate SZW is aware of the FNV complaint, that ACM found postal firms compliant with the 80% norm, and that a sector-wide collective agreement is for social partners to decide.
I cannot make statements about the specific situation at Sandd.
Over de specifieke situatie bij Sandd kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Raemakers over het niet toekennen van het loonkostenvoordeel na stage

MPs Van Weyenberg and Raemakers asked why employers lose the wage-cost advantage (loonkostenvoordeel) when a paid internship is not followed by timely registration of a target-group declaration, and whether this can be corrected. Minister Koolmees explained the three-month registration rule, said UWV will inform employers, and that he is examining a one-off 2018 exception for workers hired directly after a paid internship.
To ensure the target-group declaration is requested in time, UWV will actively inform employers, possibly via the education institutions involved.
Om ervoor te zorgen dat de doelgroepverklaring tijdig wordt aangevraagd, zal het UWV de werkgevers, al dan niet via de betrokken onderwijsinstellingen, actief gaan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht ‘Werkgevers wordt Loonkosten Voordeel onthouden omdat Doelgroep jongeren stage bij ze hebben gelopen’

Rep. Wiersma (VVD) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether employers lose a wage-cost subsidy (up to 6,000 euro) when a youth on a BBL apprenticeship contract had earlier done a paid internship with them, and whether the UWV or the minister can still grant the eligibility declaration. The minister answered that the subsidy is available regardless of a prior paid internship, that the declaration must be requested within three months of the internship start, that the UWV will inform employers, and that he is examining a one-off exception for 2018.

For the year 2018 I am examining the possibility of making an exception so that employees from the target group who entered an employment contract with the same employer directly after a paid internship in 2018 can still apply for a target group declaration for both the internship period and the contract period.

Voor het jaar 2018 onderzoek ik de mogelijkheid een uitzondering te maken in die zin dat werknemers uit de doelgroep die direct aansluitend aan een betaalde stage in 2018 een arbeidscontract zijn aangegaan met dezelfde werkgever alsnog een doelgroepverklaring kunnen aanvragen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özdil en Van der Lee over het SER-advies Energietransitie en werkgelegenheid

MPs Özdil and Van der Lee asked ministers about an SER advisory report on the energy transition and employment, including shortages of qualified staff, language barriers for status holders, and VCA certification requirements. The ministers acknowledged the labour-market challenge, pointed to retraining, a Klimaatakkoord task group, and talks with industry on certification differentiation, without committing to specific new government investment.
Where this does not lead to the desired results, there must be a good social plan.
Daar waar dit niet tot de gewenste resultaten leidt moet er een goed sociaal plan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over een vorm van slavernij bij PostNL

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked whether working conditions for agency sorters at PostNL amount to a form of slavery, including pace of work, heavy lifting, breaks, standby pay, underpayment and bypassing the collective agreement. The ministers answered that employers bear primary responsibility under the Working Conditions Act and that the Labour Inspectorate enforces the rules, that the underpayment matter is before the civil court, and that they saw no reason to meet PostNL's management.
Following the findings of the investigation, the FNV summoned PostNL and agency InPerson before the civil court on 22 February 2018.
Naar aanleiding van de uitkomsten uit het onderzoek heeft de FNV op 22 februari 2018 PostNL en uitzendbureau InPerson voor de civiele rechter gedaagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over stress veroorzakende klantbeoordelingssystemen

An MP asks the minister whether customer rating systems that pressure workers, feed personnel files and dismissal dossiers, and carry bias risks are acceptable, and whether the Inspectorate will investigate. The minister says the systems are not inherently unacceptable, that employers must manage privacy and workplace-stress risks, and that the Inspectorate supervises employers' policies generally rather than these systems specifically, while bias should be tackled directly.
The system itself does not lead to this behaviour.
Het systeem zelf leidt niet tot dit gedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol en Van Rooijen over het bericht “Riet Zaal gecompenseerd, volgens pensioenfonds PMT alleen vanwege verkeerde communicatie”

Two 50PLUS MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that pension fund PMT compensated Riet Zaal only because of miscommunication, and whether other members could be similarly harmed, including by a confidentiality clause and a lost-records issue. The minister answers that PMT says the case is specific to Zaal, that pension funds should be transparent but confidentiality is a matter for the parties, that funds handle complaints first with the Pensions Ombudsman and courts as fallback, and that the 1980s fire had limited effects.
According to PMT, this concerns the specific situation of Mrs Zaal, and there is no reason to assume a comparable situation exists for other pension fund participants.

Volgens PMT betreft dit de specifieke situatie van mevrouw Zaal en is er geen aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat een vergelijkbare situatie aan de orde zou zijn voor andere deelnemers van pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over ”de aanvulling op de WW-uitkering voor mensen die vierwekelijks worden uitbetaald”

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether unemployment benefit top-ups are disadvantaged for workers paid every four weeks, causing a missed December payment, and asked for a monthly-payment fix. The minister answered that the timing is not undesirable since higher December wages offset it, that a worked example shows four-weekly payees receive slightly more over the year, and that no change to employer reporting rules is planned.
It is therefore more favourable for the salary to be paid every four weeks rather than monthly.
Het is dus gunstiger dat het salaris per vier weken in plaats van per maand wordt betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Kops en Fritsma over het bericht “Miljardairsfamilie Van der Vorm koopt huizen voor Syriërs (en jij betaalt mee)”

PVV MPs asked why a Rotterdam housing initiative by the SNTR foundation reserves 200 homes for Syrian status holders, calling it discrimination against Dutch citizens, and whether such schemes should be stopped. The minister answered that the scheme responds to housing needs of status holders, that whether it constitutes discrimination is for a court to judge, and that no comparable initiatives are known; he rejected the call to restrict social housing to Dutch nationals.
Whether in this case there is also discrimination is not for the cabinet but for a judge to assess.
Of in het onderhavige geval ook sprake is van discriminatie is niet aan het kabinet, maar aan een rechter om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Sjoerdsma en Karabulut over financiering van Nederlandse islamitische instellingen vanuit de Golfstaten

MPs Segers, Sjoerdsma and Karabulut asked the ministers about Gulf state financing of Dutch Islamic institutions, including why the ministry withheld information from RAND researchers and from municipalities, and why Saudi and Kuwaiti information was kept confidential. The minister answered that the ministry fully cooperated with RAND, that the information was shared with other government bodies and municipalities, that the Saudi MoU would not be published at Saudi request, and that the government is exploring legal measures on transparency of funding flows.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs, to the best of its knowledge and belief, provided full cooperation to RAND during the research at the end of 2014 so that it could conduct research in complete freedom.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft naar eer en geweten tijdens de uitvoering van het onderzoek eind 2014 volledige medewerking verleend aan RAND om in alle vrijheid onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Geluk-Poortvliet over de gang van zaken rondom het vervallen van de ANW-compensatieregeling bij het ABP

Two MPs (Omtzigt and Geluk-Poortvliet, CDA) asked why the government and ABP accepted that the ANW-compensation scheme's abolition was poorly communicated, with no consequences, and whether supervisors, the ABP board and pension rules were adequate. The minister answered that supervision lies with independent regulators (DNB and AFM), that the ABP board knows its scheme, that no fine was imposed and no supervisor contacted, and that a 5-year coulance scheme and a 2019 evaluation will follow, with some commitments to evaluate.
The ABP board is currently carrying out an evaluation, in which the social partners are also involved.
Het ABP-bestuur is momenteel bezig met een evaluatie, waarbij ook de sociale partners worden betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Wiersma over meer arbeidsslaven in Europa dan sekswerkers

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports of more labour exploitation than sex trafficking in Europe, the claimed halving of registered trafficking cases in the Netherlands, prosecution and sentencing statistics, and progress on the coalition agreement's plans to strengthen the fight against trafficking. The Secretary of State answered that the rise in labour exploitation is worrying, that registered victims fell from 1,256 in 2014 to 952 in 2016 with a slight recovery in 2017, provided statistics on victims, prosecutions and sentences, and said a pimping ban and a broader interdepartmental plan are in preparation.
There is no question of a halving.
Er is geen sprake van een halvering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over slachtoffers van arbeidsuitbuiting

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about labour exploitation victims, temp agencies, the au pair scheme, the Asian catering covenant and Inspectorate capacity. The minister acknowledged the problem, described existing enforcement, self-regulation and information-sharing measures, and said he would inform parliament on Inspectorate capacity in Q3 2018.
The coalition agreement frees up an additional €50 million per year, rising gradually to 2021, to strengthen the enforcement chain under the Inspectorate Control Framework.
Het regeerakkoord maakt geleidelijk oplopend naar 2021 jaarlijks € 50 miljoen extra vrij voor versterking van de handhavingsketen conform het Inspectie Control Framework.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de hoogte van de beltarieven bij UWV

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether UWV may charge callers more than the basic tariff, arguing that consumers calling traders may not be charged extra. The Minister answered that UWV is a public body, not a trader, so the consumer-rights rule does not apply, and declined to order UWV to change its phone tariffs, though UWV is examining a switch to a usage-only number.
UWV is currently examining the possibility of switching to a different type of telephone number, where only the usage tariff applies.
UWV onderzoekt echter op dit moment de mogelijkheid om over te stappen naar een ander type telefoonnummer, waarbij alleen het gebruikstarief wordt gehanteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht 'Ministerie hield informatie over moskeeën achter voor gemeenten'

An MP asks why the Ministry of Social Affairs withheld information on foreign funding of mosques from municipalities, and whether all such information will be shared going forward and when restrictions on funding from unfree countries will follow. The minister admits information was shared late and incompletely due to diplomatic confidentiality and procedural delays, promises to inform municipalities of new funding reports, and says a report on restricting such funding will come in autumn 2018.
In doing so, this information was mistakenly not promptly shared with the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment.
Daarbij is deze informatie per abuis niet gelijk gedeeld met het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘Arabische inmenging in moskee Rotterdam’

An SP MP asked the ministers about reports of Arab foreign influence over the Essalam mosque in Rotterdam, including the foreign funder's role and dismissal of Dutch staff, and about the status of a convenant and foreign-funding legislation. The minister replied that Rotterdam could not establish actual influence on the mosque's religious line, that the government is exploring ways to restrict undesirable foreign funding, and that the Chamber will be informed after summer 2018.
I share the urgency of this issue and your wish to have more instruments at hand to counter undesirable influence through foreign funding.
Ik onderschrijf de urgentie van deze problematiek en deel met u de wens om meer instrumenten voorhanden te hebben om onwenselijke beïnvloeding middels buitenlandse financiering tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Opleiden 55-plusser is plicht’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV staff cuts, the shortage of insurance physicians, and whether sick workers must always be seen by one, plus whether employers should be obliged to hire older long-term unemployed. The minister replied that cuts are managed through workforce planning, that task delegation keeps physician oversight, that sick workers need not always see an insurance physician, and that planned measures will continue pending a feasibility check.
For now, the shortage of insurance physicians is no reason not to carry out the measures.
Vooralsnog vormt het tekort aan verzekeringsartsen geen reden om maatregelen niet uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over achterblijvende lonen in Europa

MPs Van Dijk and Van Kent asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the divergence between productivity and wage growth in Europe and the Netherlands, the fall in disposable income since 2008, rising living costs, and whether the government will act on wages. The minister acknowledged the falling labour share, explained differences between disposable income measures showing rising household income since 2008, noted modest inflation, and said wage policy is for social partners while he will raise available wage room with them.
As promised to the House during the SZW budget debate, I am drawing the available wage room to the attention of social partners.
Zoals aan de Kamer toegezegd tijdens de Begrotingsbehandeling van SZW, breng ik de loonruimte onder de aandacht bij sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘Gezellig. Cursussen koran voorlezen op de Vrije Universiteit gescheiden voor mannen en vrouwen’

PVV MPs asked whether it is unacceptable that Koran reading courses at the VU were segregated by sex and whether the government would pressure the university to stop such segregation. The minister replied that equality of men and women applies, that the VU's rules forbid segregation, that the student association moved the courses to an external location after the university intervened, and that he sees no reason for further talks with the VU.
As soon as the VU received signals about this, they entered into discussion with the student association and indicated that such segregation is not permitted at the VU.
Zodra de VU hier signalen over ontving, zijn ze in gesprek gegaan met de studentenvereniging en is aangegeven dat dergelijke segregatie op de VU niet is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht ’45 jaar werk is genoeg!’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the government would accommodate the Bouw & Infra demand for a flexible AOW age linked to 45 years of work, and whether it would support wage increases of 5.35%. The minister rejected linking AOW to a 45-year work record as unworkable, citing lack of registration and the universal nature of AOW, and said wage policy is left to sectoral bargaining parties.
Linking the AOW age to a 45-year work record is not a feasible route and also runs counter to the character of the AOW.
Het koppelen van de AOW-leeftijd aan een arbeidsverleden van 45 jaar is geen begaanbare weg en staat ook haaks op het karakter van de AOW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "de gevolgen van arbeidsmigratie"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about overcrowded housing for labour migrants, displacement, exploitation and whether permits or registration should be required. The minister answered that housing is a municipal matter, pointed to existing instruments, a forthcoming handreiking, enforcement funding, and said permits would conflict with EU free movement.
It is up to municipalities, temp agencies, employers and landlords to jointly take their responsibility and engage in discussion about quality housing for labour migrants.
Het is aan gemeenten, uitzendbureaus, werkgevers en huisvesters om gezamenlijk hun verantwoordelijkheid te pakken en het gesprek aan te gaan over kwalitatieve huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Van den Hul en Dijksma over pensioenfondsen die beleggen in Aurobindo, het omstreden geneesmiddelenbedrijf, dat mensenrechten en milieuregels aan zijn laars lapt

MPs Van Dijk, Van den Hul and Dijksma asked whether pension funds investing in Aurobindo, a pharmaceutical company accused of human rights and environmental violations, should take steps, and what the government would do about ABP's investment. The minister answered that funds should follow OECD guidelines through engagement, that ABP decides its own investments and is accountable for them, and that the government is pursuing IMVO covenants with the financial sector.
No, I do not have that information, and furthermore ABP itself is responsible for its investment policy and investment choices.
Nee, die informatie heb ik niet en verder geldt dat het ABP zelf verantwoordelijk is voor het beleggingsbeleid en de beleggingskeuzes.
Antwoord op vragen de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en De Jong over “Statushouder Werkloos”

MPs De Graaf, Fritsma and De Jong (PVV) asked the ministers whether refugees with status are poorly educated, whether economic migration has enriched the Netherlands, and whether residence permits of asylum seekers from safe countries should be revoked and an asylum stop introduced. The government answered that refugees are a diverse group, that it pursues activating policy and regional protection, that the IND judges protection needs, and that it will not introduce a full asylum stop in line with international treaties.
However, for status holders, as for Dutch people on social assistance, an activating policy applies that aims at rapid transition to work.
Voor statushouders geldt echter, net als voor Nederlanders in de bijstand, een activerend beleid dat gericht is op snelle uitstroom naar werk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent, Özdil en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat flexwerk verder oprukt, vooral onder jongeren

MPs Van Kent, Özdil and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that insecure contracts are spreading, especially among young people, and about the Wet arbeidsmarkt in balans. Minister Koolmees acknowledged the trend, said he shares concerns about its consequences for housing and family formation, and said the government will send the Wab bill to parliament in Q3 2018.
To tackle the growing divide on the labour market, I want to make it more attractive and less risky for employers to offer people a permanent contract.
Om de groeiende tweedeling op de arbeidsmarkt aan te pakken, wil ik het voor werkgevers aantrekkelijker en minder risicovol maken om mensen een vast contract aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het doorspelen van medische gegevens van personeel door Jumbo-supermarkten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Jumbo supermarkets' requests for employees' medical data, passed to an outside firm to claim wage subsidies, violate the rules and what action will stop it. The government answered that employers may not process such health data under the Wbp, that the franchisee acted without head-office approval and was warned, and that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, not the Inspectie SZW, is competent and is aware of the case.
Since there is no violation under the Arbo Act, there is no ground for the Labour Inspectorate to enforce.
Er is, aangezien er geen overtreding is op basis van de Arbowet, geen grond voor de Inspectie SZW om te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Poolse vrouwen geïntimideerd op Nederlandse werkvloer’

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about FairWork research on sexual intimidation of Polish women in Dutch workplaces, including what steps will follow its recommendations, whether recruitment agencies will be held responsible, and whether large-scale research is needed. The minister acknowledged the seriousness, pointed to employer duties under the Working Conditions Act, Inspectorate SZW oversight, support for migrant-language information, and a forthcoming letter and study on confidential advisers, while rejecting large-scale research for now.
The Ministry of SZW will consult with FairWork to explore how a network of organisations supporting migrant workers in their own language can also give more attention to sexual intimidation.

Het Ministerie van SZW zal in overleg treden met FairWork om te kijken hoe een netwerk van organisaties die arbeidsmigranten ondersteunen in de eigen taal ook meer aandacht kan geven aan het onderwerp seksuele intimidatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Waarom de strijd tegen het UWV je kapot kan maken - en hoe het anders kan’

SP MPs asked why UWV rarely uses mediation in objection cases, whether objection procedures can be made independent, and what will be done for a woman in a euthanasia procedure judged fit for work. The State Secretary answered that mediation is offered at objection stage but used only when both parties agree, that UWV's objection directorate is organisationally separate and independent, that an independent commission is unnecessary, and that individual cases cannot be discussed.
I cannot go into an individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op een individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Wiersma over het bericht “Rotterdamse droogdok is al drie jaar besmet”

MPs Dijkstra and Wiersma asked about reports that Rotterdam dry-dock work on cruise ships has dropped since a 2014 Inspectie SZW fine, raising level-playing-field concerns. The minister acknowledged the uncertainty, promised an inventory of rules and enforcement in neighbouring countries before summer, and declined to disclose details of the ongoing court case.
There is currently a court case ongoing and during that period I cannot make statements.
Er loopt op dit moment een rechtszaak en gedurende die periode kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht “VNO wil UWV-lijsten openbaar"

MPs Wiersma and Nijkerken-de Haan asked the minister and state secretary of Social Affairs about VNO-NCW's call to make UWV and municipal candidate lists public, and about the labour market mismatch. The government answered that it is working through regional matching programmes, data exchange between UWV and municipalities, extra funding for personal services, and a forthcoming follow-up letter, but did not commit to opening the lists.
We share your concern about mismatches on the labour market.
Wij delen uw zorg betreffende mismatches op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het onderzoek van het CPB “Eenverdieners onder druk”

An MP asks the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about the CPB finding that the tax burden gap between single-earner and dual-earner households is widening, and about its fairness, efficiency and international position. The government answers that the individual tax system and progressivity cause the gap, that it is taking measures to lower single-earner burdens, and that it will report annually on the gap in the 2019 budget.
The cabinet will continue to pay attention to the position of single-earner households and will monitor the development of their tax burden and purchasing power.
Het kabinet blijft aandacht houden voor de positie van de eenverdiener en zal daarbij de ontwikkeling van de belastingdruk en de koopkracht van eenverdieners in het oog houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht dat Turkije een jihadpreek dicteert in Nederland

MP Becker asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Turkey dictated a jihadist sermon to Dutch mosques, whether Dutch imams delivered it, how imams are checked for criminal statements, and how foreign political influence and mosque financing are addressed. The minister replied that one Hoorn mosque used part of a Turkish sermon once without any suspicion of criminal offences, that government does not judge sermon content beyond criminal limits, that a governance model with ISN is being discussed, and that transparency and foreign-funding reviews are underway.
From the information I have received about the Hoorn case, it appears there is no suspicion of criminal offences.
Uit de informatie die ik heb ontvangen over de zaak in Hoorn blijkt dat er géén sprake is van een verdenking van strafbare feiten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Özdil over Jihadpreken in Nederlandse moskeeën

MPs Van Dijk and Özdil asked the minister about a reported jihad-themed sermon in a Diyanet mosque in Hoorn, its compatibility with integration, the role of Diyanet, and what the government would do about it. The minister said freedom of religion applies, no criminal offences were suspected, the local triangle had reviewed the sermon, the government does not decide sermon content absent criminal limits, and it wants ISN to operate independently of Turkey.
From the information I have received about the case in Hoorn, it appears there is no suspicion of criminal offences.
Uit de informatie die ik heb ontvangen over de zaak in Hoorn blijkt dat er géén sprake is van een verdenking van strafbare feiten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Nederturken klaarstomen voor carrière’

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports on Turkish influence over Dutch Turks via Diyanet and the UETD, and whether mosques and Diyanet should be closed. The minister said Turkish authorities must not interfere in Dutch citizens' choices and would be called to account if needed, declined to investigate UETD now given no integration-based reason, and rejected closing mosques because of freedom of religion.
Closing mosques is therefore out of the question.
Van het sluiten van moskeeën kan dus geen sprake zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de beïnvloeding van Nederlanders in Nederland door Turkse lobbyorganisatie gelieerd aan AK-partij

An MP asks the minister about the Turkish-linked organisation UETD Netherlands, its links to the AK party, its funding, its role in conflicts among Turkish Dutch after the 2016 coup attempt, and its training of youths for politics. The minister answers that UETD denies formal ties to the AK party, says it is funded by member contributions, and refers to a separate letter on foreign interference for the broader policy response.
Do you see a risk in the fact that UETD appeals to Dutch citizens of Turkish background on their Turkish loyalty and asks them to deploy this in Dutch politics too?
Ziet u een risico in het feit dat de UETD Nederlanders met Turkse achtergrond op hun Turkse loyaliteit aanspreekt en hen vraagt deze ook in de Nederlandse politiek in te zetten?

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Diyanet, het Turkse ministerie voor geloofszaken met 140 moskeeën in Nederland, de uitspraak heeft gedaan dat kinderen in de puberteit, voor meisj

MPs Becker and Ten Broeke asked whether Diyanet, the Turkish religious affairs ministry operating 140 mosques in the Netherlands, issued a fatwa allowing child marriage and whether this fits a pattern of rights violations, and what it means for mosque leaders and children. The government answered that Diyanet distanced itself from the report and opposes child marriage, that child marriage under 18 is banned and punishable in the Netherlands, and that it is exploring ways to make foreign funding of religious organisations more transparent.
Diyanet issued a press statement explicitly distancing itself from this interpretation as described in the original article in the Turkish newspaper Sözcü.
Diyanet heeft een persverklaring afgegeven, waarin zij nadrukkelijk afstand doen van deze interpretatie zoals beschreven in het oorspronkelijke artikel in de Turkse krant Sözcü.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over misstanden met arbeidsmigranten bij distributiecentra van Albert Heijn

An MP from the SP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported abuses against temporary migrant workers at Albert Heijn distribution centres, including work pressure, substandard and deducted housing, on-call standby without pay, and wage-scale issues. The minister answered that employers must ensure safe working conditions, that workers can file complaints with the Inspectie SZW, that housing deductions are capped by law, and that no enforcement action or new investigation was announced beyond existing complaint procedures.
I see no reason to have further research carried out into this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om hier nader onderzoek naar te laten doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het tekortschietende toezicht op malafide bewindvoerders

SP MPs asked why supervision of malafide court-appointed financial administrators (bewindvoerders) is weak, whether the 2014 quality requirements and centralised quality control work, how information is shared among judges, and about municipalities taking over administration and a white list. The Minister answered that supervision applies to all professional administrators, that a broader evaluation is underway with results expected around summer 2018, that information sharing among judges is informal but feedback-based, and that he has reservations about an online blacklist while favouring cooperation among courts, municipalities and administrators.
Around the summer I will inform the House by letter about the evaluation.
Rond de zomer informeer ik uw Kamer bij brief over de evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder, Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht 'Politie: wij hebben allochtonen nodig'

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about a report that police need allochtonen, questioning positive discrimination, the overrepresentation of people with migration backgrounds in integrity violations, dual nationality, Islam, and prayer time for officers. Minister Grapperhaus answered that diversity is operationally necessary, selection standards are unchanged and integrity risks are addressed through measures, while rejecting the idea that dual nationality is undesirable and stating there is no policy on prayer during duty hours.
Above all, the selection criteria and quality of the police are not compromised.
Voorop staat dat aan de selectiecriteria en kwaliteit van de politie niet getornd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Wiersma over onterecht betaalde uitkeringen door het UWV

MPs Peters and Wiersma asked the Minister of Social Affairs about benefits wrongly paid out by UWV, the causes, and measures to recover every defrauded euro and intervene earlier. The minister said about €420 million in fraud-related claims were imposed in 2013–2017, outlined how extra anti-fraud funds were spent and some programmes ended, and committed to recovering all wrongly paid amounts within the statutory ten-year period.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Özdil over het bericht ‘Callgirl voor Albert Heijn’

MPs Özütok and Özdil asked the minister whether reported practices at Albert Heijn distribution centres, including intimidation, unpaid on-call work and unworkable rosters, amount to labour exploitation, whether working conditions are safe and the Inspectorate monitors them, and whether OTTO's wage deductions and the WAADI are breached. The minister answered that the article does not show labour exploitation, that the Inspectorate handles complaints and no recent relevant complaints are known, that deductions are unclear but housing deductions are capped by law, and that no enforcement action or new commitment is announced.
There are no known recent reports relating to the situation described in the article.
Er zijn geen recente meldingen bekend die betrekking hebben op de in het artikel genoemde situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Geluk-Poortvliet over het vervallen van de ANW-compensatieregeling bij het ABP

MPs Omtzigt and Geluk-Poortvliet asked about the abolition of the ANW compensation scheme at the ABP pension fund, including communication failures, the five-year limit on the hardship arrangement, and whether a duty of care applies to risk coverage. The minister acknowledged communication was unfortunate and insufficient, defended the five-year limit and the abolition as a joint social-partner decision, and declined to ask the AFM for an investigation.
I am also not willing to ask the ABP to remove this five-year term.
Ik ben ook niet bereid het ABP te verzoeken deze vijfjaarstermijn te schrappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de onafhankelijkheid van de bedrijfsarts

An MP asked the minister about the independence of company doctors (bedrijfsartsen) paid by employers, citing a Radar report on pressure on sick workers and confusion about arbo-artsen. The state secretary replied that the legal protections are adequate, that the 2017 Arbowet amendment strengthened the company doctor's position through the basiscontract, that no further measures on funding are planned, and that the effects will be evaluated in 2020.
I see no reason to take additional measures.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om aanvullende maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over dat de fiscus zelden antwoord geeft op zzp vragen

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked why the tax authority rarely answers freelancer (zzp) questions on sham self-employment, as the Bovib claimed 85% go unanswered. The State Secretary replied that the Tax Authority does not track questions per association, that approved model agreements give legal certainty, and that of 8,026 model-agreement requests, 1,808 were approved and 2,810 rejected, with 3,207 closed for non-response.
It is not always simple to give a judgment (self-employed or sham self-employed) based on the information available in an agreement.
Het is niet eenvoudig om altijd aan de hand van de in een overeenkomst beschikbare informatie een oordeel (zelfstandige/schijnzelfstandige) te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Slootweg over het bericht “Koopkracht gezinnen in veertig jaar amper gestegen”

MPs Peters and Slootweg asked the minister about a report that household income has barely risen over forty years, and about child poverty and child benefit spending compared with other countries. The government answered that standardised disposable income is about 25 percent higher than in 1977, that child poverty has fallen since 2014 but is above 2000-era levels in some years, that the Netherlands compares poorly with several neighbours, and listed measures such as higher child benefit and municipal anti-poverty funds.
The coalition agreement made an extra 80 million euro available for combating debt and poverty, particularly in families with children.
In het regeerakkoord is 80 miljoen euro extra beschikbaar gesteld voor de bestrijding van schulden en armoede – in het bijzonder in gezinnen met kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de compensatieregeling voor zwangere ZZP’ers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why the compensation for pregnant self-employed women (about 20,000 people, 5,600 euro each) is only paid in 2019, why it counts as income for allowances, and where the budget comes from. The minister answered that payment in 2019 avoids clawbacks of allowances, that the compensation is treated as income like the regular pregnancy benefit, and that any extra costs will be absorbed within the ministry's budget.
However, I have chosen to prevent the clawback of allowances as much as possible.
Ik heb hier echter voor gekozen om terugvordering van toeslagen zo veel mogelijk te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over claims door pensioenfondsen met terugwerkende kracht

An MP asked whether pension funds pursue employers retroactively for unpaid premiums and whether this is proportionate given employers' finances and dual-pension situations. The minister confirmed the practice, stated that funds must treat all covered employers equally regardless of finances while allowing payment arrangements, and explained exemption options for past periods but offered no new commitments.
I have no insight into the exemption and collection policy of individual industry-wide pension funds.
Ik heb geen zicht op het vrijstellings- en incassobeleid van individuele bedrijfstakpensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat Schiphol Deliveroo inzet voor bezorging aan de gate

An MP asked the government whether Schiphol's partnership with Deliveroo for gate food delivery is desirable given concerns about Deliveroo's worker constructions, and what consequences follow if Deliveroo must abandon its self-employed model. The minister answered that Schiphol's board is responsible for operations and the state as shareholder sees no reason to intervene, and declined to comment on individual taxpayers.
As shareholder, I am not involved in the operational management of Schiphol.
Ik ben als aandeelhouder niet betrokken bij de operationele bedrijfsvoering van Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Honderden Roma-kinderen in Nederland uitgebuit'

MPs Van Nispen and Van Dijk asked whether police handling of Roma children used for theft is perpetuating their exploitation, and about investigative capacity, forced marriage and organised child trafficking. The state secretary answered that an internal police report will be shared with parliament though sensitive parts will be withheld, pointed to existing WODC research and ongoing intensification measures, and said further research would add little value.

Yes, I will send this to you soon. However, I will not make certain parts of the administrative signal public, because it concerns sensitive investigative information, criminal methods and other information that should not be made public.

Ja, ik zal u dit spoedig doen toekomen. Bepaalde delen van het bestuurlijk signaal zal ik echter niet openbaar maken, omdat het gevoelige (opsporings)informatie, criminele handelwijzen en andere niet openbaar te maken informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het bericht ‘Kingdom of the Netherlands: Concluding Statement of the 2018 Article IV Consultation’ van het IMF

An MP asked the Social Affairs minister about IMF recommendations on wage growth, self-employed social insurance and tax treatment, and the tension with the coalition's spending plans. The minister replies that wages are rising, that wage policy is for social partners, that the government is acting against false self-employment and reducing tax deductions for the self-employed, and that additional spending is not needed given the economic upswing.
The cabinet will therefore enter into discussions with insurers to promote a better insurance offer.
Het kabinet gaat daarom in gesprek met de verzekeraars om een beter verzekeringsaanbod te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, De Roon en Wilders over Diyanet

PVV MPs asked the government whether it would end its relationship with Diyanet Nederland (ISN/HDV) and close its mosques after Diyanet reportedly approved marriage and pregnancy of 9-year-old girls, and whether it would expel the Turkish ambassador or cut diplomatic ties. The minister answered that ISN is one of many dialogue partners with no formal cooperation, that Diyanet publicly condemned child marriage, that freedom of religion and association mean closing mosques is not possible, and that diplomatic relations are needed to discuss rule-of-law issues; no Turkish ambassador is currently accredited in the Netherlands.
There is no question of formal cooperation.
Er is geen sprake van formele samenwerking.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de berichten 'Ex-moslims regelmatig bedreigd in Nederland' (Reformatorisch Dagblad, 20 januari 2018) en 'Duits parlement wil antisemitische asielzoekers uitzetten'

An SGP MP asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Justice about reports on threats against ex-Muslims in the Netherlands and German proposals to deport antisemitic asylum seekers, asking about frequency, response and whether asylum status should be affected. The government said it knows of no confirmed cases of secret gatherings, outlined victim-support and anti-discrimination measures, and said antisemitism and deportations for it are not separately registered.
Whether there is antisemitism among asylum seekers is not registered.
Of er sprake is van antisemitisme onder asielzoekers, wordt niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over "Grote commotie over in Rijswijk verspreid Turks pamflet tegen de PKK"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Turkish anti-PKK pamphlet distributed door to door in Rijswijk, Delft, Rotterdam and Antwerp, including who financed it, whether it contains criminal content, and whether it risks Turkish-Kurdish tensions in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the author appears to be a Turkish publicist acting alone with no sign of state interference, that the Public Prosecution Service saw no criminal passages on first reading so no investigation is planned, and that the government will monitor the situation without new measures.
There are currently however no signals that a state actor is interfering here; this concerns a solo action by a Turkish publicist.
Er zijn momenteel echter geen signalen dat hier sprake is van inmenging van een statelijke actor, het gaat hier om een soloactie van een Turkse publicist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Lodders over pensioenopbouw van zwangere huisartsen

Two VVD MPs asked why self-employed doctors lose pension accrual in occupational pension schemes during pregnancy and whether this will be fixed. The state secretary explained the causes (lower income and a fiscal part-time factor, visible three years later), noted that self-employed people can compensate via the third pillar, and committed to removing fiscal barriers in the end-of-year decree 2018.

I intend to arrange that there are no fiscal obstacles preventing these self-employed professionals from accruing pension within their own occupational or sector pension scheme on the same income as before the pregnancy.

ben ik voornemens te gaan regelen dat er geen fiscale belemmeringen zijn om deze zelfstandige beroepsbeoefenaren binnen de eigen beroeps- of bedrijfstakpensioenregeling over hetzelfde inkomen pensioen te laten opbouwen als vóór de zwangerschap.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Markuszower over de aankondiging van de extreem-linkse organisaties Anakbayan-Europe en Revolutionaire Eenheid, die de palestijnse veroordeelde terroriste/meervoudig moordenare

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether he knows that Rasmea Odeh, a convicted Palestinian figure, was invited to speak in Amsterdam by two far-left groups and was deported from the US for immigration fraud, and whether he will refuse her entry. The minister says he cannot verify the US deportation, does not discuss individual cases, and explains that entry can be refused via Schengen SIS alerts based on factual information such as AIVD or police reports.
However, the Netherlands does not routinely exchange information with third countries about such immigration law decisions.
Nederland wisselt echter niet standaard informatie uit met derde landen over dergelijke vreemdelingrechtelijke besluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over "de hervorming van een goed pensioenstelsel"

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Social Affairs minister about pension reform: the role of low interest rates and longevity in pension funds' liabilities, the case for collective risk-sharing and compulsory participation, the risks of individualisation, the discount rate and whether to use expected returns. The minister defends the need for reform while rejecting the article's analysis, arguing for market-based discounting and keeping collective risk-sharing, with the SER and the financial assessment framework evaluation still pending.
I cannot agree with this analysis.
Ik kan mij niet vinden in deze analyse.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pieter Heerma en Slootweg over het niet-opgevolgde advies van het Bureau ICT Toetsing (BIT) om het ICT project Wet tegemoetkomingen loondomein gedeeltelijk uit te stellen

Members Omtzigt, Heerma and Slootweg (CDA) asked why the government did not follow the BIT advice to postpone part of the Wet tegemoetkomingen loondomein ICT project, why the advice was not sent to parliament within the required four weeks, and about costs, readiness, privacy assessments, staffing and oversight. The minister acknowledged the late transmission, said the deviation was made deliberately after end-to-end testing, and gave detailed assurances on implementation progress, while declining to give a timeline for some cost and readiness details and deferring some answers.
I regret that I was unable to inform your House within the four-week response period.
Ik betreur het dat ik uw Kamer niet binnen de reactietermijn van vier weken heb kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Karabulut over een nieuw rapport inzake Noord-Koreaanse dwangarbeid in de EU en de betrokkenheid van Nederlandse bedrijven

MPs Ten Broeke and Karabulut asked about a report on North Korean forced labour in the EU, including Dutch firms' involvement in building ships, and the government's response on enforcement, the Polish role, and the Netherlands' legal jurisdiction. The minister answers that the situation could possibly qualify as forced labour or trafficking, outlines EU and UN measures, states that Poland has issued no new work permits since August 2017, and refers largely to company responsibility, the OECD guidelines, and the ILO process, without confirming the scale of Dutch firms' involvement.
How many companies and shipyards are involved, and over what period this occurred, cannot be established with certainty.
Om hoeveel bedrijven en werven het gaat, en in welke periode hiervan sprake was, valt niet met zekerheid vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het aanvullend pensioenfonds van Europarlementariërs

MP Omtzigt asked the Prime Minister and the Minister of Social Affairs about the supplementary pension fund for MEPs, which has a coverage ratio of about 37% and may need large top-up payments. Minister Blok answered that the European Parliament itself must find a solution for its own pension scheme, that the Dutch recovery rules would likely force substantial cuts for a Dutch fund at that level, and declined to write to EIOPA or commit to a specific step, saying the answers would follow within the deadlines.
It is for the EP to find a solution to this problem.
Het is aan het EP een oplossing voor deze problematiek te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over “langdurige werkloosheid werklozen van 55-67 jaar"

The MP asks the minister about long-term unemployment among workers aged 55-67, including how WW exits split between work, maximum duration and other reasons, and about IOW/IOAW benefits and the job-search requirement for older workers. The minister answers with UWV data, states that the job-search obligation stays because it aids reemployment, and points to the action plan 'Perspectief voor vijftigplussers' and its 2019 evaluation.
The measures will then be evaluated in 2019, so that we better understand what works best to improve the labour market position of workers aged 50 and over.
Vervolgens worden de maatregelen in 2019 geëvalueerd, zodat we beter weten wat het beste werkt om de arbeidsmarktpositie van vijftigplussers te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Gemeenten negeren wettelijke taaleis bijstand’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister and state secretary about a report that municipalities ignore the statutory language requirement for welfare recipients, and how this fits with plans to give municipalities a bigger role in integration. The government acknowledged the CBS findings, said municipalities must enforce the law, committed to talks with the VNG, and noted that ultimate sanctions against municipalities are possible.
It is unacceptable if it were to turn out that people who do not speak the language receive a welfare benefit for years and are left alone.
Het is onacceptabel als zou blijken dat mensen die de taal niet spreken jarenlang een bijstandsuitkering ontvangen en met rust gelaten worden.
