Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en De Jong over het bericht 'Europees pensioenfonds op rand van de afgrond'

PVV MPs asked the government about a reported EUR 326 million deficit in the European Parliament's voluntary supplementary pension fund, its total EU pension liabilities, and whether the Dutch taxpayer will bear the cost. The minister answered that the fund concerns voluntary pensions accrued before 2009, that the EP itself is responsible for its sustainability, and that the cabinet expects the EP leadership to address it.
It is up to the EP to find a solution to this problem.
Het is aan het EP een oplossing voor deze problematiek te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht 'Gros van de vluchtelingen in de bijstand'

An MP asked the Social Affairs minister about reports that most refugees are on social assistance, and about causes, data, integration and sanctions for non-integration. The minister said no national data split by benefit type exists, cited a CBS cohort study showing 90% of 2014 permit holders on assistance after 1.5 years, and promised to inventory with municipalities an activating support system, reporting back to parliament.
There are no national figures on the current share of permit holders receiving benefits, broken down by benefit type, origin and length of residence in the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen landelijke cijfers van het huidige aandeel statushouders in een uitkering, met een uitsplitsing naar type uitkering, afkomst en verblijfsduur in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Lacin over het bericht 'Chauffeurs moesten tijdens storm de weg op'

MPs Van Dijk and Lacin asked whether employers forced truck drivers onto the road during the January 2018 storm, whether sanctions, bans and fines should apply, and whether non-Dutch-speaking drivers were properly informed of the code red weather alert. The minister called the pressure unacceptable, said employers must inform drivers and that responsibility is shared, and promised to discuss measures with the transport sector and inform the House shortly, without committing to bans, fines or counting the affected drivers.
I immediately took the initiative to sit down with the transport and logistics sector to consider which measures could be taken in (expected) extreme weather conditions.
Ik heb meteen het initiatief genomen om met de transport- en logistieke sector om tafel te gaan om te bezien welke maatregelen bij (verwachte) extreme weersomstandigheden genomen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Özdil over het onderzoek 'Mind the gap: barrières en mogelijkheden voor de arbeidsparticipatie van vluchtelingenvrouwen'

MPs Özütok and Özdil asked the minister about a research report showing a large employment gap between male and female refugees and barriers for refugee women's labour participation. The minister acknowledged the gap, said the report's recommendations will feed into the integration-to-work programme and the new civic integration system, and committed to working with municipalities and Divosa on sharing effective practices.
The recommendations from this report will be taken into account in efforts to bring status holders into the labour market and in developing the new civic integration system.
De aanbevelingen uit dit rapport zullen worden meegenomen bij de inzet op toeleiding naar de arbeidsmarkt van statushouders en bij de uitwerking van het nieuwe inburgeringsstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over de berichten ‘Minister Koolmees: nieuwe zzp-wet is één van mijn grotere uitdagingen’ en ‘Zo zou de nieuwe zzp-wet eruit moeten zien volgens kenners’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports on the planned replacement of the DBA employment-relations law for self-employed workers, including whether the outcomes of a stakeholder meeting would be shared and how concerns about the client declaration would be handled. The minister answered that meeting minutes will be published, that stakeholders are involved through the planned approach, that the timeline to 1 January 2020 is very ambitious and earlier entry into force is not feasible, and that a high-level letter will follow before the summer recess.
In that connection, in line with the remark by Mr Hasekamp, it was noted that the timeline for the new legislation to take effect on 1 January 2020 is very ambitious.
Daarbij is, in aansluiting op de opmerking van de heer Hasekamp, opgemerkt dat het tijdpad van inwerkingtreding van de nieuwe wetgeving per 1 januari 2020 zeer ambitieus is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht 'De beerput van Bilal L.'

PVV MPs asked whether the Amsterdam mayor could act outside council control on de-radicalisation, and whether a Rijksrecherche probe should examine the Amsterdam (de)radicalisation network around Bilal L. The minister answered that Amsterdam runs its own local jihadism policy, that the OM alone decides on such investigations and an existing criminal probe is ongoing, and that administrative detention is not justified.
During the investigation I will not comment on this case.
Gedurende het onderzoek doe ik geen uitspraak over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de aanhoudende problemen met slapende dienstverbanden waardoor werknemers geen aanspraak kunnen maken op hun transitievergoeding

MP Van Kent asked the Minister of Social Affairs about employees whose employers keep their contracts dormant after long illness, blocking the transition payment, and about the timeline and effect of the controversial bill 34 699. The minister answered that UWV's implementation test is pending, a target effective date of 1 January 2020 is aimed for, and that he sees no reason to financially support workers who go to court.
I aim to have the measure take effect from 1 January 2020.
Ik streef ernaar om de maatregel met ingang van 1 januari 2020 in werking te laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong, Fritsma, De Graaf, en Wildersover het bericht "Te weinig geld voor bijstandsuitkeringen vluchtelingen”.

PVV MPs asked whether municipalities' welfare shortfalls caused by migrant inflow should be addressed by ending benefits for status holders, requiring ten years' residence before benefit eligibility, and closing borders. The minister replied that benefits are a legal right for all residents below the minimum income, that the shortfall is partly offset by temporary Rijk advances, that existing language-related benefit reductions stay, and that no rule changes are planned.
I see no reason to change the rules in this regard.
Ik zie geen reden om de regels hieromtrent aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over de berichten “Scholingsplan dure grap”, “Opleidingsfondsen nodig voor een leven lang leren” en “O&O-organisaties krijgen werknemers in de schoolbanken”

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports on sectoral training funds (O&O fondsen), including whether their reserves are underused, whether individual training budgets would help low- and middle-educated workers, and whether fiscal barriers to training exist. The Minister replies that reserves are necessary, that funds do not report how many workers they train, and that the government will agree on lifelong learning with social partners and education institutions, with no concrete new step beyond planned letters and a future individual learning account.
It is not possible to state how many people in total, or per O&O fund, have been trained through these funds, because the funds do not report this way.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel mensen in totaal, of per O&O fonds, geschoold zijn door middelen van deze fondsen, omdat fondsen dat niet op deze manier rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Kent over de risico’s voor de volksgezondheid van gespoten purschuim

Two SP members asked the Ministers of Interior and of Social Affairs about health risks of sprayed polyurethane foam insulation, including whether residents are protected, whether certified firms follow the 2013 guidelines, and whether isocyanates are listed as substances of very high concern. The Minister replied that TNO and RPS studies did not establish causality but precautions were taken, that the Bouwbesluit 2012 will be amended to require residents to leave and forced ventilation, that a diagnostic protocol exists, and that the REACH restriction proposal is pending.
I therefore want to include this as a requirement in the Bouwbesluit 2012.
Ik wil dit daarom als eis opnemen in het Bouwbesluit 2012.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het bericht 'Buurtbus in de problemen door tekort aan vrijwilligers'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that a neighbourhood bus service struggles to find volunteer drivers because UWV bars unemployed people receiving WW benefits from volunteering there, and whether such volunteering should be allowed without displacing paid work. The Minister says volunteering is allowed under the WW volunteering scheme when there is no economic gain or displacement, that the scheme is being evaluated and adjusted to meet a motion, and that an amended scheme is expected in spring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Groothuizen over het verplichtgestelde pensioenfonds voor notarissen

MPs Van Weyenberg and Groothuizen asked whether there is sufficient support among notaries for the statutory obligation to join the notarial pension fund, given a survey showing the 60% representativeness norm is not met. The government answered that mandatory participation for notaries rests on the Wna itself, that the desirability of compulsory membership is a matter for the profession, and declined to comment on the survey figures.

Given this responsibility of the notaries themselves, I am of the view that the figures from the support survey, their interpretation and any conclusions drawn from them are a matter for the notaries themselves.

Gezien deze verantwoordelijkheid van de beroepsgenoten in het notariaat zelf, ben ik van mening dat de cijfers die uit het draagvlakonderzoek naar voren komen, de interpretatie daarvan alsmede eventuele conclusies naar aanleiding daarvan een zaak van de beroepsgenoten in het notariaat onderling is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat het ministerie van SZW tegen de afspraken in nog altijd schoonmakers inhuurt via uitzendbureaus

An MP asked whether the Ministry of Social Affairs still hires cleaners through temp agencies despite agreements to bring them in-house, and whether a new tender for temporary cleaners at DJI breaches those agreements. The minister answered that the tender covers temporary workers for the Rijksschoonmaakorganisatie on all government buildings as a stopgap for absences, that cleaners are being transferred gradually as contracts expire, and declined to withdraw the tender.
Action is being taken in line with the agreements made.
Er wordt gehandeld in lijn met gemaakte afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie dat Uber een taxibedrijf is

MP Gijs van Dijk asked whether the EU Court of Justice ruling that Uber is a taxi company means Uber must follow Dutch taxi rules, whether Uber acts as an employer of its drivers, and whether the government will enforce against disguised self-employment. The minister answered that the ruling changes nothing for Dutch taxi regulation, that enforcement targets individual licensed drivers, that independent research on the gig economy is underway, and that tax authorities do not comment on individual cases.
It is for the tax inspector, and if disagreement persists for a judge, to assess the facts and circumstances of an individual case.
Het is aan de belastinginspecteur en bij blijvend verschil van mening aan een rechter om de feiten en omstandigheden van een individueel geval te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Privaat geld ingezet voor integratie vluchtelingen'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether using private investors (a Social Impact Bond) to fund refugee integration and reintegration into work, paid partly from the municipal welfare budget, is acceptable, and whether it is respectful and a proper public task. The minister answered that municipalities have wide policy freedom, that the Social Impact Bond payments are lawful from the Pw budget when paid only on actual welfare exits, and that participation is mandatory with possible benefit reduction.

It is permitted to finance this from the bundled Pw (formerly BUIG) benefit grant, because a surplus in the municipal benefits budget that is not used to pay benefits may be spent by municipalities at their own discretion.

Het is toegestaan dit te financieren vanuit de gebundelde uitkering Pw (voorheen BUIG) omdat een overschot op het gemeentelijke budget voor bijstandsuitkeringen dat niet is ingezet om uitkeringen te verstrekken door gemeenten naar eigen inzicht besteed mag worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "discriminatie door uitzendbureaus"

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the government whether it considers it unacceptable that employment agencies take part in discrimination, whether penalties and public naming of offending agencies are possible, and whether the Team Arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie's powers should be extended. The state secretary condemns discrimination, points to the planned follow-up action plan and talks with the staffing sector, but defers the answers on penalties, naming, powers and enforcement to a letter to parliament.
I will answer questions 3 through 9 together in the letter that the House of Representatives has requested.
De vragen 3 t/m 9 zal ik in samenhang beantwoorden in de brief die de Tweede Kamer heeft gevraagd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Een nieuwe zeer grote moskee in Noord - en nauwelijks protest’

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether they would oppose the construction of a large mosque in Amsterdam-Noord and reduce the influence of Turkish President Erdogan, citing radicalisation concerns. The government answered that freedom of religion applies equally to all faiths, that foreign influence promoting anti-democratic behaviour will not be accepted, and that permitting the mosque is a matter for the local municipal government.
It is up to the local municipal government to grant permission for the construction.
Het is aan het lokale gemeentebestuur om toestemming voor de bouw te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over Sweatshop Schiphol

MPs Laçin and Van Kent asked about reports of precarious 'sweatshop' conditions at Schiphol, including rotating workers between contracts to avoid permanent employment, and the government's role. Minister Koolmees answered that such practices are undesirable but that employers are primarily responsible, pointed to planned contract-cost measures and existing research, and declined to take shareholder action or to answer in time for the committee debate.
I cannot make a statement about the situation at an individual company.
Over de situatie bij een individueel bedrijf kan ik geen uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over ontslag uit het verantwoordingsorgaan

An MP asked the minister whether pension fund Atos's amended articles allowing its board to dismiss supervisory council (verantwoordingsorgaan) members are acceptable, and what legal protection such members have. The minister answered that the conditions were added under pension law and the Code Pensioenfondsen, that members are elected by beneficiaries so the board cannot choose them alone, and that a governance evaluation is forthcoming.
These concern conditions on integrity and fulfilment of the required tasks and responsibilities.
Dit betreffen voorwaarden omtrent integriteit en vervulling van de vereiste taken en verantwoordelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Geluk-Poortvliet over de afschaffing van de ANW-compensatie door het ABP

MPs Omtzigt and Geluk-Poortvliet asked why the ABP pension fund abruptly ended ANW-compensation for survivors, whether members were informed in time, and whether the AFM should investigate the information provided. Minister Ollongren answered that the change was agreed by social partners, that members were notified and the coulance scheme was extended to 1 May 2018, but declined to commit to an AFM investigation, leaving that to the independent regulator.
This was also noted by the social partners. They asked the ABP to adjust this information.
Dit is ook geconstateerd door sociale partners. Zij hebben het ABP verzocht deze informatie aan te passen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over het bericht dat een huiseigenaar alleen wil verhuren aan ‘mensen van Nederlandse afkomst'

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked whether a landlord refusing to rent to people not of Dutch origin is discrimination, what victims can do, and what measures will prevent it, including whether estate agents should refuse such requests and whether the sector will be engaged. The minister answered that discrimination is prohibited, pointed to the Equal Treatment Act, the College voor de Rechten van de Mens and local anti-discrimination services, noted the brokerage associations' codes of conduct, and said the issue will be raised in upcoming consultations with the sector.

In the upcoming consultations with the brokerage associations and the umbrella organisations of private landlords I will discuss whether enough attention is being paid in practice to preventing discrimination.

In de eerstvolgende overleggen met de brancheverenigingen voor makelaars en de koepelorganisaties van particuliere verhuurders zal ik in gesprek gaan over of er in de praktijk voldoende aandacht is om discriminatie te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Wiersma en El Yassini over het bericht 'Ernstig tekort aan bouwvakkers dreigt nu de economie weer bloeit'

MPs Koerhuis, Wiersma and El Yassini asked the ministers whether the projected shortage of 70,000 construction workers threatens the housing target and quality, and what the government will do about training, innovation and secure building pipelines. The minister answered that employers bear primary responsibility, pointed to existing measures (tax cuts on labour, Matchen op Werk, Techniekpact, UWV retraining budget, BBL subsidies), and said she would talk with stakeholders and regional parties without giving firm commitments.
The responsibility to attract sufficient qualified personnel lies primarily with the employers themselves.
De verantwoordelijkheid om voldoende gekwalificeerd personeel aan te trekken ligt primair bij de werkgevers zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Nog altijd kindhuwelijken in Nederland’

Two Labour MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that child marriages persist in the Netherlands despite the ban, and what measures were taken, including outreach to community key figures, an integrated action plan, and support for girls trapped in marriages. The minister answered that prior measures were implemented (a handbook, training, the LKHA knowledge centre, criminalisation of forced marriage, shelters) and that no new action plan would be started, while confirming outreach to boys follows the same chain.
Therefore no new action plan will be started.
Er zal derhalve geen nieuw actieplan worden gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het artikel “Zo maken we het basisinkomen werkelijkheid"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a basic income or basic security, as proposed in an article, has been examined in parliament, whether the Participatiewet blocks such experiments, and whether municipalities may experiment. The minister answered that a basic income is incompatible with the Participatiewet's work principle, that no municipality has applied for such an experiment, and that the cabinet refuses to allow them.
A basic security or basic income therefore cannot exist alongside the Participatiewet and cannot be seen separately from the Participatiewet.
Een basiszekerheid of basisinkomen kan daarom niet naast de Participatiewet bestaan en niet los gezien worden van de Participatiewet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de plotselinge versobering van het nabestaandenpensioen

An MP asked whether the 2017 pension decree quietly tightened survivors' pension rules by allowing a cut in risk-based partner pensions and combining it with a lower franchise, and asked about affected schemes, consent procedures and employee rights. The government answered that the rules were not materially changed, that the cut and lower franchise were already permitted in 2015 and remain allowed, that it lacks data on affected schemes, and that no reversal is needed.
However, the decree does not involve a reduction in survivors' pensions.
Het besluit houdt echter geen versobering van het nabestaandenpensioen in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over het vervallen van de ANW-compensatieregeling bij het Algemeen Burgerlijk pensioenfonds (ABP)

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the ABP pension fund's abolition of the ANW-compensation scheme, including how many members are affected, whether they can get alternative insurance, and whether a longer transition period should be given. The minister answered that the change follows a social-partner agreement, that about 15,000 people currently receive the compensation, and that members can insure themselves until 1 February 2018, while not committing to a longer transition.
It is up to the ABP to inform the participant about the changes to the pension scheme agreed by employees and employers.
Het is aan het ABP om de deelnemer te informeren over de – door werknemers en werkgevers overeengekomen – wijzigingen in de pensioenregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over de antisemitische terreuractie tegen een Joods restaurant in Amsterdam

PVV MPs asked whether the suspect in the antisemitic attack on a Jewish restaurant in Amsterdam was known to the security services, whether he would be prosecuted for terrorism and deported, and whether administrative detention should be introduced. The Minister said he cannot comment on individual cases, that prosecution and sentencing are for the prosecutor and judge, and that administrative detention without reasonable suspicion is not a legitimate deprivation of liberty, pointing to existing tools.
It is for the public prosecution service to decide on prosecuting the suspect and to formulate a sentencing demand.
Het is aan het OM om te besluiten over de vervolging van de verdachte en daarbij een strafeis te formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Polen blijven weg: tuinbouwsector zit omhoog’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the horticulture sector's shift toward recruiting non-Polish workers and the labour-market reach of unemployed people reflects a growing problem, and what steps would make Dutch jobs attractive. The minister acknowledged the trend, placed primary responsibility for recruitment on employers, and described the government's role as preventing unfair competition and abuse through equal pay rules and anti-schijnconstructie legislation.
In this dossier I see my role mainly in preventing unfair competition and tackling abuses such as underpayment and exploitation.
In dit dossier zie ik mijn rol vooral in het voorkomen van oneerlijke concurrentie en het aanpakken van misstanden zoals onderbetaling en uitbuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het bericht “Meer jonge moslims leven naar strikte islamitische regels. Dreigt segregatie?”

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report on young Muslims living by strict Islamic rules and possible segregation, including gender segregation at a university event and pressure on moderate young Muslims. The minister answered that the government does not track such numbers, rejects segregation-promoting messages as problematic for integration, notes the university bans sex segregation in rented rooms, and points to strengthening youth resilience as part of follow-up on Salafist influence.
Based on the freedom of religion in the Netherlands, the government does not keep track of how many young Dutch Muslims live (or want to live) by strict Islamic rules.
Vanuit de in Nederland geldende vrijheid van geloof houdt de overheid niet bij hoeveel jonge Nederlandse moslims naar strikt islamitische regels (willen) leven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Van Raak over het onderzoek ‘Verkenning Meldprocedures en Integriteitsvoorzieningen 2017’

MPs asked about a 2017 Huis voor klokkenluiders survey finding only 48% of employers have whistleblowing procedures meeting the Wet Huis voor klokkenluiders, and about weak reporting culture, especially in semi-public sector and firms without works councils. The minister acknowledged the gaps, said work remains, and pointed to ministry activities in 2018 and recommendations to works councils and branch organisations, without new binding measures.
The Ministry of SZW will also devote attention in 2018 to the importance of a safe work culture, including by organising meetings and drawing attention to developed instruments.

Het Ministerie van SZW zal ook in 2018 aandacht besteden aan het belang van een veilige werkcultuur, onder meer door het organiseren van bijeenkomsten en door het extra onder de aandacht brengen van ontwikkelde instrumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Jong over het bericht ‘CPB waarschuwt voor armoedeval door hogere pensioenleeftijd’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the CPB warning that raising the AOW pension age could cause a poverty trap, asking how many people are affected, whether older workers entering unemployment, disability or welfare before retirement were considered, whether the government takes responsibility for insufficient preparation time, and whether it will lower the AOW age to 65. The minister acknowledged the report, defended the phased increase and the IOW bridging benefit, provided inflow figures, and refused to lower the AOW age, citing sustainability costs.
No. This cabinet is for a solid and solidary AOW for current and future generations.
Nee. Dit kabinet is voor een solide en solidaire AOW voor huidige én toekomstige generaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht dat de gemeenten Turkse Nederlanders discrimineren bij controles op uitkeringen

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the minister whether municipalities discriminate against Turkish Dutch people in benefit checks, whether outsourcing foreign asset investigations to private firms is lawful, and whether rules should be tightened. The state secretary acknowledged the Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling that Almelo and Eindhoven's practices breached the non-discrimination ban, said outsourcing to private parties is permissible within legal limits, and promised to bring the ruling to municipalities' attention via a circular letter while declining to draft a ban on outsourcing.

I will bring the ruling of the Centrale Raad van Beroep and its consequences, as well as the options offered by the IBF for cross-border fraud, to the attention of municipalities via the circular letter.

Ik zal de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep (CRvB) en de gevolgen hiervan alsmede de mogelijkheden die het IBF biedt bij grensoverschrijdende fraude, onder de aandacht brengen bij gemeenten via de verzamelbrief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en El Yassini over het bericht 'MeerGGZ maakt bezwaar tegen cao ggz'

MPs Wiersma and El Yassini asked the minister about objections by Platform MeerGGZ to extending the GGZ collective agreement by decree (avv), including claims it is inflexible and may hinder innovation. The minister said the objections will be handled in the written avv procedure, declined to comment on the individual case, explained that avv only prevents wage undercutting, and pointed to options for MeerGGZ to obtain exemption through its own collective agreement.
I do not want to make statements about this ongoing individual procedure before I have gone through all the steps of the procedure.
Over deze lopende individuele procedure wil ik geen uitspraken doen voordat ik alle stappen in de procedure doorlopen heb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema, Wilders over het bericht 'Videos. Universitaire kindbruidjes over de zegeningen van islam'

PVV MPs asked the Education Minister whether a university Islam academy's programme undermines critical thinking, and whether Oman-funded chairs should be banned. The minister denied any duty to suppress critical thinking, said the academy responds to partner requests, and rejected a ban since Oman has no influence over the chair, which the university controls.
No. It is precisely a task of Dutch education to stimulate critical thinking.
Nee. Het is juist een taak van het Nederlands onderwijs kritisch vermogen te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Kent en Lacin over werklozen die bij de NS met levensgevaarlijke chroomverf moesten werken

Three SP MPs asked the ministers about unemployed Tilburg workers exposed to chromium-6 paint in an NS-linked re-integration project, including whether authorities intervened, whether victims get compensation, and whether a damages fund should be set up. The government said the Tilburg municipality remains ultimately responsible, an independent RIVM investigation is underway with results expected August 2018, and it will decide on compensation after that, while also tightening REACH and exposure rules.
I would first like to await the results of this investigation; these are expected at the end of August 2018.
Ik wil graag eerst de resultaten van dit onderzoek afwachten; deze worden eind augustus 2018 verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over de lange wachttijden voor uitslagen van de inburgeringsexamens bij DUO

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Social Affairs about waiting times of up to 18 weeks for civic integration exam results at DUO, and whether these delays could cause candidates to exceed their integration deadline and lose loan-to-grant conversion. The minister acknowledged the delays, said DUO extends deadlines so candidates are not penalised, and described capacity measures while admitting waiting times may rise further in the short term.
Therefore, in the coming period it will be examined which additional measures must be taken to shorten the waiting times.
Daarom zal de komende tijd worden bezien welke extra maatregelen genomen moeten worden om de wachttijden in te korten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de misstanden bij de arbeidsomstandigheden en huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten in het Westland

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about alleged abuses by staffing agency Efficient at Work toward migrant workers in Westland, including weekly contracts, forced transport and insurance, pregnancy dismissal, poor housing and keurmerk oversight. The minister defended weekly contracts as lawful, said minimum-wage deductions are restricted and the municipality inspected the housing, and rejected a licensing system while noting private certification bodies take the signals seriously.
Whether there is an investigation, I make no statement.
Over of sprake is van een onderzoek doe ik geen uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Gijs van Dijk over de "carve out van gepensioneerden".

MPs Lodders and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether pension funds considering a carve-out for pensioners are blocked by the Pensioenwet, and whether the law should be changed now. The minister answered that no funds are known to be seriously considering a carve-out, that it could bring advantages but also risks such as broken solidarity, and that its fate should be decided together with the wider pension reform, so the legal barriers are not lifted immediately.

Distinguishing between the pension assets and the investment policy of the active and deferred participants and of the pensioner group is an interesting route that is also being examined in the context of renewing the pension system.

Het onderscheid maken tussen het pensioenvermogen en het beleggingsbeleid van de groep actieve en gewezen deelnemers en van de groep gepensioneerden is een interessante route die ook in het kader van vernieuwing van het pensioenstelsel wordt bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Özdil over het bericht dat werknemers met een tijdelijk contract er fors op achteruit gaan bij ziekte

MPs Van Kent and Özdil asked whether the planned removal of the labour tax credit and income-dependent combination credit for sick temporary workers, who lose their jobs and move to the Sickness Benefit Act, which can cost up to 3,000 euro net per year, was a deliberate choice that punishes illness. The minister replied that the measure aligns tax treatment with unemployed people on WW, applies from 1 January 2020 only to new cases, will be elaborated with the State Secretary of Finance, and will involve social partners.
The cabinet intends to abolish the labour tax credit and the IACK from 1 January 2020 for ZW beneficiaries who no longer have an employer.
Het kabinet is voornemens om de arbeidskorting en IACK per 1 januari 2020 af te schaffen voor ZW-gerechtigden die geen werkgever (meer) hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, De Graaf en Agema over het bericht dat senioren in Apeldoorn overdonderd zijn door de komst van Turkse leeftijdsgenoten

MPs from the PVV asked ministers whether it is acceptable that a housing corporation in Apeldoorn plans to let vacated flats in a senior complex to Turkish elderly receiving home care, without consulting current residents, and asked for the plans to be stopped. The minister replied that corporations are free to set allocation policy within the Housing and Tenancy Acts, that the corporation appears to have followed the legal consultation procedure, and that residents can complain to the independent complaints committee or the courts, but that the minister has no role in individual allocation policy.
As far as I can tell, the housing corporation has acted within the framework of the law.
Voor zover ik kan nagaan heeft de woningcorporatie binnen de kaders van de wet gehandeld.

Exempts housing associations in shrinking areas from the rental landlord levy when they buy private homes and add them to social rental stock, with extended deadlines.
With this amendment it is arranged that approved institutions in shrinking areas are exempt from paying the rental landlord levy.
Met dit amendement wordt geregeld dat toegelaten instellingen in krimpgebieden zijn vrijgesteld van de afdracht van verhuurderheffing

Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van Vliet en Albert de Vries ter vervanging van nr. 9 over een vrijstelling voor toegelaten instellingen in krimpgebieden, indien zij particuliere woningen opkopen en
Amends the landlord levy rules to exempt housing corporations in shrinking regions that buy private homes and add them to their social rental stock, with changed time limits.
This amendment provides that approved institutions in shrinking regions are exempt from the landlord levy if they buy private homes
Met dit amendement wordt geregeld dat toegelaten instellingen in krimpgebieden zijn vrijgesteld van de afdracht van verhuurderheffing indien zij particuliere woningen opkopen
Motie van het lid Van Vliet over een onderzoek naar een systeem van verdere tariefdifferentiatie
Asks the government to study easing the landlord levy's burden on high-WOZ areas by freezing WOZ values there or by tariff differentiation.
requests the government to investigate dampening this effect by freezing WOZ values in those areas or by a system of further tariff differentiation
verzoekt de regering, onderzoek te doen naar demping van dit effect door bevriezing van de WOZ-waardes in die gebieden of door een systeem van verdere tariefdifferentiatie
Motie van de leden Albert de Vries en Van Vliet over vrijstelling van de verhuurderheffing voor bewoners met financiële problemen door funderingsproblematiek
Asks the government to examine whether exempting housing corporations from the landlord levy when renting out homes can help residents in serious financial trouble due to foundation problems.
requests the government, in consultation with municipalities facing foundation problems, to examine whether exemption from the landlord levy can contribute to a solution

verzoekt de regering, in overleg met de gemeenten waar funderingsproblematiek speelt en het Kennis Centrum Aanpak Funderingsproblematiek te onderzoeken of vrijstelling van verhuurderheffing kan bijdragen

Amendement van de leden Van Vliet en Albert de Vries over een vrijstelling voor toegelaten instellingen in krimpgebieden, indien zij particuliere woningen opkopen en aan hun sociaal verhuurbezit toevo
Exempts housing associations in shrinking regions from the landlord levy when they buy private homes and add them to social rental stock, with a 20-year exemption period.
housing associations in shrinking areas are exempt from paying the landlord levy
toegelaten instellingen in krimpgebieden zijn vrijgesteld van de afdracht van verhuurderheffing
Motie van het lid Van Vliet over tijdelijke verhuur aan statushouders
Asks the government to legally allow temporary letting of social housing to status holders under municipal housing agreements.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Vliet over marktverstorende bestedingen van netwerkbedrijven

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about dividend flows and commercial activities of grid operator Liander and its parent Alliander, including alleged cross-subsidisation and whether public shareholders have sufficient oversight. The minister answers that legal rules (Besluit financieel beheer netbeheerder, Elektriciteitswet, Gaswet) limit commercial side activities and cross-subsidy, that ACM supervises compliance, that no grounds for concern exist, and that he will discuss the matter with shareholders and the energy transition bill will address activity boundaries.
I have no signals that grid operator Liander does not meet these requirements.
Ik heb geen signalen dat netbeheerder Liander niet aan deze eisen voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen Van der Linde en Van Vliet over het artikel ‘De Key staat Airbnb toe in sociale huurhuizen’

MPs Van der Linde and Van Vliet asked the Minister for Housing whether he knew of, was consulted about, and would act against a plan by housing corporation De Key to allow Airbnb-style tourist rentals of social rental homes. The minister said he opposes such use, that corporations currently do not permit it, that De Key has dropped the experiment, and that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties could intervene if such a plan proceeded.
If the Aw is of the opinion that statutory provisions are at stake through the conduct of a housing corporation, it can intervene by means of an intervention.
Indien de Aw van oordeel is dat de wettelijke bepalingen in het geding zijn door het handelen van een woningcorporatie, dan kan zij door middel van een interventie ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Vliet en Bashir over het bericht dat het Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw de woningwet blokkeert

MPs Van Vliet and Bashir asked whether the Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw is blocking housing corporations from splitting their social (DAEB) and commercial (non-DAEB) activities, and why it requires mortgage power over all property. The minister replied that corporations must submit splitting proposals to the Aw by 1 January 2017, that no proposals had yet been filed, that WSW's collateral demands are meant for financial stress, and that WSW will publish conditions for releasing collateral, with no risk fee charged in 2017.
WSW requests a power of attorney over all collateral because in situations of financial stress the value of the underlying collateral can drop quickly.
Het WSW vraagt volmacht op al het onderpand, omdat in situaties van financiële stress de waarde van het onderliggende onderpand snel terug kan lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Vliet over hoge vertrekbonussen bij een woningcorporatie

MPs Ronnes and Van Vliet asked the minister about exceptionally high exit payments to supervisory board members at housing corporation Weller, and whether the WNT transitional rules were properly applied. The minister answered that the payments were legal under the pre-WNT reglement and the transitional regime, that he finds them socially insensitive, and that no WNT violation was found so no clawback is planned.
Er is derhalve conform de regelgeving gehandeld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon, Voordewind, Grashoff, Van der Staaij, Thieme, Bontes, Kuzu, Van Vliet, Krol, Klein en Houwers over de levensbedreigende situatie

MPs asked the ministers about the humanitarian siege of Madaya in Syria, where about 40,000 people face starvation, and whether the Netherlands would press for a ceasefire, humanitarian access and airdrops. The ministers confirmed the severity of the situation, described Dutch funding and diplomatic efforts through the UN and ICRC, and explained why airdrops are not considered feasible.
The Netherlands has for some time been pressing within the UN for a ceasefire so that humanitarian aid can be provided to the population.
Nederland dringt in VN-verband al geruime tijd aan op een staakt-het-vuren zodat humanitaire hulp geboden kan worden aan de bevolking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Vliet over de berichten dat de vrijstelling vennootschapsbelastingplicht voor zeehavens mogelijk vervalt voordat dat er sprake is van een gelijk speelveld in de EU

An MP asked why the government would let the corporate tax exemption for seaports lapse before a level playing field exists in the EU, and whether the exemption could be kept. The Secretary of State explains that the exemption is likely state aid the Commission will require ending from 1 January 2017 after a one-year transition, and that Nederland faces court-ordered recovery if it keeps it, so it has warned ports and Parliament accordingly.
That is why the cabinet has called on the European Commission to issue state aid guidelines for seaports to provide that clarity.
Vandaar dat het kabinet de Europese Commissie heeft opgeroepen te komen met richtsnoeren staatssteun voor zeehavens om die duidelijkheid te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Vliet over de berichten inzake het megalomane project ‘Maankwartier’ in Heerlen

An MP asks the Minister for Housing about the Maankwartier project in Heerlen, in which housing corporation Weller invested tenant money, raising concerns about vacancy, undisclosed investors, financial risk, and refused Wob requests for progress reports. The Minister answers that Weller acted within the rules at the time, that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties finds its finances sound, and that the progress reports stay confidential, while acknowledging that such hotel and commercial activities are no longer permitted under the new Woningwet.
It is not in the interest of tenants that planned investments be fully public if that could make those investments more expensive or less profitable.
Het is niet in het belang van huurders dat voorgenomen investeringen volledig openbaar zijn als dat er toe kan leiden dat die investeringen daardoor duurder worden of minder opbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes c.s. over de inhoud van de prospectus voor beursgang ABN AMRO

MPs from several parties asked the Finance Minister whether the ABN AMRO prospectus for its stock market listing shows share-linked bonuses that conflict with earlier assurances and the Merkies/Nijboer amendment, and about conflicts of interest of two board members. The minister answered that identified staff may receive variable pay in non-cash form, that the top 7 board members and 25 senior managers are barred from variable pay while the state holds a stake, that the amendment is complied with, and that the bonus decisions rest with ABN AMRO itself.
ABN AMRO as a company itself bears responsibility for drawing up a variable pay scheme within the legal framework.
ABN AMRO heeft als vennootschap zelf de verantwoordelijkheid om binnen het wettelijke kader een variabele beloningsregeling op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt, Bashir, Tony van Dijck en Van Vliet over de afschaffing van de oldtimervrijstelling

MPs from CDA, SP, PVV and Van Vliet asked the Finance State Secretary about the revenue estimates for abolishing the classic-car tax exemption, the number of diesel and LPG cars affected, and the cost of extending transitional rules to them. The State Secretary defended revised revenue estimates of roughly 60 to 70 million euros, gave a table of affected vehicles, and rejected extending transitional rules to diesel and LPG cars because of budget and air-quality concerns.

In my letter on the classic car measure I only intended to indicate that, to reach the estimated revenue of 137 million euros, the second part of the revenue, the replacement cars, would need to yield 82 million euros in motor vehicle tax.

Ik heb in mijn brief over de oldtimermaatregel slechts willen aangegeven dat, om de geraamde opbrengst van € 137 miljoen te halen, het tweede deel van de opbrengst, de vervangende auto's, € 82 miljoen aan MRB zou moeten opbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Vliet over de raming versus realisatie van de maatregel “integrale vennootschapsbelastingplicht voor woningcorporaties”

An MP asks the Minister of Finance why the realised revenue of the integrated corporate tax liability for housing associations fell well below the 500 million euro projected in 2008, and what administrative and implementation costs and future prospects apply. The State Secretary explains that revenues were low due to the unforeseen use of a reinvestment reserve and property write-downs, implementation costs were broadly in line, and expected revenue will rise on recovery of the housing market.
When the integrated corporate tax liability for housing associations was introduced, the revenue from the integrated corporate tax liability for 2008 was projected at 500 million euros.
Bij de invoering van de integrale Vpb-plicht voor woningcorporaties is de opbrengst van de integrale vennootschapsbelastingplicht voor 2008 geraamd op 500 miljoen euro.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Vliet over de splitsing van activiteiten door woningcorporaties

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about the splitting of housing corporations' commercial activities, citing losses and non-market returns, and asked whether a legal split better protects the core task than an administrative separation, how commercial risks will be prevented from shifting to the core, and whether bankruptcy of corporations should be examined. The minister replied that a legal split offers stronger safeguards, that an administrative separation carries extra conditions (market test, financial test, supervisor powers to force divestment), that both options remain open, and that the revised Housing Act foresees sanitation focused on core activities with bankruptcy possible if sanitation is not pursued.
For that reason, the bill for the revised Housing Act provides that with an administrative separation a number of additional conditions apply to carrying out non-core activities.
Om die reden is in het wetsvoorstel voor de herziene Woningwet geregeld dat bij een administratieve scheiding een aantal extra voorwaarden geldt voor het uitvoeren van niet-DAEB-activiteiten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Graus en Van Vliet over de gevolgen van de voorgenomen accijnsverhoging

Two MPs from the PVV asked the ministers whether the 2013 beer excise increase and the planned 2014 increase will actually raise revenue or merely fuel excise tourism, cross-border unfair competition and revenue losses. The state secretary of Finance answered that 2013 beer excise receipts are in line with expectations, that Dutch excise applies to foreign brewers selling here, that illegal commercial trade is being tackled with the Belastingdienst and brewers' association, and that a border-effects report will be sent after the summer recess before the government decides on the 2014 increases.
After the summer recess I will send the border-effects report I promised to the House of Representatives.
Na het zomerreces zal ik de door mij toegezegde grenseffectenrapportage aan de Tweede Kamer sturen.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma en Van Vliet over mogelijk misbruik van de kennismigrantenregeling

Two PVV MPs asked whether foreigners often switch an existing residence permit to 'knowledge migrant' status and whether the 30% tax ruling for expats should be denied to those already living in the Netherlands. The government answered that 1,130 (2010) and 1,260 (2011) such changes occurred, and that people already resident on another basis are excluded from the 30% ruling unless they are students, interns or PhD candidates.
Employees who already reside in the Netherlands on another residence basis are not eligible for the 30% ruling, unless they reside in the Netherlands as a student, intern or PhD candidate.

Werknemers die reeds op grond van een ander verblijfsdoel in Nederland verblijven, komen niet in aanmerking voor de 30%-regeling, tenzij zij in Nederland als student, stagiair of promovendus verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Vliet, Fritsma en Madlener over het bericht “Inwoners EU hebben recht op uitkering”

PVV MPs asked why EU residents may receive social assistance while doubts exist about their residence right and an income requirement applies, and whether all wrongly paid benefits to foreigners will be recovered. The minister answered that residence rights under the EU free movement directive depend on an individual assessment by the IND, that municipalities handle benefit decisions, and that municipalities are responsible for recovery policy.
The implementation of the WWB has been decentralised to the municipalities.
De uitvoering van de WWB is gedecentraliseerd aan de gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders, Tony van Dijck en Van Vliet over de sombere CBS-cijfers over de werkloosheid, de huizenprijzen en het consumentenvertrouwen

Opposition PVV MPs asked whether the minister would relax the 3% deficit ceiling and reconsider labour, housing and pension reforms in light of gloomy CBS figures on unemployment, house prices and consumer confidence. The minister replied that the 2013 deficit will exceed 3%, citing a housing package and business stimulus, that the government keeps its spending rules and will not add cuts in 2013, and that it will push ahead with reforms and targeted support for unemployed workers and youth.
The cabinet will further maintain the budget rules for 2013; any overruns will be resolved within the budget, and the spending ceiling will be respected.
Het kabinet zal verder voor 2013 de begrotingsregels handhaven; eventuele overschrijdingen zullen binnen de begroting worden opgelost, het uitgavenplafond wordt gerespecteerd.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Van Vliet over de mogelijke komst van duizenden Marokkanen naar Nederland

Two PVV MPs asked whether the cessation of Dutch child benefit for children living abroad could drive thousands of Moroccan teenagers to the Netherlands, and asked about dual nationality and measures to prevent it. The minister replied that parents freely choose where their children live, that child benefit is only partial support, that the number of affected teenagers is about 1500, and that no measures to prevent such moves are planned.
I do not intend to take measures to prevent children currently living in Morocco from possibly moving to the Netherlands.
Ik ben niet van plan om maatregelen te treffen om te voorkomen dat kinderen die op dit moment in Marokko wonen eventueel in Nederland gaan wonen.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma en Van Vliet over het bericht dat België Europese bijstandsfraudeurs uitzet

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government knows of Belgium expelling EU welfare fraudsters, how many EU nationals were removed from the Netherlands for benefit fraud or failing the income requirement, and how EU nationals can receive benefits despite the income requirement. The minister answered that 70 residence rights were ended in 2012 (10 forced returns), that benefit receipt does not automatically end residence, and that experiments with the municipalities of Vaals and Rotterdam aim to speed up information exchange, with results promised before summer.
The minister of Social Affairs and Employment promised in the General Consultation on Labour Migration of 17 January 2013 to inform the House before the summer about the results of the experiments.

De minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid heeft in het Algemeen Overleg Arbeidsmigratie van 17 januari 2013 toegezegd om de Kamer voor de zomer te informeren over de resultaten van de experimenten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Van Vliet over het bericht ‘Oudere mannen vaker werkloos’

Two PVV MPs asked the minister about a report that older men are increasingly unemployed and how this fits with raising the AOW age, the planned easing of dismissal law, the job-continuation bonus, and the bridging scheme for those unable to prepare for the higher AOW age. The minister replied that unemployment among men aged 45-65 remains the lowest of age groups, that dismissal criteria and the selection principle are retained, that the bonus supports working longer, and that bridging scheme contours were sent to parliament with implementation planned for 2013.
On 23 January a letter was sent to the House of Representatives outlining the contours of the bridging scheme.
Op 23 januari jl. is een brief verstuurd aan de Tweede Kamer waarin de contouren van de overbruggingsregeling zijn geschetst.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon, Van Vliet en Wilders over het protest van Marokko tegen het korten van Nederlandse uitkeringen voor Marokkanen

PVV MPs asked whether the Dutch ambassador was summoned by Morocco over cuts to Dutch benefits paid to Moroccans, whether the ambassador was told to stay out of Dutch legislation, and whether new benefits to return migrants could be frozen. The minister replied that the ambassador met the Moroccan minister at Dutch request on a previously scheduled matter, that no summoning took place, and that freezing new benefits requires a treaty amendment, pointing to the residence-country principle and planned ending of child benefit export.
No. The Dutch ambassador met with the Moroccan Minister of Employment and Vocational Training on 9 January.
Nee. De Nederlandse ambassadeur heeft op 9 januari jl. gesproken met de Marokkaanse minister van Werkgelegenheid en Beroepsopleidingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw c.s. over de zaak Van Rey - Weekers

Opposition and coalition MPs ask the State Secretary for Finance about the Van Rey–Weekers affair: a billboard donation, the sale of a tax office and a tax request involving real estate. They press on the nature and financing of the donation, contacts about closing tax offices, and handling of a personal tax request. The item is a bundle of written questions; the answers are not included in the text provided.
Have you verified that the donation was indeed made only by Mr Van Rey and, as agreed, processed via the regional campaign fund? Can you make the accounts public?

Heeft u zich ervan vergewist dat de donatie inderdaad alleen door de heer Van Rey is gedaan en, zoals afgesproken, via de regionale campagnekas is afgehandeld? Kunt u de rekeningen hiervan openbaar maken?
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf, Klever, Graus, Bosma en Van Vliet over het bericht “Topsalaris staatsbedrijven nog ruim boven Balkenendenorm”?

PVV MPs asked whether state-owned enterprise executive pay exceeding the Balkenende norm should be clawed back, and whether the Balkenende norm is high enough. The minister replied that state holdings fall outside the Balkenende pay-cap law because they are not publicly funded, but that the state's pay policy for these holdings is assessed against its own framework, which will be revised.
state holdings do not fall under the Public and Semi-Public Sector Senior Officials (Remuneration) Act, because they are not financed with public funds
staatsdeelnemingen vallen niet onder de Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen publieke en semipublieke sector, omdat zij niet met publieke middelen worden bekostigd
Antwoord vragen Driessen en Van Vliet over bezoldiging van FMO’s bestuurders

MPs Driessen and Van Vliet asked about state ownership of development bank FMO, its capital base, and whether its executives' pay (directors earning up to 429,000 euro including pensions) fits a development organisation and should be subject to the Balkenende norm. The minister confirmed the state holds 51% and over 90% of equity is state-funded, explained that pay figures include pensions and that the CEO's fixed pay is now capped at 270,000 euro, and argued FMO operates as a market-facing bank so the public/market pay category applies, declining to apply the Balkenende norm or sell the shares.
The public interest is reflected in the way the state, as shareholder, acts on the remuneration policy, which must be sufficiently moderate.
Het publiek belang vindt zijn weerslag in de wijze waarop de staat als aandeelhouder acteert ten aanzien van het beloningsbeleid, dat voldoende gematigd moet zijn.
Antwoord vragen de Mos, van Vliet en van Bemmel over het bericht “Hedwige mogelijk deels onder water”

PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether the risks of flooding caused by the Hedwige polder de-embankment, including for the Doel nuclear plant across the border, warranted independent research or invoking treaty clausula rebus sic stantibus. The secretary answered that flood safety was already a key condition in planning, so the de-embankment does not compromise safety and further independent research is not needed.
No, in the planning for the de-embankment of the Hedwige polder flood safety has been taken into account as an important condition.
Nee, in de planvorming voor de ontpoldering van de Hedwigepolder is de veiligheid tegen overstroming als een belangrijke voorwaarde meegenomen.
Antwoord vragen Van Vliet over het jaarlijks mislopen van 2 miljard aan belastinginkomsten

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about roughly 2 billion euro in tax revenue lost each year, citing a union report on the Tax Administration's collection and write-offs, and about overlapping collection agencies. The government answers that write-offs were about 1.8 billion in 2011 (mostly unrecoverable debts), that open debts of 4.4 billion are not all uncollectable, and that it is studying collection pilots and consolidation without committing to a specific structural change.
Nevertheless I consider this share too high and I have asked the Tax Administration to come up with plans to reduce it.
Toch vind ik dit deel te hoog en ik heb de Belastingdienst gevraagd met plannen te komen om dit omlaag te brengen.
Antwoord vragen De Mos en Van Vliet over de metallurgische industrie

PVV MPs De Mos and Van Vliet asked the ministers whether the government will act to protect the metallurgical industry's level playing field against the EU emissions trading system and the German nuclear phase-out, and urge that the system be scrapped. The minister answers that the Dutch government supports the ETS and only seeks compensation for genuine carbon leakage risk, while the Commission's state-aid guidelines are still pending.
The aim is to maintain a level playing field in Europe and to prevent member states from using state aid to distort European competitive conditions.
Het doel is handhaving van het gelijke speelveld in Europa en daartoe voorkomen dat lidstaten door middel van staatssteun de Europese concurrentieverhoudingen kunnen verstoren.
Antwoord vragen Elissen en Van Vliet over stijgende WOZ-waarderingen

Two PVV MPs asked why WOZ property valuations keep rising while house prices fall, whether this creates municipal arbitrariness, and what will be done to protect homeowners. The minister answered that valuations lag market prices by a year, that municipal arbitrariness is not evidenced and the Waarderingskamer supervises, and that a bill to make WOZ values public and informal objection channels are planned.
I have not found any evidence that there is municipal arbitrariness.
Mij is niet gebleken dat er sprake is van gemeentelijke willekeur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck, Van Vliet en Lucassen over het bericht dat banken weigeren om tweeverdieners met een modaal inkomen een hogere hypotheek te verstrekken

PVV MPs asked whether the AFM's objection to relaxed mortgage rules for dual-earner households with modal incomes, and its view on the limits of lending, was consistent with its supervisory role, and whether supervisors should refrain from commenting on the housing market. The minister replied that the AFM may state what it considers responsible lending under the open norm, and that the AFM and DNB, as independent supervisors, are free to comment on the housing market while respecting existing rules.
The AFM and DNB, as independent supervisors, are free to express views on the housing market.
Het staat de AFM en DNB als onafhankelijk toezichthouder vrij om zich uit te spreken over de woningmarkt.
Vragen van het lid Van Vliet (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de onbelaste kilometervergoeding (ingezonden 8 december 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether scenarios for lowering the tax-free kilometre allowance were being calculated, whether employees would lose money, and whether the government would rule out touching the allowance. The State Secretary confirmed an exploration with the transport minister is ongoing, could not yet quantify effects or answer on public transport, electric cars and bicycles, and said the allowance is a cost reimbursement, not in-kind income.
That exploration is currently under way. On earlier occasions I promised the House that I would send the results of that exploration to the House before the summer recess.
Die verkenning vindt momenteel plaats. Bij eerdere gelegenheden heb ik de Kamer toegezegd de resultaten van die verkenning voor het zomerreces aan de Kamer te zullen zenden.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Neppérus (VVD), Van Vliet (PVV), Koolmees (D66), Braakhuis (GroenLinks) en Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het rechtstreeks overmaken van kinderopvang

Six MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary of Finance whether childcare allowance should be paid directly to childcare providers to prevent parental arrears, and whether a system with certified payee parties would be designed with stakeholders. The State Secretary said government should in principle not intervene, that a single bank account per taxpayer is planned with an exception for childcare centres under strict conditions, and that the Minister of Social Affairs will consult the sector and report to parliament.

As I indicated at the legislative consultation of 7 November regarding the Tax Package 2012, I will include an exception for childcare centres to the mandatory use of a single bank account via an amendment.

Zoals ik in het wetgevingsoverleg van 7 november jl. over het Belastingpakket 2012 heb aangegeven, zal ik bij nota van wijziging voor kindercentra een uitzondering op het verplicht gebruik van één rekeningnummer opnemen.

Vragen van de leden Braakhuis (GroenLinks) en Van Vliet (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het gebruik van dienstauto’s door managers van de Belastingdienst (ingezonden 12 oktober 2011).

MPs Braakhuis and Van Vliet asked whether Tax Administration managers with homes far from The Hague are entitled to chauffeured company cars for commuting, and about the costs and justification. The state secretary confirmed that nine nationally active managers have chauffeured cars, that use is function-based and periodically reviewed, and that he considers the costs of about 797,000 euros for 2011 justified and will weigh the budget situation in future allocation decisions.
Use of a company car is function-based. Currently this concerns nine managers who have a car with a chauffeur.
Het gebruik van dienstauto is functiegebonden. Het gaat momenteel om negen managers die een auto met chauffeur hebben.

Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen (SP), Van Veldhoven (D66), Leegte (VVD), Van Tongeren (GL), Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (CU), Van der Werf (CDA), Van Vliet (PVV), Samsom (PvdA) en Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecret

Nine MPs asked why the Hagestein hydropower plant has been out of use since 2005, why a renovation plan and a private 20-year concession offer were not acted upon, and what the government's view is on the case. The state secretary answered that Rijkswaterstaat is still studying technical, legal and environmental requirements and will decide in 2012 whether to tender, integrate or shut down the plant, and will inform stakeholders in coming months.
RWS will take the initiative to inform the interested companies and governments about the state of affairs in a few months' time.
RWS zal het initiatief nemen om de belanghebbende bedrijven en overheden over enkele maanden in te lichten over de stand van zaken

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Van Vliet en De Mos (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over verouderde gasleidingen die tikkende tijdbommen in de Nederlan

PVV MPs asked whether outdated brittle gas pipes in the Dutch subsoil are ticking time bombs, whether risk assessments and replacement timelines of about thirty years are acceptable, and who is responsible for replacing about 10,000 km of cast iron. The minister answers that responsibility lies with regional grid operators supervised by SodM, that the most vulnerable pipes will be replaced within five years, that new safety rules took effect in 2011, and that most cast iron pipes will be replaced by 2041.
SodM supervises the implementation of the plans.
SodM houdt toezicht op de uitvoering van de plannen.

Vragen van de leden Wilders, Kortenoeven en Van Vliet (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de recente ontmoeting tussen de Iraanse president Mahmoud Ahm

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about Ahmadinejad's remarks to the new Dutch ambassador in Iran, the ambassador's trade-related statements, and calls to restrict relations with Iran and to set up an international tribunal against Ahmadinejad and Khamenei. The government answered that it pursues a two-track policy of pressure and sanctions requiring contact with Iranian leaders, that the press quote did not reflect the ambassador's words, and that the ICC rather than a new tribunal handles such crimes.
For this two-track policy, the possibility of contact with Iran's leaders is necessary.
Voor dit tweesporenbeleid is de mogelijkheid tot contact met de leiders van Iran noodzakelijk.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Driessen en Van Vliet (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken, van Justitie, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Financiën over het bericht dat Duitsland de Inter

PVV MPs asked ministers whether the Dutch branch of the IHH aid organisation, banned in Germany over alleged Hamas funding, should be scrutinised, de-listed as an ANBI charity, or designated as terrorist. The government said it has no indications of IHH Netherlands financing Hamas, that AIVD assesses risks, that the ANBI integrity test is limited to criminal convictions, and that further study of Union of Good is promised.
The AIVD assesses and interprets any indications of risks from the perspective of national security.
De AIVD beoordeelt en duidt eventuele aanwijzingen voor risico's vanuit het belang van de nationale veiligheid.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Van Vliet (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over het Iraanse Revolutionaire Garde Korps (IRGC) (ingezonden 30 juni 2010).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers about the role of Iran's Revolutionary Guard (IRGC) in Iran's nuclear programme, whether it should be listed as terrorist, and whether Dutch firms' ties to it should be investigated. The minister said Nederland is concerned about the IRGC, that IRGC elements were included in UN and EU sanctions, and that export transactions to Iran already get extra scrutiny via licensing, without committing to a separate investigation of Dutch business ties.
Where necessary, under the applicable sanctions policy towards Iran, export transactions are already subjected to further examination.
Waar nodig worden, in het kader van het geldende sanctiebeleid jegens Iran, uitvoertransacties reeds onderworpen aan nader onderzoek.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven, Wilders, De Roon en Van Vliet (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over de positie van oliemaatschappij Koninklijke Nederlandse Shell onder het (aa

PVV MPs asked whether the government knows of a July 2010 letter from 22 US Congress members urging Shell to end its Iran activities and disclose them to US authorities, and whether it will urge Shell to disclose its Iran activities in the Netherlands too. The ministers answered that they know the letter, that it fits efforts for strict Iran sanctions, that Shell must answer it itself, and that Shell must account transparently to its shareholders while the government supervises compliance with EU and UN sanctions.
Shell is bound by the regulations arising from the relevant UN and European sanctions measures against Iran; it is the government's task to monitor compliance with them.
Shell is gebonden aan de regelgeving die voortvloeit uit de relevante VNVR- en Europese sanctiemaatregelen jegens Iran; het is de taak van de overheid toe te zien op naleving daarvan.

m: Amendement van het lid Remkes ter invoering van een extra belastingschijf
Amendment replacing the flat 30.4% income tax rate with a progressive bracket table, raising the rate to 38% for higher incomes.
A flat rate of 30.4% has the charm of simplicity.
Een vlaktarief van 30,4% heeft de charme van de eenvoud.

qn: Vragen van de leden Aptroot en Remkes (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Financiën over de stijging van de BPM in 2010 (ingezonden 14 april 2010).

Two VVD MPs asked the finance minister whether a CBS finding that the January 2010 BPM rate cut led to a 0.5% rise in new car prices, due to the new CO2 levy, contradicts the promise of revenue-neutral reform, and asked for a table of budgetary effects of the BPM shift to MRB through 2013. The minister said the CBS monthly comparison is not representative, that the CPB confirmed revenue neutrality, and gave the scheduled BPM-to-MRB transfer amounts through 2013 from the Belastingplan 2009.
The CPB confirmed the revenue neutrality, assuming the assumed 2.8% annual decrease in CO2 emissions.
Het CPB heeft de lastenneutraliteit bevestigd, uitgaande van de veronderstelde 2,8% afname van de CO 2 -uitstoot.

Conduct directed at the head or a member of the government of a friendly state is not to be punishable as simple insult.
Niet als eenvoudige belediging strafbaar zijn gedragingen die zijn gericht tot het hoofd of een lid van de regering van een bevriende staat.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Markuszower ter vervanging van nr. 14 over geen strafverhoging voor ambtenaren en geen klachtvereiste voor de Koning, politieagenten, militairen en ambulancepersoneel
Removes the enhanced insult penalty for officials, including judicial officials, and makes the complaint requirement apply to them, while exempting the Crown, police, military and ambulance staff.
Judges are public figures who take part in public debate.
Rechters zijn publieke figuren die zich in het publieke debat mengen.
Amendement van het lid Markuszower over het schrappen van de rechter uit de artikelen 267 en 279
Removes judges from the aggravated insult offence and the complaint requirement for insulting judges, so that insulting judicial officials is not treated as aggravated.
This amendment provides that insulting judicial officials entrusted with adjudication does not fall under the aggravated penalty of Article 267 of the Criminal Code.
Dit amendement regelt dat belediging van met rechtspraak belaste rechterlijke ambtenaren niet onder de strafverzwaring van artikel 267 van het Wetboek van Strafrecht valt.
Motie van het lid Markuszower over een systeem van gekozen strafrechters

Asks the government to introduce elected criminal judges and elected members of the College of Procurators-General, advocates-general and chief public prosecutors, with elections held alongside provincial elections.
requests the government to introduce as soon as possible a system of elected criminal judges handling offences
verzoekt de regering, zo spoedig mogelijk een systeem van gekozen strafrechters belast met misdrijven
Motie van het lid Markuszower over de rest van zijn gevangenisstraf Robert M. in de isoleercel
Asks the government to ensure that Robert M. is immediately placed in an isolation cell for the entire remainder of his prison sentence.
requests the government to ensure that Robert M. is immediately placed in an isolation cell for the entire duration of his prison sentence
verzoekt de regering, ervoor te zorgen dat Robert M. per direct voor de gehele duur van zijn gevangenisstraf in de isoleercel wordt gegooid
Motie van het lid Markuszower over opzeggen van het EVRM
Asks the government to terminate the European Convention on Human Rights, removing an external check on national legislation and citizens' rights.
requests the government to terminate the European Convention on Human Rights
verzoekt de regering, het Europees Verdrag tot bescherming van de rechten van de mens en de fundamentele vrijheden (EVRM) op te zeggen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber-van de Klashorst, Vlottes, Boon en Markuszower over de 'Stichting Plant een Olijfboom'

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about the Stichting Plant een Olijfboom, whose staff allegedly praised the 7 October attack, questioning its ANBI charity status, missing financial reporting, possible funding of Hamas, and calls for an FIOD investigation or a ban. The minister condemned such statements but said the ANBI public-benefit test is neutral and non-prosecutable conduct is no ground for revocation, that financial publication gaps are usually remedied, that tax secrecy prevents comment on the individual organisation, and that dissolution/banning under Article 2:20 BW is for the Public Prosecution Service and the court.
The Tax Authority is bound by the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act and therefore cannot provide further information about individual institutions.
De Belastingdienst is gehouden aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen en kan daarom geen nadere informatie verstrekken over individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over het bericht ‘Israëlische ambassade dient klacht in bij Schiphol na incident met vrijgelaten gijzelaar’

MPs Wilders and Markuszower asked whether reports were true that two Israeli women, one a former Hamas hostage, were mistreated by a Schiphol security employee, and whether the employee could be dismissed. The minister said he was shocked, the Marechaussee mediated on site, the employee works for Schiphol so the ministry lacks authority over them, and Schiphol says it apologised personally via the embassy.
Because it concerns an employee of Schiphol, the Ministry of IenW has no authority over this employee.
Omdat het een medewerker van Schiphol betreft, heeft het Ministerie van IenW geen zeggenschap over deze medewerker.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pool en Markuszower over het nieuws dat het demissionaire kabinet onderzoekt of er asielzoekers kunnen worden opgevangen op locaties van Defensie

PVV MPs asked whether the caretaker cabinet's plans to house asylum seekers on Defence sites should be abandoned, citing security risks, incidents and the military's primary purpose. The Defence Minister answered that such requests are weighed case by case for humanitarian reasons and legal feasibility, that security measures are added after consent, and that incidents are recorded by COA.
For the number of reported incidents, I refer you to the 'COA incident registration per location' on www.coa.nl.
Voor het aantal gemelde incidenten verwijs ik u naar de «COA incidentenregistratie per locatie» op www.coa.nl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vondeling en Markuszower over ‘overvolle gevangenissen en Tbs-klinieken’

PVV MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection how many convicted offenders are free because prisons and tbs clinics are full, whether convicted criminals should never escape their sentences, and what will be done to ensure all sentenced criminals are imprisoned. The Minister answered that 636 adult male self-reporters are temporarily not being called up, that about 150 tbs-passanten are held in prisons, and that the measure is a temporary emergency to be lifted as soon as staffing allows, with further measures being examined.
Not admitting self-reporters is a temporary emergency measure due to staff shortages at DJI, so that not all cells can be used.
Het niet opnemen van zelfmelders is een tijdelijke noodmaatregel als gevolg van persoonstekort bij DJI waardoor niet alle cellen inzetbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over artikel 12 procedure

The PVV MP Markuszower asks the Minister of Justice and Security what has been done with recommendations on elder abuse recognition in police training and judicial education, and why a public prosecutor did not recognise financial abuse and sought a bewilligingsprocedure against a court-ordered investigation. The Minister says the recommendations are unclear, describes general police and judicial training on recognising vulnerable persons and domestic violence, and declines to comment on the individual case because it is pending before the court.
It does not befit me as Minister of Justice and Security to make statements about individual cases, all the more so while the judgment is still reserved for the court.
Het past mij niet als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om uitspraken te doen over individuele zaken, te meer zolang het oordeel hierin nog is voorbehouden aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Dader verkrachting verdacht van nieuwe verkrachting tijdens proefverlof’
