An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why a convicted rapist was granted leave in 2022 and whether such offenders should never get leave; the minister declined to discuss individual cases, described the leave regime and responsible officials, and rejected the call for categorical exclusion and life imprisonment. The answers restate existing rules without committing to any new action.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower inzake de lage straf voor het doodrijden van Shana Leurs

MPs Wilders and Markuszower asked why a driver who killed Shana Leurs received a six-month sentence, and whether minimum sentences, mandatory driving bans and other stricter measures could be introduced. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case, defended judicial discretion and the existing legal framework, and pointed to a pending motion on lifetime driving bans and an upcoming evaluation.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to comment on this case, or other individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om op deze zaak, en andere individuele zaken, in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het vervoeren van asielzoekers per taxi

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about taxis used to transport asylum seekers, how often this happens, the costs, and why they do not use public transport. The State Secretary replied that taxis are used only in specific cases, such as transporting unaccompanied minors or vulnerable persons to the Ter Apel registration centre, that costs are paid from the state budget, that COA is responsible for its own cost records, and referred to earlier answers on the remaining questions.
COA is an independent administrative body and itself bears responsibility for the costs of orders related to transporting asylum seekers.
COA is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan en draagt zelf verantwoordelijkheid voor de kosten die betrekking hebben op opdrachten die verbandhouden met het vervoeren van asielzoekers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over de overname van de tijdelijke opvanglocatie voor asielzoekers door het COA

MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why COA took over a municipal emergency reception site in Groningen without consent, whether residents were consulted, and whether more sites will be taken over. The State Secretary replied that takeovers happen in consultation with municipalities, that the Groningen site remains temporary emergency shelter with no plan to make it permanent, that informing residents is the municipality's responsibility, and that more suitable sites are being discussed with municipalities before 1 April 2023.
It is primarily the responsibility of the municipality to inform residents about the emergency shelter remaining open longer.
Het is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente om de omwonenden te informeren over het langer open blijven van een (crisis)noodopvanglocatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over gratis zwemles voor asielzoekers

An MP asked why asylum seekers up to age 35 get free swimming lessons funded by COA while Dutch children and adults do not, calling it discriminatory. The government answered that asylum seekers and residents drown relatively more often, that COA covers swimming lessons as a targeted risk-reduction measure, and that other municipal and national financial schemes exist for Dutch residents.
COA reimburses the cost of swimming lessons for residents up to and including age 35.
Het COA vergoedt de kosten voor zwemlessen voor bewoners tot en met 35 jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Helder over het bericht 'Slachtoffers moeten te lang wachten tot er wat gebeurt met hun aangifte'

MPs Markuszower and Helder asked the Minister of Justice about reports that victims wait too long for their complaints to be acted on, citing a shortage of public prosecutors, cases being dropped, and unanswered warnings from the prosecutors' union. The Minister answered that the government is providing structural extra funding and recruitment measures, that no registration exists on the number of unsolved or dismissed cases, and that the College of Procurators-General did respond to the union's letter.
No registration is kept of this; the registration system does not offer a way to do so.
Hiervan wordt geen registratie bijgehouden, het registratiesysteem biedt daarvoor geen mogelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over een asielzoeker die 6 weken cel heeft gekregen voor het vernielen van 23 auto’s in Ter Apel

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Justice and Security why an Eritrean asylum seeker who smashed 23 cars in Ter Apel received only six weeks in prison, whether victims will be compensated, why he was not returned to Germany, and what measures will protect residents. The State Secretary declines to comment on the individual case, explains the general prosecution, compensation and VRIS procedures, and lists the nuisance-reduction measures and funding being pursued.
I will not make any further statements about the individual circumstances of this case.
Over de individuele omstandigheden van dit geval doe ik verder geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Markuszower over het bericht ‘Asielchaos zet politie klem’

Two PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister why Amsterdam police must release 10% of their AVIM capacity to asylum identification backlogs, how this affects human trafficking work and public safety, and why the borders are not closed to halt asylum inflow. The minister answered that the reallocation is temporary and may affect other AVIM tasks while trafficking work is protected, and that closing borders is not a sustainable solution, pointing instead to measures such as a national coordinator on nuisance and extra funding.
This may indeed affect AVIM's other work, such as supervision and enforcement tasks under the Aliens Act and participation in various consultation groups.
Dit kan inderdaad invloed hebben op de overige werkzaamheden van AVIM, zoals de toezicht- en handhavingstaken in het kader van de Vreemdelingenwet en deelname in verschillende overleggroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Maeijer over het bericht 'Zonder onderzoek draaien we om hete brij'

MPs Markuszower and Maeijer asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether an independent inquiry is needed into the role of judges in out-of-home placements of children from the childcare benefits scandal, and how further placements due to debt problems will be prevented. The minister answered that an Inspectorate inquiry is underway, an independent inquiry commission is being prepared, the judiciary will review files itself, and no further inquiry is needed, while stating that debt alone is no ground for placement.

At this moment I see no reason for another inquiry because the inspectorate investigation is already underway, an inquiry commission is being prepared, the judiciary itself will conduct file research, and a reflection process of family and youth judges is ongoing.
Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding voor nog een onderzoek omdat het inspectieonderzoek al loopt, er een onderzoekscommissie in voorbereiding is, de Rechtspraak zelf dossieronderzoek zal gaan doen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over het bericht: ‘Woede over autobranden in Eindhoven’

Two PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister about car arsons in Eindhoven, including cars parked against homes, whether this constitutes terrorism and whether Extinction Rebellion should be listed as a terrorist organisation. The Minister said the matter is for police and prosecutors, that no reliable count of offences linked to the group is possible, that the NCTV definition of terrorism is adopted, and that Extinction Rebellion is not on the EU/UN terrorist list, while pledging all lawful means to prevent terrorist offences.
It is not possible for the police and the OM to provide a reliable overview of such criminal activities since May 2018.
Het is voor de politie en het OM niet mogelijk om een betrouwbaar overzicht te geven van betreffende dergelijke strafbare activiteiten sinds mei 2018.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over de berichten 'Je kunt me kankerjood noemen, maar ik meld het wel' en 'Nederlands joodse man onthult het antisemitisme waar hij mee te maken heeft'

MPs Wilders and Markuszower asked the Justice Minister about reports of a Jewish man in Wijchen repeatedly harassed, spat on and assaulted by a group of youths, and about police and prosecution handling. The minister replied that the police investigated every report, the prosecutor found insufficient evidence for prosecution, police held 'stop talks' with youths and parents, and discrimination handling will be strengthened through the local partnership.
I cannot make any further statements about the identity of those involved in this case.
Over de identiteit van de betrokkenen in deze zaak kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Helder over de trage voortgang van onderzoeken naar de Deventer moordzaak

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security why investigations into the Deventer murder case have dragged on for nearly a decade and what steps will speed them up. The minister answered that the review research is now complete, the results were handed to the defence, the delay was caused by a broader review and COVID, and that no further measures are needed since the research has concluded.
The investigation, carried out on the orders of the Advocate-General at the Supreme Court, has now been completed.
Het onderzoek, dat is uitgevoerd in opdracht van de advocaat-generaal (AG) bij de Hoge Raad, is inmiddels voltooid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over het afdwingen van opvangplaatsen van vreemdelingen

PVV MPs asked whether the government would requisition property such as sports halls, offices, hotels and homes to house asylum seekers, and whether ministers would house migrants in their own property. The state secretary answered that requisitioning property is not currently under consideration and referred to earlier letters on ministers' property holdings, adding that housing migrants in one's own home is a private matter and not an obligation.
For completeness, I refer you regarding ownership of immovable property to letters from the Prime Minister dated 14 January 2022 on the interests of ministers.
Volledigheidshalve verwijs ik u ten aanzien van het bezit van onroerend goed naar brieven van de Minister-President d.d. 14 januari 2022 inzake de belangen van bewindspersonen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder, Markuszower en de Graaf over het bericht ‘Hoofddoek boa moet kunnen’

MPs Helder, Markuszower and De Graaf asked whether Arnhem's decision to allow headscarves on municipal enforcement officers' (boa) uniforms conflicts with two adopted House motions, and what the minister will do about it. The minister said municipal councils may adopt their own motions, that a national guideline on boa uniform neutrality will be drafted in dialogue with the VNG and local government, and that the choice of instrument will be reported to the House in spring.

To this end, I will, in dialogue with the Association of Netherlands Municipalities (VNG) and local government, draft a guideline that secures the neutrality and nationwide uniformity and recognisability of the boa uniform.

Hiertoe zal ik, in dialoog met de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) en het lokaal bestuur, een richtlijn opstellen waarin de neutraliteit en landelijke uniformiteit en herkenbaarheid van het boa-uniform worden geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over luxe vervoer voor asielzoekers

The PVV MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked why asylum-seeker children in Utrecht were taken to school by touring coach despite having free bicycles, and asked for an overview of everything asylum seekers receive for free. State Secretary Van der Burg answered that the coach was temporary because the Afghan evacuees initially lacked bicycles and cycling skills and had no means for public transport, that the service has ended since the spring holiday, and that asylum seekers are entitled to reception under law, with the COA's provisions set out in a regulation rather than a single overview.
A touring coach was temporarily deployed for about 75 school-age children of Afghan evacuees.
Er is tijdelijk een touringcar voor ongeveer 75 leerplichtige kinderen van Afghaanse evacuées ingezet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over een nieuw azc

An MP asked whether the Expo Assen hall is being used as an asylum reception location, what it costs, and why the government keeps housing asylum seekers at the expense of Dutch citizens and businesses, and asked when borders will be closed. The Secretary of State confirmed Expo Assen is used as temporary emergency reception until end of March 2022 for about 300 people, declined to provide business information as a private organisation, and stated the government respects international obligations and will keep asking municipalities and provinces for reception places.
Expo Assen is a private organisation and I therefore do not have the business information you requested.
Expo Assen is een private organisatie en ik beschik derhalve niet over de door u gevraagde bedrijfsinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Markuszower over het bericht 'Alarm jeugdrechters om crisis jeugdzorg: gebrekkige dossiers en niet passende beslissingen'

MPs Maeijer and Markuszower asked the government about reports that juvenile judges warn of a youth care crisis, with poor case files and inappropriate decisions, and about waiting times, closed placements and the quality of factual investigation in child protection. The minister acknowledges pressure on child protection, reports regional gaps and an action programme, but gives no national figures on children waiting or unnecessarily detained, and points to other bodies and ongoing reviews.
No national figures are available on how many children are currently waiting for the child protection measure imposed by the juvenile judge.
Er zijn op landelijk niveau geen cijfers beschikbaar hoeveel kinderen op dit moment wachten op de door de kinderrechter opgelegde jeugdbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘OM sluit geheime deal met voormalige topaanklagers’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about reports that the Public Prosecution Service secretly settled lawsuits with former prosecutor-general Van Nimwegen and chief prosecutor Bloos, and sought to know the reasons, amounts, and whether the deal was funded from crime-fighting budget. The Minister confirmed he was informed during talks, said the agreement is a confidential employer-employee matter and gave no amounts, but denied it was paid from crime-fighting budget and rejected reversing it.
The agreements that Mr Van Nimwegen and Ms Bloos made with the OM concern the relationship between employee and employer.
De afspraken die de heer van Nimwegen en mevrouw Bloos met het OM gemaakt hebben, betreffen de relatie tussen werknemer en werkgever.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Fritsma en Markuszower over ‘een jaar stilte rond de inspectie van een koopvaardijschip door marineschip de Zr. Ms. De Ruyter’

PVV MPs asked why, a year after a Dutch navy ship inspected a merchant vessel for possible sanctions violations, the government still withholds the ship's name, flag and inspection location, and how long the prosecution will take. The Minister of Justice declined to give details of the individual criminal investigation, then said the case was closed without any sanctions violation found and that neither the EU nor the UN was involved.
As is known, I do not provide information of this kind from individual criminal investigations.
Over dergelijke informatie uit individuele strafrechtelijke onderzoeken doe ik zoals bekend geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, Markuszower en Wilders over woningweigering door statushouders

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether it is acceptable that refugee status holders (statushouders) refuse housing offers, citing reports of families expelled from a reception centre, and requested data on refusals since 2010. The minister answered that refusals are rare and mostly handled by COA's procedure, gave figures showing 1,696 refusal procedures since 2013 with 1,598 judged unjustified and 137 eviction procedures started, and rejected calls to deport such persons.
Of the total number of housing refusals, 98 were found justified and 1,598 were found unjustified.
Van het totale aantal woningweigeringen zijn er 98 terecht en 1.598 onterecht bevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over ‘de trage voortgang van de onderzoeken naar de Deventer moordzaak’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice why the Amsterdam cold case team had not finished its investigation into the Deventer murder case two years after it began, what steps had been taken since October 2020, and when the investigations would be concluded. The Minister, relaying the Procurator-General's reply, explained the sequence of the investigation, said the Procurator-General is independent and responsible for steering the work, and expected first results within four months and a second phase of a few months more.
The PG remains responsible for the investigation and it is for the PG and AG to steer the progress of individual cases.
De PG blijft verantwoordelijk voor het onderzoek en het is aan de PG en AG om te sturen op de voortgang van individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Personeel gevangenis Zaandam op dodenlijst´

An MP asked whether the government is aware of reports that staff of Zaandam prison appeared on a death list and what it will do to protect them and their families. The minister confirmed awareness, described a staff meeting, the ongoing police and prosecution investigation, individual talks and existing security measures, without announcing new concrete steps.
On Monday 23 August, all staff of the department where the list was found gathered with the prison management.
Op maandag 23 augustus jl. zijn alle medewerkers van de afdeling waar de lijst werd aangetroffen bij elkaar gekomen met de directie van de inrichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Gevangenis Limburg laat vrouw per ongeluk te vroeg vrij door rekenfout'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a prisoner released early due to a calculation error at a Limburg prison, including the offences, why she was not yet arrested, whether a description was sent to investigators, how often such early releases occur, and what measures will prevent them. The minister acknowledged the error as human, said the offender has been re-arrested and serves the remaining sentence, a description was sent, five early-release alerts occurred in 2021, and cited existing safeguards such as a four-eyes check and software support.
I will not go into individual cases any further.
Ik ga verder niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, Madlener en Wilders over het bericht 'Geweld en overlast asielzoekers in ov regio Emmen: ’We zijn het spuugzat’'

PVV MPs asked whether asylum seekers in the Emmen public transport region were committing daily intimidation and violence against bus drivers, and demanded expulsion or an asylum stop. The State Secretary confirmed 7 reported incidents mostly over payment problems, said no police reports were filed, noted that the reported assault turned out not to be physical, and refused to expel offenders or halt asylum, citing legal rights and existing security measures.
Of those 7 incidents, according to Qbuzz no report and/or complaint was filed with the police.
Van die 7 incidenten is volgens Qbuzz geen melding en/of aangifte gedaan bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht dat het financieel steunen van IS niet wordt bestraft

PVV MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked the Justice Minister about the Limburg court's acquittal of two suspects on terrorism financing and participation in a terrorist organisation, and whether judges should be dismissed or elected. Minister Grapperhaus declined to comment on the specific case, said the public prosecution service will appeal, and rejected dismissing judges over a ruling or changing the law because the judiciary is independent.

In the Netherlands we have an independent judiciary; this means among other things that judges are not elected and that judges cannot be dismissed if the content of their ruling is unwelcome to parties or others.

In Nederland kennen we een onafhankelijke rechterlijke macht; dat betekent onder meer dat rechters niet worden gekozen en dat rechters niet kunnen worden ontslagen als de inhoud van hun uitspraak partijen of anderen onwelgevallig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht dat een asielzoeker is aangeklaagd voor zeven moordpogingen

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports that an asylum seeker was charged with seven attempted murders at an asylum centre, asking why he was admitted and not detained, and whether borders should be closed. The State Secretary declined to comment on individual cases, said reducing crime and nuisance is a priority with measures already taken, and referred to earlier answers on closing borders to asylum seekers.
As your House is aware, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over het bericht dat de aanpak van zware asielcriminaliteit ernstig faalt

PVV MPs Wilders and Markuszower asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security why serious crime by asylum seekers is rising, why borders stay open, and whether offenders will be expelled and detained. The State Secretary confirmed the rise for the group in COA reception centres, gave conviction figures for Algerian, Moroccan and Tunisian residents, rejected closing the borders as unrealistic, and said expulsion for nuisance is limited by national and international law while enforcement continues.
For the immigration enforcement approach I am bound by national and international laws and regulations.
Voor de vreemdelingrechtelijke aanpak ben ik gebonden aan (inter)nationale wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het weggeven van 10.000 Nederlandse paspoorten aan gelukszoekers

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security why 10,000 former Ranov-permit holders were being given Dutch passports despite lacking identity documents, and whether this attracts asylum seekers and criminals. The State Secretary rejected the characterisations, said naturalisation conditions and the rule that doubtful identity or nationality leads to refusal still apply, and explained a categorical exemption based on a WODC/IND study; he could not say how many had lied about identity or how many were criminals, pointing to existing public-order criteria and withdrawal rules.
The number of persons who lied about their personal details when granted residence rights is unknown.
Het aantal personen dat bij het verstrekken van het verblijfsrecht heeft gelogen over hun persoonsgegevens is onbekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Kops over het bericht dat er weer miljoenen worden uitgetrokken voor de huisvesting van asielzoekers

MPs Markuszower and Kops asked whether millions spent on renovating the Gilze asylum centre and on housing for asylum seekers, including a EUR 50 million housing scheme, is justified given the Dutch housing shortage. The government answered that the renovation maintains monumental COA buildings and that the EUR 50 million scheme is mostly unearmarked, serves several priority groups, and eases pressure on social housing, while refusing to end asylum reception.
Of this amount, EUR 3 million is specifically earmarked for developing so-called interim facilities.
Van dit bedrag is € 3 miljoen specifiek bestemd voor het ontwikkelen van zogeheten tussenvoorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Markuszower over het mét subsidie huisvesten van grote statushoudersgezinnen

MPs Kops and Markuszower (PVV) asked why municipalities receive subsidies to house large refugee-status-holder families, calling it absurd and unfair to Dutch housing seekers. The State Secretary defended the scheme as necessary because large families stay too long in COA reception, and refused to end it or to have refugees find housing abroad.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over de explosieve stijging van het aantal gelukszoekers dat wekelijks Nederland binnenstroomt

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether weekly asylum inflow of 400 to 700 people in weeks 22 to 25 of 2021 was unacceptable, whether weekly inflow should be zero, and whether borders should be closed to asylum seekers and migrants from Islamic countries. The State Secretary rejected the characterisation, attributed the recent rise to easing of COVID-19 travel restrictions, said the inflow is monitored and it will act if warranted, and refused to close borders, referring to earlier answers.
The inflow is closely monitored and action will be taken when this is deemed appropriate.
De instroom wordt nauwgezet gevolgd en daarop wordt geacteerd wanneer dit aangewezen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht dat journalist Ans Boersma schuldig is aan valsheid in geschrifte, maar geen straf krijgt

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a court ruling finding journalist Ans Boersma guilty of forgery related to a visa for a Syrian militant figure but imposing no penalty, and about how terrorists obtain visas and whether minimum sentences should be introduced. The minister declined to comment on the individual ruling and the damages, said the government opposes minimum sentences to protect judicial discretion, and explained visa screening rules without giving case numbers.
It is not appropriate for me to pass judgment on a judicial ruling.
Het past mij niet om een oordeel te vellen over een rechterlijke uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over de delicten die Bredanaar J. B. onder toezicht van de Reclassering pleegde

An MP asks the minister whether the government knew, when answering questions in October 2017, that a supervised offender had committed a rape a week before a stabbing, and whether Reclassering supervision failed, and asks about sentencing and minimum sentences. The minister denies failed supervision, says the earlier offence was unknown at the time, declines to detail the individual case, and rejects minimum sentences.
It is not appropriate for me to go into detail on an individual case.
Het past mij niet om in detail in te gaan op een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over het bericht dat een asielzoeker uit Libië dreigde dat Christenen moesten worden vermoord en nu spoorloos verdwenen is

PVV MPs Wilders and Markuszower asked why a Libyan asylum seeker convicted for threats against Christians disappeared, why he received only a two-week sentence, why he was not held or deported, and whether his photo was circulated. The Secretary of State declined to comment on the individual case, explained the general vigilance and detention and publication rules, and said a two-week sentence alone does not justify refusing or revoking asylum status.
As you know, I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Zoals u weet kan ik over individuele zaken geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht dat in Deelen in Gelderland een AZC komt met 200 asielzoekers en huisvesting voor 400 arbeidsmigranten

MPs Heinen and Aartsen asked the ministers of Finance and Social Affairs whether bonus rules at Booking.com were changed and whether such bonuses are acceptable for a company receiving state aid. Minister Koolmees answered that bonuses and dividends during NOW support are undesirable, that NOW4 will require consultation with employee representatives on bonus and dividend policy, that Booking.com has repaid its NOW advance, and that no change to the regulatory framework is planned beyond raising concerns with the European Commission.
I have no insight into the amount of bonuses paid by companies.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de hoogte van bonussen van bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht dat een asielzoeker uit Iran in korte tijd meerdere meisjes heeft aangerand

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary about reports that an Iranian asylum seeker committed multiple sexual assaults, why he had not been deported after a prior conviction, and whether he would be removed after serving his sentence. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, stated that sexual offences are unacceptable and that the courts decide on sanctions, and explained the legal conditions under which asylum residence permits can be refused or withdrawn.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals u bekend kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over de berichten ‘Complete pakketreizen met als doel een al dan niet succesvolle asielaanvraag in Nederland’ en ‘Vooral Syriërs met valse documenten’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports of all-in travel packages from Syria to the Netherlands for asylum fraud, and whether fraudulent asylum seekers should be expelled, residence permits revoked, and borders closed. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the Netherlands has become a smuggling paradise, gave prosecution figures for 2020, said dual nationality is not a basis for action, declined to give numbers on fraud-based permits, and described existing revocation and criminal procedures without committing to closing borders.
It is not possible to provide figures on the number of residence permits that may have been granted on the basis of false or forged identity or nationality documents and/or statements.
Het is niet mogelijk om cijfers te geven over het aantal verblijfsvergunningen die mogelijk op basis van valse of vervalste identiteits- of nationaliteitsdocumenten en/of verklaringen zijn verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht dat in Budel in Brabant inwoners de stelende asielzoekers uit het AZC zo zat zijn dat zij een burgerwacht hebben gevormd

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security whether residents forming neighbourhood patrols in Budel over nuisance by asylum seekers should be seen as proof of failed asylum policy, and whether the government would detain and deport offenders and reward the patrol volunteers. The State Secretary answered that these are neighbourhood prevention teams aimed at general safety, that the municipality supports them, that detention depends on legal grounds handled by prosecutors, police and courts, and that she visits municipalities regularly.
There is no question of a neighbourhood watch but of neighbourhood prevention teams.
Er is geen sprake van een buurtwacht maar van buurtpreventieteams.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over de gruwelijke overval in de woning van PSV-spits Zahavi

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister about a violent home robbery at PSV striker Zahavi's residence, including whether there was an anti-Jewish motive, the arrest and prosecution rates for home robberies, typical sentences and whether Parliament would be informed. The minister declined details on the ongoing criminal investigation and sentencing averages, provided national statistics on home robberies, and confirmed an anti-Jewish dimension is being investigated.
As long as the criminal investigation in this individual case is ongoing, I cannot provide further substantive information about it.
Zolang het strafrechtelijk onderzoek in deze individuele zaak loopt, kan ik daarover geen nadere inhoudelijke mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Fors lagere straf voor doodschieten Bas van Wijk’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a court sentence of nine years for the fatal shooting of Bas van Wijk, which was far below the prosecution's demand, and whether a procedural error by the prosecution contributed to it. The minister defended judicial independence, said the court's sentence can still have deterrent effect, acknowledged a partial nullification of the indictment that may have lowered the sentence, noted that the prosecution has appealed, and saw no reason for further action.
The prosecution regrets the omission in this case.
Het OM betreurt de omissie in dit geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht ‘Beruchte NSB’ers kochten Joodse huizen op in Arnhem’

Two PVV MPs asked ministers about reports that NSB members bought up Jewish houses in Arnhem during the war, asking how much property Arnhem seized, for a full restitution overview, for restitution of looted property, and for investigation of municipal and professional roles. The government answered that Arnhem's own investigation is ongoing, that no federal additional research or restitution is planned, and that post-war restitution was already addressed through the 2000 compensation fund.
This investigation is complex because much administration was lost, partly due to the destruction of Arnhem in the last year of the war.
Dit onderzoek is complex, omdat veel administratie verloren is gegaan, onder meer door de verwoesting van Arnhem in het laatste oorlogsjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Markuszower over kinderrechters die de noodklok luiden over de situatie van de jeugdzorg in Zeeland

PVV MPs asked whether judges' warnings that no youth care provider in Zeeland can take on court-ordered child protection cases, causing long waits, mean children are left without help, and what the government will do. The minister answers that new measures can still be assigned, but some children wait for a fixed case manager, with interim safety arrangements; a taskforce and a takeover of Intervence are underway, and the government says it will not take over regie.
Under the Youth Act, municipalities are responsible for implementing youth protection and youth probation.
Gemeenten zijn conform de Jeugdwet verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van jeugdbescherming en -reclassering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en De Graaf over het bericht dat het CBS gaat stoppen met onderscheid maken tussen een ‘westerse’ en ‘niet-westerse’ achtergrond

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether abandoning the 'western' versus 'non-western' background classification by Statistics Netherlands (CBS) hides immigration problems, and urged the CBS to be called to order. The government replied that the CBS will keep recording origin and migration background, that the categories lost meaning, and that the minister will not interfere with the CBS's statistical categorisation because it is an independent administrative body.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het feit dat er gewoon reisbureaus zijn die zich specialiseren in leuke reizen naar Ethiopië terwijl nog steeds mensen uit dit land asiel aanvragen in Nederland

PVV MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked whether it is absurd that Ethiopians seek asylum in the Netherlands while travel agencies sell holidays to Ethiopia, and whether all Ethiopian asylum seekers can therefore return, and whether borders should be closed to them. The State Secretary answered that asylum claims are assessed individually against the country situation, that tourist access does not equal absence of risk, that the general asylum report is being considered for implications, and that closing borders is not a realistic solution.
I am considering the implications for national asylum policy and expect to inform the House shortly.
Ik ben mij aan het beraden over de implicaties voor het landgebonden asielbeleid. Ik verwacht de Kamer daarover op korte termijn te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht dat de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND) het afgelopen jaar bijna 50.000 vreemdelingen de Nederlandse nationaliteit heeft gegeven

An MP from the PVV asked whether naturalisations of about 50,000 foreigners, many Syrians who arrived in 2015, should be reversed, Syrians returned, and nationality revocation pursued. The State Secretary answered that the security situation in Syria has not substantially improved, that return is not initiated by the government, a new general country report is awaited, and that the European Convention on Nationality prohibits revoking nationality for these reasons.
I will inform your House in due course whether there is reason to change the asylum policy towards Syria.
Ik zal uw Kamer te zijner tijd informeren of er aanleiding bestaat het asielbeleid ten aanzien van Syrië te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht dat er een Syrische terreurverdachte is opgepakt in een AZC in Friesland

Two PVV MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how a Syrian terror suspect arrested in a Friesland asylum centre could enter the Netherlands and remain free, and whether migration screening can rule out further terrorists. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case because of an ongoing criminal investigation, described the layered screening and monitoring in the asylum chain, and rejected preventive detention of Syrian asylum seekers and border closure while supporting a strengthened Schengen.
As you know, I do not make statements about individual cases.
Zoals u weet doe ik over individuele zaken geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Kops over het bericht dat 11.000 vergunninghouders in de tweede helft van dit jaar een woning moeten krijgen

PVV MPs Markuszower and Kops asked why about 11,000 asylum permit holders should receive housing within six months when Dutch citizens wait years, and whether they should be denied housing and borders closed. The minister replied that asylum protection is required by law, that housing allocation is handled by municipalities under a half-yearly quota, that no nationality-based distinction is made, and that closing borders is not a realistic solution.
No distinction is made in the Netherlands on the basis of nationality.
Er wordt in Nederland geen onderscheid gemaakt op basis van nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht dat een levensgevaarlijke asielcrimineel weer op vrije voeten is gezet en zo een slachtpartij kon aanrichten in een AZC

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why a Nigerian asylum seeker arrested a week earlier for violence was released a day later and then allegedly carried out a stabbing at an asylum centre, and whether he would be punished, deported and whether an asylum stop and closure of centres would be introduced. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, said the police and Public Prosecution Service handle criminal matters, referred to a forthcoming incident report for statistics, and did not agree to an asylum stop.
As your House is aware, I cannot comment on individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Lagere straffen slijterij-moord'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that appellate courts reduced sentences for a murder-related case because the prosecution and courts exceeded the reasonable time limit, and asked about sentencing norms, data on sentence reductions and whether murderers are being 'rewarded' for delays. The minister confirmed the overrun, explained the Supreme Court's sentence-reduction framework, said the judiciary does not register such reductions so no quarterly data will be shared, and stated the judiciary is working to clear backlogs.
The Judiciary and the Public Prosecution Service do not keep records of exceedances of the reasonable time limit and of the consequences attached to them in a specific criminal case.
De Rechtspraak en het Openbaar Ministerie houden geen registratie bij van overschrijdingen van de redelijke termijn en de gevolgen die daaraan in een specifieke strafzaak zijn verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Markuszower over het bericht ‘Asielzoekers (14, 15 en 16) aangehouden na gewelddadige inbraak Oisterwijk’

PVV MPs asked whether juveniles aged 14-16 who commit serious crimes should always be tried under adult criminal law, for statistics on asylum-seeking minors suspected of crimes, for expulsion of convicted asylum seekers and their families, and for closing borders and asylum centres. The State Secretary replied that the juvenile justice system is sufficiently equipped, promised a conference on maximum penalties, said data for 2015-2017 would require detailed research and 2020 figures will appear in the Staat van Migratie, stated that return will be pursued where grounds exist (without discussing individual files), and rejected closing borders as unrealistic.
Of course, due to the Personal Data Protection Act I cannot go into the individual files.
Natuurlijk kan ik vanwege de wet bescherming persoonsgegevens niet in gaan op de individuele dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Tbs met dwangverpleging geëist tegen moordenaar van Rik van de Rakt

MP Markuszower asks why the Public Prosecution Service demanded a treatment order rather than prison for the killer of 18-year-old Rik van de Rakt, whether officials who failed should be dismissed, and whether minimum sentences should be introduced. The minister replies that the prosecution is independent, that TBS aims at treatment and safe reintegration, that the municipality's inquiry found information was shared within legal limits, that various reforms have been implemented, and that minimum sentences are rejected to protect judicial discretion.
The Public Prosecution Service is independent in determining the sentencing demand in criminal cases.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (hierna: OM) is onafhankelijk in het bepalen van de strafeis in strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'OM: Incident Akwasi heeft geen juridische gevolgen'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether public prosecutors should pursue presenter Akwasi for theft, threats and intimidation over a media incident, and accused the prosecution service of political and corrupt non-prosecution. The Minister replied that the prosecution service decided independently not to prosecute, citing the broadcaster's refusal to cooperate and insufficient evidence, and rejected the suggestion of political bias.
The decision of the Public Prosecution Service not to prosecute Mr Akwasi is an autonomous decision.
De beslissing van het Openbaar Ministerie om de heer Akwasi niet te vervolgen betreft een autonome beslissing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Kuiken, Markuszower en Voordewind over de poging van het Koninklijk Huis om een strafzaak te beïnvloeden

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister and Justice Minister about alleged attempts by circles around the Royal House to influence the Poch criminal case, leaks from the investigation, and withheld Argentine legal-aid documents. The minister answered that the Commission Poch found no confirmation of the alleged influence, that a leak prosecution is likely time-barred, and that the archive documents will be assessed for release under Article 68 of the Constitution after the Commission is dissolved.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht 'Gevangenis Vught verdacht van financiering terrorisme'

MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked how the Vught prison could transfer money to convicted terrorist Mohammed D., whether staff should be disciplined, and whether terrorist prisoners should be denied purchases and any money. The Minister says a 2019 exemption from the terrorism sanctions regime allows limited payments for prisoners, that the Public Prosecution Service investigates possible violations, and that he sees no need for a full structural restriction; he declines to comment on Mohammed D.'s individual case.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Meer dan 160 enkelbanden uit de lucht door netwerkstoring’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a network outage that took over 160 ankle monitors offline, including whether wearers knew, whether offenders were among them, whether sabotage or crimes occurred, and whether the ankle monitor should be abolished. The minister explained that wearers are not alerted, that location data is stored during outages, that no sabotage or violations were recorded, and that new dual-SIM bands are being rolled out by May 2021.
Answering this question precisely would require case-file research for each ankle monitor wearer, involving several organisations, to retrieve this data.
Het precies beantwoorden van deze vraag zou per enkelbanddrager dossieronderzoek vergen, waarbij meerdere organisaties betrokken zijn, om deze gegevens te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Verdachte fatale mishandeling Jan (73) uit Arnhem sloeg ook oud-dominee (68) in elkaar: ‘Hij haalde vol uit’’

An MP asks the Minister of Justice why a suspect in a fatal assault on a 73-year-old man had earlier been a suspect in a case involving an 68-year-old former minister, why police visited the victim only after seven weeks, and whether the prosecution's dropping of that case was a blunder, and asks for harsher treatment of juvenile violent offenders. The minister confirms the earlier case was dismissed and that police contacted the victim promptly, declines to comment on the individual case, and rejects abolishing juvenile criminal law or introducing minimum sentences.
As Minister, I must exercise restraint in answering parliamentary questions that concern an individual case.
Als Minister past mij terughoudendheid bij de beantwoording van Kamervragen die een individuele zaak betreffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Mohammed B. opnieuw door het lint in de gevangenis’

PVV MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a 2019 prison incident in which two terrorism detainees damaged a gym, causing about 34,000 euro in damage, and why the news came out a year later, and whether terrorist detainees should be fully isolated, moved to the EBI, and deported. The minister said the incident was published in the October 2019 monthly incident overview, that one detainee was punished and reported while the other was punished without a report, and rejected full isolation and a higher security regime as unnecessary and contrary to human rights law, saying deportation of a non-resident is pursued via the return service with a long entry ban.
The newspaper report concerns an incident that took place on 20 September 2019.
Het krantenbericht gaat over een incident dat plaatsvond op 20 september 2019.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Fritsma en Markuszower over de beroerde informatievoorziening aan de Tweede Kamer inzake de inspectie van een koopvaardijschip door marineschip de Zr. Ms. De Ruyter

PVV MPs asked the Justice, Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers why information on the Dutch navy's boarding of a merchant ship (Zr. Ms. De Ruyter) was withheld, and asked about the legal basis, the cargo, sanctions and links to Operation Irini. Minister Grapperhaus refused details citing an ongoing criminal investigation, cited the Criminal Code as legal basis, denied any link to Irini, and promised to inform parliament once possible.
As is customary, your House will be informed as soon as the still ongoing criminal investigation allows for this.
Zoals te doen gebruikelijk zal uw Kamer worden geïnformeerd zodra daar gezien het thans nog lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek de mogelijkheid toe bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Markuszower en De Graaf over het bericht 'Greenpeace gooit opnieuw keien op zeebodem: 'Levensgevaarlijke actie''

PVV MPs asked whether Greenpeace dumping boulders on the North Sea bed endangers fishers, whether this should be prosecuted as attempted murder or manslaughter, why the Dutch flag can be kept, and whether Greenpeace can be banned. The Minister replied that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, which is examining the matter, that the flag cannot be withdrawn under Dutch law, and that only a court on Public Prosecution Service request can dissolve an organisation.
A judgement on the criminality of this conduct is for the Public Prosecution Service.
Een oordeel over de strafbaarheid van dit handelen is aan het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht “Klokkenluider Huig Plug: ‘De bezem moet door het hele Ministerie Justitie en Veiligheid!’’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that DJI incident lists are incomplete, a prison cell fire not being listed, a complaint by medical staff against the Inspectorate J&V, and whether a judge may also serve as a prison director. The minister answered that piketmeldingen are only made for serious or media-sensitive incidents, that the full incident data 2016-2019 and periodic reports are published, and that the complaint and IGJ investigation are being handled.
I am of the view that together this provides a sufficient overview of the seriousness, numbers and development of incidents within DJI institutions, and I will therefore suffice with this.
Ik ben van mening dat dit samen voldoende overzicht geeft in de ernst, de aantallen en de ontwikkeling van incidenten binnen de inrichtingen van DJI en volsta daar dan ook mee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Criminelen tarten justitie: weer meer enkelbanden doorgeknipt'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of rising ankle monitor sabotage, how many monitored people committed offences, the status of seven fugitives who cut their bands, and whether serious offenders should be barred from monitors or monitors abolished as a substitute for prison. The minister declined to discuss individual cases, gave aggregate figures, said sabotage statistics will be published in early 2021, and defended the monitor as a control tool while promising a sturdier band and a file analysis.
It does not befit me to go into individual cases.
Het past mij niet om in te gaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en de Jong over het bericht; ‘Shannon ziet de beelden nog voor zich: “Mijn dochter werd mishandeld op de crèche”

MPs Markuszower and De Jong asked about a report of a child abused at a daycare centre, the status of a motion for a lifetime ban on working with children for offenders, and whether people who settled civilly with victims should lose their VOG. The minister said the motion is sufficiently implemented via criminal-law occupational bans and VOG screening, and that civil settlements are not registered and cannot be used in VOG screening.
For this reason, I consider the motion concerning the protection of minors through an occupational ban to be sufficiently implemented.
Om deze reden acht ik de motie die ziet op het beschermen van minderjarigen via een beroepsverbod, voldoende uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Wilders, Markuszower en Graus over heksenjacht door NVWA

MPs De Roon, Wilders, Markuszower and Graus asked whether the government instructed the NVWA to target the Israel Producten Centrum over labelling of wine from Judea and Samaria, and why Israel is treated differently from other countries. Minister Blok answered that the NVWA acts on complaints under EU origin-labelling rules applied equally to all countries, and that a binding CJEU ruling requires settlement-origin labelling.
No. Following a complaint received, the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA) carried out an inspection in April 2019.
Nee. Naar aanleiding van een binnengekomen klacht heeft de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) in april 2019 een inspectie uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht 'A. broedt op derde aanval'

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Justice whether a Syrian asylum seeker who had twice attacked a Jewish restaurant could be deported, whether prosecutors were too lenient in the first case, and what measures would prevent a third attack. The Minister said the residence permit will be reviewed by the IND after conviction and deportation is not currently possible due to the Syrian security situation, declined to comment on the pending case, and pointed to existing police and municipal measures.
Moreover, I understand that the Public Prosecution Service is currently still investigating whether there is reason to also charge a terrorist intent in the current trial.
Overigens heb ik begrepen dat het OM op dit moment nog onderzoekt of er aanleiding bestaat om in de huidige rechtszaak ook een terroristisch oogmerk ten laste te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht ‘Kolossale fouten gemaakt bij terugkeer tbs’er Michel B.’

PVV MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of serious failures in the Oostvaarderskliniek's supervision of tbs patient Michel B. and whether other tbs patients are adequately monitored, and asked for the draft inspectorate report and a suspension of all tbs leave. The minister declined to share the draft report pending the final version, expected in autumn, said leave is a safe, essential part of tbs treatment, and refused to suspend leave.
The Inspectorate JenV report is still in draft form and is currently under embargo for hearing of the parties involved.
Het rapport van de Inspectie JenV bevindt zich nog in de conceptfase, en ligt nu onder embargo voor wederhoor voor bij betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht 'Irakees die zijn Friese vrouw voor ogen van hun kinderen doodde alweer vrij'

PVV MPs asked why an Iraqi man who killed his Frisian wife in front of their children was released so quickly by Iraqi authorities, and called for entry bans and an end to asylum for nationals of countries such as Iraq. The State Secretary said Iraq's prosecution is an internal matter he cannot judge, that Nederland uses Article 1F to exclude criminals from asylum, and that asylum claims must be assessed individually rather than halted by country.
At the same time, in my view it is not for a minister to pass judgment on the prosecution of a criminal offence.
Tegelijkertijd is het naar mijn mening niet aan een bewindspersoon om een oordeel uit te spreken over de berechting van een strafbaar feit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht ‘Neonazi Heerlen’

PVV MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked the Justice Minister whether the German-Iraqi neo-Nazi Fadi J. and his party, who called for killing Jews, should be prosecuted, expelled, and whether the government tolerates violence against Jews. The minister answered that prosecution is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service, expulsion for the courts, and that a general conclusion cannot be drawn from one case.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to make such decisions, not for me as Minister of Justice and Security.
Het is aan het OM om dergelijke beslissingen te nemen, niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Politie dringend op zoek naar ontsnapte tbs’er’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why a tbs (forensic psychiatric) patient who absconded from a resocialisation unit while on unsupervised leave was granted leave, when his full name was only released after weeks, how dangerous he is, how many tbs patients absconded or reoffended in 2020, and whether public safety should outweigh his liberty. The minister answered that leave is granted only when treatment and safety allow, with binding advice from the independent AVT, that police and prosecutors release names only after other search methods fail, that he was arrested on 26 August, that 15 absconsions and 2 escapes occurred in 2020 (all found), and that no reoffending data for 2020 exists.
Leave is only granted if the treatment permits it.
Verlof wordt alleen toegekend als de behandeling dit toelaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Geadopteerden ontevreden over onderzoek’

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister for Legal Protection about criticism of the independent commission investigating illegal intercountry adoptions, including doubts about members with former state ties, the reliability of interview reports, the small number of adoptees heard, and promised document disclosure. The Minister rejects the criticism, defends the commission's independence and expertise, says the commission decides whom to hear and how reports are verified, and declines to disclose documents beyond what the Wob permits.
It is up to the commission to determine whom it must hear in order to carry out this assignment.
Het is aan de commissie om te bepalen wie zij moet horen ten behoeve van de uitvoering van deze opdracht.

Antwoord op schriftelijke vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over “het bericht dat vier van de vijf gemeenten niet weten of ‘tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog Joods vastgoed is onteigend en doorverkocht terwijl dat

MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked ministers whether the government will map all looted Jewish property during WWII, return unlawfully collected taxes and fees, and open the Nederlands Beheersinstituut archives. The government replied that the Kordes commission and the 2000 settlement already addressed postwar restitution, that no new investigation or restitution is planned, and that most Verkaufsbücher archive material is already digitised and open.
In view of the outcomes of this research and the government's response, there is no reason to conduct new research into looted real estate.
Gezien de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek en de reactie van het kabinet is er geen aanleiding om opnieuw onderzoek te doen naar geroofd onroerend goed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht ‘Ruit ingeslagen bij restaurant HaCarmel: ‘Het begint bijna gewoon te worden’’

PVV MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked why the 100-metre exclusion order on the Syrian asylum-seeker suspected of attacking restaurant HaCarmel was apparently not enforced, and whether the government was responsible. Minister Grapperhaus replied that police did enforce the order with intensive surveillance when warranted and municipal cameras, that the suspect is in pre-trial detention, and that any residence-permit withdrawal and deportation will follow normal procedures, with forced return currently not possible due to the Syrian security situation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, Markuszower en Wilders over een massale vechtpartij in AZC Budel

PVV MPs asked why only one asylum seeker was arrested after a mass brawl at AZC Budel involving about 100 residents, whether all rioters would be jailed and deported, and whether the centre and all AZCs should be closed and an asylum stop imposed. The State Secretary said about 15 people were directly or indirectly involved, declined to comment on the ongoing criminal investigation, and rejected closing the centres or borders, noting COA can impose sanctions under the ROV.
While the criminal investigation is ongoing, I cannot provide further information on the outcome of this investigation.
Gedurende het lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoek kan ik geen verdere mededelingen doen over de uitkomst van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Popken en Markuszower over een inspectie door het marineschip Zr. Ms. De Ruyter

MPs De Roon, Popken and Markuszower asked whether the frigate De Ruyter carried out a ship inspection over a possible sanctions violation, which vessel and flag were involved, what evidence existed, and with whom findings were shared. The government confirmed the inspection, said details could not be disclosed because a criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service is ongoing and shared findings only with that service, and declined to give operational details of the ship's operations.
As you know, as Minister of Justice and Security I do not make substantive statements about an ongoing criminal investigation.
Zoals bij u bekend doe ik als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid geen inhoudelijke mededelingen over een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Markuszower en Wilders over Hezbollah en ammoniumnitraat

Three PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Hezbollah stored ammonium nitrate and about threats by its leader, and whether the Beirut explosion's chemicals belonged to Hezbollah and how to undermine the group internationally. The minister replied that the Beirut blast was an accident involving seized substances, that the Netherlands supports independent international investigation, and that Hezbollah's military wing has been on the EU terrorist list since 2013 while the Dutch push for listing the political wing lacks support.
The Netherlands strongly advocates thorough, independent international investigation into the explosion and is exploring contributing technical expertise to it.
Nederland maakt zich hard voor gedegen, onafhankelijk internationaal onderzoek naar de explosie en onderzoekt de mogelijkheid om hieraan bij te dragen met technische expertise.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Verdachte zaak-Maddie verbleef in Nederland’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether a German convicted offender suspected in the Madeleine McCann case stayed in the Netherlands, what Dutch authorities knew, and whether convicted sex and violent offenders can travel or live abroad. The minister declined to give case details due to an ongoing foreign criminal investigation, but explained the legal options to restrict travel of Dutch sex offenders and noted that EU free movement limits restrictions on foreign convicts.
There is an ongoing criminal investigation abroad.
Er is sprake van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Gevangene Sittard overleden aan overdosis drugs’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a prisoner in Sittard could die of a drug overdose, how drugs entered the prison, and whether the anti-smuggling measures had failed and staff should be dismissed. The minister confirmed the death, said the investigation could not establish how drugs entered, declined to discuss the individual case, saw no reason for dismissals, and pointed to additional measures and a forthcoming policy letter.
Because this is an individual case, I will not go into the specific circumstances of the detention and the death.
Omdat het een individuele zaak betreft, ga ik niet nader in op de specifieke omstandigheden van de detentie en het overlijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Gewelddadige tbs’er Hendrik M. neemt wederom de benen, zoekactie gestart’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why a violent TBS patient who absconded during unsupervised leave was not yet found, why no police bulletin was issued, and whether all leave for violent TBS patients should be withdrawn. The minister explained that the patient was arrested on 9 June, that a photo was published instead of a bulletin, and rejected withdrawing all leave, arguing leave is essential to treatment.
During a TBS measure, every leave request is thoroughly assessed by an internal committee of a TBS clinic.
Gedurende een tbs-maatregel wordt elke verlofaanvraag grondig getoetst door een interne commissie van een tbs-kliniek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Sjoerdsma, Sneller, Markuszower, Kuiken, Buitenweg en Wassenberg over nieuwe onthullingen in de zaak van Julio Poch

MPs asked the Justice Minister about new revelations in the Poch case, including whether the Royal House was informed, why a 2008 travel journal and a 2009 ministerial note were not sent to parliament, and on what legal basis documents are withheld during an ongoing inquiry. The minister answered that the Royal House question is part of the Machielse commission's remit, that the journal was handed to the commission, and that the 2009 note was shared confidentially with parliament, while declining to release further documents during the inquiry to protect its independence.
Given the importance of establishing the truth, however, I am reluctant to provide separate documents during the ongoing inquiry.
Gezien het belang van de waarheidsvinding ben ik echter terughoudend met het verstrekken van separate documenten tijdens het lopende onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Hof moet na hardhandige arrestatie Michael P. weer kijken naar straf’

An MP asked the Justice Minister to act against an advocate-general who advised a reduced sentence for Michael P. after his violent arrest, and asked whether police officers should be prosecuted or honoured. The minister answered that the advocate-general acts independently, that the prosecution service decides on prosecution and sentencing demands, and that dismissal is outside his role.
Given the separation of powers, it is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to judge the independent advice of an advocate-general at the Supreme Court.
Gelet op de scheiding der machten is het niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om te oordelen over onafhankelijke adviezen van een advocaat-generaal bij de Hoge Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Wilders en Markuszower over Iraniërs die dreigen met de vernietiging van historische Joodse graftombes

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he would publicly condemn the arson at the Jewish tomb of Esther and Mordechai in Iran, whether he still considered it adequately protected, and whether he would press Iran to protect it. The minister said the Netherlands regularly raises antisemitism concerns with Iran, that local authorities opened an investigation, and that the Supreme Leader's threatening rhetoric is unacceptable, but gave no commitment beyond continued diplomatic engagement.
The Netherlands regularly raises concerns about antisemitism and anti-Zionism in Iran in talks with the Iranian authorities and will continue to do so.
Nederland brengt met regelmaat zorgen over antisemitisme en antizionisme in Iran over in gesprekken met de Iraanse autoriteiten en zal dit blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het weigeren van de rechtbank Zeeland-West-Brabant locatie Breda om gedenkplaten te plaatsen

MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked why the Zeeland-West-Brabant court (Breda location) refuses to install commemorative plaques for Jewish judges murdered in WWII, as exist in Amsterdam and The Hague. The Minister replied that the judiciary independently decides on such memorials, that the court found no evidence of Jewish staff victims in its archives, and that the Minister will not engage the court.
The judiciary has the authority to independently decide whether or not to place a memorial.
De Rechtspraak heeft de bevoegdheid om zelfstandig te beslissen over het al dan niet plaatsen van een gedenkteken

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Emiel van Dijk over het bericht dat de Eritreeër die tot 6 jaar cel en TBS veroordeeld is voor doodslag, verkrachting en mishandeling van een oudere dame in Amsterdam, welli

MPs Markuszower and Emiel van Dijk asked whether an Eritrean sentenced to six years and TBS for manslaughter, rape and assault could be guaranteed deportation and loss of residence after serving his sentence, and whether that matches earlier statements by the state secretary. The state secretary declined to comment on the individual case, said the IND will decide on revoking the residence permit once the conviction is final, and said public safety is a primary consideration.
I will not go into the substance of individual cases and cannot anticipate the IND's decision or the course of the TBS treatment.
Ik ga niet in op de inhoud van individuele zaken en kan ook niet vooruitlopen op de beslissing van de IND of het verloop van de behandeling in het TBS-traject.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Markuszower en Wilders over Erdogan die dreigt politieke tegenstanders in Europa te kidnappen of vermoorden

MPs De Roon, Markuszower and Wilders asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers whether Erdogan's reported threats to kidnap or kill political opponents in Europe were known, how many Turkish extradition requests Netherlands received since 2016, and what measures were taken. The government said it knows of reports on repatriation of Turkish nationals from third countries, has no indication of Turkish kidnapping teams active in the Netherlands, and that police and prosecutors are alert and urge victims to file complaints.
The cabinet currently has no indication that Turkish abduction teams are active in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet heeft op dit moment geen aanwijzing dat er in Nederland Turkse ontvoeringsteams actief zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Markuszower over het bericht dat KLM weigerde mee te werken aan het vertrek van Lili en Howick

MPs Van Dijk and Markuszower asked whether KLM's refusal to fly two Armenian children deported by the Netherlands undermined court rulings, how often airlines have refused deportations, and what the costs are. The State Secretary referred to the Inspectorate's report and its announced measures, said airlines generally cooperate but the captain may refuse passengers for safety reasons, and said the state cannot assess the costs or KLM's reasoning.
I cannot speculate on the considerations KLM made before deciding not to transport the two children.
Ik kan niet speculeren over de afwegingen die de KLM heeft gemaakt voorafgaand aan het besluit de twee kinderen niet te vervoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Wekelijks tbs-geweld’

An MP asked whether incidents of violence in TBS clinics are reported and prosecuted, and whether TBS should be replaced by prison. The minister answered that clinics must report offences and DJI requires complaints for violence against staff, but the OM does not track prosecutions centrally, and defended TBS as more effective than prison for preventing reoffending.
The Public Prosecution Service does not centrally keep track of whether criminal offences have been committed against staff of TBS institutions.
Het Openbaar Ministerie houdt niet centraal bij of strafbare feiten zijn gepleegd tegen medewerkers van tbs-instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over de vrijlating van een gevaarlijk persoon uit de Woenselse Poort

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the release of a dangerous man from the Woenselse Poort TBS clinic, the Reclassering's recidivism assessment, and whether minimum sentences will be introduced. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, denied that anyone was released for non-cooperation, cited existing and pending measures (the straffen en beschermen bill, Wet Langdurig Toezicht, forensic care rules) and rejected minimum sentences as incompatible with judicial sentencing discretion.
It is not appropriate for me to go into this individual case in more detail.
Het past mij niet om op deze individuele casus nader in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Medewerker PI Krimpen bewusteloos na aanval van gedetineerde'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a report that a prison officer at PI Krimpen was knocked unconscious by an inmate, asking how it happened, whether the inmate is still in isolation, and what will be done to restore staff control. The minister confirmed the incident, described the sequence, said the inmate was punished, transferred to a stricter regime and reported for attempted manslaughter, and pointed to a recent letter to parliament on strengthening staff's position.
Violence against staff is unacceptable to me.
Geweld tegen personeel vind ik onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Markuszower en Wilders over de statushouder die een 68 jarige vrouw doodmartelde

MPs from the PVV asked whether the statushouder (refugee status holder) suspected of a fatal assault on a 68-year-old woman would have his residence permit revoked and be deported, how screening failed to catch him, and whether asylum seekers and migrants from Islamic countries should be barred. The minister replied that individual cases are not discussed, outlined the screening and monitoring process, said revocation is limited by EU and refugee-convention rules and that the government will not categorically close borders.
In principle I make no statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doe ik in beginsel geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Onduidelijkheid over blokkeermoslims’

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister why the Public Prosecution Service acted quickly against 'blokkeerfriezen' but not against 'blokkeermoslims' who disrupted a demonstration, and whether he would instruct prosecution and guarantee the right to demonstrate. The Minister said a criminal investigation is ongoing and declined to comment on the case, refused to instruct prosecutors in individual cases, and stated that mayors are responsible for maintaining public order under the Public Assembly Act.
There is an ongoing criminal investigation. While this investigation is ongoing, I cannot comment on this criminal case.
Er is sprake van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek. Lopende dit onderzoek kan ik geen uitlatingen doen over deze strafzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Omstreden kliniek opnieuw in de fout met verlof patiënten’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a news report that a clinic in Den Dolder again released patients on leave wrongly, and about how forensic patients' freedoms are restored after the Michael P. case. The minister said the incident involved two civil GGZ patients outside the justice ministry's responsibility, gave the number of forensic patients on leave, and stated that the clinic has learned lessons and that inspectorates are monitoring improvements.
At my request, the inspectorates are keeping a close eye on whether the improvements introduced also take hold.
De inspecties houden op mijn verzoek goed vinger aan de pols om erop toe te zien dat de ingezette verbeteringen ook beklijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Markuszower over de aanpak van een Algerijn die bijna een Groningse held doodstak

PVV MPs Fritsma and Markuszower asked why an Algerian offender who nearly killed a Groningen victim was released rather than deported, and why the victim was given unclear information about the case. The State Secretary acknowledged a Dublin transfer deadline was missed during detention, leading to release after the sentence, and said the offender was later re-detained with a return decision issued, while refusing to rule out an asylum stop and declining to report more on the individual case citing privacy.
Mistakenly, a request for postponement was not made in time to the EU member state responsible, so the transfer could not proceed.
Abusievelijk is nagelaten om tijdig aan de verantwoordelijke EU-lidstaat om uitstel te vragen, waardoor de overdracht geen doorgang kon vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Levenslang gestrafte wil vaker verlof en na 27 jaar vrijkomen’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether life sentences really mean life, whether relief leave and eventual release of a life-sentenced prisoner would harm victims and relatives, and whether the government would prevent this offender from getting leave or release. The minister answered that life means life in principle, that reviewed policy gives life prisoners a prospect of release, that victims and relatives can be heard in the process, and that he cannot comment on a court ruling while advisory bodies still have to advise.
It does not befit me to comment on a court ruling.
Het past mij niet om mij uit te laten over een rechterlijke uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Tien jaar cel en tbs voor doodsteken therapeut tbs-kliniek Kijvelanden’

The MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about a case where a therapist was killed in a tbs clinic by a man already in treatment, questioning the sentence, his leave eligibility, placement in a regular clinic, and why tbs was reimposed. The Minister states that judges independently set sentences, that leave decisions are binding-advised by the independent AVT, declines to discuss the individual case, and gives recidivism statistics and figures on dangerous tbs patients.
I will not go into this individual case.
Ik ga niet in op dit individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over de berichten rond Rinus Otte

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether a reclassering report rating Michael P.'s recidivism risk as high was available to the appeal judge Rinus Otte, whether Otte should be dismissed, and how he can now protect the public. The Minister replies that a report rating risk as high-moderate existed, that the judiciary is independent so he will not judge the verdict, and that judges cannot be held personally accountable for collegial rulings.
It does not befit me as Minister to judge a verdict or the deliberation that took place in that context.
Het past mij als Minister niet om te oordelen over een vonnis of de beraadslaging die in dat kader heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht 'Jihadboeken in bajesbieb/Haatlectuur op bestelling'

Three PVV MPs asked whether Islamic books inciting hatred and violence are available in prisons, how many Islamic chaplains and Muslim prisoners there are, and whether Islamic books should be banned and imams dismissed. The minister answered that detainees may read religious literature unless it threatens order or security, that the director may refuse books inciting discrimination or violence, that DJI employs 43 FTE Islamic chaplains without central registration of detainees' religion, and rejected banning books or dismissing imams.
Detainees are not centrally registered by religion or belief.
