Gedetineerden worden niet centraal geregistreerd op religie of levensbeschouwing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Moordende rapper scoort gouden plaat in de bajes’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a convicted murderer could record a gold-selling album and give a radio interview from prison, and pressed for sanctions, asset seizure, isolation and withdrawal of station funding. The Minister said the prisoner was disciplined with a cell placement for unauthorised media contact, that the prison law allows seizing income only for outstanding fines, and that there is no legal basis to cut FunX's subsidy.
The prisoner in question did not ask for permission for the radio interview about his gold album.
De betreffende gedetineerde heeft voor het radiointerview over zijn gouden plaat geen toestemming gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Ongelooflijk dat tbs’ers in dorp rondlopen’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether tbs (hospital order) patients from De Kijvelanden are allowed to roam freely in Albrandswaard, whether leave for tbs patients should be ended, and for an overview of incidents. The minister replied that leave is carefully staged, assessed by the clinic and the independent AVT advisory committee, that incidents are evaluated, that recidivism figures are low, and that no leave will be ended, while providing incident figures for 2015 to 2018.
Leave is granted carefully and step by step, and is only allowed if it is considered safe.
Verlofverlening vindt zorgvuldig en stapsgewijs plaats en wordt alleen toegestaan indien dat veilig wordt geacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht dat het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) niets doet met een aantal doodsbedreigingen vanuit het buitenland op een Nederlandse politicus

MP Markuszower asks whether the Public Prosecution Service is failing to act on death threats from abroad against an opposition politician, and whether this signals tolerance of such threats. Minister Grapperhaus replies that the threats were investigated by the Team Bedreigde Politici, that there are no indications the senders will come to the Netherlands, and that each case is assessed for all available options.
The Public Prosecution Service has stated that the investigation found no indications at this time that the senders of the threats will come to the Netherlands.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft laten weten dat uit het onderzoek is gekomen dat er op dit moment geen aanwijzingen zijn dat de afzenders van de bedreigingen naar Nederland zullen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Albanese moordenaar ontloopt uitlevering’

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the rule of law is failing because a convicted Albanian murderer may avoid extradition, and whether the ECHR should be denounced. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, said he is still in extradition detention pending a court procedure, and refused to denounce the ECHR, calling human rights essential to the rule of law.
I do not go into details of individual cases.
Op details van individuele zaken ga ik niet in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weerdenburg, De Roon en Markuszower over de financiering van een aanval op onafhankelijke Israëlische rechtspraak

PVV MPs asked whether the Dutch government financed a critical B'Tselem report on Israel's High Court and whether this undermines judicial independence. The minister answered that the EUR 176,000 grant was given under a strategic plan with B'Tselem setting its own research aims and conclusions, that Nederland did not steer the report, and that it does not regard the funding as undermining judicial independence.
There has been no substantive steering by the Netherlands.
Er is geen sprake geweest van inhoudelijke sturing door Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Deskundigen adviseren jeugd-tbs voor verdachte (19) geruchtmakende verkrachtingszaak De Esch’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether a 19-year-old suspect in a violent rape case should be tried under adult criminal law rather than youth law and kept in pre-trial detention, and asked about his prior violent offence. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, explained that judges decide on adolescent criminal law case by case, and said the Public Prosecution Service is independent in these decisions.
I will not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Veel gedetineerden gaan in de cel door met drugshandel, smokkel of afpersing’

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that prisoners continue drug trafficking, smuggling and extortion from prison, questioning the failure to act on GRIP reports, the lack of registration of crimes committed by prisoners, and whether more staff and extra-secure capacity should be provided. The Minister acknowledges the problem, describes an intensified chain approach with DJI, OM and police, promises talks and a response to the DSP-groep study, and states that current EBI capacity suffices.
Continuing criminal activities in and from detention is unacceptable.
Het voortzetten van criminele activiteiten in en vanuit detentie is onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over de berichten betreffende het misbruikschandaal in de atletiekwereld

MP Markuszower asked the Minister of Justice and Security for a timeline of who knew what about abuse in athletics, whether failing to report abuse should be made a crime, and whether victims could report anonymously. The minister declined a timeline citing ongoing criminal investigations, pointed to existing reporting practices, a 2017 convenant and a planned study on widening reporting duties, and described existing and planned privacy measures for victims, though answers were delayed.
I do not make statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over de berichten inzake Bekir A. de vermoedelijke moordenaar van een 16-jarig meisje

The MP Markuszower asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a suspect could approach a 16-year-old victim despite a no-contact order and probation supervision, why he had firearms, and whether the sentence was too lenient, and asked the Minister to instruct prosecutors against suspended sentences for repeat violent offenders. The Minister expressed sympathy, said he cannot comment on the ongoing criminal investigation, noted the victim's first report in May 2018 and that the Inspectorate will investigate the agencies' conduct, and stated that judges rule independently and that suspended sentences with strict conditions can be more effective.
I cannot enter into the judgment of the judge in individual criminal cases.
Ik kan niet in het oordeel van de rechter in individuele strafzaken treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en De Graaf over het bericht ‘Jihad-opruier Mounim A. komt vrij’

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether he would act against judges who released a jihad-inciter and urged administrative detention of jihadists. The minister defended the independence of judges, refused to intervene in individual cases, and rejected administrative detention as unjustified, pointing to criminal-law and other measures instead.
Administrative detention, in the sense of preventive detention without a reasonable suspicion, is not a justified deprivation of liberty.
Administratieve detentie, in de zin van preventieve detentie zonder dat sprake is van een redelijke verdenking, is geen gerechtvaardigde vrijheidsontneming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Helder over het bericht ‘Crimineel liever niet te snel storen’

Two PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister how the rule of law and public safety can be defended when police and prosecutors intervene early against criminals planning violence, and whether preparatory offences should be tightened. The minister answered that police and prosecutors weigh effectiveness and timing case by case, that existing preparation offences (art. 46 Sr) are adequate, and that a bill raises penalties for automatic firearms and criminal organisations.
Are you prepared to amend the law and sharpen the punishable preparatory acts?
Bent u bereid de wet te wijzigen en de strafbare voorbereidingshandelingen aan te scherpen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake het bericht ‘Tbs'er verdacht van verkrachting medewerkster’

MP Markuszower asked whether the government will publish the DJI incident monitor annually, whether assaults by tbs patients on clinic staff are registered, whether clinics always file reports, and whether every tbs patient committing a crime will be prosecuted. The minister answered that serious incidents are published anonymised on the DJI website, that clinics must report and file complaints, and that the OM assesses each complaint for prosecution, without committing to prosecute every offence.
The DJI incident monitor is an internal source used to evaluate these incidents within DJI and learn from them.
De DJI-incidentenmonitor is een interne bron, die wordt gebruikt om deze incidenten binnen DJI te evalueren en hiervan te leren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Agema, De Graaf en Markuszower over de door een prediker gedane uitspraak in een online cursus van de As Soenah moskee te Den Haag, te weten: ‘Vrouwenbesnijdenis is niet verplicht

MPs Wilders, Agema, De Graaf and Markuszower asked about a preacher's statement that female genital cutting is recommended though not mandatory, and how many girls were cut, how many cases were prosecuted, and what subsidised organisations do. The minister answered that prevalence research is under way with results expected mid-2019, that cutting is prosecuted as assault, that cases are not registered separately, and that the government funds an integrated chain approach and will report on it in a progress letter.
It therefore cannot be retrieved from the registers how many court cases of genital mutilation there are.
Het is daarom niet uit de registers te halen om hoeveel rechtszaken van genitale verminking het gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Rechters te makkelijk gewraakt’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the public prosecution service and judges jointly pushed to restrict the right to challenge judges (wraking), and whether recent Supreme Court rulings and this push undermine judicial impartiality and require legislation. The Minister answered that the College and Raad had written to him about more flexibility in handling challenge requests, that the Supreme Court rulings fit current law and do not call for amendment, and that he will consider legal options later and inform the House once that is done.
The Supreme Court rules that challenging judges in criminal cases is not possible on the ground that they made unwelcome (interim) decisions.
De Hoge Raad oordeelt daarin dat wraking van rechters in strafzaken niet mogelijk is op de grond dat zij onwelgevallige (tussen)beslissingen hebben genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Drugsfeest in gevangenis Zaanstad'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Legal Protection how drugs and phones reached prisoners at JC Zaanstad after a leaked video showed a drug party, how supervision failed, and whether staff would be dismissed and prisoners punished more harshly. The Minister said the seven prisoners were identified and placed in isolation, searches were carried out, security measures are under review, no staff involvement was found, and a bill to criminalise smuggling of contraband was submitted.
There is no indication that staff are involved in the smuggling of contraband.
Er is geen aanwijzing dat personeel betrokken is bij de invoer van contrabande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Tbs’er verdacht van verkrachting medewerkster'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a TBS patient suspected of raping and assaulting a staff member at a day-care centre inside the clinic, asking about supervision, past incidents, staff protection, and abolition of TBS. The minister acknowledged the incident as serious but exceptional, described added security measures and staff protection programmes, provided incident figures without delict types, and defended TBS as aimed at preventing reoffending.
The type of offence is not registered, since at that point it is not yet clear under which criminal provision the violence against staff falls.
Het type delict wordt niet geregistreerd, aangezien op dat moment nog niet duidelijk is, onder welke strafbepaling het geweld tegen het personeel valt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Staat wil deal met Volkert van der Graaf'

An MP from the PVV asks why the Public Prosecution Service negotiates with Volkert van der Graaf, the convicted killer of Pim Fortuyn, and why he was released early and may leave the country, and whether he should be re-jailed or expelled. The minister answers that the court and prosecution agreed a new reporting arrangement without judicial intervention, that early release and conditions are for the judge to decide, that emigration would be subject to ordinary rules, and that re-arrest or expulsion will not be pursued.
Ultimately it is up to the judge to assess whether conditional release should be withheld.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechter om te beoordelen of de voorwaardelijke invrijheidstelling (v.i.) achterwege moet worden gelaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Drie jaar cel en tbs voor verkrachtende verlof-tbs’er’

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection how a tbs detainee who raped a girl came to be granted leave, whether such leave decisions are sound, and whether leave should be banned after violent or sexual offences committed on leave. The minister replies that leave is an essential, carefully assessed part of treatment reviewed by the clinic and the independent AVT, that incidents are evaluated and protocols adjusted where needed, and that existing rules already allow tbs to be extended, while declining to comment on sentencing.
That happens very carefully and in a step-by-step manner.
Dat gebeurt heel zorgvuldig en stapsgewijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Zedenzaak van Brech bleef te vaak onopgemerkt'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice whether destruction rules for prosecution files under the archive and justice data laws hamper crime detection, and whether those rules should change. The Minister said sex-crime files are kept for 80 years, that the OM reported no indication the retention rules hindered the investigation in the Verstappen case, and saw no reason to amend the law.
The investigation into the death of Nicky Verstappen is an ongoing criminal investigation, so I cannot go into the particulars of this case.
Het onderzoek naar de dood van Nicky Verstappen betreft een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek, zodat ik niet kan ingaan op bijzonderheden van deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Woede over nieuwe kans voor enkelbandknipper’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why a violent offender who had cut his ankle tag was given a new chance with an ankle tag and early release, and whether the law would be changed so such offenders stay in prison, given the victims' families' anger. The minister refused to change the law now, pointing to recidivism reduction and victims' interests, and said a bill limiting conditional release is expected this autumn.
The judge weighs all the interests involved, including those of the surviving relatives.
De rechter maakt daarbij een afweging van alle betrokken belangen, inclusief die van nabestaanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Markuszower over het bericht ‘Wonen naast een tbs-kliniek: Hoe een verkrachting het dorpje Oostrum opschudde’

PVV MPs Helder and Markuszower asked about police questioning of a rape victim in Oostrum, police requests for secrecy about a tbs-detainee perpetrator, compensation, sentencing and tbs leave policy. Minister Grapperhaus defended police handling in general terms, declined to comment on the individual case, and said the leave system is a necessary part of tbs treatment with an Inspectorate study pending.
I cannot go into an individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op een individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Ontsnapte tbs’er Patrick B. zit weer vast’

The MP asks how a tbs patient who had earlier escaped from leave was granted leave again, and whether patients who escaped or attempted escape will be denied leave. The Minister declines to discuss individual cases, explains the independent leave-assessment process (clinic committee and the AVT advisory college), notes that an escape ends leave and bars leave for at least a year, and states that no one who escaped in 2018 was transferred to another clinic.
It is not appropriate for me to address individual cases.
Het past mij niet om in te gaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong, Helder en Markuszower over het bericht 'Tientallen criminelen krijgen uitkering ondanks openstaande celstraf'

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Justice why convicted criminals with outstanding prison sentences still receive benefits, how much this costs, and what will be done to stop and recover payments. The minister answers that benefits are terminated under a 2011 scheme, 837 benefits were withdrawn in 2016-2017, courts have in some cases ruled withdrawal unlawful, and a CJIB-UWV pilot with letters to offenders will continue.

To withdraw or refuse benefits of convicted persons with an outstanding prison sentence, benefit agencies match CJIB files of fugitives from the investigation register against files of benefit recipients.

Om de uitkeringen van veroordeelden met een openstaande vrijheidsstraf in te trekken of te weigeren, matchen uitkeringsinstanties CJIB-bestanden van voortvluchtigen uit het opsporingsregister met de bestanden van uitkeringsgerechtigden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en De Graaf over het bericht ‘Jihadist Maastricht verdacht van betrokkenheid bij ontvoering Zuid-Afrika’

MPs Markuszower and De Graaf asked the Justice Minister about reports that a convicted jihadist from Maastricht, under supervision with an ankle monitor, may have been linked to a kidnapping in South Africa, questioning the adequacy of the supervision and whether terrorists should be stripped of Dutch nationality. The minister said courts decide on sanctions and conditions, declined to comment on an individual case still before a judge, and explained the legal basis for nationality revocation and related measures.
Since this concerns an individual criminal case still before the judge, I cannot respond to this question.
Aangezien het hier gaat om een individuele strafzaak die nog onder de rechter is, kan ik niet op deze vraag ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, De Roon en Agema over het beleid van Jeugdbescherming Rijnmond inzake reisadviezen naar Israël

PVV MPs asked whether the Rotterdam youth protection agency JRR gives children under supervision a negative travel advice for Israel, why it differs from Turkey or Morocco, and whether it should allow travel to such areas when accompanied by an adult. The minister answered that the certified institution assesses each trip case by case for every destination, that the ministry's advice is only one factor, and that it will not restrict the institution's power to refuse travel when child development is at risk.
There is no general negative travel advice for any country.
Er is daarbij geen sprake van een algemeen negatief reisadvies voor welk land dan ook.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Markuszower over het bericht 'Extreem links vaak vrijuit'

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Justice why the public prosecution service does not prosecute far-left extremists reported as often going unpunished, and whether the minister would instruct prosecutors to pursue them. The minister answered that far-left extremism is not treated differently from other extremism, that lawful activism is permitted and police and prosecutors act where the law is broken, and that he does not interfere in prosecutorial decisions, referring to earlier answers.
As Minister of Justice and Security, I do not interfere in the independent judgment and responsibilities of the public prosecutor.
Ik treed als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid niet in de onafhankelijke oordeelsvorming en verantwoordelijkheden van de officier van justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over een verbod op Denk

MPs from the PVV asked whether the government would arrest and deport a Denk party staffer who said he was proud to be an IS supporter, and whether it would seek a ban on the Denk party. The Minister answered that IS-linked conduct is criminal and that dissolving a party is an exceptional measure requiring high legal standards, which is for the public prosecutor to decide, and that individual cases cannot be discussed.
It is for the public prosecutor to decide whether a request under article 2:20 of the Civil Code is opportune.
Het is aan het openbaar ministerie om te bepalen of een verzoek ex artikel 2:20 Burgerlijk Wetboek opportuun is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Zus vermoorde Nadia terug bij af na tbs-draai’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why transmural leave was approved for a violent tbs detainee, whether victims are being further harmed, and whether the decision files and a list of leave grants can be shared. The minister explained that leave is based on independent advice from the AVT and treatment progress, that victims are informed of leave conditions, and declined to share individual advice or a list of detainees.
I see no reason to send advice on individual tbs detainees underlying a leave authorisation to your House.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om adviezen over individuele tbs-gestelden, die aan een verlofmachtiging ten grondslag liggen, aan uw Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Proefverlof ophanden voor vader die zijn zes kinderen de dood injoeg’

PVV MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked the Minister for Legal Protection why a father who murdered his six children could receive trial leave (proefverlof) from TBS detention, and whether minimum sentences and blocking the leave were considered. The minister replied that trial leave is a carefully assessed step in resocialisation with independent review and victim input, that he sees no basis for minimum sentences, and declined to comment on the specific case.
I will not go further into the decision-making and the details of this specific case.
Ik ga hier niet verder in op de besluitvorming en de details van deze specifieke zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het  bericht ‘Gedetineerde ontsnapt tijdens vervoer naar andere gevangenis in Grave’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice why a detainee escaped during transport and why he was not handcuffed, and whether the costs of recapturing him could be recovered from him. The minister said the case is under investigation, that handcuffing is a discretionary power based on individual risk rather than a standard requirement, and that recapture costs are borne by the state rather than the escapee.
This concerns an individual case that is still under investigation. I cannot comment on it.
Dit betreft een individuele casus die nog in onderzoek is. Ik kan hier geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Weggepest en toch vervolgd'

An MP asks whether a shop owner who defended herself against attackers should be prosecuted and whether self-defence rules for citizens should be widened, and asks the minister to instruct the prosecutor to drop the case. The minister declines to discuss the facts because the case is before the court, explains the existing self-defence rules (proportionality and subsidiarity judged by courts), and says there is no reason to instruct the prosecutor to withdraw the case.
The case is still before the court. For that reason I will not go into the facts of the case as they have been described.
De zaak is nog onder de rechter. Om die reden ga ik niet in op de feiten van de zaak zoals die zijn geschetst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Veroordeelde knipt enkelband door en vlucht’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a suspect could cut off his ankle tag and flee, why a violent offender was released from pre-trial detention, and when suspects of violent crimes will be required to remain in custody and attend hearings. The minister said the tags are hard but not impossible to remove, a stronger band is being introduced, the court decided the release, and a bill requiring detained suspects of serious sex or violent offences to attend hearings will go to consultation before summer.
I aim to put this proposal out for consultation before the summer.
Ik streef ernaar dit voorstel voor de zomer in consultatie te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘De rechtspraak moet een slag maken naar etnische diversiteit’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice whether the Court of Appeal president's remarks that too few judges have a migration background and that more judges should understand 'their culture' undermine judicial neutrality, and whether they amount to advocacy for sharia justice. The Minister answered that judicial composition is the judiciary's own responsibility, that diversity does not affect impartiality, and that judges can separate personal views from their function.
The composition of judicial staff is the responsibility of the judiciary itself.
De samenstelling van het rechtspraakpersoneel is de verantwoordelijkheid van de rechtspraak zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht “Makkelijk om aan drugs en kinderporno te komen”

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about press reports that drugs and child pornography are easily obtained in a forensic psychiatric clinic, including sanctions for contraband, lax checks after leave, and staff tolerance. The minister replied that contraband is prohibited with consequences, describes existing controls and an ongoing safety investigation, and says the clinic reports no safety problems while the Inspectorate may investigate further.
I can indicate that an investigation into safety in forensic care is currently under way.
Wel kan ik aangeven dat er momenteel een onderzoek loopt naar de veiligheid in de forensische zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en De Graaf over het bericht 'Joods restaurant weer belaagd'

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the prosecutor would pursue an antisemitic motive for repeated vandalism of a Jewish restaurant in Amsterdam and whether the acting mayor should be replaced for failing to protect it. The minister said prosecution is for the OM to decide, that a discrimination aspect would be raised as an aggravating factor, and that local authorities determine protective measures, with the acting mayor already reporting measures to the council.
Where there is reason to do so, the local authority takes additional measures to protect the entrepreneur, employees and those present.
Indien daartoe aanleiding is treft het lokale gezag aanvullende maatregelen ter bescherming van de ondernemer, de werknemers en aanwezigen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Markuszower over de aankondiging van de extreem-linkse organisaties Anakbayan-Europe en Revolutionaire Eenheid, die de palestijnse veroordeelde terroriste/meervoudig moordenare

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether he knows that Rasmea Odeh, a convicted Palestinian figure, was invited to speak in Amsterdam by two far-left groups and was deported from the US for immigration fraud, and whether he will refuse her entry. The minister says he cannot verify the US deportation, does not discuss individual cases, and explains that entry can be refused via Schengen SIS alerts based on factual information such as AIVD or police reports.
However, the Netherlands does not routinely exchange information with third countries about such immigration law decisions.
Nederland wisselt echter niet standaard informatie uit met derde landen over dergelijke vreemdelingrechtelijke besluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht 'De beerput van Bilal L.'

PVV MPs asked whether the Amsterdam mayor could act outside council control on de-radicalisation, and whether a Rijksrecherche probe should examine the Amsterdam (de)radicalisation network around Bilal L. The minister answered that Amsterdam runs its own local jihadism policy, that the OM alone decides on such investigations and an existing criminal probe is ongoing, and that administrative detention is not justified.
During the investigation I will not comment on this case.
Gedurende het onderzoek doe ik geen uitspraak over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Kinderlokker krijgt weer tbs en een celstraf’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a convicted child lurer could reoffend right after leaving TBS, whether supervision existed, and how often released TBS patients reoffend. The Minister said the release followed a court decision with a conditional BOPZ order and no probation supervision, defended TBS as effective, and gave WODC recidivism figures of about 21 to 23 percent within two years.
Because no criminal-law framework applies while a BOPZ order is in force, there is no probation supervision.
Omdat tijdens de toepassing van een BOPZ-machtiging geen sprake is van een strafrechtelijk kader, is er geen toezicht van de reclassering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over de antisemitische terreuractie tegen een Joods restaurant in Amsterdam

PVV MPs asked whether the suspect in the antisemitic attack on a Jewish restaurant in Amsterdam was known to the security services, whether he would be prosecuted for terrorism and deported, and whether administrative detention should be introduced. The Minister said he cannot comment on individual cases, that prosecution and sentencing are for the prosecutor and judge, and that administrative detention without reasonable suspicion is not a legitimate deprivation of liberty, pointing to existing tools.
It is for the public prosecution service to decide on prosecuting the suspect and to formulate a sentencing demand.
Het is aan het OM om te besluiten over de vervolging van de verdachte en daarbij een strafeis te formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, Fritsma, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Brede onrust na aanval op joods restaurant’

MPs of the PVV asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the suspect in an attack on a Jewish restaurant, who threw a burning liquid, was prosecuted only for vandalism and theft rather than a terrorist offence, and whether he could be deported. The Minister replied that prosecution and sentencing are for the Public Prosecution Service and the courts, that he would not comment on the individual case, and noted the court had adjourned the case for further investigation.
As you know, it is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide on prosecuting the suspect and to formulate a sentencing demand.
Zoals bij u bekend is het aan het OM om te besluiten over de vervolging van de verdachte en daarbij een strafeis te formuleren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, De Graaf en Wilders over de berichtgeving inzake een Brabantse islamgeleerde die geen straf krijgt voor het verkrachten van zijn stiefkind vanwege dementie

MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a 74-year-old suspect could be declared demented to avoid prosecution for raping his stepchild, and called for life imprisonment, denaturalisation and expulsion. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case, which is before the courts, and referred to a letter sent to parliament.
This concerns an individual case that is still before the courts.
Het gaat hier om een individuele zaak die nog onder de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over de berichten inzake de aanhouding van Michael P. uit Zeewolde

MP Markuszower asked the Justice Minister why convicted offender Michael P. was able to leave custody and be placed in a forensic clinic, and about the clinic's closure and the number of similar offenders outside prison. The minister declined to discuss the individual case because of ongoing criminal and inspection investigations, explained the general rules for leave and placement in forensic clinics, and gave a count of 128 transferred detainees.
It is important that the criminal investigation and the inspectorates' investigation can proceed carefully. Therefore I cannot go further into the details about Michael P. and his detention.
Het is belangrijk dat het strafrechtelijk onderzoek en het onderzoek van de Inspecties zorgvuldig kunnen verlopen. Daarom kan ik niet verder ingaan op de details over Michael P. en zijn detentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Markuszower over het bericht ‘Terrorist krijgt slechts 4 jaar cel opgelegd’

MPs De Graaf and Markuszower asked the Justice Minister whether a four-year prison sentence for a terrorist, reported in the press, is too lenient and whether the government will raise sentences and deport and denaturalise such offenders. Minister Grapperhaus answered that sentencing is for the independent judiciary and prosecutors, and that denaturalisation is possible case by case for dual nationals with a 20-year entry ban.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide on prosecution and determine the sentencing demand.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te besluiten over de vervolging en het bepalen van de strafeis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Slachtoffer Chris vreest lagere straf door verstrijken van de tijd’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Justice and Security why a victim fears a lower sentence due to delay in a kick-attack case, and whether the prosecution is responsible. The Minister replied that the hearing has not yet taken place, that the delay is due to scheduling with multiple suspects and lawyers, and that he cannot guarantee the sentence demand, as that belongs to the prosecution and the judge.
No, the sentence demand and the penalty to be imposed are for the prosecution and the judge respectively.
Nee, over de eis en de op te leggen straf gaan het OM respectievelijk de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Markuszower over het bericht dat een niet bestaand land lid is geworden van Interpol

PVV MPs asked why the Palestinian Authority could join Interpol, whether the Netherlands supports this, and when aid would be cut given attacks on Israel. The government said the bid had sufficient support in Interpol's General Assembly, the Dutch delegations abstained because the Kingdom does not recognise a State of Palestine, and it sees no reason to revise relations with the Palestinian Authority.
The cabinet therefore sees no reason to revise the relationship with the Palestinian Authority.
Het kabinet ziet daarom geen aanleiding om de relatie met de Palestijnse Autoriteit te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Vader gedode Sandra uit Enschede vindt het onverteerbaar: dader mag op verlof'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice why a young adult convicted of murder was tried under juvenile criminal law, and how leave arrangements for dangerous detainees can be justified given the risk to society. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, explained the adolescent criminal law and the structured leave system, and said no guarantee against reoffending can be given.
I cannot go into the circumstances of this individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de omstandigheden in deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Lotsverbondenheid’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the government can guarantee that a convicted child murderer on TBS will not reoffend during unsupervised leave, when he will be released, and for lists of convicted rapists and murderers on leave or release in the next two years. The Minister (Rechtsbescherming) answered that leave follows a multi-step assessment by the clinic and the AVT advisory committee, that risk cannot be fully excluded, that individual timelines cannot be disclosed, and that lists would breach data protection law.
No. Providing these lists would be in breach of the Personal Data Protection Act.
Nee. Het verstrekken van deze lijsten zou in strijd zijn met de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Markuszower over het bericht dat Erdogan Interpol misbruikt om jacht te maken op politieke tegenstanders

MPs De Roon, Helder and Markuszower asked whether Turkey misuses Interpol systems to pursue political opponents, what safeguards exist, and whether Dutch nationals have been affected. The government answered that it shares concern, describes Interpol's safeguards (Constitution article 3, Secretary General review, the CCF complaints commission) and Dutch pre-checks of Red Notices, and says it knows of no cases involving Dutch nationals.
The cabinet is concerned about reports, such as this one, that Turkey uses INTERPOL for arrest requests that violate article 3 of the INTERPOL Constitution.
Het kabinet is bezorgd over berichten, zoals onderhavig rapport, dat INTERPOL door Turkije wordt gebruikt voor arrestatie-verzoeken die een schending vormen van artikel 3 van de INTERPOL Constitutie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Steekpartij Breda: opnieuw misdrijf van J.B. onder toezicht reclassering'

An MP asked the Minister why a suspect under reclassering supervision could commit a stabbing, whether the reclassering director should resign, and whether longer prison sentences rather than ankle monitors should be used. The Minister defended supervision with conditions and partner cooperation, declined to comment on the personal demand, and argued that conditions and monitoring reduce recidivism better than imprisonment.
I regret that the efforts of the reclassering and its partners could not prevent the person concerned from being suspected of stabbing a 31-year-old woman.
Ik betreur dat de inzet en inspanningen van de reclassering en haar partners niet hebben kunnen voorkomen dat de betrokkene wordt verdacht van het neersteken van een 31-jarige vrouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Opnieuw werkstraf kopschopper’

An MP asked the Justice Minister why a violent attacker of NS security staff received a community service sentence despite guidelines allowing higher demands for assaults on public-duty workers, and whether minimum sentences should be introduced. The minister defended community service as effective, said serious violent offences warrant more than a community service sentence, clarified the guideline was a doubling rather than tripling, and rejected minimum sentences as undesirable under the coalition agreement.
No. By letter of 12 February 2013 my predecessor informed the House of the withdrawal of the bill on introducing minimum sentences for recidivism in serious offences.

Bij brief van 12 februari 2013 3 heeft mijn ambtsvoorganger uw Kamer op de hoogte gesteld van de intrekking van het wetsvoorstel omtrent het invoeren van minimumstraffen voor recidive bij zware misdrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Markuszower over het bericht “Terreurvader Bunschoten vrij met enkelband”

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether an ankle monitor and location ban are sufficient to protect the children of a suspect in a child abuse case, after he was released from preventive custody. The State Secretary answered that the independent judge decided on the release under strict conditions, that sentencing is for the courts, and that the government does not decide on pre-trial detention.
The independent judge, and not the government, decides in the Netherlands whether suspects must await their trial in custody.
De onafhankelijke rechter, en dus niet de regering, beslist in Nederland of verdachten hun berechting in de cel moeten afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht dat criminele vreemdelingen zelden worden uitgezet

PVV MPs asked why criminal foreigners often keep residence permits, how often this happens, and whether the state will close borders to asylum seekers and migrants from Islamic countries. The Secretary of State explained the graduated-scale test for revoking permits, said the IND cannot say how many cases involve insufficient sentences, and rejected a categorical border closure as unrealistic.
Based on the data available at the IND, it cannot be stated in how many cases an imposed sentence is insufficient to proceed to revocation of a residence permit.
Op basis van de bij de IND beschikbare gegevens is niet aan te geven in hoeveel gevallen een opgelegde straf onvoldoende is om over te gaan tot intrekking van een verblijfsvergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'We horen niets meer van OM'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Justice why a gay couple attacked in Arnhem has heard nothing from the prosecution service about their case, and whether violent juvenile offenders should face minimum sentences. The minister answered that the victims were informed several times, the case file was sent to the prosecutor and a hearing is being planned, that minors are treated with restraint on privacy and detention grounds, and that he does not favour minimum sentences.
When it concerns minor suspects, as in the present case, it is standard policy to be restrained in sharing substantive information because of the suspects' privacy interests.

Wanneer het gaat om minderjarige verdachten, zoals in de onderhavige casus, is het standaard beleid om terughoudend te zijn met het delen van inhoudelijke informatie in verband met privacybelangen van de verdachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over de berichten ‘Drugs en telefoons via luier baby de gevangenis in’ en ‘Modernisering om smokkelwaar’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports of drugs and phones being smuggled into prison, asking whether promised measures are being taken and whether the inmate should be punished and denied leave. The State Secretary replied that a bill criminalising bringing prohibited objects into prisons is in consultation, that existing disciplinary sanctions apply, and that the prison director decides sanctions in individual cases.
The director of the institution determines which sanction is imposed; it is not appropriate for me to comment on individual cases.
De directeur van de inrichting bepaalt welke sanctie wordt opgelegd, het past mij niet uitspraken te doen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht “Twaalf verboden relaties medewerkers en patiënten in tbs-klinieken”

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of twelve prohibited relationships between staff and patients in forensic psychiatric (tbs) clinics, including whether young inexperienced staff make key decisions and how many leave days were granted in such cases. The state secretary answered that such relations are unacceptable, that decisions are taken collectively in multidisciplinary consultation with independent leave review, and that four staff members lost their jobs.
Antwoord op aanvullende vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht “Tbs’er pleegt zedenmisdrijf tijdens verlof”

MP Markuszower asks whether the State Secretary's use of the term 'patiënten' for tbs detainees is offensive and whether he will instead call them 'convicted criminals'. The State Secretary rejects both, stating that tbs detainees are patients because they have psychiatric disorders and receive medical treatment.
No. A patient is someone who is offered medical help in case of injury, illness or a disorder.
Nee. Een patiënt is iemand aan wie medische hulp wordt geboden in geval van letsel, ziekte of een aandoening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Klassenfoto tijdens Offerfeest kost school 500 euro'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about a report that a court awarded 500 euros in damages to pupils or parents because children missed a school photo during an Islamic feast, and whether the judge should be suspended and such absences banned. The minister confirmed the ruling, declined to act against an independent judge, and refused to end the leave option, citing the Leerplichtwet's exemption for religious obligations available to all faiths.
It is not for me, as Minister of Justice and Security, to intervene in decisions taken by an independent judge.
Het is niet aan mij, als Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie, om te treden in beslissingen genomen door een onafhankelijke rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Maximaal 2 jaar cel'

An MP from the PVV asks why juveniles who commit serious murders can receive at most two years of youth detention, and whether adult criminal law should apply to 14-to-17-year-olds. The State Secretary defends the separate juvenile justice system, notes that adult law applies to 16-17-year-olds in only 45 cases in 2016, and rejects life sentences for minors, while pointing to intensive closed treatment (PIJ measure) as the tool for serious cases.
No, I do not share that view.
Nee, die mening deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Dode celbrand Scheveningen zat op psychiatrische afdeling'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security whether a prisoner set the fatal cell fire in Scheveningen and how contraband could enter the prison. The State Secretary corrected that the person was held in an ISD unit rather than a psychiatric ward, declined to discuss the cause citing security and privacy, pointed to internal calamity and security investigations shared with the Inspectorate, and said no link between contraband and fire has been shown.
Due to security within the penitentiary institution and privacy rights, I cannot go into the circumstances of the incident.
In verband met de veiligheid binnen de penitentiaire inrichting (PI) en het privacyrecht kan ik niet ingaan op de toedracht van het incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Doodrijder peuter liever in cel dan kliniek’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a news report that a fatal child-killing driver preferred prison to a psychiatric clinic, asking whether prison regimes should be made harsher, whether treatment refusers can be held in custody, whether 18 months' imprisonment is too lenient, and when minimum sentences will be introduced. The State Secretary answered that the regimes serve different purposes and no change is seen, that breaching probation conditions can lead to serving the remaining sentence, that compulsory admission under the Wet Bopz is possible, declined to judge a court ruling, and said minimum sentences are undesirable under the coalition agreement.
It is not appropriate for me to give a judgment on the ruling of an independent judge.
Het past mij niet een oordeel te geven over de uitspraak van een onafhankelijke rechter.
Vragen van het lid Markuszower (PVV) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Tbs’er pleegt zedenmisdrijf tijdens verlof» (ingezonden 19 juni 2017).

The MP asked the state secretary about a tbs patient who committed a sex offence while on leave, whether he will be prosecuted, whether leave should have been granted, how many escapes and offences occurred, and whether tbs should be abolished. The state secretary confirmed the suspect is being prosecuted, defended the leave assessment procedure as thorough and independent, noted 32 escapes in 2016 and that leave is suspended for a year after an offence, and rejected abolishing tbs.

Every leave application is, in accordance with the rules, thoroughly assessed by an internal leave review committee of a tbs clinic and then by the Advisory Committee on Tbs Leave Assessment (AVT), which consists of experts and is fully independent.

Elke verlofaanvraag wordt, conform de regels, grondig getoetst door een interne verloftoetsingscommissie van een Tbs-kliniek en vervolgens door het Adviescollege Verloftoetsing Tbs (AVT), dat bestaat uit deskundigen en geheel onafhankelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Tbs'er Mike J. in 2018 buiten de kliniek'

An MP from the PVV asked whether tbs (forensic psychiatric detention) patients suspected of high reoffending risk, such as a convicted murderer seen outside a clinic on leave, should never receive leave, and whether tbs should be abolished in favour of prison. The State Secretary rejected both demands, defending leave as a carefully assessed, phased resocialisation step and tbs as better at reducing reoffending than imprisonment.

Leave during tbs treatment is only possible after thorough assessment of the application by various parties, including the clinic's behavioural experts and the independent Advisory Committee on Tbs Leave Review (AVT).

Verlof tijdens de tbs-behandeling is alleen mogelijk na uitvoerige beoordeling van de aanvraag door verschillende partijen, waaronder de gedragsdeskundigen van de kliniek en het onafhankelijke Adviescollege Verloftoetsing Tbs (AVT).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht dat een levenslang gestrafte op verlof mag

An MP asked whether a life-sentenced murderer may be granted leave and why the government would not resist a tribunal ruling allowing it. The state secretary answered that his refusal of leave was overturned by the RSJ appeals commission, a new decision was issued, and leave will only be considered after September 2017 reports; he also said he cannot override the RSJ, which is the highest penitentiary court.
The RSJ is the highest court in penitentiary matters. No appeal lies against a ruling of this court.
De RSJ is de hoogste rechter in penitentiaire zaken. Tegen een uitspraak van deze rechter staat geen hoger beroep open.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Boodschappen doen op afstand in gevangenis Nieuwegein’

An MP asked the state secretary why prisoners in Nieuwegein can order groceries remotely and whether this undermines the purpose of imprisonment, and asked for measures to restrict such freedoms. The government replied that prisoners can only order from a government-set product list via internal prison shops, that the purchasing system will move to Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen from July 2017, and that it will not change the current rules.
In view of the foregoing, I do not intend to change the current rules regarding the purchase of necessities in penal institutions.
Gelet op het voorgaande ben ik niet voornemens om de huidige regels ten aanzien van het kopen van benodigdheden in Penitentiaire Inrichtingen te veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht dat er een dief met enkelband is opgepakt voor verkrachting

An MP asked the State Secretary whether an ankle-monitored offender who allegedly raped a woman should have served his sentence in prison, how the monitor failed, and whether minimum sentences and an end to early release should be introduced. The State Secretary replied that the ankle tag is a supervisory aid rather than a punishment, that it was not triggered because the offender did not breach his location order, that the government will not stop using tags, that early release is under review, and that imposing minimum sentences is undesirable.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Drugsgebruik tbs-kliniek niet meer toegestaan'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether drug use is tolerated in tbs clinics, who is responsible, how it will be sanctioned, and when all clinics will be drug-free, and asked why tbs is not abolished. The government answered that drugs are not tolerated inside tbs clinics, that drug use is addressed in treatment plans and affects leave, that the inspectorates' follow-up on FPK De Woenselse Poort shows the drug policy was tightened, and that tbs is kept as a protective and treatment measure.
Within the walls of the tbs clinics in the Netherlands, drugs are not tolerated.
Binnen de muren van de tbs-klinieken in Nederland worden drugs niet gedoogd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Gesmokkelde telefoons kwamen via andere gevangenis’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that smuggled phones entered a prison via another facility, and whether extra anti-smuggling measures (such as detection gates) should be applied in every prison. The State Secretary answered that prison directors decide on contraband measures, announced a bill criminalising bringing prohibited items into prisons, listed measures against continued criminal activity in detention, and promised to send an Inspectorate report with a policy response.
I will send this report, accompanied by a policy response, to your House soon.
Ik zal dit rapport vergezeld van een beleidsreactie snel aan uw Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Dat een levenslanggestrafte opheldering krijgt over gratie

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether reports that a life-sentenced prisoner would receive clarification about pardon should be stopped, and whether life sentences can be kept absolute despite European human rights case law. The State Secretary answered that under ECHR article 3 and the Dutch Supreme Court's 2016 ruling, life prisoners must have a real prospect of release, and that a new policy framework will keep life sentences imposable and enforceable while refusing to denounce the treaties.
To meet the ruling of the highest penitentiary judge, the ministerial regulation on temporary leave from the institution needs amending. I therefore intend to amend the regulation on that point.

Om tegemoet te komen aan het oordeel van de hoogste penitentiaire rechter behoeft de ministeriële Regeling tijdelijk verlaten van de inrichting aanpassing. Ik ben dan ook voornemens de regeling op dat punt aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over misstanden in het Zuiderparkbad

MPs from the PVV asked the ministers about reported assaults, harassment and vandalism at the Zuiderparkbad in The Hague, including the ethnicity of perpetrators, whether they should be punished harshly, what has been done and whether national measures would be taken. The minister answered that the matter is a local responsibility, that the municipality has introduced security measures and a review is underway, and that prosecution is for the public prosecutor to decide.
Enforcing order and rules in swimming pools is a local matter.
De handhaving van de orde en regels in zwembaden is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Verdachte hotelmoord voortvluchtige TBS’er’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a fugitive TBS (forced psychiatric treatment) patient suspected of a hotel killing in Arnhem, including how leave is granted, the Adviescollege Verloftoetsing's failures, and whether the TBS system should be abolished. The State Secretary answered that leave is assessed carefully by the clinic, the AVT and the Minister, that the case is under investigation by the prosecutor and an internal review by the clinic, that the police search was regrettable, and that the government sees no reason to abolish TBS, citing recidivism figures.
The investigation into the bodies found on 23 March 2017 in the vacant hotel in Arnhem is still ongoing. I first want to await the outcomes of these investigations.
Het onderzoek naar de op 23 maart 2017 aangetroffen lichamen in het leegstaande hotel in Arnhem is nog in volle gang. Ik wil de uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken eerst afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Markuszower over het bericht dat werklui inbreuk zouden hebben gemaakt op de ‘huisvrede’ van krakers

MPs Kops and Markuszower asked the Minister of Home Affairs why workers were sent away from a squatted building for trespass, and why squatting is apparently not enforced, arguing owners should be protected. The Minister declined to comment on the specific Amsterdam case as a local matter, explained that squatters can be protected against trespass when residence is factual, and stated the existing instruments suffice to protect owners.
The way the squatting ban is enforced is a local matter.
De wijze waarop het kraakverbod wordt gehandhaafd is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Verdachte van verkrachting meisje komt niet opdagen, zaak uitgesteld’

An MP asked why a suspect in a child rape case was released after the court refused pre-trial detention, and what the minister would do about the judge's decision. The minister said it is not for the minister to comment on decisions of an independent court, and that the criminal investigation is ongoing so no statements can be made.
It is not for me as Minister of Security and Justice to intervene in decisions taken by an independent judicial body.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie om te treden in beslissingen genomen door een onafhankelijk rechterlijk college.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Eijk  c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 45 over het uitstellen van de inwerkingtreding van de multiplier lucratief belang tot 2028
Postpones the entry into force of the box 2 multiplier for substantial interests to 1 January 2028, financed by a small increase in the AOF premium.
article I, part C, under 1, enters into force on 1 January 2028
treedt artikel I, onderdeel C, onder 1, met ingang van 1 januari 2028 in werking
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van Eijk  en Peter de Groot ter vervanging van nr. 68 over het matigen van de voorgestelde lastenverzwaringen in box 3
Moderates the box 3 forfait increase for other assets from 2026 and reverses the reduction of the tax-free allowance.
This amendment aims to moderate the increase in the flat-rate return for other assets in box 3 proposed for 2026 and to reverse the reduction of the tax-free allowance.

Dit amendement strekt ertoe de per 2026 voorgestelde verhoging van het forfaitaire rendement voor overige bezittingen in box 3 te matigen en de verlaging van het heffingsvrije vermogen terug te draaien.
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over alsnog een mkb-toets en een ATR-advies betreffende invoering van een pseudo-eindheffing voor fossiele leaseauto's
Asks the government to carry out an SME test and a regulatory burden advisory (ATR) opinion on the pseudo-excise tax for fossil lease cars, and to monitor and report to the Chamber regularly.
requests the government to still carry out an SME test and an ATR advice for this measure
verzoekt de regering alsnog een mkb-toets en een ATR-advies plaats te laten vinden bij deze maatregel
Motie van het lid Van Eijk  c.s. over binnen de verdere implementatie van de Wmebv hoge prioriteit geven aan de digitale bezwaarfase
Asks the government to give high priority to enabling full digital objection procedures within the Wmebv implementation, and to report on progress in the Voorjaarsnota.
requests the government to give high priority to the digital objection phase within the further implementation of the Wmebv
verzoekt de regering om binnen de verdere implementatie van de Wmebv hoge prioriteit te geven aan de digitale bezwaarfase
Motie van het lid Van Eijk  c.s. over krachtig inzetten op een gelijk speelveld en behoud van de concurrentiekracht van het Europese en Nederlandse bedrijfsleven
Asks the government to push in international negotiations for a level playing field and lower administrative burden on the Pillar 2 global minimum tax, with safe harbours and room for tax facilities.
requests the government to press in international negotiations for a level playing field and preservation of competitiveness of European and Dutch business
verzoekt de regering in de internationale onderhandelingen krachtig in te zetten op: – een gelijk speelveld en behoud van de concurrentiekracht van het Europese en Nederlandse bedrijfsleven
Motie van het lid Inge van Dijk c.s. over een voorstel voor het inpassen van de structurele indexering van de schijfgrens binnen het budget van de Wbso
Asks the cabinet to propose, in the Belastingplan 2027, how the Wbso schijfgrens can be indexed every year within the existing Wbso budget.
requests the government to jointly from the ministries of EZK and Finance make a proposal in the Belastingplan 2027
verzoekt de regering om gezamenlijk vanuit de ministeries van EZK en Financiën bij het Belastingplan 2027 een voorstel te doen
Motie van het lid Van Eijk  c.s. over een oplossing uitwerken voor de verzilveringsproblemen in de Wbso
Asks the government to work out a solution for Wbso innovation tax relief redemption problems for start-ups, such as a carry-forward option, and inform the Chamber.
requests the government to work out a solution for the redemption problems in the Wbso
verzoekt de regering een oplossing uit te werken voor de verzilveringsproblemen in de Wbso
Motie van de leden Van Eijk  en Grinwis over het inzagerecht conform de Wet stroomlijning fiscaal inzagerecht in werking laten treden
Motion asking the government to bring the tax right of inspection into force as legislated and to report to the Chamber at least yearly on progress toward a workable system.
requests the government to bring the right of inspection into force in accordance with the law
verzoekt de regering het inzagerecht conform de wet in werking te laten treden
Amendement van de leden Van Eijk  en Peter de Groot over het matigen van de voorgestelde lastenverzwaringen in box 3
Amendment lowering the box 3 forfait return percentages and reversing the cut to the tax-free allowance, reducing the planned tax burden on savings and other assets from 2026 to 2028.
This amendment aims to moderate the proposed 2026 increase in the deemed return for other assets in box 3 and to reverse the reduction of the tax-free allowance.

Dit amendement strekt ertoe de per 2026 voorgestelde verhoging van het forfaitaire rendement voor overige bezittingen in box 3 te matigen en de verlaging van het heffingsvrije vermogen terug te draaien.
Amendement van het lid Van Eijk  over de pseudo-eindheffing laten aansluiten op de periode van daadwerkelijke ter beschikkingstelling
Deletes the rule that the flat-rate pseudo-tax on fossil company cars applies to a full calendar month, so it is levied pro rata from the actual date the car is made available.
The pseudo-tax is not due for the full calendar year if the fossil passenger car is made available for only part of the calendar year.
De pseudo-eindheffing is niet over het volledige kalenderjaar verschuldigd als de fossiele personenauto slechts een deel van het kalenderjaar ter beschikking wordt gesteld.
Amendement van het lid Van Eijk  over uitbreiding overgangsrecht fgr
Extends the transitional rule on fonds voor gemene rekening tax status to bodies founded on or after 1 January 2025, letting them opt out of FGR treatment temporarily.
This amendment aims to extend the transitional law for the fund for joint account (fgr) so that it applies not only to funds that already existed on 31 December 2024
Dit amendement beoogt het overgangsrecht voor het fonds voor gemene rekening (fgr) uit te breiden zodat het niet alleen geldt voor fondsen die reeds op 31 december 2024 bestonden
Amendement van het lid Van Eijk  c.s. over het uitstellen van de inwerkingtreding van de multiplier lucratief belang tot 2029
Amendment postponing the entry into force of the multiplier on the lucrative interest tax measure from 2026 to 1 January 2029, funded by a premium increase.
With this amendment the entry-into-force date of the proposed multiplier measure is postponed to 1 January 2029.
Met dit amendement wordt de inwerkingtredingsdatum van de voorgestelde multipliermaatregel uitgesteld tot 1 januari 2029.
Motie van de leden Van Eijk  en Martens-America over verkennen hoe de toegang tot de innovatieregelingen verbeterd en vereenvoudigd kan worden
Asks the government to explore how access to innovation tax schemes (Wbso, expat scheme, innovation box) can be improved and simplified, while keeping business taxes from rising.
requests the government to explore how access to these innovation schemes can be improved and simplified
verzoekt de regering daarnaast te verkennen hoe de toegang tot deze innovatieregelingen verbeterd en vereenvoudigd kan worden
Motie van het lid Van Eijk over uitspreken de belasting op sparen, erven en schenken niet te verhogen
Asks the government not to raise taxes on saving, inheritance and gifts.
states that the tax on saving, inheritance and gifts should not be raised
spreekt uit de belasting op sparen, erven en schenken niet te verhogen
Motie van de leden Van Eijk  en Peter de Groot over voorzien in een tegemoetkoming voor het ontbreken van kostenaftrek door de box 3-heffing op woningen in 2026 en 2027 te verlagen
Asks the government to explore options for compensating landlords and holiday-home owners for the missing cost deduction under box 3 by lowering the taxation on homes in 2026 and 2027.
requests the government to map out options to provide compensation for the absence of cost deduction
verzoekt de regering opties in kaart te brengen om te voorzien in een tegemoetkoming voor het ontbreken van kostenaftrek
Motie van de leden Van Eijk  en Vermeer over onderzoeken hoe de wettelijke controletaak van accountants kan worden beperkt en vereenvoudigd
Asks the government to study how the statutory audit task of accountants can be limited and simplified while preserving audit quality.
requests the government to investigate how the statutory audit task of accountants can be limited and simplified
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken op welke wijze de wettelijke controletaak van accountants kan worden beperkt en vereenvoudigd
Motie van de leden Van Eijk  en Vermeer over actief betrokken blijven bij de implementatie van de nieuwe beroepsprofielen
Asks the government to stay actively involved in implementing new accountant professional profiles and have their effects monitored.
requests the government to remain actively involved in implementing the new professional profiles
verzoekt de regering actief betrokken te blijven bij de implementatie van de nieuwe beroepsprofielen
Amendement van de leden Van der Lee en Van Eijk  ter vervanging van nr. 10 over voorhang bij het aanwijzen van niet-OOB organisaties

Requires that the proposal for the AMvB extending the appointment power to non-OOB organisations not be submitted until four weeks after the draft is laid before both Houses, creating parliamentary involvement.
The proposal for a general administrative order to be established under the fourth paragraph is not made until four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both Houses of the States General.

De voordracht voor een krachtens het vierde lid vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Motie van het lid Mutluer c.s. over uitspreken dat de Kamer onder bepaalde voorwaarden instemt met decharge voor de jaarverantwoording 2024 van JenV

Conditionally agrees to discharge (decharge) of the Ministry of Justice and Security's 2024 accountability report, conditional on concrete plans in the 2026 budget on case throughput information, implementation tests, victims' information, and correcting errors.
declares that the House agrees to discharge the 2024 accountability report of the Ministry of Justice and Security, on condition that
spreekt uit dat de Kamer instemt met decharge voor de jaarverantwoording 2024 van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, onder de voorwaarde
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Stoffer c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 21 over het verplicht stellen van een formulier voor het aannemelijk maken van het werkelijke rendement

Makes taxpayers use the tax authority's standard form (OWR) when invoking the box 3 counter-evidence rule, with a six-week period for supplementary documents, and exempts cases where the data was already requested with the tax return.
However, this amendment specifies that this must be accompanied by mandatory use of the OWR form.
Wel wordt met dit amendement vastgelegd dat dit gepaard moet gaan met het verplichte gebruik van het OWR-formulier.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Stoffer c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het verplicht stellen van een formulier voor het aannemelijk maken van het werkelijke rendement
Requires taxpayers to use a tax-authority form when invoking the actual-return counter-evidence rule, with extra documents allowed only within six weeks, displacing general appeal rules.
It can be argued that taxpayers are restricted in their legal rights by this amendment.
Gesteld kan worden dat belastingplichtigen met dit amendement in hun wettelijke recht beperkt worden.
Motie van de leden Van Eijk  en Stoffer over de effecten op bepaalde groepen belastingplichtigen in beeld brengen
Asks the government to consult affected groups of box 3 taxpayers, such as landlords and owners of heritage properties, to map effects of planned rate increases and explore alternatives.
requests the government to consult these groups of taxpayers to map the effects of the proposed policy
verzoekt de regering om in overleg te treden met deze groepen belastingplichtigen om de effecten van het voorgenomen beleid in beeld te brengen
Motie van het lid Van Eijk over bij de Belastingdienst zodanig prioriteren dat invoering van het nieuwe box 3-stelsel per 1 januari 2028 wordt gerealiseerd
Asks the government to prioritise Tax Authority IT projects so the new box 3 system is implemented on 1 January 2028 and to keep the House informed.
requests the government to prioritise the Tax Authority's IT portfolio so that the box 3 system based on actual return is introduced on 1 January 2028
verzoekt de regering het IV-portfolio van de Belastingdienst zodanig te prioriteren dat invoering van het box 3-stelsel op basis van werkelijk rendement per 1 januari 2028 wordt gerealiseerd
Amendement van het lid Stoffer c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 9 over het verplicht stellen van een formulier voor het aannemelijk maken van het werkelijke rendement
Requires taxpayers to use a tax authority form to substantiate actual return under the box 3 counter-evidence rule, with up to six weeks for supplementary documents.
The taxpayer uses a form made available by the inspector to substantiate the actual return
De belastingplichtige maakt gebruik van een door de inspecteur ter beschikking te stellen formulier om het werkelijke rendement aannemelijk te maken
Motie van het lid Van Eijk over een wettelijke grondslag voor het onder strikte voorwaarden delen van informatie tussen notarissen over geweigerde cliënten
Asks the government to study a legal basis allowing notaries to share information about refused clients under strict conditions and report to the House by year end.
requests the government to examine how a statutory basis can be created for notaries to share information about refused clients under strict conditions
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken op welke wijze een wettelijke grondslag kan worden gecreëerd voor het onder strikte voorwaarden delen van informatie tussen notarissen over geweigerde cliënten
Motie van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van Eijk over de instrumenten en de sturingsmogelijkheden in kaart brengen die gemeenten hebben om de kosten te beperken

Asks the government to inventory the instruments and steering options municipalities already have to limit costs in youth care and other policy areas, with best-practice examples, and to inform the House before summer 2025.
requests the government to map what instruments and steering options municipalities already have to limit costs
verzoekt de regering in kaart te brengen wat gemeenten nu al aan instrumenten en sturingsmogelijkheden hebben om de kosten te beperken
Motie van het lid Aukje de Vries c.s. over gemeenten de mogelijkheid geven te werken met een stelpost onderuitputting
Asks the government to let municipalities use a budget reserve for expected underspending, agreed with provinces as financial supervisors.

requests the government to give municipalities the option to work with a budget item for underspending and to make agreements about this with the provinces as financial supervisors of municipal finances

verzoekt de regering om gemeenten de mogelijkheid te geven om te werken met een stelpost onderuitputting en daarover afspraken te maken met de provincies als financieel toezichthouders op de gemeentefinanciën
Motie van het lid Inge van Dijk c.s. over een betere afstemming voor de heffingskortingen en belastingheffing bij overuren of meerdere dienstverbanden
Asks the government to better align tax credits and tax treatment for overtime and multiple jobs, and to examine a bonus exemption within the wage cost scheme.
requests the government to come up with practical solutions for better alignment of tax credits and tax levying for overtime or multiple employments
verzoekt de regering met praktische oplossingen te komen voor een betere afstemming voor de heffingskortingen en belastingheffing bij overuren of meerdere dienstverbanden
Amendement van het lid Vermeer c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 55 over de anti-fragmentatiemaatregel niet invoeren
Deletes the anti-fragmentation measure limiting interest deduction for real estate funds and lowers the general interest deduction limit from 25% to 24.5%.
Article XV, part G, under 1 and 2, is deleted.
Artikel XV, onderdeel G, onder 1 en 2, vervalt.
Motie van het lid Van Eijk over het verder uitwerken van de beleidsoptie voor voordelige waardering van aandelenopties
Asks the government to further develop a policy option for favourable valuation of share options, including a lower threshold alternative for start-ups, and to inform the Kamer by 1 July 2025.
requests the government to further develop the policy option, whereby moderate taxation leads to a fair and internationally competitive rate
verzoekt de regering de beleidsoptie verder uit te werken, waarbij «gematigd belasten» leidt tot een eerlijk en in internationaal verband redelijk en concurrerend tarief
Motie van het lid Inge van Dijk c.s. over voor de Voorjaarsnota verschillende opties en uitvoeringsimplicaties voor tariefdifferentiatie in de kansspelbelasting in kaart brengen
Asks the government to map options and implementation implications for differentiating the gambling tax rate before the Spring Memorandum.
requests the government to map out, before the Spring Memorandum, the various options and implementation implications for tariff differentiation in the gambling tax
verzoekt de regering om voor de Voorjaarsnota in kaart te brengen wat de verschillende opties en uitvoeringsimplicaties zijn voor tariefdifferentiatie in de kansspelbelasting
Motie van het lid Vlottes c.s. over in de nog te ontvangen grenseffectenrapportages nadrukkelijk ingaan op een eventuele daling van verkoopvolumes en de oorzaken hiervan
Asks the government to address any decline in national sales volumes and its causes in the forthcoming cross-border effects reports.
requests the government to explicitly address in the forthcoming cross-border effects reports any decline in sales volumes and its causes
verzoekt de regering bij de nog te ontvangen grenseffectenrapportages nadrukkelijk in te gaan op een eventuele daling van verkoopvolumes en de oorzaken hiervan
Amendement van het lid Van Eijk  over het tot en met 2024 terugwerken van de kwijtscheldingswinstvrijstelling
Makes the retroactive application of the tax change to the debt-forgiveness profit exemption run from 2024, and adjusts the green investment box 3 exemption amounts for 2025 and 2026.
Motie van het lid Stoffer c.s. over de gevolgen van de versobering van de BOR voor de agrarische sector zo veel mogelijk beperken

Asks the government to consult the agricultural sector on limiting the effects of excluding cooperative membership rights from the business succession scheme and to inform the House before the Spring Memorandum.
requests the government to consult with the sector to examine how the consequences of this tightening can be limited as much as possible
verzoekt de regering in overleg met de sector te bezien hoe de gevolgen van deze versobering zo veel mogelijk beperkt kunnen worden

Motie van de leden Van Eijk  en Vermeer over inzichtelijk maken welke antimisbruikmaatregelen er in de EU zijn tegen belastingconstructies waarbij misbruik wordt gemaakt van de generieke renteaftrekbe
Asks the government to report on which anti-abuse measures other EU member states have adopted against tax constructions exploiting the generic interest deduction limitation.
requests the government to make clear whether, and if so which, anti-abuse measures other EU countries have implemented
verzoekt de regering inzichtelijk te maken of, en, zo ja, welke antimisbruikmaatregelen andere EU-landen hebben geïmplementeerd
Motie van het lid Van Eijk over onderzoek naar knelpunten rondom het fonds voor gemene rekening
Asks the government to investigate with pension funds and asset managers whether problems remain for the fonds voor gemene rekening and to inform the House by 1 July 2025.
requests the government to investigate together with pension funds and asset managers whether bottlenecks remain
verzoekt de regering om samen met onder andere pensioenfondsen en vermogensbeheerders te onderzoeken of er knelpunten
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over technische omissies in de wettekst van de Successiewet ten aanzien van de BOR zo spoedig mogelijk repareren
Asks the government to quickly repair technical omissions in the Successiewet text on the business succession scheme (BOR) so it matches the original intent.
requests the government to repair these technical omissions in the statutory text of the Successiewet regarding the BOR as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering deze technische omissies in de wettekst van de Successiewet ten aanzien van de BOR zo spoedig mogelijk te repareren
Amendement van de leden Van Eijk  en Vermeer over het uitbreiden van de vrije ruimte in de werkkostenregeling
Lowers the free space and tax thresholds in the wage cost scheme for employers and removes the green investment tax relief in box 3.
With this amendment SME employers get more tax room for good employership.
