Met dit amendement krijgen werkgevers in het mkb meer fiscale ruimte voor goed werkgeverschap.
Motie van het lid Van Eijk over onderzoeken hoe Nederland een nieuw systeem van duurzame innovatiekredieten kan vormgeven
Asks the government to research how the Netherlands could design a new system of refundable innovation tax credits and report by 1 July 2025.
requests the government to research how the Netherlands can design a new system of sustainable innovation credits
verzoekt de regering om onderzoek te doen naar hoe Nederland een nieuw systeem van duurzame innovatiekredieten kan vormgeven
Motie van de leden Van Eijk  en Grinwis over een gedifferentieerde verbruiksbelasting op niet-alcoholische dranken inrichten op basis van toegevoegde suikers
Asks the government to develop a sixth variant of a differentiated beverage excise based on added sugars, following the UK model, and send it to the House before the Christmas recess.
requests the government to work out a sixth variant in which a differentiated excise on non-alcoholic beverages is based on added sugars
verzoekt de regering om een zesde variant uit te werken waarin een gedifferentieerde verbruiksbelasting op niet-alcoholische dranken wordt ingericht op basis van toegevoegde suikers
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Inge van Dijk c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 38 over een structurele verhoging van het budget voor de WBSO
Proposes structurally raising the WBSO R&D tax relief budget by 100 million euros through higher rates and thresholds, funded by a higher AOF premium.
With this amendment the submitters aim to structurally increase the budget for the WBSO R&D tax relief by 100 million euros.
Indieners beogen met dit amendement het budget voor de Wet Bevordering Speur- en Ontwikkelingswerk (WBSO) structureel te verhogen met € 100 miljoen.
Amendement van het lid Van Eijk  over herstel van een omissie inzake de rekenregels voor het nettopensioen
Amends the net-pension rule in the income tax act so that net-pension premiums are fully deducted from the annual space, with retroactive effect to 1 July 2023.
By adding a separate letter Z and the proposed change to the formula, this is restored with retroactive effect to 1 July 2023.

Met het opnemen van een afzonderlijke letter Z en de voorgestelde aanpassing van de formule van artikel 3.125, tweede lid, Wet IB 2001 wordt dit met terugwerkende kracht tot en met 1 juli 2023, de datum van invoering van deze bepaling, hersteld.
Amendement van het lid Van Eijk  over inwerkingtreding van de materiële bepalingen uit de Wet FKR per 2026
Amendment to the Wet FKR changing effective dates of substantive provisions from 2025 to 2026 and making related technical and substantive adjustments for religious bodies and limited partnerships.
Article I, part O, under 2, lapses.
Artikel I, onderdeel O, onder 2, vervalt.
Amendement van de leden Vermeer en Van Eijk  over de anti-fragmentatiemaatregel niet invoeren
Amendment removes the anti-fragmentation measure restricting interest deduction for real estate funds and lowers the interest deduction limit from 25% to 24.5%.
This amendment proposes not to introduce this anti-fragmentation measure.
Met dit amendement wordt voorgesteld om deze antifragmentatiemaatregel niet in te voeren.

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Stoffer c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 8 over de voorgestelde beperking van de reikwijdte van de BOR en DSR ab in werking laten treden gelijktijdig met de familietoets en
Amended amendment narrowing the scope of the BOR and DSR business-succession tax reliefs by redefining qualifying shares and timing their entry into force with other rules.
Motie van het lid Heite c.s. over binnen de bestaande budgettaire kaders een team inrichten dat gemeenten ondersteunt bij de brede ondersteuning
Asks the State Secretary to supervise broad support by municipalities, consult VNG, set up a support team within budget, and deliver an evaluation after one year.
requests the State Secretary to deliver an evaluation after one year on the adequacy and effectiveness of the broad support
verzoekt de Staatssecretaris om na één jaar een evaluatie op te leveren over de toereikendheid en effectiviteit van de brede ondersteuning
Motie van het lid Idsinga c.s. over twee jaar na inwerkingtreding van het belastingverdrag met Malta in samenwerking met Curaçao een evaluatie naar de Kamer sturen
Asks the government to send parliament an evaluation two years after the Malta tax treaty enters into force, covering economic effects and possible revision.
requests the government to send parliament an evaluation two years after entry into force and in cooperation with Curaçao
verzoekt de regering twee jaar na inwerkingtreding en in samenwerking met Curaçao een evaluatie naar de Kamer te sturen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Van Eijk over het bericht 'Door angst voor schijnzelfstandigheid worden wachtlijsten bij UWV nog langer'

VVD MPs asked why UWV is ending contracts with self-employed occupational physicians over fear of sham self-employment, whether this reflects tax enforcement, and how it fits motions to avoid categorical exclusion of freelancers. The government answers that UWV no longer hires physicians as freelancers due to sham-self-employment risk, that the Tax Authority enforces risk-based and has lifted its moratorium with a soft landing, and that freelancers still work at UWV in some domains.
The Tax Authority cannot, under its duty of confidentiality, answer whether enforcement has taken place against occupational physicians working on UWV assignments.
De Belastingdienst kan op grond van zijn geheimhoudingsplicht niet beantwoorden of van handhaving sprake is bij verzekeringsartsen die in opdracht van UWV werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Verkuijlen over het bericht ‘Fiscaal beleid bedreigt onze weerbaarheid op zee’

Two MPs asked whether the Pillar Two global minimum tax undermines the shipping tonnage regime and what the fiscal and employment impact of Dutch shipping firms leaving would be. The State Secretary answered that the regime may be touched by minimum tax only in specific cases, that the amounts at stake are limited, that no exemption or tax credit is planned, and that the impact will be monitored after first filings in 2026.
Once the filing data are available, the consequences of the minimum tax for the Netherlands will be included in the annual monitoring letter.
Wanneer de aangiftegegevens voorhanden zijn, zullen de gevolgen van de minimumbelasting voor Nederland in de jaarlijkse monitoringsbrief worden betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Moordenaar krijgt na jaren cel en tbs baan in zorgkliniek: ’Hoe kan zo iemand werken met kwetsbare personen?

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van Eijk asked why a convicted murderer was given a job in a care clinic and how VOG screening allowed this, and how often such VOG certificates are issued to people with serious violent convictions. The State Secretary says individual cases cannot be discussed for privacy reasons, defends the balancing in VOG decisions and reintegration, and states there is no intention to expand continuous screening or the VOG-P beyond current rules pending a WODC study expected in early 2026.
Because of the protection of personal privacy, I cannot go into individual cases.
Vanwege de bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer kan ik niet ingaan op individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Van der Burg over het bericht ‘Remco S. loopt nog altijd vrij rond in India na de moord op José

Two MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that a suspect in the murder of a Dutch woman remains free in India, and about extradition, diplomatic contact, victim information and compensation. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, stated that India has primary jurisdiction and extradition depends on facts and procedures, said Nederland's influence over foreign procedures is very limited, and noted victims of crimes abroad are not eligible for Schadefonds compensation, though the law may be revised.
On individual criminal cases, contact about them with a foreign authority, and how a foreign authority acts, I cannot provide information.
Over individuele strafzaken, het contact daarover met een buitenlandse autoriteit en de wijze waarop door een buitenlandse autoriteit wordt gehandeld, kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Stekende tbs’er al eerder met onbegeleid verlof'

MPs Van Eijk and Rajkowski asked about a stabbing by a tbs patient who had earlier been granted unaccompanied leave, victims' speaking rights, and the legal basis for leave for unlawfully present foreigners in tbs. The Secretary of State answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, outlined the victim-notification and speaking-right arrangements, and acknowledged the tension between migration and criminal law, promising talks with the Minister of Asylum and Migration.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk over de fiscale en morele behandeling van de Bijzondere Invaliditeitsverhoging (BIV)

An MP (Van Eijk, VVD) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Bijzondere Invaliditeitsverhoging (BIV) for disabled veterans should be tax-exempt, the budgetary and implementation effects of such an exemption, the second opinion by HHP Chambers, the status of court cases, and the reasons the BIV cannot fall under the existing exemption in the Wet IB 2001. The government answers that the net BIV is adequate compensation, rejects defiscalisation based on independent professors' advice, declines to comment on pending cases and on the Landsadvocaat advice, and explains that the BIV is freely disposable income not covered by the exemption.
I cannot comment substantively on pending cases.
Ik kan niet inhoudelijk ingaan op lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Kisteman over het voorkomen dat financieel gezonde bedrijven onnodig failliet gaan en het bieden van maatwerk voor ondernemers met coronabelastingschulden

MPs Van Eijk and Kisteman (VVD) asked the State Secretary of Finance about bankruptcies of financially healthy firms with corona tax debts, the scope for tailored debt settlements, and operational problems with creditors, payment terms and the valuation of settlement offers. The State Secretary answered at length, announcing amendments to the collection guidelines from 1 July 2025 (clarifying hold-out creditors and allowing settlement payments beyond twelve months), while defending the existing rules on creditors, enforcement proceeds and deadlines and promising ongoing monitoring via stand-van-zakenbrieven.
I can now inform the House that two amendments to the Collection Guidelines 2008 have proven feasible from 1 July 2025.
Ik kan uw Kamer inmiddels mededelen dat twee wijzigingen van de Leidraad invordering 2008 (LI 2008) haalbaar zijn gebleken per 1 juli 2025.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Van Eijk over het bericht “Ouders ‘gaan volledig uit hun plaat’ bij kinderopvang: ‘We moeten een streep trekken’”

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of aggressive parents towards childcare staff and what measures exist, including withdrawing childcare allowance and a blacklist. The state secretary said signals are limited, noted that providers can terminate contracts and report serious cases, and rejected further national measures, blacklists and allowance withdrawal as too far-reaching.
Given these possibilities, I currently see no reason to take further measures from central government.
Gegeven deze mogelijkheden zie ik op dit moment geen reden om verdere maatregelen vanuit de rijksoverheid te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk over de late bekendmaking van de forfaitaire rendementspercentages in Box 3

An MP asked why the 2024 Box 3 forfait return percentages were only published on 7 March 2025, and whether publication could be accelerated. The State Secretary replied that the percentages are set after the year ends by ministerial regulation with retroactive effect, that averages are only available in January, that no legal publication deadline exists, and promised to publish next year's regulation by 1 March 2026.
The law contains no final publication deadline for the ministerial regulation.
In de wet is geen uiterste publicatiedatum opgenomen voor de ministeriële regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Van Eijk over schijnzelfstandigheid bij de UHT

MPs Aartsen and Van Eijk (VVD) asked whether the UHT childcare benefits recovery body stopped working with self-employed contractors from 1 April 2025, why it withdrew its offer to pay fines for intermediaries, and how it assesses bogus self-employment under the Deliveroo criteria. The government answered that UHT still uses self-employed workers where legally possible, applies an internal risk framework, withdrew the fine-compensation offer after tax-compliance concerns, and sees no legal-certainty problem.
As you know, your House asked the government to implement as well as possible the motion of 1 October 2024 by MP Boon (PVV).
Zoals bekend heeft uw Kamer de regering gevraagd om zo goed mogelijk uitvoering te geven aan de Kamermotie van 1 oktober 2024
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kisteman en Van Eijk over de BijzonderBeheer Barometer van PwC (i.v.m. antwoord op vraag 4)

MPs Kisteman and Van Eijk asked the Ministers about PwC's Bijzonder Beheer Barometer, which claims Tax Authority rules (requiring settlements to include all creditors and limiting payment plans to twelve months) make restructuring unworkable for firms. The minister defended the Tax Authority's strict debt-relief policy, said flexibility exists for individual cases, gave no commitment to change the WHOA or policy, and noted the Impulsaanpak Winkelgebieden might be extended only if budget becomes available.
The receiver, in principle, pursues a strict deferral and debt-relief policy towards entrepreneurs.
De ontvanger voert ten aanzien van ondernemers in beginsel een stringent uitstel- en kwijtscheldingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk over het Memorandum for the Secretary of the Treasury (VS) inzake de Global Tax Deal

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the January 2025 US presidential memorandum rejecting the OECD global minimum tax deal and threatening countermeasures against foreign tax measures, and about the Dutch and EU response. The minister answered that the Netherlands implemented the Pillar Two rules via the Wet minimumbelasting 2024, that the memorandum gives no detail on countermeasures, and that the Netherlands will coordinate with the EU and other countries without committing to changing the law.
It is unclear which draft bills are meant here. Furthermore, the memorandum gives no insight into the possible design of any countermeasures.
Het is onduidelijk welke conceptwetsvoorstellen hier worden bedoeld. Verder geeft het memorandum geen inzicht in de mogelijke vormgeving van eventuele tegenmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk over de Brief monitoring van de effecten van de aanpak van belastingontwijking

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the effectiveness of the earnings stripping and additional CFC measures under ATAD1, the consultation practice for the low-tax jurisdiction list, the compliance burden of overlapping anti-avoidance rules, the 2021 CFC income adjustment, the Model B CFC rule, foreign direct investment figures, and pending EU tax directive proposals. The State Secretary answered that effects are hard to measure and not statistically proven, that consultation on the list is only needed for new listings, that overlapping measures were deliberately left without a special offset rule, and provided FDI data and a pointer to a possible confidential briefing on EU tax negotiations.
Your House of Parliament has placed a parliamentary reservation on the BEFIT (corporate tax harmonisation) directive proposal.
Uw Kamer heeft een behandelbehoud gemaakt ten aanzien van het BEFIT (harmonisatie vennootschapsbelasting) richtlijnvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kisteman, Van Eijk en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Achteraf betalen kan binnenkort ook in fysieke winkels dankzij nieuwe samenwerking'

Three VVD MPs asked the government about news that buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) would extend to physical shops, and about its effects on young people and indebted consumers. The minister answered that BNPL-in-shops offers minimal social added value with large risks, pointed to the coming CCDII directive, age verification and a sector code, and said a temporary ban is not feasible.
The government therefore finds the announcement to extend BNPL services to physical shops very undesirable.
De aankondiging om BNPL-diensten uit te breiden naar fysieke winkels vindt het kabinet dan ook zeer onwenselijk.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk over het Speciaal verslag ‘Bestrijding van schadelijke belastingregelingen en ontwijking van vennootschapsbelasting’ d.d. 29 november 2024 van de Europese Rekenkamer

MP Van Eijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about the European Court of Auditors' special report on combating harmful tax regimes and corporate tax avoidance, covering its scope, main conclusions, Dutch best practices, the TDRD dispute mechanism and an alternative arbitration committee. The State Secretary answered each question, noting the report targets the European Commission rather than member states, highlighting Dutch practices and stricter-than-minimum ATAD implementation, and stating Dutch support for Commission guidance while promising arbitration committee developments in early 2025.

Question 6: Does the European Court of Auditors identify improvement points for the Netherlands in the report? If so, what are they? Answer 6: The ERK directs its recommendations to the European Commission, and to that extent the ERK identifies no concrete improvement points for the Netherlands.

Vraag 6 Signaleert de Europese Rekenkamer in het rapport verbeterpunten voor Nederland? Zo ja, wat zijn deze verbeterpunten? Antwoord 6 De ERK richt haar aanbevelingen tot de Europese Commissie, en in zoverre signaleert de ERK geen concrete verbeterpunten voor Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen, Van Eijk en Flach over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst zelf zich niet gaat houden aan de wet DBA en van belastinggeld ook de boetes en naheffingen gaat betalen

MPs Aartsen, Van Eijk and Flach asked why the Dutch government's own Dienst Toeslagen (UHT, the childcare benefits restoration operation) would keep using potential bogus self-employed workers after 1 January 2025, despite rules requiring the rest of the market to stop, and whether it would pay fines and back-payments with public money. The government answered that it regrets the situation, will keep deploying such workers into 2025 and possibly 2026 to avoid delaying compensation, will offer brokers reimbursement of fines, has no budget provision for these, and will report on the scale of self-employed use across government later in 2025.
The cabinet does not consider it exemplary behaviour for government organisations to act in breach of the law.
Het kabinet vindt het niet van voorbeeldgedrag getuigen dat overheidsorganisaties in strijd met de wet handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk over navorderingen hoeveelheid- en waardeoverschrijding bij bijzondere regeling Douane

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary of Finance about post-clearance recoveries of customs duties caused by quantity or value overstatements under the special customs regime, including how many occurred, the total amount involved and how many exceeded one million euros. The State Secretary answered that 46 such recoveries occurred in the last five years, involving nearly 27 million euros in import duties, six of them above one million euros, because the Customs systems do not record the reason for a recovery and a manual inventory was made.
This yielded that in the last five years a recovery as a result of a quantity or value overstatement occurred 46 times.
Dit heeft opgeleverd dat in de laatste vijf jaar 46 keer een navordering als gevolg van een hoeveelheids- of waardeoverschrijding heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Peter de Groot en Van Eijk (allen VVD) over het artikel 'Enorme ozb-verhoging Amsterdam ’Middenklasse maximaal uitgekleed”

VVD MPs asked the government about a steep property tax (OZB) increase proposed by Amsterdam, its effect on household costs, parking charges and erfpacht, and whether the government would engage Amsterdam to cap OZB rises. The minister declined to comment on Amsterdam's local tax decision as a matter for the municipal council, provided cost data, and committed to talks with municipalities on capping OZB increases.
It is up to the municipal councils to make choices here, weighing among other things the tax burden, service levels and other matters.
Het is aan de gemeenteraden hierin keuzes te maken, waarbij onder meer belastingdruk, voorzieningenniveau en andere zaken tegen elkaar worden afgewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Mohandis, Inge van Dijk, van Eijk en Paulusma over de aanpak van misstanden in de danswereld

MPs from several parties asked the government why victims of abuse in the dance world feel that compensation, apologies and trauma care are missing, and why the answers to earlier questions were so cold. The government replies that it relies on the Alliantie Dans Veilig and two new commissions, refers trauma care to existing mental health providers, says compensation is for the sector and civil or criminal law, and promises continued involvement without committing to new measures.
As for compensation for victims, that is a matter for the sector itself. It is not the role of the government here.
Wat betreft een tegemoetkoming aan slachtoffers is dat aan de sector zelf. Dat is hier niet de rol van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Eijk over het bericht 'Onderzoek naar klachten over evangelist Tom de Wal, hij geeft intussen Mercedes CLA en Audi A6 weg'

MPs asked whether faith healer Tom de Wal, who reportedly gives away luxury cars, falls under the Wkkgz, whether his title misleads patients, and whether his foundation's ANBI status fits the public-benefit requirement. The minister said the IGJ has no signals of structurally harmful practices, sees no reason to re-evaluate the rules, considers religious healing protected, and explained that ANBI status is neutrally assessed and the tax authority cannot act on such conduct.
However, I have no concrete signals that this is the case in practice.
Ik heb echter geen concrete signalen dat hiervan sprake is in de praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Mohandis , Inge van Dijk, Van Eijk en Paulusma over de afhandeling van de misstanden in de danswereld en de omgang met slachtoffers

MPs asked the Minister of VWS and the State Secretary of OCW how the government is handling misconduct in the dance sector, including compensation, apologies, trauma care for victims, and the status of adopted motions. The government responded that the Alliantie Dans Veilig, with recognition statements, support networks, OCW dance round tables and a school-level social safety programme, is taking action, while leaving the date for compensation and the sports-offender ban to a separate letter on motions.

Recently the omnibus letter on motions and commitments on sport and exercise was sent by the Minister of VWS to the House of Representatives, and the motions concerning the dance sector form part of it.

Onlangs is de verzamelbrief over de moties en toezeggingen sport en bewegen door de Minister van VWS naar de Tweede Kamer verzonden, de moties met betrekking tot de danssector vormen daar onderdeel van.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk en Aartsen over het bericht van de Hoge Raad: ‘Gratis verstrekking gezonde lunchmaaltijden aan werknemers valt voor de loonbelasting onder de gerichte vrijstelling voor Arbovoorzie

MPs Van Eijk and Aartsen asked whether the Supreme Court ruling that free healthy lunches fall under the tax exemption for occupational health provisions should be read broadly, and what the government will do to stimulate such lunches. The State Secretary answered that the ruling concerns pre-2022 rules, that since 2022 the exemption covers only mandatory occupational health provisions, that employers can provide healthy lunches using the WKR free space, and that the government sees no need or plan to change tax law, though an Arbo-regulation simplification plan is underway.
The cabinet considers it a good initiative that employers invest in keeping their staff healthy by providing healthy lunch meals.
Het kabinet vindt het een goed initiatief dat werkgevers zich door gezonde lunchmaaltijden te verstrekken inzetten om hun personeel gezond te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Eijk over het bericht ‘Deel huisartsen zwicht voor druk ouders en scholen bij voorschrijven ADHD-medicatie’

MPs Tielen and Van Eijk asked about reports that some GPs yield to parent and school pressure to prescribe ADHD medication, and about diagnosis and prescription trends, the ADHD misuse programme, referrals to specialist mental health care, and medical certificates. The minister says the government takes pressure on GPs seriously, points to 'Meer Tijd voor de Patiënt', the Gezonde Focus programme (focused mainly on students) and tables of diagnoses, prescriptions and referrals, but does not commit to new research on referral growth or to studying doctors' pressure around medical certificates.
I cannot provide an overview of the number of referrals to specialist mental health care since 2010 broken down by age group.
Ik kan geen overzicht geven over het aantal doorverwijzingen naar de specialistische ggz sinds 2010 uitgesplitst naar leeftijdsgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk over het Besluit met voorwaarden voor algemeen nut investeringen en het toezicht op algemeen nut beogende instellingen (ANBI’s)

The MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the new decree setting conditions for general-interest investments by ANBI charities, and whether it raises risks of misuse, definitional disputes, increased investment, or the need for stricter enforcement and oversight. The State Secretary replies that the conditions are carefully formulated, that no inherent misuse risk is seen, that enforcement intensification is not currently needed, and that the ANBI evaluation and digitalisation of oversight are underway.
This decree currently gives no reason to intensify enforcement of compliance by ANBIs.
Dit besluit geeft voor nu geen aanleiding voor intensivering van de handhaving op naleving door ANBI’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Martens-America over het hoofdstuk 'Zo krijg je geld terug van DUO' in het boek DRUKS 2

MPs Van Eijk and Martens-America asked whether DUO's prestatiebeurs (performance grant) facilities are widely misunderstood, whether a generic 'structural functional limitation' note suffices, whether late claims are allowed, and whether a book promoting ways to get money back from DUO is undesirable. The minister answered that DUO staff know the rules, that medical claims require a signed medical form and a causal link, that late claims are possible with justification and a five-year coulance term, and that free public information is not objectionable.
However, I see the task of ensuring that (former) students are informed through our own channels so well that no external explanation or help is needed.
Wel zie ik de taak om ervoor te zorgen dat (oud-) studenten via onze eigen kanalen zo geïnformeerd worden dat er verder geen externe toelichting of hulp nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk over de lokale lastendruk

A VVD MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and Minister De Jonge about local tax burdens, the split between waste, sewage and parking levies, and rules on parking charges. The minister answered with COELO figures on rising local levies from 2020 to 2024, the tariff systems used for waste charges, and stated that parking charge decisions lie with municipal councils.
It is for the municipal councils concerned to decide whether and where parking charges are levied.
Het is aan de betreffende gemeenteraden zelf om te beslissen of en waar parkeerbelastingen worden geheven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Eijk over het bericht ‘Onveilig sportklimaat en machtsmisbruik bij gewichthefbond’

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about reports of an unsafe sports climate and abuse of power at the Dutch weightlifting federation, including when NOC*NSF received complaints and started an investigation, whether reporters were contacted about the findings, and when the Commission on an independent integrity centre would be delivered. The minister answered that complaints date from 2020, an independent investigation ran from February 2023 to December 2023, reporters have been kept informed and can contact NOC*NSF, and the Chamber will be informed on the integrity centre before the summer recess.
I expect to inform the Chamber before the summer recess on the progress of preparing legislation for the independent integrity centre.
Ik informeer de Kamer naar verwachting voor het zomerreces over de voortgang van de voorbereiding van wetgeving voor het onafhankelijke integriteitscentrum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Brekelmans en Van Eijk over het bericht ‘Kabinet moet alerter zijn op spionage met Chinese scanners bij douane’

MPs from the VVD asked whether the government should reconsider using Nuctech scanners at Dutch customs given espionage risks, and why Nuctech has not been excluded as other countries did. The state secretary answered that a TNO-led study found current use does not endanger national security, that a retest is underway because of planned algorithm integration, and that the government will share results around summer recess.
The conclusions of the TNO-led study were submitted to the House of Representatives on a confidential basis.
De conclusies van het onderzoek onder regie van TNO zijn vertrouwelijk aangeboden aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Van Eijk over de kamerbrief van 11 maart 2024 inzake het rapport ‘VAT Gap in the EU, report 2023’

MPs Idsinga and Van Eijk-Nagel asked the State Secretary of Finance about the VAT gap report, including the size of the gap, its main causes, fraud versus other causes, and Commission follow-up. The State Secretary answered that the 2022 gap is €3.6bn (4.9%), that causes include fraud, optimisation and administrative errors, and pointed to VIDA package measures, evaluation of the reduced VAT rate and questions about the Ecofin discussion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Idsinga over het bericht 'A historic step’: G20 discusses plans for global minimum tax on billionaires'

MPs Van Eijk and Idsinga asked the State Secretary of Finance about a proposed global minimum tax on billionaires discussed at the G20, about how billionaires avoid tax, the revenue lost in the Netherlands, and national enforcement options, with 10 questions in total. The government answered that it is prioritising taxation of high net worth individuals in the OECD, will explore the issue step by step, and listed existing and planned anti-avoidance measures, while providing no revenue estimate and declining to commit to joining the initiative.
There is no estimate of the revenue of a minimum tax for billionaires in the Netherlands.
Er is geen raming van de opbrengst van een minimumbelasting voor miljardairs in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk over het bericht ‘Frauderisico bij brievenbus-bv’s: ‘In Muiden 403 bedrijven op één adres’’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a report that 403 companies are registered at one address in Muiden, and whether Dutch shell-company red flags and mass registration enable concealment of illegal activity and tax avoidance. The State Secretary disputed that Dutch red-flag counts are high relative to other countries, acknowledged mass registration can hide money flows, and pointed to an AML package with a registration duty for domicile providers, FIU reporting, and EU-level Unshell measures, while stating that Tax Authority data analysis of risky addresses is not yet available.
I am curious about the outcomes of this research and will consider what is needed based on the FEC's conclusions.
Ik ben benieuwd naar de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek en zal bezien wat nodig is, aan de hand van de conclusies van het FEC.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk over het bericht ‘Amerikaanse multinationals ontwijken Nederlandse bijheffing minimumbelasting’

MP Van Eijk asked whether the temporary safe-harbour for the undertaxed profits rule, which delays the Dutch top-up tax on parent-subsidiary structures, creates an escape route for US multinationals, and what steps the government will take against avoidance. The State Secretary acknowledged the report, defended the temporary safe-harbour as an OECD/Inclusive Framework compromise limited to 2025-2026 that cannot be extended, said no further anti-avoidance measures are planned for now, and expected no lower tax revenue in 2024-2025.
The cabinet will address the effects of the Minimum Tax Act 2024 measures in future versions of the monitoring letter on the tackling of tax avoidance, once the tax return data are available.
