requests the government to share with the House before the Christmas recess an overview
verzoekt de regering om voor het kerstreces van dit jaar een overzicht met de Kamer te delen
Motie van het lid Rooderkerk c.s. over de Kamer bij de Voorjaarsnota informeren over creatieve manieren om jongeren beter en structureler te betrekken bij het klimaatbeleid
Asks the government to inform the Chamber in the Spring Memorandum about creative ways to involve young people in climate policy, including the generation test.
requests the government to inform the Chamber, in the Spring Memorandum, about creative ways to involve young people in Netherlands more effectively and structurally in climate policy
verzoekt de regering de Kamer bij de Voorjaarsnota te informeren over de creatieve manieren om jongeren in Nederland beter en structureler te betrekken bij het klimaatbeleid
Amendement van de leden Rooderkerk en Postma over dekking voor middelen voor niet-commerciële organisaties ten behoeve van de aanpak van energiearmoede
Lowers the energy budget of the climate and energy ministry by 10 million euros to fund non-commercial energy poverty organisations in the housing ministry budget.
the commitment amount and the expenditure amount reduced by € 10,000 (x € 1,000)
het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verlaagd met € 10.000 (x € 1.000)
Motie van het lid Rooderkerk over de maatregelen die het kabinet meeneemt in de klimaatbesluitvorming in het eerste kwartaal van 2025 met de Kamer delen
Asks the government to share with parliament in Q1 2025 the climate measures it considers in spring decision-making.
requests the government to share with the House in Q1 2025 the various measures the cabinet considers in climate decision-making
verzoekt de regering om in het eerste kwartaal van 2025 de verschillende maatregelen die het kabinet meeneemt in de klimaatbesluitvorming met de Kamer te delen
Motie van het lid Rooderkerk c.s. over maatregelen om de impact van voorstellen met een negatieve klimaatimpact te beperken
Asks the government to state, for proposals with a net negative CO2 impact, which measures it takes to limit that impact.
requests the government to indicate, for proposals with a negative climate impact (net negative CO2 balance), which measures are taken to limit this impact
verzoekt de regering voor voorstellen met een negatieve klimaatimpact (netto negatief CO2-saldo) aan te geven welke maatregelen er worden genomen om deze impact te beperken
Motie van de leden Rooderkerk en Sneller over bij de aankomende voorjaarsbesluitvorming komen met concrete voorstellen voor de uitbreiding van het lokale belastinggebied
Asks the government to produce concrete proposals for expanding the local tax base of municipalities in the spring budget decision.
requests the government to come up with concrete proposals for expanding the local tax base
verzoekt de regering om tot concrete voorstellen voor de uitbreiding van het lokaal belastinggebied te komen
Motie van de leden Rooderkerk en Sneller over in de analyse van de doorwerking van het regeerprogramma komen tot een gedeeld beeld van de grootte van de totale disbalans tussen taken en middelen
Asks the government, in joint analysis with municipalities, to aim for a shared picture of the total gap between municipal tasks and funding and to agree on its consequences.
requests the government, in the joint analysis, to aim to reach a shared picture of the size of the total imbalance between tasks and resources
verzoekt de regering bij de gezamenlijke analyse ernaar te streven om tot een gedeeld beeld te komen van de grootte van de totale disbalans tussen taken en middelen
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 15 over de redelijke vergoeding op minimaal 50% van de leveringsprijs vaststellen tot 1 januari 2030
Sets a minimum reasonable compensation of 50% of the agreed supply price for electricity fed back under net-metering abolition until 2030, to protect consumers against energy suppliers.
Strong protection is important because consumers have little bargaining power against energy suppliers.
Stevige bescherming is van belang aangezien consumenten weinig onderhandelingsmacht hebben ten opzichte van energieleveranciers.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Grinwis en Rooderkerk ter vervanging van nr. 9 over de redelijke vergoeding op minimaal 50% van de leveringsprijs vaststellen tot 1 januari 2030
Amends the energy bill so that for active consumers the reasonable compensation for fed-in electricity is at least 50% of the supply price until 2030, with ACM setting the percentage thereafter.
the reasonable compensation referred to in the seventh paragraph is not less than 50% of the agreed price for the electricity supplied
de redelijke vergoeding, bedoeld in het zevende lid, niet minder dan 50% van de voor de te leveren elektriciteit overeengekomen prijs
Amendement van de leden Paternotte en Rooderkerk over middelen voor het vervolgonderwijs

Amendment restores about one billion euro of education and research budget cuts in higher and vocational education by raising spending on several budget articles and proposing separate funding offsets.
This amendment therefore reverses all education cuts in further education.
Dit amendement draait daarom alle onderwijsbezuinigingen in het vervolgonderwijs terug.
Amendement van de leden Grinwis en Rooderkerk over het markttoezicht door de ACM uitbreiden met toezicht op het aanbod op terugleveringsovereenkomsten
Extends ACM market supervision to the availability of competitive offers for feed-in agreements and lets ACM impose binding conduct rules on suppliers.
the market supervision of ACM is extended to supervision of the availability of competitive offers on feed-in agreements
het markttoezicht van de ACM wordt uitgebreid met toezicht op de beschikbaarheid van een concurrerend aanbod op terugleveringsovereenkomsten
Amendement van de leden Grinwis en Rooderkerk over de redelijke vergoeding op minimaal 50% van de leveringsprijs vaststellen tot 1 januari 2030
Sets a statutory minimum of 50 percent of the agreed price as the reasonable compensation for electricity fed back by active consumers, until 2030.
If a market participant has a supply and feed-back agreement with an active consumer, the reasonable compensation is not less than 50 percent of the agreed supply price.

Indien een marktdeelnemer een leverings- en terugleveringsovereenkomst heeft met een actieve afnemer, dan bedraagt de redelijke vergoeding, bedoeld in het zevende lid, niet minder dan 50% van de voor de levering overeengekomen prijs.
Motie van de leden Pijpelink en Rooderkerk over de hoogste prioriteit geven aan de aanpak van het lerarentekort en de achteruitgang van de beheersing van de basisvaardigheden
Asks the government to give the highest priority to tackling the teacher shortage and declining basic skills in primary and secondary education policy.
requests the government to give highest priority to tackling these problems in the coming period
verzoekt de regering om de aanpak van deze problemen de komende tijd de hoogste prioriteit te geven
Motie van het lid Rooderkerk c.s. over uitspreken dat de btw op school- en studieboeken niet verhoogd moet worden
Asks the House to state that VAT on school and study books should not be raised, as planned in the coalition agreement.
expresses that VAT on school and study books should not be raised
spreekt uit dat de btw op school- en studieboeken niet verhoogd moet worden

Motie van het lid Rooderkerk over uitspreken dat er in Nederland reeds neutrale seksuele voorlichting plaatsvindt, die goed is toegespitst op de leeftijd van kinderen, en dat het van belang is dat dit
States that Dutch sexual education is already neutral and well suited to children's ages and asks that this continue.
declares that neutral sexual education already takes place in the Netherlands
spreekt uit dat er in Nederland reeds neutrale seksuele voorlichting plaatsvindt
Motie van het lid Rooderkerk c.s. over uitspreken dat de langstudeerboete een dramatisch slecht idee is
Motion declaring that the proposed long-study fine (langstudeerboete) is a very bad idea and moving to the next item.
declares that the long-study fine is a dramatically bad idea
spreekt uit dat de langstudeerboete een dramatisch slecht idee is
Motie van het lid Rooderkerk over het uitwerken van een meerjarig, zorgvuldig afbouwpad van de salderingsregeling, met oog voor een acceptabele terugverdientijd
Asks the government, on taking office, to draw up a multi-year, gradual phase-out path for the net-metering scheme with an acceptable payback period, instead of abolishing it in one step.
requests the government, upon the arrival of a new cabinet, to draw up a multi-year, careful phase-out path for the net-metering scheme
verzoekt de regering om bij het aantreden van een nieuw kabinet een meerjarig, zorgvuldig afbouwpad van de salderingsregeling uit te werken
Motie van het lid Rooderkerk over de Kamer informeren over het bedrag dat in 2024 nodig zou zijn om het binnenklimaat in en de duurzaamheid van schoolgebouwen te verbeteren
Motion asking the government to inform the House of the amount needed in 2024 to improve indoor climate and sustainability of school buildings.
requests the government to inform the House of the amount needed in 2024 to improve the indoor climate and sustainability of school buildings
verzoekt de regering de Kamer te informeren over het bedrag dat in 2024 nodig zou zijn om het binnenklimaat in en de duurzaamheid van schoolgebouwen te verbeteren
Amendement van het lid Rooderkerk over het voorzien in een hoorrecht van individuele leerlingen aangaande beslissingen omtrent basisondersteuningsvoorzieningen die die leerling betreffen
Gives individual pupils a right to be heard before school boards decide on basic support provisions concerning them, with an explanation of how their view was taken into account.
If basic support provisions are arranged for a pupil, the competent authority gives the pupil the opportunity to freely express his or her view on this, in a manner the pupil determines.

Indien voor een leerling basisondersteuningsvoorzieningen worden getroffen, stelt het bevoegd gezag de leerling in de gelegenheid hierover, op een door de leerling te bepalen wijze, vrijelijk zijn mening naar voren te brengen.
Motie van de leden Rooderkerk en Grinwis over regelen dat nieuwe zon-PV-systemen op Nederlandse daken flexibel worden ingesteld, zodat ze minder vaak uitvallen
Asks the government to require new residential solar PV systems to be set flexibly so they fail less often, and to inform owners of settings changes.
requests the government to arrange that new solar PV systems on Dutch roofs are set flexibly
verzoekt de regering om te regelen dat nieuwe zon-PV-systemen op Nederlandse daken flexibel worden ingesteld
Amendement van het lid Rooderkerk over het bij verordening van gemeente of provincie kunnen vragen naar lokaal mede-eigenaarschap
Lets provinces and municipalities require renewable energy producers to motivate their efforts toward 50 percent local co-ownership via a local regulation.
Provincial states and the municipal council may by regulation determine that a producer, when building or expanding a renewable energy installation, must motivate its efforts.
Provinciale staten en de gemeenteraad kunnen bij verordening bepalen dat een producent bij de aanleg of uitbreiding van een installatie voor de productie van energie uit hernieuwbare bronnen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over de berichten 'Meisjes krijgen lagere schooladviezen dan jongens terwijl ze beter scoren' en 'Doorstroomtoets helpt ook niet tegen onderadvisering meisjes, maar Staatssecreta

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Education why girls receive lower school recommendations than boys despite scoring higher on the entry test, and whether the doorstroomtoets corrects for this under-advising. The State Secretary acknowledged the under-advising of girls, said the adjustment measure has largely corrected it, committed to funding longer follow-up research and further study, but said a single national test by 2027 is not feasible (earliest 2029).
Yes, I am willing to facilitate this.
Ik ben bereid om dit te faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heera Dijk en Rooderkerk over de doorstroomtoets op de BES-eilanden

MPs Heera Dijk and Rooderkerk asked whether the mandatory Doorstroomtoets Bonaire, replacing the IEP test for 2025-2026, can be combined with the IEP test and whether early testing and unvalidated predictive value pose risks for Bonaire pupils. The state secretary confirmed the statutory obligation, rejected dual testing as infeasible, defended the early testing date and the test's quality, and committed to talks with school boards and an evaluation with the Chamber.
That is why I support administering this test this school year.
Daarom sta ik er ook achter om deze toets dit schooljaar af te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het bericht ‘Van Gogh Museum dreigt deuren te sluiten, ruziet met staat over geld voor onderhoud’

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the state should raise the Van Gogh Museum's subsidy by 2.5 million euro per year for renovation, questioning the museum's risk of closure, the 1962 agreement and the timing of a decision. The minister replies that the current housing subsidy is sufficient for necessary maintenance, that the museum should fund more ambitious sustainability plans itself, that the expert report will be shared once redacted, and that a court case is scheduled for February 2026 with a final decision possibly not until 2027.
The Van Gogh Museum has however asked me to redact information in view of confidentiality objections.
Het Van Gogh Museum heeft mij echter verzocht om informatie te redigeren met het oog op vertrouwelijkheidsbezwaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het artikel 'Homo zijn mag wel, homo doen niet: de dubbele boodschap in religieus onderwijs'

An MP asked the minister about a Nieuwsuur report on religious school teaching materials that stigmatise LHBTI people and Jews, and whether the inspectorate knows of such methods and how it will respond. The minister said the inspectorate does not supervise teaching materials as such, but will assess how they are used under the civic education duty, and will act through remedial orders where schools fail to counter discriminatory content.
The inspectorate keeps no overview of teaching methods because it does not supervise teaching methods as such.
inspectie) houdt geen overzicht van lesmethoden bij omdat zij geen toezicht houdt op lesmethoden als zodanig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over de nieuwsberichten over Duitse windturbines aan de grens bij Noord-Brabant, Limburg en Gelderland

An MP asked the minister about German wind turbines near the Dutch border, the number of affected households, whether Espoo and Aarhus obligations are breached, and what the government will do to support Dutch municipalities and citizens. The minister answered that the matter lies with the provinces and German authorities, that no clear breach of treaties is established, and that the government will keep discussing the issue with German authorities through existing channels without committing to new action.
Because I am not the competent authority in this matter, I do not know exact figures on how many households are involved.
Omdat ik geen bevoegd gezag ben in dezen ken ik geen exacte cijfers over hoeveel huishoudens het betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Thijssen, Rooderkerk, Bamenga, Postma, Gabriëls, Wingelaar, Teunissen en Koekkoek over de MER Tata Steel en misleidende communicatie over uitstootcijfers

MPs asked the government about the Tata Steel HeraCless environmental impact report (MER), including rising fine particulate, NOx and dioxin levels, unclear emission reduction figures, EAF slag risks, CO2 reduction claims, the pending health impact assessment, job cuts and conditions for state subsidy. The state secretary largely deferred to the competent authority (Province of Noord-Holland) and the ongoing procedure, while stating that negotiations on the maatwerk agreement continue and that binding, enforceable terms and monitoring will be included.
The national government cannot yet take positions, because the competent authority still has to interpret and assess the MER.
Er zijn door de Rijksoverheid nog geen stellingen in te nemen, omdat het bevoegd gezag de MER nog moet interpreteren en beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk, Westerveld, Van Campen en Heite over de staat van lhbti-acceptatie in het onderwijs en scherper toezicht daarop

MPs asked whether the Inspectorate of Education's last thematic study on sexual diversity (2020) should be repeated, how school supervision covers LGBTQ acceptance and civic duties, and what support schools receive. The state secretary answered that the Inspectorate has deeper research planned for 2026, that sexual diversity is a standing supervision point with repair orders and funding sanctions for non-compliance, and listed existing surveys, a pending bill on safe education, and support programmes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het onderzoek van BOOS en Follow the Money naar Stichting Durf te Dromen en mogelijke misleiding van scholen

An MP asked the education minister about reports that schools paid a commercial company linked to charity Stichting Durf te Dromen, whether this occurred elsewhere, and what safeguards exist against mixing public and private money. The state secretary said schools choose their own suppliers, the ministry keeps no overview, there are no signals of similar cases, and schools are only urged to be transparent and report suspected subsidy fraud to DUS-I.
No, the Ministry of OCW does not keep an overview of the services purchased by schools.
Nee, het Ministerie van OCW houdt geen overzicht bij van de diensten die door scholen worden afgenomen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over de berichten 'Door kabinet beloofd onderzoek naar doorstroomtoetsen blijkt niet te bestaan' en 'Scholen die overstapten op andere doorstroomtoets scoren flink beter'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Education why no targeted research into differences between primary-school end-of-primary tests (doorstroomtoetsen) providers was started, despite earlier promises, and about the PO-Raad analysis showing schools switching providers scored higher. The State Secretary answered that a broad CvTE research programme examines factors such as paper versus digital administration and that the government will address consequences of the test's role in the school-advice system and supervision.
No, this is not correct. Several studies are underway that contribute to answering the question of where the differences between test providers come from.
Nee, dit klopt niet. Er lopen verschillende onderzoeken die bijdragen aan het antwoord op de vraag waar de verschillen tussen toetsaanbieders vandaan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Rooderkerk over de brand op een vrachtschip in de haven van Amsterdam

MPs Bamenga and Rooderkerk (D66) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the cause of a May 2025 ship fire in the Amsterdam port, repeated fires, prevention measures, and health monitoring of residents. The minister answered that the cause is unknown and the matter is a local responsibility, cited general measures on battery waste and prevention by industry, and reported that GGD and the safety region issued advice to residents.
This concerns a local incident, which is handled by the local competent authority.
Het betreft een lokaal incident, dat door het lokaal bevoegd gezag behandeld wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het bericht ‘Uniper stopt met veel investeringen in Nederland vanwege onduidelijk beleid’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about reports that Uniper is halting major Dutch investments due to unclear energy policy, including effects on hydrogen, green gas, CO2 reduction and security of supply. The minister answered that details of the projects and amounts are unknown, that Uniper continues its Maasvlakte hydrogen project and keeps its power plants, and that the cabinet will address dispatchable capacity via a possible capacity mechanism with a decision planned in the first half of 2026.
The cabinet does not have details regarding Uniper's specific projects or the scale of the associated investments.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over details met betrekking tot de betreffende projecten van Uniper of de omvang van de hiermee gepaard gaande investeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Rooderkerk over onverwachte bezuinigingen van een half miljard euro extra op onderwijs in de Voorjaarsnota.

Two D66 MPs asked the education minister why nearly half a billion euros in extra cuts to education were introduced in the spring budget memorandum, given pressure on basic skills, and asked about the effects on pupils losing the education opportunities scheme, higher education funding, vocational practical training, and consistency with earlier parliamentary deals. The minister answered that the net budget rises structurally by about 2 billion euros, that the cuts are offsets within the OCW budget, that the education opportunities scheme is abolished (about 177 million per year) with the government pointing to other basic-skills programmes, and that institutions can absorb the higher education and practical-training reductions.
With this spring budget memorandum, the OCW budget is structurally increased by a net of about 2 billion euros, largely as a result of the fully paid-out wage adjustment.
Met deze Voorjaarsnota wordt er per saldo structureel circa € 2 miljard toegevoegd aan de OCW-begroting, grotendeels als gevolg van de loonbijstelling die volledig wordt uitgekeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk, Pijpelink en Beckerman over het bericht 'Nationaal Onderwijsmuseum in Dordrecht dreigt te verdwijnen vanwege geldgebrek'

MPs asked why the Minister is ending funding for the National Education Museum in Dordrecht, whether alternatives were explored, and whether the decision will be reconsidered. The Staatssecretaris replied that budget cuts forced choices favouring core education tasks, that alternatives would require a substantial subsidy increase deemed unavailable, that the collection belongs to the museum foundation, and that no reconsideration is planned.
I informed the Education Museum as early as possible to give it the chance to seek alternative funding or, if it sees no options, to achieve a careful wind-down.

Ik heb het Onderwijsmuseum zo vroeg mogelijk geïnformeerd om de kans te bieden op zoek te gaan naar alternatieve financiering of, als zij hier geen mogelijkheden voor zien, een zorgvuldige afbouw te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Vijlbrief over een kapitaalstorting voor Tennet om de energierekening van mensen en bedrijven te verlagen

MPs Rooderkerk and Vijlbrief (D66) asked whether public investment in the electricity grid should be financed by cutting other public services or by letting national debt rise, and whether future generations should share the cost. The minister answered that options were weighed in the spring decision-making (raising the energy tax reduction on electricity, the IBO options), that grid investment is financed by public grid operators recouped via tariffs, and that all users, present and future, pay through tariffs, without committing to a specific cut or debt choice.
The cabinet endorses that it is desirable for all users of the electricity grid to contribute to the investments in, and maintenance of, the grid.
Het kabinet onderschrijft dat het wenselijk is dat alle gebruikers van het elektriciteitsnet meebetalen aan de investeringen in, en het onderhoud van het net.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief en Rooderkerk over het uitblijven van duurzame investeringen door bedrijven en beleggers

MPs Vijlbrief and Rooderkerk asked whether unclear climate policy is delaying green investment, whether a climate package will be in place this spring, and about the cost of delayed action and government cuts to the green economy. The minister replied that the government is committed to the Climate Act targets, cited grid congestion, CCS capacity and electricity prices as the main reasons for delayed investment, promised clarity in the Klimaatplan and Voorjaarsnota, and deferred several points to the spring budget.
The cabinet has committed in the Coalition Agreement and Government Programme to the existing agreements on the 2030 and 2050 climate targets as formulated in the Climate Act.
Het kabinet heeft zich in het Hoofdlijnenakkoord en het Regeerprogramma gecommitteerd aan de bestaande afspraken voor de klimaatdoelen van 2030 en 2050 zoals geformuleerd in de Klimaatwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over de agressieve en misleidende telefonische verkoop van thuisbatterijen

An MP asked the ministers about aggressive and misleading telephone sales of home batteries, including threatened fees, withdrawal rights, repeat offenders and privacy of phone numbers. The minister answered that the ACM is autonomous and handles enforcement, that consumers keep a 14-day cooling-off right extended if misinformed, that the stricter ban on unsolicited calling applies from 1 July 2026, and that the government will talk with the ACM but cannot urge enforcement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over de zienswijze van scholen die weigeren de doorstroomtoets uit te voeren

MP Rooderkerk asked the State Secretary for Education how the government responds to schools' objections to the doorstroomtoets (transition test) and the claims of excessive differentiation and weak validity of the test. The State Secretary defends the test as an objective second input to school advice, rejects the claim of over-differentiation, and promises further discussion and a letter in April.
The transition test offers pupils an objective second data point alongside the provisional school advice.
De doorstroomtoets biedt leerlingen een objectief, tweede gegeven bij het voorlopige schooladvies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Rooderkerk over de economische kansen van verduurzaming op Curaçao

Two D66 MPs asked about a Curaçao solar park, EV charging and electric buses, including a 13.2 million euro financing gap and Dutch funding commitments. The minister says Curaçao is responsible for procurement and financing, that Dutch SDE funds cannot be used directly but grid and storage costs may be eligible, and that a feasibility study and a May visit to Curaçao are planned.
It is up to Curaçao to shape the implementation and financing.
Het is aan Curaçao om de uitvoering en financiering vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief en Rooderkerk over de klimaataanpak van de minister

Two MPs from D66 asked the minister for Housing and Spatial Planning about the climate approach for the built environment: emissions, energy-cost differences by label, buildings in the public sector, grid congestion, labour shortages, funding, the heat pump subsidy and whether targets could be dropped. The minister answered with emissions and cost tables, described existing public-sector instruments and funding, said the grid and labour effects were not fully quantified, and deferred the overall climate package and the question of dropping targets to the Minister of Climate and Green Growth and the spring budget decision.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het bericht 'Boeren, bedrijven en milieuclubs: kabinet, kom snel met stabiel klimaatbeleid'

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth whether a spring climate package will be made, how it will be financed, how the process is organised, and whether the climate targets could be dropped without funding. The minister answered that alternative climate and energy measures are being prepared for the spring decision-making, financed mainly from the Climate Fund, and that the government is holding to its climate targets while preparing alternative policy if they are missed.
For the spring decision-making, the cabinet is working on alternative climate and energy measures as set out in the Climate Note.
Het kabinet werkt ten behoeve van de voorjaarsbesluitvorming aan alternatieve klimaat- en energiemaatregelen zoals aangegeven in de Klimaatnota.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Rooderkerk over het bericht 'De impact van vervuilende industrie op burgers en overheden'

MPs Paulusma and Rooderkerk asked the Health Minister about health risks from polluting industry, climate change, air quality, housing, zoonoses, pandemic preparedness and budget cuts. The minister answered that climate change poses health risks, that industrial clusters are regulated regionally, that work on industry and residents is ongoing, and that funding decisions are still pending.
Much work has been done in recent years to improve our pandemic preparedness.
Er is in de afgelopen jaren hard gewerkt aan het verbeteren van onze pandemische paraatheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Rooderkerk en Teunissen over extra klimaatmaatregelen naar aanleiding van de Klimaat- en Energieverkenning 2024

MPs asked whether extra climate measures are being drafted, whether any measures fall outside the IBO report, and whether ministry fiches and PBL/TNO reflections on the Meerjarenprogramma can be shared before the KEV debate. The Minister answers that the cabinet is still deciding alternative policy for the spring Voorjaarsnota, that it draws on many sources including the IBO and a pricing study, and that fiches and PBL/TNO reflections will be shared with the concept-Meerjarenprogramma.
The cabinet will share these fiches with the Chamber when it presents the draft Meerjarenprogramma.
Deze fiches zal het kabinet bij het aanbieden van het concept-Meerjarenprogramma met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Bamenga over het artikel op de website PITANE.BLUE van 19 januari 2025: ‘OV-NL: doel uitstootvrije bussen in 2030 onder druk door gebrek aan stroom’

MPs Rooderkerk and Bamenga asked the Minister and State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about mobility CO2 emissions, whether the 2030 restemissie target is reachable, funding, grid congestion delaying bus electrification, air quality and whether climate targets could be dropped. The State Secretary answered that the government is not on track, will consider alternative measures in spring, has no budget space yet, cites grid-congestion agreements and subsidies, and states it will only deviate from climate targets if alternative policy fails.
Therefore the cabinet is looking this spring at the possibilities for taking alternative measures, as also agreed in the coalition programme.
Daarom kijkt het kabinet dit voorjaar naar de mogelijkheden om alternatieve maatregelen te treffen, zoals ook afgesproken in het regeerprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Rooderkerk over het bericht 'Schoof: binnen twee maanden stikstofplan, 'economie moet blijven functioneren''

Two D66 MPs asked the agriculture minister for sector-level agricultural emissions figures, whether the 2030 climate target for farming is achievable, the budget gap, and how the stikstof (nitrogen) lock affects green projects. The minister gave breakdowns for 2023, said 2024 figures and the 2030 target status will follow later, outlined planned policy measures, and promised a joint package to be announced in the spring budget.
The cabinet will consider the required budgets for the various challenges, including the climate task, during the spring budget decision-making.
Het kabinet zal bij de voorjaarsbesluitvorming stil staan bij de benodigde budgetten voor de verschillende opgaven, waaronder de klimaatopgave.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het nieuwsbericht ‘Mode-industrie maakt nog nauwelijks begin met verplicht recyclen’

An MP asked the State Secretary why textile recycling remains near 0.3% despite the extended producer responsibility (UPV) for textiles, whether producers and the Stichting UPV Textiel are doing enough, and whether the ILT will enforce compliance. The State Secretary answered that the targets took effect in 2025 to give producers time, reporting is due from 2026, the ILT will enforce from then, and it is too early to judge effectiveness; stricter measures are possible after the 2028 evaluation or the EU waste directive revision.
From 2026 the ILT can enforce whether these targets are met, based on the submitted reports.
Vanaf 2026 kan de ILT handhaven op het al dan niet behalen van deze doelstellingen op basis van de ingediende rapportages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het bericht 'Noodfonds Energie stopt in 2025 door gebrek aan bedrijfssteun'

An MP from D66 asked ministers whether the Noodfonds Energie (emergency energy fund) should end in 2025 for lack of business contributions, and whether other parties such as grid operators could contribute. The government answered that talks with energy suppliers and grid operators continue, that the fund is needed for 2025, and that the sector's contribution to administrative costs is required to avoid state aid risk, with a request under the Comptabiliteitswet to start disbursement quickly.
The cabinet is actively looking for a solution to make this possible.
Het kabinet zoekt actief naar een oplossing om dit mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Rooderkerk over het bericht 'Dringend meer geld nodig voor schoolgebouwen'

MPs Sneller and Rooderkerk asked the government whether school building funding is adequate, citing an IBO finding of at least 730 million euros a year shortfall, and how school housing fits the Herstelplan and the planned school housing bill. The State Secretary acknowledged the IBO figure and the need for faster renewal but said no additional funds are available, and argued the housing bill sets no new building standards and that gemeenten will be compensated via the gemeentefonds.
The honest story is that this cabinet has had to make hard choices; there are no additional funds.
Het eerlijke verhaal is dat dit kabinet scherpe keuzes heeft moeten maken; er zijn geen aanvullende middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over “de schimmige telefonische verkoop van thuisbatterijen”

An MP asked the Minister whether telephone sales of home batteries are shady, the regulatory position on leases and bundled energy contracts, and whether the Energiewet will curb such sales. The Minister answered that the ACM handles enforcement, that existing tools seem sufficient, that new telecom rules will bar unsolicited sales calls to existing customers, and that stakeholders will be consulted.
The cabinet has taken note of the article reporting shady telephone sales of home batteries.
Het kabinet heeft kennisgenomen van het artikel waarin wordt gesproken over schimmige telefonische verkoop van thuisbatterijen.
Beantwoording op vragen van de leden Kröger c.s. over het gaswinningsproject bij Ternaard

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, SP, PvdD and D66 asked why the government will not share TNO and Mijnraad advice, the official appraisal of those advice, the Wnb permit, and why not all relevant documents were published under Awb 3:11 and the Aarhus Convention, plus questions on Waddenzee World Heritage Outstanding Universal Value. The minister refused to publish the advice before the decision, citing negotiating position with NAM and protection of a careful decision-making process, offering only confidential inspection by the Kamer, and asserted procedures were correctly followed.
Once the decision-making is complete, the cabinet will of course make the advice public and inform the Kamer about it.
Zodra de besluitvorming is afgerond zal het kabinet de adviezen uiteraard openbaar maken en de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen, Teunissen en Rooderkerk over de uitspraak van het Gerechtshof over de rechtszaak tussen Milieudefensie en Shell

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, PvdD and D66 asked the minister how the Hague appeal court's ruling in the Milieudefensie v. Shell climate case affects climate targets, corporate duties, and whether new oil and gas fields should be restricted. The minister replied that the case is a private civil dispute, that corporate responsibility is addressed through EU CSDDD and existing climate policy, and that no new measures on new fossil licences will be taken.
This concerns a civil case between private parties. The government is not a party to this case.
Het betreft een civielrechtelijke zaak tussen private partijen. De overheid is geen partij in deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Beckerman, Rooderkerk en Teunissen over gaswinning bij Ternaard

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, SP, D66 and PvdD asked whether the gas extraction permit at Ternaard was properly re-tested in light of SodM advice, Waddenacademie and UNESCO warnings, MER commission input and undisclosed advice, and whether all studies would be shared. The minister replied that the permit was granted in February 2024 under the Nature Protection Act, that the relevant advice gave no reason to revoke or amend it, that the Landsadvocaat advised UNESCO's position falls outside the legal test, and that the government would share some advice confidentially and publish others after final decision-making.

In line with my commitment in the debate of 11 December, I am willing to make the advice of TNO, SodM and Mijnraad available confidentially for inspection, so that committee members can read the content of this advice.

Conform mijn toezegging in het debat van 11 december, ben ik bereid de adviezen van TNO, SodM en Mijnraad vertrouwelijk ter inzage te leggen, zodat de commissieleden van de inhoud van deze adviezen kennis kunnen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Bamenga, Rooderkerk en Gabriëls over de faillissementen van steeds meer koplopers in onze circulaire economie

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government what it had done after several Dutch circular plastics recyclers went bankrupt, what caused the failures, and how the government responded to cheap Chinese and virgin plastic. The state secretary answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, outlined market causes and EU trade measures, and set out planned measures including a plastic levy from 2028, a recyclate norm from 2027 and EUR 267 million in subsidies.
The cabinet cannot go into individual cases, but can confirm that the Ministry of KGG has had contact with a number of plastic recycling companies to explore options for support.

Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op individuele casus, maar wel bevestigen dat het Ministerie van KGG contact heeft gehad met een aantal plasticrecyclingbedrijven om mogelijkheden voor ondersteuning te bekijken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over de berichten ‘Nederlandse gasvoorraden de laagste van Europa: hebben we nog genoeg voor deze winter?’ en ‘Moet Europa zich zorgen maken over slinkende gasvoorraden met stren

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth whether Dutch gas storage levels, which are the lowest in Europe, are sufficient for the coming winter, and about the effects on prices, consumption and energy saving. The minister answered that storage is commercial, that current levels plus infrastructure are expected to suffice even in a cold winter, that a structural filling obligation via EBN and a bill are being prepared, and that other questions are pending.
For now, however, the expectation is that there is enough gas in the storage facilities to get through the winter, even if it is a cold winter.
Vooralsnog is het echter de verwachting dat er voldoende gas in de opslagen zit om de winter door te komen, ook als sprake is van een koude winter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Paulusma over het artikel 'Aidsfonds maakt zich zorgen over stijging hiv-infecties bij jonge mannen'

MPs Rooderkerk and Paulusma asked the State Secretary of Health about rising HIV diagnoses among young men, the effectiveness of PrEP and condom campaigns, budget cuts to prevention, and whether Amsterdam's approach can be scaled nationally. The State Secretary acknowledged the rise, described PrEP-care and prevention measures, said that cuts to specific grants are under review with decisions due early next year, and promised a monitoring update before summer.
I will inform your House about this in more detail before the summer.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover voor de zomer nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over snel aanvullende klimaatmaatregelen nemen

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth whether new climate measures will be decided in the spring 2025 budget memorandum, why not sooner given the Raad van State's advice, and whether the measures will be sufficient to reach the 2030 targets. The minister answered that alternative policy will be decided in spring 2025 under the regular budget cycle, that the Climate Act sets no decision date, that preparations are underway, and that PBL can only model the package after that decision, while committing to publish the KEV on Prinsjesdag.
It is correct that the Climate Act nowhere states when the decision-making must take place.
Het klopt dat in de Klimaatwet nergens staat wanneer de besluitvorming moet plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Sneller over marktconcentratie op de schoolboeken- en schoolboekendistributiemarkt

MPs Rooderkerk and Sneller asked about market concentration in the school textbook and distribution market, including market shares, ownership, vendor lock-in, costs and waste of workbooks. The State Secretary gave estimates of concentration (about 77% for the three largest VO publishers, about 80% for the four largest PO publishers, two main distributors per sector), said ACM oversight and a study with EZ are underway, and pointed to SIVON, Edu-V and open learning materials, while declining to give exact market-share data.
The Ministry of OCW does not have specific market shares for individual publishers.
Het Ministerie van OCW beschikt niet over specifieke marktaandelen van afzonderlijke uitgevers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het bericht 'AOB waarschuwt voor 'onopgemerkte bezuiniging': in Randstad vanaf 2026 minder geld voor leraren.'

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about the abolition of the Randstad salary function-mix scheme for secondary teachers from 2026, its financial impact on schools, and whether a phase-in path or reversal is possible. The state secretary confirmed the cuts, said a phase-in is not necessary, refused to reverse the measure, and promised to share the financial analysis with parliament.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Kröger en Rooderkerk over de kosten van de bouw van twee kerncentrales die volgens experts aanzienlijk hoger uitpakken dan de kostenraming van het kabinet

MPs Teunissen, Kröger and Rooderkerk asked the minister why cost estimates for two new nuclear plants (potentially 35-40 billion euro according to Follow the Money) differ from the cabinet's figure, and about financing, risk allocation and cost comparisons. The minister replied that no construction cost estimate has been made, only a reservation for the state share, that a cost indication will follow in spring 2025 after third-party review, and that cost commitments and risk allocation will be settled only in contract negotiations, while largely deflecting comparisons and the sunk-cost question.
The cabinet has not estimated costs for the construction of the nuclear power plants, but has set aside money for the government contribution to financing the total costs.
Het kabinet heeft geen kosten geraamd voor de bouw van de kerncentrales, maar heeft geld gereserveerd voor de overheidsbijdrage in de financiering van de totale kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over 59 grote en kleine podiumgroepen en festivals die op het omvallen staan, ondanks een positief advies van het Fonds Podiumkunsten

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why 59 performing arts groups and festivals with positive Fonds Podiumkunsten advice are at risk of closure, requesting a list, funding of about 10.9 million euros, and an explanation of why youth choirs received support while these did not. The minister confirmed the list (now 57 institutions after two were funded), said there is no room for the 10 million euro without harming other priorities except a one-off transition payment and funding for classical youth talent development, and said the impact of fiscal measures will be monitored.
I see no room to find another 10 million euros in the culture budget without this coming at the expense of other priorities shared by the House.
Ik zie geen ruimte om op de cultuurbegroting nog eens ruim € 10 miljoen te vinden, zonder dat dit ten koste gaat van andere door de Kamer gedeelde prioriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Rooderkerk over maatregelen die contraproductief werken voor het oplossen van de klimaatcrisis

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management about the CO2 impact of opening Lelystad Airport to commercial flights and of possibly reversing zero-emission zones, including whether the climate minister was consulted and what the timeline is. The government said the decision is still pending in 2025, that an updated environmental impact report will assess CO2 emissions and be submitted to parliament, and that the zero-emission zone reduction was estimated at 1 Mton CO2 per year from 2030.

Once there is clarity on a definitive planning of these products, the House will be informed about the decision-making steps. The role of parliament is (also) safeguarded through the pre-submission procedure.
Zodra er zicht is op een definitieve planning van deze producten wordt de Kamer geïnformeerd over de besluitvormingsstappen. De rol van het parlement is (ook) via de voorhangprocedure geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Paternotte over de niet ingevulde bezuiniging op het basis- en voortgezet onderwijs en het mbo

D66 MPs Rooderkerk and Paternotte asked why the education subsidy cut (subsidietaakstelling) was booked on primary, secondary and vocational education budgets without concrete measures, which initiatives are affected, and why the cut was not allocated in detail. Minister Bruins explained the provisional booking was a deliberate technical choice, confirmed that several named organisations and internship funding are not cut in substance, but declined to give some details, deferring them to a forthcoming letter and amendment note.
The fact that subsidy budgets in the draft budget were reduced by such large amounts, ahead of an amendment note with the structural allocation of the cut, raises many questions.

Het feit dat subsidiebudgetten in de Ontwerpbegroting met dergelijke grote bedragen zijn verlaagd, vooruitlopend op een nota van wijziging met structurele invulling van de taakstelling, roept veel vragen op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Rooderkerk en Teunissen over het bericht 'Klimaatminister voorspelt dat haar eigen beleid niet voldoende is'

MPs Kröger, Rooderkerk and Teunissen asked the climate minister about a newspaper report that her own policy would not be sufficient to meet the 2030 climate target, and why this was not stated in parliament, and about the expected CO2 effects of several scrapped or retained measures. The minister confirmed the warning, said the impact of individual measures cannot be quantified separately, deferred the full assessment to the KEV projection and the Klimaatnota, and declined to name new measures before the spring decision-making.
The cabinet does not want to anticipate the political decision-making in spring 2025 on possible alternative climate measures.
Het kabinet wil niet op de politieke besluitvorming in het Voorjaar 2025 over mogelijke alternatieve klimaatmaatregelen vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk, Beckerman, Pijpelink en Ergin over het delen van alternatieve opties voor het uitstellen van de curriculumherziening

Four MPs asked the State Secretary for Education to share a scenario exploration document on revising the core objectives (kerndoelen) before a committee debate on the curriculum reform. The State Secretary refused, citing the convention that documents prepared for cabinet and sub-committee deliberations are not made public to protect cabinet unity.
In line with cabinet-wide disclosure policy, documents prepared for the Council of Ministers and its sub-committees are in principle not made public in order to safeguard the unity of cabinet policy.

In lijn met het kabinetsbrede beleid rondom openbaarmaking worden stukken ter voorbereiding van de ministerraad en onderraden in principe niet openbaar gemaakt om de eenheid van kabinetsbeleid te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Rooderkerk, Podt en Bamenga over het schrappen van het Nationaal Programma Landelijk Gebied (NPLG)

MPs from D66 asked whether the National Programme for the Rural Area (NPLG) remains government policy, what the quantitative effects of scrapping it are on climate, nature, and Water Framework Directive goals, and how alternative measures and the decision-making process were handled. The minister answers that the cabinet is ending the NPLG in favour of an implementation-focused, area-specific approach with contours due by year-end, while stating that the international targets stay in place, and that scrapping was agreed in inter-ministerial consultation and in the Regeerprogramma.
As a cabinet we are taking a different course and ending the NPLG, as the draft had been adopted by the previous caretaker cabinet.
Als kabinet slaan we een andere koers in en stoppen met het NPLG, zoals dat als ontwerp nog door het vorige demissionaire kabinet was vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Van der Werf over het bericht ‘Britse overheid wil vrouwenhaat aanpakken als ‘ideologisch extremisme’’

MPs Rooderkerk and Van der Werf asked whether misogyny should be treated as ideological extremism after a UK announcement, whether there are links to far-right ideology and violence against women, and whether security services monitor it. The government answered that misogyny is not classed as an extremist ideology by itself but appears in extremist narratives, that the NCTV will consult the UK, and that the AIVD cannot publicly detail how it investigates threats.
As stated in the answer to question 9, the AIVD cannot, under the Wiv 2017, publicly disclose how it investigates threats to national security.

Zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 9 kan de AIVD, op basis van de Wiv 2017, geen uitspraken in het openbaar doen op welke wijze onderzoek wordt gedaan naar dreigingen voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over de subsidieverstrekking aan het Internationaal Theater Amsterdam

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the international excellence supplement in the cultural basic infrastructure, which ITA received until recently, was not awarded to ITA after the Council for Culture classified it as a medium-sized theatre, and whether the funds could still be awarded. The Minister confirmed the regulation excludes medium-sized theatres, said the hardship clause has a very high threshold, and will decide later depending on developments at ITA.
Depending on further developments at ITA, I will make a decision on whether, and if so how, the funds could still lawfully be awarded.
Afhankelijk van de verdere ontwikkelingen bij ITA zal ik een besluit nemen over of, en zo ja, hoe de middelen alsnog rechtmatig zouden kunnen worden toegekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het bericht ‘Pleidooi voor AI-richtlijn op scholen: 'Risico's groot, bewustzijn laag'’

Rooderkerk (D66) asked the State Secretary for Education about an AOb call for an AI guideline in schools, student data flowing to AI companies, teacher preparedness, algorithmic discrimination risks in adaptive learning tools, and oversight of programs like Snappet. The State Secretary answered that schools choose their own AI tools under GDPR and the EU AI Act, that national bodies like NOLAI and Kennisnet provide guidance, and that she will talk with the education sector without committing to a national AI guideline.
I have no insight into how students use AI at home to produce assignments and homework.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de manier waarop leerlingen thuis gebruik maken van AI voor het maken van werkstukken en huiswerkopdrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het bericht “Tientallen schoolbestuurders privé actief bij onderwijsadviesbureaus”

An MP asked the state secretary for education about reports that dozens of school board members are also active for education advisory firms, and whether this conflict of interest and the quality and integrity rules for board members and advisers are adequate. The state secretary called such conflicts unacceptable, pointed to existing civil law and inspectorate powers, and announced a bill on minimum integrity and quality requirements for school boards and internal supervision, plus a review of the advisory market with a letter to parliament this autumn.
It is not known how many education board members have given up their secondary positions.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel onderwijsbestuurders nevenfuncties hebben opgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Paternotte, Rooderkerk, Paulusma en Sneller  over de btw-verhogingen op boeken, cultuur, sport en logies

D66 MPs asked the government what it aims to achieve by raising VAT on books, newspapers, culture, sport and accommodation, and about impact analyses, exemptions, legal risks, household purchasing power, sector and education effects, regional effects and the 40-organisation appeal. The state secretary answers that the rate change yields about 2.3 billion euros structurally, that no specific impact analysis was done and none is planned (only monitoring), that some reduced-rate categories are kept for policy-weighing reasons, and that most distributional, sectoral and regional effects cannot be quantified.
I do not intend to carry out a further impact analysis, but the effect of the tariff increase will be monitored.
Ik ben niet voornemens om een nadere impactanalyse uit te voeren, wel zal het effect van de tariefsverhoging worden gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Boswijk, Paternotte en Rooderkerk over de stijgende invoer van Russisch gas

MPs asked whether EU imports of Russian gas are rising, whether this creates dependence and vulnerability, whether cheap Russian gas undermines alternatives, and what measures the EU could take. The minister acknowledged a slight rise in early 2024 but said Russian shares have fallen sharply since 2021, outlined EU phase-out steps and Dutch proposals for a roadmap, while declining to provide a list of affected projects because the government lacks access to market parties' data.
Such an overview cannot be provided, because the Dutch government has no insight into the projects of market parties and their economic feasibility.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet te geven, omdat de Nederlandse overheid geen inzage heeft in de projecten van marktpartijen en de economische haalbaarheid daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Bamenga en Rooderkerk over het nieuws dat omwonenden van zware industrie structureel hogere zorgkosten hebben

MPs from D66 asked the government to react to news that residents near heavy industry have higher healthcare costs, and about health data, pollution, legal enforcement of permits and the Tata Steel negotiations. The government answered that health depends on many factors so the link to industry is not direct, that no specific national data exists but further research (RIVM studies, a health impact method for permits under the Omgevingswet) is underway, and that enforcement tools lie with provinces and municipalities.
No, such insight specifically for residents of industry does not exist, and this possible link cannot simply be demonstrated, because it depends on many factors.
Nee, dergelijk inzicht speciaal voor omwonenden van de industrie bestaat niet en dit eventuele verband is ook niet zomaar aan te tonen, omdat het afhangt van veel factoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostic´, Teunissen, Koekkoek, Thijssen, Gabriëls, Bamenga, Rooderkerk en Zeedijk over de analyse van de toekomstplannen van Tata Steel door CE Delft

MPs from several parties asked the government to respond to a CE Delft analysis (commissioned by Greenpeace) comparing Tata Steel's transition plans with the Gezondheidsultimatum scenario on health, CO2, costs and feasibility. The government answered that the Gezondheidsultimatum is not feasible, that it will pursue a negotiated maatwerkafspraak based on Tata's plan with accelerated nuisance reduction, and that many details remain confidential due to ongoing negotiations.
The cabinet cannot make negotiated agreements on unfeasible plans and has chosen to pursue Tata Steel's plans with accelerated nuisance reduction.
Het kabinet kan geen maatwerkafspraken maken over onhaalbare plannen en heeft gekozen om in te zetten op de plannen van Tata Steel met versnelde overlastreductie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het bericht ‘Talenten in klassieke muziek hard geraakt door nieuwe subsidieronde’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about talent-development music institutions losing subsidy in the new 2025–2028 round and the wider decline of music education. The minister answered that the outcome followed a pre-published, independently assessed application procedure with oversubscription, that these organisations are not part of the cultural basic infrastructure, that a meeting with the sector is planned, and that seven positively assessed organisations together need nearly €10 million, with details promised around Prinsjesdag.
A meeting between these institutions and my ministry is already planned.
Er staat hierover reeds een gesprek gepland tussen deze instellingen en mijn ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het bericht 'Extern ingehuurde docenten voor scholen bijna twee keer zo duur'

MP Rooderkerk asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about reports that externally hired teachers cost nearly twice as much, and about the growth of hiring, why permanent teachers leave, and what the government will do. The minister answered that personnel not in employment (PNIL) rose from 2.5% to 4.4% of personnel costs in primary education and from 2.3% to 4.4% in secondary education, that a planned bill (SHRM) aims to curb external hiring, and that research into teachers' motives is underway with results expected end of this year.
Whether teachers leave their permanent posts and are then hired back in education cannot be determined from the PNIL data for 2022 and 2023 due to insufficient data.
Of leerkrachten uit dienst gaan en zich vervolgens laten inhuren in het onderwijs kan ik door onvoldoende gegevens niet uit de PNIL-uitvraag van 2022 en 2023 halen.

m: Motie van het lid Akerboom over diersoorten die in hun voortbestaan worden bedreigd per direct van de landelijke vrijstellingslijst af halen
Asks the government to immediately remove threatened species from the national hunting exemption list, following a Council of State ruling that the exemption is insufficiently justified.
requests the government to immediately remove the threatened species from the national exemption list
verzoekt de regering om per direct die soorten die in hun voortbestaan worden bedreigd, van de landelijke vrijstellingslijst af te halen
Motie van het lid Akerboom over de essentiële rol van grote predatoren in het ecosysteem meenemen in het toekomstbestendig maken van het natuurbeleid
Asks the government to take the essential ecological role of large predators into account when making nature policy future-proof.
requests the government to take into account the essential role of large predators for the functioning of the ecosystem when making nature policy future-proof
verzoekt de regering om de essentiële rol van grote predatoren voor het functioneren van het ecosysteem mee te nemen in het toekomstbestendig maken van het natuurbeleid
Motie van het lid Akerboom over de salderingsregeling niet afbouwen tot in ieder geval 2030
Asks the government not to phase out the net-metering scheme for solar panels before at least 2030.
requests the government not to phase out the net-metering scheme until at least 2030
verzoekt de regering de salderingsregeling niet af te bouwen tot in ieder geval 2030
Motie van het lid Van Raan c.s. over het strenger normeren van de industrie
Asks the government to impose stricter emission norms on industry to meet climate goals.
requests the government to set stricter norms for industry
verzoekt de regering tot het strenger normeren van de industrie
Motie van het lid Westerveld c.s. over de mogelijkheid van een verplichte Fair Practice Code betrekken bij de voorbereiding van de nieuwe BIS
Motion asks the government to consider making the Fair Practice Code mandatory as a subsidy condition when preparing the new cultural basic infrastructure (BIS) subsidies.
requests the government to consider making the Fair Practice Code mandatory as a subsidy condition for institutions
verzoekt de regering om de mogelijkheid om de Fair Practice Code te verplichten, als subsidievoorwaarde voor instellingen
Motie van het lid Akerboom over de mogelijkheden onderzoeken om samen met de sector tot een Code Cultuur, Klimaat & Milieu te komen
Motion asks the government to explore with the cultural sector how to reach a Code Culture, Climate and Environment.
requests the government to explore possibilities to reach a Code Culture, Climate and Environment with the sector
verzoekt de regering de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om samen met de sector tot een Code Cultuur, Klimaat & Milieu te komen
Motie van de leden Akerboom en Westerveld over onderzoeken hoe concrete stappen kunnen worden gezet om culturele instellingen en activiteiten te verduurzamen
Asks the government to investigate concrete steps to make cultural institutions and activities more sustainable and turn the results into guidance for the sector.
requests the government to investigate how concrete steps can be taken towards making cultural institutions and activities sustainable
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken hoe concreet stappen gezet kunnen worden naar het verduurzamen van culturele instellingen en activiteiten
Motie van het lid Kwint c.s. over ervoor zorgen dat techreuzen en audiostreamingsdiensten een eerlijke bijdrage leveren aan de inkomenspositie van makers
Asks the cabinet to ensure tech giants and audio streaming services make a fair contribution to creators' incomes.
requests the cabinet to ensure that tech giants and audio streaming services make a fair contribution to the income position of creators

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de schade door PFAS in landbouwgif

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about PFAS in pesticides and biocides, including their health effects, legal maximum levels, soil accumulation, the EU restriction proposal, and whether a warning should be placed on the Ctgb website. The minister answered substantively on most points, stating PFAS are present in about 5% of approved products, that the EU proposal targets PFAS as excipients, and refusing a website warning because no official classification exists.
I support these proposals and will continue to actively question the European Commission about them.
Ik steun deze voorstellen en zal de Europese Commissie hier actief op blijven bevragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de landelijke vrijstellingslijst

An MP asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen whether national exemption lists for killing and trapping species can remain in force when a species' favourable conservation status is at stake, and about the status of hare and rabbit, the review of hunting policy, how counts are made, and the role of large predators. The minister answered that species can be exempted for damage control only if they do not harm favourable conservation status, that hare and rabbit are not in favourable status, that a broader review of fauna management is underway with provinces and stakeholders with results expected in 2024, and that large predators will be taken into account.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom over het oprichten van een brievenbusfirma in Nederland door het grootse vleesbedrijf ter wereld

MPs Van Raan and Akerboom asked the government about JBS's plan to set up a Dutch holding company as part of a US listing, and about the environmental, animal welfare, corruption, labour and tax allegations against the firm. The government said it does not comment on individual companies, expects Dutch-based firms to follow OECD and UN due diligence standards, and said that tax-driven conduit companies are undesirable and that an EU-wide approach ('Unshell') is preferred.
However, the cabinet does not make statements about claims and possible violations of law by individual companies.
Het kabinet doet echter geen uitspraken over claims en mogelijke wetsovertredingen van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over ‘de gruwelijke jacht op kangoeroes in Australië, die nog altijd wordt ondersteund in Nederland door kangoeroeproducten te importeren.’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about cruelty in Australian kangaroo hunting, Dutch imports of kangaroo products, enforcement of the Australian code of practice, and Dutch import restrictions. The minister answered that Australian authorities are responsible for oversight, that the EU Commission sees no legal basis for an import ban on welfare grounds, and that a textile-related motion is being explored with another minister.
It is up to the Australian authorities to monitor compliance with the code of practice.
Het is aan de Australische autoriteiten toe te zien op de naleving van de gedragscode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom over begrenzing natuurvergunning Schiphol

The ministers answered that the 460,000 flight movement limit is the most relevant constraint, the permit's reference situation is correctly formulated, legal advice cannot be released, and no second opinion or rights-based review is planned.
Advice from the State Advocate is only made public when it concerns general policy advice.
