Akerboom (PvdD) asks why the Netherlands does not use EU funds (LIFE, Elfpo, EFRO-Interreg, GLB) for wolf policy, and raises questions on coexistence, fencing, compensation, information campaigns and public debate about wolves. The minister answers that no EU funds were requested for wolf policy because other priorities were set, promises to explore a national wolf information point and to discuss the matter in a committee debate, and states that compensation and preventive measures are provincial responsibilities.

The cabinet drew up the National Strategic Plan (NSP), based on the priorities for resilient and sustainable agriculture under the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP), so that funds are deployed as efficiently as possible.

Het kabinet heeft het Nationaal Strategisch Plan (NSP) opgesteld, aan de hand van de prioriteiten rond een veerkrachtige en duurzame landbouw uit het Gemeenschappelijk Landbouwbeleid (GLB) zodat de middelen zo doelmatig mogelijk ingezet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de wolf

An MP asked the ministers about a wolf shot in Wapse, including whether the fence was wolf-proof, whether the shooting met the protocol, and whether the mayor or police should face prosecution. The minister said a criminal complaint is under investigation and that the matter cannot be judged until then, while stating enforcement of livestock protection duties awaits clarification of the norm.
A criminal complaint has been filed about the incident and the exact circumstances are therefore part of a criminal investigation.
Er is strafrechtelijke aangifte gedaan over het incident en de exacte toedracht vormt daarmee onderdeel van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over het vergassen van ganzen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister about gassing geese in Kinderdijk, the animal suffering involved, and whether gassing and culling should be replaced by prevention and innovation. The minister defends goose catches during moult with CO2 gassing as necessary for aviation safety and damage control, says the Council of State has upheld this method, and promises ongoing innovation and prevention work without committing to a ban or new investigation.
I am not willing to prohibit this killing method.
Ik ben niet bereid deze dodingsmethode te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over een stikstofpiekbelaster; een slingerende weg door de Veluwe

An MP asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen whether traffic emissions on the Gortelseweg through the Veluwe should qualify the road as a nitrogen peak-load source, whether it should be closed or restricted, and whether a national overview of such roads exists. The Minister replied that the peak-load approach covers only livestock and industrial sources, that the province and municipality are responsible for traffic measures, and that no overview of roads will be made.
It is up to the province to map the deposition contribution of road traffic on the Gortelseweg and other roads and to take it into account when drawing up the provincial area programmes.
Het is aan de provincie om de depositiebijdrage van het wegverkeer op de Gortelseweg en andere wegen in beeld te brengen en te betrekken bij het opstellen van de provinciale gebiedsprogramma’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de parlementaire BBQ

An MP asked ministers about the parliamentary BBQ, renamed NLvoedt, and whether its meat, fish and dairy industry organisers, including a sitting senator, give disproportionate lobbying influence, and whether ministers should attend. The government replied that lobbying is a legitimate part of democracy, that the event's partners are publicly listed, that attendance is a matter for individual politicians, and that it sees no ground to exclude such events, while committing to an evaluation of agenda and lobby-paragraph transparency tools.
To improve transparency and accountability, the guideline on transparency of ministers' agendas has been tightened in line with the Van Baarle-Dassen motion.
Om transparantie en verantwoording te verbeteren is de «Uitvoeringsrichtlijn transparantie agenda’s bewindslieden» aangescherpt in lijn met de motie Van Baarle-Dassen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over 'een nieuw geitenpaadje voor stikstof-vergunningverlening: wordt intern salderen het nieuwe extern salderen?'

An MP asks whether intra-site netting (intern salderen) is being used by the municipality of Breda to circumvent the provincial halt on external netting of nitrogen permits for a housing project near the Ulvenhoutse Bos Natura 2000 area, and whether the rules are being followed. The minister answers that intern salderen is permit-free and that the project's nitrogen is not in conflict with the provincial halt, declines to judge the specific project, and defers a legislative proposal to reintroduce a permit requirement pending a decision on controversial status.
For specifications of the project in question, I refer you to the municipal executive.
Voor specificaties van het genoemde project verwijs ik u naar het college.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de voortdurende mishandeling van piepjonge kalfjes tijdens langeafstandstransporten uit Ierland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture about recurring mistreatment and legal violations in long-distance transports of very young calves from Ireland to Dutch veal farms, and what the Minister will do to stop it. The Minister condemns the abuse, says enforcement lies with the Irish and French competent authorities and that the NVWA inspects in the Netherlands, supports an EU-level ban on long transports of unweaned animals, but states she cannot ban the trade herself due to EU free movement rules and will await the Commission's revision of the Transport Regulation.
Due to the EU rules on free movement of goods, I cannot prohibit these transports.
Vanwege de regels omtrent vrij verkeer van goederen in de EU kan ik deze transporten niet verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over verboden bijengif dat via huisdieren in de natuur komt

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about veterinary flea and tick products containing banned neonicotinoids (fipronil, imidacloprid) that reach nature via pet dogs, and whether these products should be banned or restricted. The minister answers that the EMA is revising its environmental risk assessment, the Netherlands will push for stronger EU action and explore national options, but that ectoparasiticides remain necessary for animal and public health.
The Netherlands will strongly commit to this topic within the EU and also nationally inventory the possibilities to establish a policy direction.
Nederland zal zich krachtig inzetten voor dit onderwerp binnen de EU en tevens nationaal de mogelijkheden inventariseren om een beleidsrichting vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de toelating van een nieuw bijengif in de landbouw: de pesticide flupyradifurone

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about the pesticide flupyradifurone, its permitted uses, its similarity to neonicotinoids, and whether it should be reassessed or banned in open crops given insect decline. The minister answers that the EU is reviewing the substance under Article 21 and that the Ctgb will act if unacceptable risks are shown, but declines to ban it in the interim.
However, should it turn out that there are direct unacceptable risks from the use of flupyradifurone, the Ctgb will intervene directly on the existing authorisations.
Mocht echter blijken dat er directe onaanvaardbare risico’s zijn bij het gebruik van flupyradifurone, dan zal het Ctgb direct ingrijpen op de bestaande toelatingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over het toezicht en de handhaving op de eco-regeling van de Europese landbouwsubsidies

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether farmers can claim water board ditches and managed-by-others landscape elements to meet the 4% non-productive land requirement and the eco-scheme, and how the government supervises and enforces against such accounting tricks. The minister said the rules allow landscape elements under lease or agreement to count, that administrative and on-site checks against double claims and erroneous declarations exist, and that subsidies can be reclaimed, without committing to new measures.
If there is an incorrect declaration, the subsidy-granting organisation can take action against it and, for example, reclaim the subsidy.
Indien er sprake is van een foutieve opgave, kan de subsidieverstrekkende organisatie hiertegen optreden en bijvoorbeeld de subsidie terugvorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Akerboom en Van Esch over het gat in de voedselkringloop: menselijke mest

MPs Akerboom and Van Esch asked the minister whether human excrement could be used as fertiliser to close the nutrient cycle, why it is classed as waste, the medicine-residue risks, and whether farmers could get experimental room. The minister answered that direct use carries risks, that phosphate recovery and a public-private research project are under way, and that no short-term experimental room will be created, though controlled trials may be considered.

Given the current uncertainties about the risks of directly using human excrement as fertiliser in agriculture, I do not intend to create experimental space for field trials on farms in the short term.

Gezien de onzekerheden die er momenteel zijn met betrekking tot de risico's van het direct gebruik van menselijke uitwerpselen als meststof in de landbouw ben ik niet voornemens om op korte termijn experimenteerruimte voor praktijkproeven bij boeren te creëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de aankomende hitte en de gevolgen voor dieren

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about heat stress risks to farm animals, shelter in pastures, transport temperature limits, and NVWA enforcement capacity. The Minister answered that heat stress is a welfare harm, that the legal duty to protect outdoor animals is an open norm, that a handreiking for municipalities is being prepared, and that transport temperature limits will be lowered after an impact analysis due in September.
The NVWA checks compliance with the statutory provisions.
De NVWA controleert op de wettelijke bepalingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Akerboom over de gezondheidskosten van het eten van vlees

MPs Van Esch and Akerboom asked the government about health costs of meat consumption, true pricing, and a meat levy. The government acknowledged the health costs, said it is studying true pricing and a sugar-based beverage tax review, but declined to commit to a meat levy given parliament's prior rejection of one.
Setting prices in supermarkets is the responsibility of the supermarkets themselves.
Het stellen van prijzen in de supermarkten is de verantwoordelijkheid van de supermarkten zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid lid Akerboom over het illegaal mengen van varkens in slachthuizen, met gevechten en verwondingen als gevolg

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about pigs from different groups being mixed in slaughterhouse holding pens, causing fights and injuries, and about the NVWA's delayed enforcement after an animal-welfare organisation's request. The minister acknowledged the violations, said enforcement will apply from 15 August 2024 under a compliance period it calls a deadline, and urged slaughterhouses to act sooner.
The term 'eindlijner' means these animals are slaughtered separately from groups of animals without any noted abnormalities.
Het woord «eindlijner» houdt in, dat deze dieren apart van de groepen dieren zonder geconstateerde bijzonderheden geslacht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over een restaurant waar mensen zelf een kip slachten

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a restaurant in Arnhem where guests slaughter their own chicken, asking whether this is acceptable as a marketing stunt and how compliance with animal welfare rules is guaranteed. The minister answered that the owner, not guests, performs the stunning and killing with the required knowledge, that inspection of the footage and a phone call found no violations, and that no further action is planned.
Supervision of the (home) slaughter of poultry outside a slaughterhouse takes place on the basis of reports.
Het toezicht op de (thuis)slacht van pluimvee buiten een slachthuis vindt plaats op basis van meldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Akerboom en Van Raan over Nederlandse investeringen in een oliepijplijn in Oeganda met grote risico’s voor mens, dier en natuur

MPs Akerboom and Van Raan asked the government about Dutch investment in the EACOP oil pipeline in Uganda, covering land displacement, arrests of protesters, CO2 emissions, and Dutch financial institutions' investments in TotalEnergies. The minister answered that the government does not assess the project itself, relies on companies and financial institutions to apply due diligence, and defers to Uganda's sovereignty, while promising to raise human rights concerns and pursue EU and national IMVO legislation.
The cabinet does not make its own assessment of the consequences of this project.
Het kabinet maakt geen eigen appreciatie van de gevolgen van dit project
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de aangifte van de dochter van een vermoorde mensenrechtenactivist tegen de Nederlandse Financieringsmaatschappij voor ontwikkelingslanden (FMO)

Akerboom (PvdD) asked the minister about the criminal complaint filed by Berta Cáceres's daughter against FMO, the status of the case, FMO's monitoring of the Agua Zarca project, and why the minister declined to answer questions citing the civil proceedings. The minister answered that a civil case is pending and paused, FMO says funds did not reach hitmen, the ministry is not a party and does not rule on individual investments, and FMO has strengthened its ESG and integrity policies.
To avoid disturbing the course of justice, I will not make further statements about FMO's role.
Om de rechtsgang niet te verstoren doe ik over de rol van FMO geen nadere uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Akerboom over de Catshuissessie met het bedrijfsleven over de IMVO-wet en het vestigingsklimaat

Two MPs asked whether the Prime Minister's Catshuis session with business on the investment climate would target the IMVO due diligence law, which companies attend, and whether sustainable firms and OECD guidelines would be on the agenda. The minister answered that the session is broader than IMVO, covers the investment climate and geopolitics, lists the attending companies, and that a level playing field with neighbouring countries, including OECD guidelines, is important.
This Catshuis session is not specifically about (I)MVO, but broadly about the investment climate.
Deze Catshuissessie gaat niet specifiek over (I)MVO, maar breed over het vestigingsklimaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Kröger, Sylvana Simons en Akerboom over ongedocumenteerde mensen in Nederland

MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the size and composition of the undocumented population in the Netherlands, and whether Dutch policy could adopt German, Irish or city-level measures such as regularisation or city ID cards. The State Secretary answered that return remains the central policy, that existing support (LVV, minors' rights, medical care) suffices, and that he is reluctant to add broader facilities or a new education convention.
I am therefore, unlike the initiatives mentioned in question 3, reluctant to provide additional facilities such as a city pass.
Derhalve ben ik, in tegenstelling tot de in vraag 3 genoemde initiatieven, terughoudend in het faciliteren van aanvullende voorzieningen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over Iraanse demonstranten die de doodstraf opgelegd hebben gekregen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about death sentences against Iranian protesters, the adequacy of EU sanctions, trade measures and Dutch dependencies on Iran. The minister answered that Netherlands condemns the repression, supports EU sanctions packages and a UN fact-finding mission, but judges trade sanctions limited in effect and declined to name future sanction targets.
The cabinet cannot make statements about concrete (and whether or not future) targets of EU sanctions, as this would undermine the effectiveness and surprise effect of sanctions.
Over concrete (en al dan niet toekomstige) doelwitten van EU-sancties kan het kabinet geen uitspraken doen, omdat dit de effectiviteit en het verassingseffect van sancties zou ondermijnen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Akerboom en Teunissen over het feit dat de mondiale biodiversiteitsdoelen alleen te behalen zijn door het hervormen van voedsel- en energiesystemen en een sterke beleidsinzet op natuurhers

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked ministers how the government will act on PBL findings that global biodiversity targets require transforming food and energy systems and stronger nature and climate policy, including on protein transition, financial-sector investment and COP negotiations. The minister acknowledges the urgency, points to the coalition agreement, national protein strategy, a forthcoming subsidy review and an inter-departmental biodiversity study, but largely restates existing policy and defers concrete steps to later.
The cabinet acknowledges that there is no time to lose and that a joint approach is required to tackle the climate and biodiversity crisis.
Het kabinet erkent dat er geen tijd te verliezen is en dat een gezamenlijke aanpak vereist is om de klimaat- en biodiversiteitscrisis aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Akerboom en Vestering over het levensbelang van de natuur voor mens, dier en het oplossen van de klimaat- en biodiversiteitscrises

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked the nature minister about the link between biodiversity loss and the climate crisis, Dutch ecological footprint, North Sea role, and the 150,000 hectare nature expansion figure. The minister acknowledged the seriousness of the issues, pointed to existing and forthcoming policy (NBSAP, NPLG, Noordzeeakkoord, food strategy) and gave general commitments without new binding measures.
The cabinet is working on this through, among other things, a substantial reduction of greenhouse gases, accelerating the circular economy and the transition to a nature-inclusive society.
Het kabinet zet daar op in middels onder meer een forse reductie van broeikasgassen, het versnellen van de circulaire economie en de transitie naar een natuurinclusieve samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over houtstook als grootste bron van kankerverwekkende stoffen (PAK’s) in het oppervlaktewater

MP Akerboom asked whether the government will act on Deltares findings that domestic wood burning is the largest source of carcinogenic PAHs in surface water, and how this squares with ISDE and SDE+ subsidies for biomass. The Secretary of State says she supports reducing wood-burning emissions and lists measures (stove alert, emission measurement, information material, earlier Ecodesign limits), while defending SDE+ biomass support and promising an ISDE evaluation.
Based on this evaluation, a decision will be made on whether it is desirable to continue the subsidy for renewable heat based on biomass after the current scheme ends (2020).
Op basis van deze evaluatie zal de afweging worden gemaakt of het wenselijk is om de subsidie voor hernieuwbare warmte op basis van biomassa na afloop van de huidige regeling (2020) voort te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Akerboom, Van Raan, Teunissen, Ouwehand en Wassenberg over de speech van Greta Thunberg tijdens de VN-klimaattop COP24 in Katowice, Polen

MPs Akerboom, Van Raan, Teunissen, Ouwehand and Wassenberg asked the government to respond to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech and whether ministers would take radical climate measures. The government replied that its policy aims at the Paris targets, that it engages youth and business in the Klimaatakkoord, and that it is pursuing a range of climate measures across ministries.
Government policy is therefore aimed at meeting the targets of Paris.
Het kabinetsbeleid is dan ook gericht op het halen van de doelen van Parijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

MPs Van Raan and Akerboom asked the government whether it bears responsibility for climate policy and how it responds to a speech by Greta Thunberg at COP24, including whether ministers would act to keep warming to 1.5 degrees. The government answered only by referring to a previous answer, Aanhangsel Handelingen 2018-2019 nr. 1305, without addressing the substance.
The written questions from members Van Raan and Akerboom (both PvdD), question number 2018Z24281, have been answered by means of Appendix to the Proceedings, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1305.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom (beiden PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24281 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

MP Akerboom (PvdD) asked 21 questions about Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, challenging the government's climate policy, economic growth assumptions, and responsibility toward young people, and proposing measures such as a 0% VAT rate on fruit and vegetables and plant-based catering. The answer was a brief referral stating that the questions were answered in a separate Aanhangsel document, without giving substantive responses in this document.
The written questions from MP Akerboom (PvdD), question number 2018Z24296, have been answered by means of Aanhangsel Handelingen, parliamentary session 2018–2019, no. 1305.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Akerboom (PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24296 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP asked the government whether it bears responsibility for climate policy and how it responds to a series of statements by Greta Thunberg at COP24, including whether it disputes her criticisms and whether it will change policy and its own practices. The answer, given on behalf of several ministers, is not included in the text as provided, which is cut off after the question list.
Answer: The written questions from MP Akerboom (PvdD), question number 2018Z24293, have been answered by means of Appendix to the Proceedings, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1305.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Akerboom (PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24293 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1305 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the government, in 21 questions, how it would respond to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, including whether ministers share responsibility for climate policy and whether they will act on climate targets. The government's answer, given jointly by many ministers, refers to the answers already given in the Aanhangsel Handelingen, indicating the questions were answered by reference rather than on substance.
The written questions from MP Akerboom (PvdD), question number 2018Z24295, have been answered by way of Appendix to the Proceedings, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1305.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Akerboom (PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24295 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP asks the government to respond to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, including whether the Netherlands' climate policy is adequate and whether ministers will take further action, and asks about plant-based catering in ministries. The government answers that the questions were answered in a separate Aanhangsel document, so the substance is not stated in this item.
The written questions from MP Akerboom (PvdD), question number 2018Z24294, have been answered by way of Aanhangsel Handelingen, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1305.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Akerboom (PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24294 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1305 .
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

Two PvdD MPs asked the government to react to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, including whether ministers accept her claims about growth, fossil fuels, and intergenerational justice, and what concrete steps they will take. The government answered that the questions were answered in an appendix to the parliamentary record, referring to a separate written answer rather than addressing the substance here.
The written questions from MPs Van Raan and Akerboom (both PvdD), question number 2018Z24283, have been answered by means of Parliamentary Proceedings appendix, session 2018–2019, no. 1305.
De schriftelijke van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom (beiden PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24283 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1305 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over het nieuws dat Nederland genetische gegevens gaat delen met andere EU-landen

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about Dutch participation in the Million European Genomes project, which shares genetic data with other EU member states, including what data, governance, safeguards and consent apply. The minister answered that the project is in its start-up phase, that governance is still being developed within the GDPR framework, and that only pseudonymised data from consenting individuals will be used, but gave no firm answers on access restrictions or who decides sharing.
A governance model for the collaboration is currently being developed.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan een governancemodel van de samenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Akerboom over de pilot omgevingsmanagement gericht op de aardgaswinning onder de Waddenzee bij Ternaard

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the minister about a pilot on local stakeholder involvement for gas extraction under the Wadden Sea near Ternaard, a UNESCO site, including why island municipalities were not involved and whether national and international interests or local support could halt the project. The minister explained the pilot aims to test participation instruments, that the municipality of Ameland declined to join, that the Hand aan de Kraan principle and the Structuurvisie Waddenzee set limits, and that local support is assessed at the end of the process without a simple yes/no veto.
Determining local support is not a simple yes or no regarding the proposed gas extraction.
Bij het vaststellen van lokaal draagvlak gaat het niet om een eenvoudig ja of nee met betrekking tot de voorgestelde gaswinning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Akerboom en Teunissen over het bericht ‘Chemieconcern Ineos overweegt miljardeninvestering en fabriek in Rotterdam’

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the minister about a possible INEOS plant in Rotterdam linked to shale gas, citing environmental, climate and plastics concerns and asking whether the government would oppose it. The minister said the plant would process imported ethane and propane (shale-derived byproducts) into ethylene and propylene, estimated about 0.8 Mton CO2 per year, acknowledged the plastics problem, and said the government would not oppose the investment but would apply climate agreements, with talks with Dutch authorities ongoing.
The cabinet wants to promote CO2 emission reduction in existing industry and stimulate the development of new industries, companies and business activity.
Het kabinet wil CO 2 -emissiereductie in de bestaande industrie bevorderen en de ontwikkeling van nieuwe industrieën, bedrijven en bedrijvigheid stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom over het bericht dat 10 jaar lang pogingen van de EU en 1 miljard euro de opslag van CO2 niet van de grond hebben gekregen

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the minister whether the European Court of Auditors' finding that EU carbon capture and storage (CCS) programmes failed, and related court rulings, undermine reliance on CCS to meet CO2 targets. The minister answered that CCS remains a useful part of the emissions mix, that the EU programmes failed mainly due to an unfavourable investment climate, and that the government will not exclude options, while noting that 1.5 degrees pathways rely heavily on other measures.
The conclusion is that neither programme succeeded in ensuring CCS is applied in the EU, mainly due to the unfavourable investment climate.
De conclusie is dat beide programma's er niet in geslaagd zijn te zorgen dat CCS in de EU wordt toegepast, met name vanwege het ongunstige investeringsklimaat.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Ferrier en Gill'ard ter vervanging van nr. 24 over financiële ondersteuning ex-asielzoekers
Shifts budget from poverty reduction to support for the return of former asylum seekers to their countries of origin.
This amendment aims to provide financial support for the return of former asylum seekers present in the Netherlands to their country of origin.
Dit amendement beoogt financiële ondersteuning te bieden aan de terugkeer van in Nederland aanwezige ex-asielzoekers naar hun land van herkomst.
Amendement van het lid Gill'ard C.S. ter vervanging van nr. 3 over de productontwikkeling van hittebestendig oxytocine
Shifts 1.5 million euro within the foreign affairs budget to heat-stable oxytocin product development, with conditions on patents and affordable pricing.
Amendement van de leden Gill'ard en Ferrier voor vrijmaken van gelden t.b.v. de productontwikkeling van hittebestendig oxytocine
Shifts 1.5 million euro within the foreign affairs budget to develop heat-stable oxytocin for postpartum haemorrhage.
This amendment aims to use 1.5 million euro within article 5.5 Reproductive health for the product development of heat-resistant oxytocin
Dit amendement beoogt de aanwending van € 1,5 miljoen binnen artikel 5.5 «Reproductieve gezondheid» ten behoeve van de productontwikkeling van hittebestendig oxytocine
Motie Ferrier c.s. over de beleidsvoornemens ten aanzien van de begrotingssteun aan Rwanda
Motion asks the government to inform the House after a visit to Rwanda about its findings and policy plans on budget support given Rwanda's role in the Eastern Congo conflict.
requests the government to inform the House directly after this visit, and at latest before 15 December 2008, about the outcomes of its findings
verzoekt de regering de Kamer direct na dit bezoek, doch uiterlijk vóór 15 december 2008, over de uitkomsten van zijn bevindingen te informeren
Motie Diks c.s. over een vrouwenparagraaf in de "stand van zaken"-brief
Asks the government to add a women's rights paragraph to country 'state of affairs' letters where relevant.
requests the government to add a women's paragraph to each country state-of-affairs letter where relevant
verzoekt de regering om, wanneer hier aanleiding toe is, in elke «stand van zaken»-brief over een land een vrouwenparagraaf toe te voegen
Motie Gill'ard c.s. over het slechten van politieke, ethnische en religieuze geschillen in Sudan
Asks the government to give more attention in its Sudan aid programme to resolving political, ethnic and religious disputes.
requests the government to devote more attention in its aid programme for Sudan to resolving political, ethnic and religious disputes
verzoekt de regering in haar hulpprogramma voor Sudan meer aandacht te besteden aan het slechten van politieke, etnische en religieuze geschillen
Motie Gill'ard over een meerjarig MDG5-fonds voor Centraal- en Oost-Europa
Asks the government to set up a multi-year MDG5 fund for Central and Eastern Europe to support NGOs on maternal health.
